jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; improve runbooks, troubleshooting checklists, and knowledge articles. * Identify recurring incidents and automate repeatable operational work with scripts and existing infrastructure management tools. * Collaborate with remote engineering teams, on\-site technicians, OEMs, and vendors to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3–6 years of experience supporting Linux servers, HPC, cloud, or data center infrastructure in a production environment. * Practical troubleshooting experience with enterprise compute hardware, BMC interfaces (iDRAC/iLO or equivalent), operating systems, and monitoring tools. * Working familiarity with storage technologies such as NFS, distributed filesystems, object storage, and storage performance fundamentals. * Experience using ticketing systems, change management procedures, and Bash or Python scripting for routine diagnostics and automation. * Exposure to NVIDIA GPU systems, InfiniBand/RDMA, Kubernetes, Slurm, or AI/HPC storage platforms is a strong advantage. **Core Competencies** * Structured, evidence\-driven troubleshooting with sound judgment on when to remediate, collaborate, or escalate. * Strong ownership of tickets, attention to operational detail, and commitment to reliable customer service. * Ability to work effectively across NOC, SRE, hardware, network, storage, and Tier 3 engineering teams. * Clear written and verbal communication in English. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

jobs.title: AI Website Builder
jobs.description: **About the company** Agentplace is a platform for building AI agents that serve customers: they answer questions, book appointments, handle customer service, and deliver services online. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company. **About the role** We're looking for an AI Agent Builder to create AI agents for real businesses on Agentplace: understand each business, design the interface and AI workflows, connect integrations, test, and publish. This isn't a classic developer role. It's about product and UX thinking, design taste, and shipping working products fast through vibe coding and no\-code. Freelancers and solo agencies welcome: keep your own clients and work with us on a contract basis. **What you'll do** * Dive into each client's business and understand their customers * Design the interface and user flows (UX/UI) * Build AI workflows: how the agent answers questions, helps choose a service, collects data, and drives users to booking or payment * Connect integrations via API (calendar, payments, CRM, messengers) * Test, refine, and publish AI agents **Who you are** You combine product and UX thinking with vibe coding or no\-code experience, a strong sense of design, and basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API skills. You might be: * A Framer or Webflow developer * A product designer who codes * A no\-code or automation builder (Zapier, Make, n8n) * A vibe coder shipping with Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, or Replit * A freelancer who builds chatbots and websites for clients * A junior solutions engineer **Details** * Format: remote * Type: contract, flexible hours * Compensation: up to $1,500/month **How to apply** To apply, complete a short test task. Plan on 1–2 hours. Pick any real business, look at its website, and build an AI agent for it on Agentplace. The agent should do more than look good. It should: * answer customer questions * help choose a service * collect customer details * guide the customer to booking or payment Build it here: agentplace.io. Use the Luna model, it's free. Publish your agent as public and send the link to **nikita@agentplace.io**. **Applications are reviewed by email only.** Applications sent through the job board's Apply button, without a link to your agent, will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer. The best agents may be featured in our public agent gallery. Pay: From $1,500\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. \*\*\*Schedule is M\-F 7 PM\-3 AM or 6 PM\-2 AM (must have a flexible schedule) In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print\-and‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience

jobs.title: Founding AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: **tl;dr/Overview:** =================== At Alleviate Health we’re building AI Agents that drastically accelerate clinical trials by autonomously communicating with patients to recruit them into trials and support them over years, pruning billions in excess spend. We’re solving the problem that keeps execs at the largest $100B\+ Pharma companies up at night. We bootstrapped to winning some of the largest enterprise accounts in the market and are seeing massive market pull. We’ve now raised a $4\.3M seed round led by a16z and are hiring a world\-class team to solve the largest problem in drug development and win one of the largest opportunities in AI – while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. **Context:** ------------ Conducting a clinical trial is the most complex and broken, but also the most high‑stakes and capital intensive, problem of our era. To bring a life\-saving medicine from the lab bench to patients, pharma companies spend **tens of billions a year** for research sites to **qualify \& screen hundreds of thousands of patients and then to stay in contact with those patients over years.** Approximately 80% of clinical trials are delayed due to problems with recruitment and between $600,000 and $8 million is lost for each day a trial is delayed. This enormous, labor\-intensive struggle of screening, recruitment, and retention of patients across thousands of small research sites in every single trial is the foundational bottleneck in clinical trials. **About Alleviate:** -------------------- At Alleviate we've built SOTA AI Agents that autonomously recruit \& retain patients in trials. Currently, our AI agents conduct over 100,000 conversations every month by: * Intelligently screening \& routing patients to the right trials. * Collecting necessary data for the trial from patients multiple times per week. * Answering patients’ questions perfectly and supporting them 24/7 throughout the trial \- reducing costly drop\-offs. * Continuously learning from each interaction to optimize performance. Our team worked at a small research site for months to understand the problem deeply \- personally calling and speaking to patients \- and then **bootstrapped to working with some of the largest clinical research organizations** in the world and conducting over a 100k conversations per month. **Some vitals on Alleviate (Achieved without a single dollar raised):** ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * **Hypergrowth**. We’re growing rapidly MoM (both within existing \& new accounts). We’ve landed (and realized) multiple 6 figure deals. Our largest live contract has an annual value of \>$350k. * **Our win rate on commercial deals is \>92%.** We’re the market leading solution \- we’ve never lost a deal to competitors and have actively poached multiple customers from competitors. * **Our market is gigantic and immensely painful.** We can’t mention their names publicly but have landed pilots with top 20 pharma(s) that will grow to $XM\+/yr. Our pipeline grows organically due to customer fear of falling behind after hearing from our existing customers. **Investors (a16z, Jack Altman…):** ----------------------------------- We’re now backed by Andreessen Horowitz and other investors like Jack Altman (Co\-Founder of Lattice), Zach Weinberg (Co\-Founder of Flatiron Health, the largest Pharma tech exit of all time), Ali Rowghani (Former CFO \& COO of Twitter), Trey Holterman (CEO \& Co\-Founder of Tennr) and many others who’ve built category defining healthcare \& pharma companies. **What you might work on:** --------------------------- * Orchestrating a fleet of AI agents that coordinate patient recruitment across hundreds of clinical trials across North America (For now). * Scaling language models across Voice, SMS, and email while keeping conversations consistent and personalized across all channels. We’re going after the largest problem in one of the largest markets in the world. We already replace tens of millions in excess spend and will replace billions of dollars of excess spend while slashing the time it takes to bring life\-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them. We’re looking for exceptional founding engineers to help us realize this ambition. If you’re an engineer that finds this goal compelling, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)** Location: Southern California \| Hybrid Department: Engineering \& Product Experience Level: Junior to Mid\-Level Compensation: $35 to $45 per hour Schedule: Hybrid \| One day per week in person \| SoCal **Role Overview** AIVA MD is looking for a Full\-Stack Developer with a strong backend focus to join our engineering team. You will need to know Django (Python), React, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Everything is written from scratch on a clean stack we own and operate entirely. No legacy code, no shortcuts. We build for healthcare, which means correctness and security are non\-negotiable. This role is for someone who wants to build something real, learn fast, and work closely with the leadership team. You will not be handed a ticket queue and left alone. You will be in the details with us every day. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Django REST API endpoints, clinical records, and multi\-tenant data routing * Build React/Vite frontend components including dashboards, forms, modals, and real\-time updates * Write and review database migrations following additive\-only practices no critical changes without explicit sign\-off * Test all changes on staging before production, nothing goes to production untested * Participate in code review and maintain clean, documented code as features ship * Identify bugs, flag blockers early, and communicate clearly on what is in progress and what is done **Required Qualifications** * 1 to 3 years of experience in software development or a strong portfolio of personal or open source projects * Python \-\- comfortable writing functions, classes, and working with libraries * Django basics \-\- understands models, views, URLs, migrations, and how the ORM works * React \-\- can build functional components with hooks, manage state, and make API calls * Git \-\- knows how to branch, commit, push, and open a pull request without breaking things * Linux command line \-\- can SSH into a server, navigate directories, and run commands * SQL basics \-\- can read a query, understand joins, and write a simple migration * Strong attention to detail and a commitment to getting things right the first time * Comfortable asking questions before guessing, especially on anything that touches patient data * Must reside in Southern California and be available for one in\-person day per week * Must be authorized to work in the United States **Preferred Qualifications** Experience in healthcare or regulated software is preferred but not required. Exposure to any of the following is a plus: * AWS services * PostgreSQL * HIPAA\-compliant software development * WebSockets or real\-time features * Docker or containerization basics * EHR systems or healthcare data standards **What We're Looking For** We are looking for someone who is curious, careful, and takes ownership of their work. The right candidate reads existing code before writing new code, understands the pattern before adding to it, and recognizes that in a healthcare platform a mistake is not just a bug, it is a compliance risk. You do not need to know everything. You do need to be the kind of developer who figures things out, communicates clearly when something is unclear, and never ships code they are not confident in. Experience is helpful but attitude and work ethic matter more at this level. This role offers a clear path to grow from a junior developer into a senior engineer as your knowledge of the platform, the stack, and the healthcare domain deepens. **Eligibility** * Must be authorized to work in the United States * Must reside in Southern California * Must be available during standard PST business hours * Must be able to commute to a SoCal office or client location approximately one day per week * Must have a reliable internet connection and a professional work\-from\-home environment Pay: $35\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer – Paid Training Provided
jobs.description: **About Us:** Virtual Spy Room is a Detroit\-based, AI\-powered true crime escape room built on our proprietary investigation software, MOST. Players act as members of a fictional investigative unit and get 60 minutes to solve a case. We’re looking for a junior or entry\-level software developer to join us and grow into a key technical role. This is a paid, hands\-on position where you’ll receive on\-the\-job training directly from me, the founder, a self\-taught developer with real industry experience, and learn our systems from the ground up. **What You’ll Work On:** Every game is built around a fictional case, and each case needs its own evidence trail. jobs.description: **The Role:** As a Machine Learning Systems Administrator / DevOps Engineer, you will maintain and build the core infrastructure behind both our model training and our inference cloud. Your work will directly affect developer productivity, training throughput, and the performance and reliability of our inference platform. **What We’re Looking For / Requirements:** * Experience with Linux system administration, user and access management, and automation * Demonstrated expertise in scripting languages for system tooling and automation (bash, Python, etc.) * Experience with containers (Docker) and scheduling/orchestration systems (Slurm, Kubernetes) * Experience running production services, including monitoring and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), deployment pipelines, and incident response * Experience building tooling for cluster validation and reliability (accelerator, networking, and storage health checks) * Experience setting up and managing developer tools and third\-party services (e.g., cloud storage providers, Docker Hub, Slack, Gmail, Telegraf, experiment trackers) * Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across compute, storage, and networking * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams **Qualifications / Additional Skills:** * Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) * Prior work supporting ML/AI infrastructure, including GPU management and workload optimization * Experience deploying and operating LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Ray) * Experience with multiple accelerator platforms (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, TPUs) * Experience with high\-performance networking (InfiniBand, RoCE) and distributed storage * Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Familiarity with Apptainer and with integrating containers into Slurm and Kubernetes **Why Work at Zyphra:** * Our research methodology is grounded in methodical, step\-by\-step approaches to ambitious goals. jobs.title: Multiple U.S. Locations - Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE) - Electrical - All Levels
jobs.description: **About Us** Apollo is a Mission\-Critical Infrastructure Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations Support Services Company. We serve mission\-critical industries globally with commissioning, emergency response, operations support, and owner's representative services. Apollo is currently executing projects in multiple states in the United States, in Canada and Brazil. Since our inception, we have built a commissioning firm based on trust, one relationship at a time. We hire the best people who can handle critical systems, love challenges, and thrive in a dynamic environment. We focus on understanding each client's needs and are relentless in meeting them. **Location** Multiple U.S. Locations – Atlanta, GA; Ashburn, VA; Chicago, IL; Phoenix, AZ; Columbus, OH; Portland, OR; Jackson, MS **Job Description** We are seeking skilled and motivated professionals of all experience levels to join our team as Data Center Electrical Commissioning Engineers (CxEs). The Electrical CxE will commission electrical systems in data centers, ensuring they meet top performance and reliability standards. This role requires a deep understanding of mission\-critical environments, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. All newly hired team members entering Apollo’s Commissioning Engineer career path begin in the role of Commissioning Engineer in Training (Cx\-EIT). In this role, team members develop and apply technical commissioning knowledge, engineering judgment, and field experience through structured project execution, mentorship, and progressive responsibility within mission\-critical environments. Cx\-EIT team members actively contribute to project execution activities, including technical reviews, systems evaluations, commissioning documentation development, field inspections, functional testing, issue identification and resolution support, and coordination with project stakeholders. Upon successful demonstration of technical competency, achievement of qualification and performance milestones, and management approval, team members may progress into the role of Electrical Commissioning Engineer. Progression timing may vary based on individual performance, project experience, business needs, and completion of required development objectives. Activities will include but are not limited to testing and/or validation of transformers, electrical switchgear, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units, Static Transfer Switch (STS) units, Power Distribution Units (PDU), electrical distribution equipment, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and Building Management and Automation Systems (BMS). This role involves supporting data center construction/commissioning activities, so working hours may include nights and/or weekends. This is an onsite, client\-facing role that may require approximately 90% or more travel to various client locations. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, equivalent professional experience or experience in a related field (including but not limited to electrical field service technician, data center technician or military). **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct commissioning activities for electrical and EPMS/BMS systems in data centers. * Create and implement detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and checklists for Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems. * Review and evaluate design documents, submittals, and equipment specifications. * Conduct site inspections, functional performance tests, and system verifications. * Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations. * Work closely with project teams, including contractors, engineers, and data center operators, to maintain schedule. * Diagnose and resolve system performance, reliability, and safety issues. * Document results/findings and generate comprehensive commissioning reports. * Maintain open and current communication with the client about the status of the project. * Provide training and support to data center staff on system operation and maintenance. * Ensure adherence to industry standards, codes, and regulations. * Attend project meetings and offer technical expertise. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Demands** The following physical demands must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions: * Frequently manipulating, moving, or grasping small parts, devices, or tools. * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office areas, critical facilities and other environments, including tight and confined spaces. * Exposure to low/high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind. * Working and walking on different types of terrain on active construction sites (e.g., concrete flooring, gravel, unpaved roads). * Frequently ascending and descending stairs and ladders to access equipment. * Occasionally positioning oneself under or over equipment. * Occasionally moving equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in commissioning, designing, or constructing electrical systems, especially in data centers or mission\-critical environments. * Extensive knowledge of electricity systems, medium\-to\-low voltage electrical distribution systems, power generation systems, UPS systems and control systems. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and clients. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, specifications and engineering design drawings. * Ability to read and operate electrical test equipment. * Skilled in using commissioning software and tools, including MS Office Suite; Mid\-Level and Experienced\-Level candidates should also be proficient with Procore and CxAlloy. * Ability to travel to different data center locations as needed. **Experience Levels** * **Entry\-Level:** 0\-1 years of experience in commissioning or a related field, with a focus on mission\-critical facilities. * **Mid\-Level:** 2\-5 years of experience with demonstrated project management capabilities and a solid understanding of data center systems. * **Experienced\-Level:** 6\+ years of experience, with extensive knowledge of complex mission\-critical systems and leadership experience. **Prerequisites for Employment** * Successful background check, including pre\-employment drug screening * US citizens, permanent residents or any candidate with eligibility to work in the US **What We Offer** Apollo offers its employees a full benefits package, including: * Health and wellness plans (medical, dental, vision, life, disability) * Flexible spending accounts * Paid time off, holidays, and more * Paid parental leave * 401K plan with immediate match benefits * Employee assistance programs * Tuition reimbursement programs Employee discount programs * Apollo challenges the brightest, most talented, and driven individuals in the industry by providing an environment that embraces initiative, diversity, and achievement. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer supporting women, minorities, veterans and people with disabilities. We participate in the Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program.

jobs.title: Performance Engineer

Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility\-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy. With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision\-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity. Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long\-term land value and strengthen regional economies. **Job Summary** Panthera Grid is seeking an experienced and motivated Performance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will have minimum 3 years of relevant experience in utility\-scale performance engineering. The Performance Engineer is responsible for maximizing the operational and financial performance of the company's utility\-scale solar and energy storage assets. This role serves as the technical lead for performance analytics, production forecasting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization initiatives across a portfolio of operating renewable energy facilities. The Performance Engineer will have extensive modeling experience with PVsyst, a strong understanding of all inputs required for generating P50 energy estimates and of PV plant construction and operation. The Performance position will report to the Reliability Engineering Manager. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in solar plant and battery storage performance assessment, energy modeling, SCADA analytics, and operational troubleshooting. This individual will work closely with Asset Management, Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M), Commercial Operations, Development, Engineering, and third\-party service providers to identify performance risks and opportunities, improve fleet availability, and ensure achievement of energy production targets. The Performance Engineer will be a subject matter expert in photovoltaic system and Battery storage behavior, plant performance metrics, and operational analytics, helping drive continuous improvement across the renewable energy portfolio. **Responsibilities** * Monitor and analyze fleet\-wide solar plant performance, availability, and energy production against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees. * Develop, maintain, and improve performance monitoring dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools. * Assist in root cause analyses of underperformance events and production losses. * Evaluate SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, and revenue meter data to identify operational issues and optimization opportunities. * Perform daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance assessments for operating assets. * Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison against performance models. * Support asset managers in assessing operational risks and revenue impacts associated with plant performance issues. * Collaborate with O\&M providers and internal resources to troubleshoot equipment failures and recurring performance losses. * Analyze inverter, tracker, module, and balance\-of\-system performance trends and degradation rates. * Lead performance guarantee evaluations, liquidated damages assessments, and contractual performance testing activities. * Review and update production forecasts, weather assumptions, and performance models as operating data becomes available. * Develop and maintain fleet degradation analyses and long\-term performance projections. * Identify and quantify opportunities for performance improvements and operational cost reductions. * Support due diligence efforts for project acquisitions, financing activities, and portfolio valuations. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders. * Stay current with evolving industry standards, technologies, and best practices related to solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics. * Develop automation tools, scripts, and analytical workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel VBA, or similar platforms. * Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet reliability and performance. * Onboard new assets in performance platforms. **Requirements*** Minimum 3 years of renewable industry experience in a performance\-related role * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (preferred), Meteorology, Statistics, Physics, or some other quantitative field * Strong knowledge of PV solar energy systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) * Proficiency in data analysis using Excel, Python, MATLAB, Fabric or other related software. * Understanding inverter operation, power conversion principles, and power electronics. * Advanced understanding of and experience with PVsyst software. * Professional verbal and written communication skills * Ability to discuss technical and advanced engineering concepts to both expert and non\-technical people. * Self\-motivated, able to work both independently with minimal oversight and in coordination with other groups and individuals. * Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, at times in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred:** * Experience with utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). * Experience supporting NERC, ISO, or utility compliance requirements. * Familiarity with SCADA platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, or similar tools. * Experience with performance guarantee testing and ASTM performance testing protocols. * Knowledge of energy markets and renewable asset commercial operations. * Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science applications in renewable energy. * Experience managing third\-party O\&M or EPC contractors Location: Hybrid in Houston, Texas (4 days in office, Fridays remote). **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H\-1B or L\-2, are not available for this position.** **Benefits** Panthera Grid Partners offers an exciting benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending account, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability, voluntary life, and long\-term disability, paid paternal leave, and a retirement plan with matching contributions. Full\-time position with competitive compensation package, including bonus.

jobs.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a senior, hands\-on AI Cluster Integration Engineer to bring large\-scale GPU compute clusters from physical installation to validated, commercially ready production. Working alongside a team of senior infrastructure engineers, this person will own critical elements of cluster bring\-up, bare\-metal provisioning, advanced systems configuration, performance optimization, and acceptance testing. After deployment, the engineer will provide Tier 3 technical escalation and sustained performance support for operating clusters. The focus is on compute\-platform readiness and workload performance rather than primary ownership of network switch and fabric configuration. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Cluster Bring\-Up and Systems Integration** * Lead technical bring\-up of materially complete, racked, powered, and cabled AI clusters through production readiness and customer handoff. * Establish and validate system baselines across BIOS/BMC, firmware, GPU drivers, operating systems, and cluster software stacks. * Deploy and optimize automated bare\-metal provisioning, imaging, node configuration, and lifecycle workflows at scale. * Configure and troubleshoot advanced Linux and GPU systems, including kernel, driver, accelerator, and host\-level performance settings. * Integrate and validate Kubernetes and Slurm environments in partnership with platform, networking, and operations engineers. **Performance Engineering and Acceptance** * Execute NVIDIA Field Diagnostics, L11/L12 validation, burn\-in, stability, and hardware health qualification procedures. * Run and analyze NCCL collective communication tests, GPU benchmarks, and distributed workload performance at node, rack, and cluster scale. * Troubleshoot GPU, NVLink/NVSwitch, PCIe, RDMA, and InfiniBand/Ethernet performance issues, partnering with network engineers on fabric\-related remediation. * Identify configuration bottlenecks and optimize throughput, latency, scaling efficiency, and cluster reliability. * Own technical acceptance criteria, test evidence, defect tracking, remediation verification, and readiness recommendations for commercial service. **Tier 3 Operations and Reliability** * Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production incidents involving compute nodes, GPU software, provisioning, scheduling, and degraded performance. * Perform deep root cause analysis, coordinate vendor engineering escalations, and lead corrective actions for recurring or systemic issues. * Support fleet\-level upgrades, configuration changes, cluster expansions, and post\-maintenance validation with appropriate change controls. * Develop diagnostic tooling, automation, runbooks, and operational handoff material for SRE, NOC, and site support teams. **Cross\-Functional Execution** * Work closely with infrastructure engineering, site operations, OEMs, and software/platform teams to resolve cross\-stack issues and meet delivery milestones. * Provide concise technical status, benchmark findings, risks, and acceptance recommendations to engineering leadership and stakeholders. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of hands\-on Linux systems engineering, HPC, cloud, or large\-scale infrastructure experience, including senior\-level troubleshooting. * Proven experience bringing GPU or HPC clusters into production and qualifying systems against performance and reliability targets. * Strong expertise in Linux, automation (Python/Bash/Ansible), bare\-metal provisioning, configuration management, and systems diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms, NCCL, Field Diagnostics, and multi\-node performance testing. * Practical experience with Kubernetes and Slurm; familiarity with high\-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand/RDMA, and parallel or distributed storage. **Core Competencies** * Deep technical curiosity and the ability to isolate difficult problems across hardware, firmware, operating systems, and distributed workloads. * Strong ownership of outcomes, with a systematic approach to testing, documentation, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Comfortable collaborating with highly experienced peer engineers while driving independent technical decisions and execution. * Clear communication with engineering leadership, vendors, site personnel, and customer\-facing stakeholders. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

ownership of deployment outcomes, acceptance criteria, operational reliability, and technical documentation. * Ability to make independent technical decisions while collaborating effectively with full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry\-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. **Job Summary:** As Principal Data Engineer for Marketing and Consumer Data, you will serve as the senior technical leader for Identity and Device data products — including Identity360 and related consumer identifier datasets — that underpin marketing measurement, activation, and analytics across Disney Entertainment \& ESPN. You will define technical direction, drive complex cross\-system initiatives, establish engineering standards, and mentor leads and senior engineers, while partnering with onshore squad leaders, product, and enterprise architecture to deliver reliable batch and near\-real\-time data at petabyte scale. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Define and drive technical strategy for Identity \& Device data products within Marketing and Consumer Data — including pipeline architecture, platform patterns, and modernization roadmap in partnership with onshore squad leaders and enterprise architecture. * Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact initiatives across Identity360, device/consumer identifier datasets, and dependent Marketing data products — setting technical approach, sequencing, and quality bar for other engineers. * Serve as principal SME and escalation point for identity foundational data — data modeling, batch and near\-real\-time processing, performance at scale, and production reliability — including participation in on\-call rotation and incident leadership for critical pipelines. * Establish and uphold engineering standards for the Identity \& Device team and Marketing Data Engineering — code quality, CI/CD, observability, data governance (GDPR, RTBF, CCPA), and reusable platform patterns across Databricks, AWS, and orchestration tooling. * Mentor and develop engineers through design reviews, pairing, and coaching — building depth in big\-data engineering, identity domain knowledge, and operational excellence. * Partner cross\-functionally with Product, QA, Operations, Privacy/Legal, and peer Marketing data squads (Data Collection, Activation, Acquisition) to align requirements, resolve cross\-domain dependencies, and represent Bangalore technical decisions to stakeholders. **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** Basic Qualifications * 10\+ years of related big data engineering experience modeling and developing large data pipelines and experience with Python, Scala, or Java; strong AWS fundamentals (S3, Lambda, IAM) preferred. * 5\+ years hands\-on experience including performance tuning at scale with distributed systems such as Hadoop or Databricks compute using tools/libraries such as Spark, Presto, Hive to query and process large datasets at the petabyte level. * methodologies and practices * Operational experience in multi\-system/services production environment as senior data engineer and point\-of\-contact / SME * Problem solving skills with strong attention to detail and excellent analytical and communication skills * Solid experience with data integration and orchestration toolsets (e.g. Airflow), CI/CD * Demonstrated ability with cloud infrastructure technologies, including Terraform. * Strong understanding of slowly changing dimensions (SCD tables) and how to build scalable and performant datasets. Required Education * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in SFO, CA is $187,900 \- $252,000 per year and New York is $179,700 \- $241,000 per year. jobs.title: Product Manager, Network Rules & Governance
jobs.description: **Context** Altic is the rules\-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is not the alternatives access platforms of the last decade, it is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume. The network is built in a sequence, and the sequence is not arbitrary. Rules, then digitisation, then intelligence, then scale. You cannot digitise without rules. You cannot get to intelligence without digitisation. This is why Altic starts with the rulebook. What follows from that is the part people miss. The rulebook, the technical specification and the participant agreement are not paperwork sitting alongside the technology. They are what the technology gets built on. A legal framework agreed once across every participant is what makes a common technical standard possible, and that standard is what turns a set of bilateral relationships into market infrastructure. The rules work is the foundation of the network build, not a condition of being allowed to start it. Every large network has a function that owns its rules. Payments has Visa Rules Management and a Rules Committee. ACH has Nacha's operating rules. Securities settlement has the DTCC and SWIFT standards bodies. Private markets has never had one. This role is the first of its kind for the asset class. **Purpose of the Role** You will own the Altic rulebook, the technical specification and the network's participant agreement as products, not as documents. That means being accountable for what they say, how they change, who agrees to them, and how quickly the network can absorb a change once it is agreed. It also means being the face of them. Externally, you are the rulebook. The immediate job is twofold. Give the network a genuine product owner of its rules, and formalise the governance framework that decides how those rules change, including standing up the committee structure that does not exist yet. Where it goes after that is harder to predict, but as the scope of the network grows the manual version of this job stops scaling. Part of the role is building towards the capability that replaces it: a change\-management capability that captures participant feedback, assesses impact across the network, and shortens the cycle from a raised issue to a published rule. You define the rules and the requirements the network is built against, working closely with technical product management and engineering as the build takes shape. The test of your work is not whether the documents are well drafted. It is whether the rules are agreed, adopted, and clear enough to build against. **Key Stakeholders** * Legal and governance, internal and outside counsel * GPs and asset managers participating in the network * Wealth managers and platform participants * Service providers including transfer agents, fund administrators and custodians * Business Development, Partnerships and Strategy * PMN Technical Product Management and Engineering * PMN Product and Operations **Why This Role Is Different** This role offers: * A first of its kind mandate. Nobody has built a rules function for private markets. There is no incumbent playbook to inherit and no template to fill in. * The governance framework does not exist yet. You will formalise it and stand up the committee structure, rather than inherit someone else's process and administer it. * The rules are the foundation of the build. What gets agreed in the rulebook is what the technical network is designed against, so this is not documentation that sits to one side. * Ownership of the artefacts the entire network depends on, rather than a slice of a roadmap someone else set. * A genuinely external role. You will present the rulebook, teach it, and run the forums and events where the network argues it out, in person and virtually. The rulebook is not a document you maintain. It is the product the network runs on, and you are the person who stands behind it. **How you will provide meaningful contributions:** **What You'll Actually Be Doing** This role sits between legal, engineering and the participants themselves, and a lot of it happens in front of people. On any given week, you might be: * Walking a GP's counsel through a rule they have taken issue with, and coming back with a change the rest of the network can actually absorb. * Presenting the rulebook to a wealth platform's operations leadership, then staying in the room for the two hours of questions that follow. * Turning a legal position agreed with outside counsel into a clear requirement the technical product and engineering teams can specify against without guessing. * Working out whether the exception a participant is asking for is a waiver, a rule change, or a signal that the rule itself is wro the latest AI techniques to automate and prototype. Comfortable across AI, no\-code and low\-code tools, and inclined to build a working thing rather than write a requirements document about it. **Domain experience (beneficial, not required):** any of the following gives you a head start, and none of them on its own is the role: direct experience at a network participant or service provider, whether a transfer agent, fund administrator, custodian, GP or wealth platform; alternatives product or operations experience from a firm such as iCapital or CAIS; knowledge of the wealth management channel and of managed accounts, including model\-driven and portfolio\-driven trading; a legal background in financial markets, private markets or funds; or a legal\-tech background. **Personal Attributes** * Comfortable being the first person to do something, with no incumbent process to inherit. * Patient with detail and impatient with drift. Rules reward both. * Shows rather than tells. Defaults to a working prototype over a slide deck. * Holds a position under pressure from a large counterparty, and changes it when the argument is genuinely better. * Treats a recurring exception as a design problem rather than an administrative one. * Happy to be the named owner of something the whole network can disagree with in public. **About InvestCloud** InvestCloud, a global leader in wealth technology, aspires to enable a smarter financial future. Driving the digital transformation of the wealth management industry, the company serves a broad array of clients globally, including Wealth and Asset Managers, Wirehouses, Banks, RIAs, and Insurers. In terms of scale, the company’s clients represent more than 40 percent of the $132 trillion of total assets globally. As a leader in delivering personalization and scale across advisory programs, including unified managed accounts (UMA) and separately managed accounts (SMA), the company is committed to the success of its clients. By equipping and enabling advisors and their clients with connected technology, enhanced intelligence, and inspired experiences, InvestCloud delivers leading digital wealth management and financial planning solutions, complemented by a dynamic data warehouse, which scale across the complete wealth continuum. In 2024, InvestCloud was named CNBC World’s Top Fintech Company, a proof point of the company’s commitment to innovation and client success. Headquartered in the United States, InvestCloud serves clients around the world. For more information, visit InvestCloud.com (https://nam10\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=https%3A%2F%2Finvestcloud.com%2F\&data\=05%7C02%7Chjacobsen%40investcloud.com%7Ced84e5c3e8524e4d5c1e08dce318b0e3%7C134fa738eba84721a959151561c6c68e%7C0%7C0%7C638634942404266514%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=MWVDvATUCh92zSkL%2F9PonMNS3hr8Zqp2xaVJmF4Vbx8%3D\&reserved\=0\). **Our Values** Client Connected Human Centered Technology Forward Respect \+ Integrity Excellence The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on the applicant’s geographic location. Salary range: $165,000 \- $195,000\. Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, vision, disability, and life/AD\&D insurance plans, Flexible Savings Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), health advocacy, voluntary ancillary plans (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, legal, identity theft, auto/home, and pet insurance), 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off. \#LI\-BH1 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend/Infra [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payers, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments, and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== As a Senior Backend/Infra Engineer at Amigo, you'll build the core services behind our agent platform. The systems you own handle millions of conversations a month, so concurrency, reliability, and clean design are the job itself, not an afterthought. You'll own services end to end, from design through production. **What you'll do** ================== * Designing high\-throughput services that handle concurrent conversations at scale * Owning a core platform service from design to production * Building systems that stay available and degrade gracefully when things fail * Handling sensitive healthcare data with the care it requires * Improving performance, observability, and operational health across services * Shaping architectural decisions as the platform grows * Think carefully and holistically about system design under time pressure. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've built and operated production backend systems at scale and owned the outcome * You're strong with concurrency, distributed systems, and service design * You prefer simple, maintainable solutions to hard problems * You debug well across services, queues, and databases * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in a regulated or high\-reliability domain (healthcare, finance, legal) * High\-throughput or low\-latency system design * Experience with production AI or ML systems **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $260K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tools
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, a tools engineer builds the tools that turn what our robots record in the field into data our models learn from. Engineers use the same tools to match a change in a robot’s telemetry to the moment an error happened. What a robot should learn from a day of real work is still an open question: which moments are worth training on, and which labels hold up under review. Some of our best labels come from records captured on site while the robots work. Data quality is model quality here. You will own the tools that decide what goes into a training set, and what those tools reveal about the data shapes where our R\&D goes next. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own the viewer engineers use to play back a robot’s data and line up telemetry with errors. * Own dataset curation: the dataset API and the tools engineers use to find and group episodes and build training sets. * Build annotation tooling with the rest of the software team, and weigh what we build against what we buy. * Build the quality review process for annotated data. * Work with the ML team who train on this data, the engineers who debug the fleet with it, and the annotators who label it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have built an internal tool that became the way a team works. * Have built visualization or analysis tools for large volumes of sensor and video data. * Have built dataset tooling or a data pipeline that ML engineers train from. * Have designed a labeling or review workflow that people use to annotate data at volume. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.description: **Software Developer \| AI\-Assisted Development** **Company:** Navigate Real Estate **Location:** Fairfield, CA, Hybrid **Pay:** $25\-30 per hour **Schedule:** Part\-time, approximately 30 hours per week **About the Position** Navigate Real Estate is a growing, locally owned real estate brokerage building its own technology to transform how real estate professionals work. We’re looking for a motivated, tech\-savvy Software Developer to help build, improve, and maintain our proprietary software platform, Port Ivan. Port Ivan brings together transaction coordination, back\-office operations, marketing, and other business tools into one integrated system. We embrace modern AI\-assisted development tools, including Replit and AI coding assistants, to build applications efficiently. We’re looking for someone who enjoys technology, learns quickly, solves problems creatively, and is excited about using AI to develop real\-world software. You’ll work directly with company leadership to improve existing features, develop new functionality, troubleshoot issues, and help shape the future of our platform. **What You’ll Do** * Develop, improve, and maintain our proprietary software applications. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to build and modify software. * Troubleshoot bugs and resolve technical issues. * Develop new features based on feedback from employees and real estate agents. * Improve user experience, functionality, and application performance. * Integrate third\-party services and APIs. * Test software updates and ensure new features work correctly. * Work with company leadership to plan and prioritize development projects. * Research and recommend new technologies and tools. * Regular in person meetings and trainings will be required at our offices (Fairfield, Vacaville, Petaluma, Middletown) * Outside of scheduled meetings and other tasks, work location and schedule are flexible. **What We’re Looking For** * Strong computer skills and an interest in software development. * Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Replit, Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT. * Basic understanding of web applications, databases, APIs, and software development. * Ability to troubleshoot problems and independently research solutions. * Strong attention to detail and logical problem\-solving skills. * Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly. * Excellent communication and organizational skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. **Preferred, but Not Required** * Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, or SQL. * Experience developing or maintaining web applications. * Familiarity with GitHub, APIs, and database management. * Experience with Replit or similar cloud development environments. * Knowledge of real estate operations or business management software. A computer science degree is not required. We value demonstrated technical ability, creativity, problem\-solving skills, and a willingness to learn over formal education. **Why Join Navigate?** At Navigate Real Estate, we’re building technology that supports our business every day. This is an opportunity to work on a real software platform used by a growing company. You’ll have direct input into product development, work closely with decision\-makers, and see the results of your work put into practice. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to develop new technical skills, and the chance to help build technology from the ground up. **How to Apply** Submit your resume along with a brief description of your experience with software development or AI\-assisted coding tools. If you’ve built an application, website, automation, or other software project, we’d love to see an example. We’re especially interested in candidates who enjoy experimenting with new technologies and finding creative solutions to everyday business challenges. Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid sick time * Work from home Application Question(s): * Are you able to attend in person meetings and trainings 1\-2 times per month (Fairfield, CA)? * Do you have experience with using an AI coding platform such as Replit? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fairfield, CA 94534

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Creeda is an AI\-powered franchise accounting platform. We sell live financial visibility to franchises so they can run their businesses better, and automation to franchise\-focused bookkeeping firms so they can reduce costs and increase efficiency. There are 850,000 franchises in the US, constituting a $921B industry. Creeda is growing very fast, so we are looking for the brightest engineers to help us execute. **The role** You'll start by building. We need a strong generalist who can work anywhere in the stack, front end to back end to data, and make the platform better wherever it needs it most. Some weeks that's shipping a feature a customer is waiting on, some weeks it's fixing an integration that breaks a bookkeeper's close, some weeks it's making onboarding faster so a firm can bring over hundreds of locations instead of fifty. You take a problem and own it end to end. As we sign larger firms, the job will become more of a FDE role. You'll fly out, sit with their accountants, watch how they actually work, and build automations on site that go straight into production. Their bookkeepers describe what they need, you build it that week, and every firm serving that brand gets it. Half engineer, half the person our customers call when they want something built. This is one of the highest\-leverage seats at Creeda. You'll see the customer, write the code, and ship the fix in the same day. Who this is not for * Engineers who want clean specs and a well\-defined surface. There is no such thing here yet. * Engineers who do not want to talk to customers. Roughly a third of this job is people. * Engineers who want to work only on the interesting parts. The data cleaning is not a phase we are going to grow out of; it is the product. What we are looking forRequired * Strong backend engineering in TypeScript or Python. We run both (TypeScript on Node and Next.js for the product, workers and importers; Python for the classifier and ML training) on Postgres. You need to be strong in one and willing to work in the other. * Real experience with data that was not made for you: documents meant for humans (PDFs, spreadsheets a bookkeeper has already edited), vendor exports, third\-party APIs that contradict themselves. * Enough rigor to work on financial data, where being approximately right is being wrong. You should be able to explain why a balance check passing proves the arithmetic and not the entry. * Judgment about code\*\*.\*\* We build with AI coding agents, and they are fast enough that the bottleneck has moved to review. You need software design fundamentals strong enough to look at generated code and say precisely why it is wrong. You should be good at the other end of it too, setting constraints up front so the agent produces something reviewable in the first place. * Clear written communication. Every area of the codebase carries its own orientation doc, read by the next engineer and by the AI coding agents we build with, and we treat that documentation as an asset. * Willingness to travel periodically once phase two begins, several multi\-day trips per quarter Helpful, not required * Putting ML or LLM output into production behind hard constraints, where the model is allowed to be wrong but the system is not * Double\-entry bookkeeping. You know what a journal entry is and why it has to balance. * Accounting, fintech, POS, payroll or ERP background * QuickBooks Online's API, Plaid, or any general ledger system * Having worked somewhere small enough that titles did not decide who did what We do not require a CS degree, and we do not care where you worked before. We care that you have built something that had to be right. Details * **Location:** New York City * **Visa:** We can accept CPT/OPT but unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10018
