jobs.title: Software Engineer III/Senior, Infrastructure Platform
jobs.description: **About ngrok Inc.** -------------------- ngrok is an all\-in\-one cloud networking platform that secures, transforms, and routes traffic to services running anywhere. Instead of cobbling together nginx, NLBs, VPNs, model routers, and oodles of other tools, developers solve every networking problem with one gateway. Doesn’t matter if they’re sharing localhost or running AI workloads in production. We're trusted by more than 9 million developers at companies like GitHub, Okta, HashiCorp, and Twilio. What started as a way to put your local app on a public URL has grown into a universal gateway for API delivery, AI inference, device fleets, and site\-to\-site connectivity. It’s the same ngrok that millions of developers have loved and leaned on every day for years, now with the power to run production traffic at scale. A few things you should know: * We are obsessed with our pets, Viper sunglasses and Bufo (yes, the toad) * We have a designated Chief Emoji Officer \- they are vital to our success! * We like software that’s serious and culture that’s not Still reading? Good. There's more below worth your time. **About the Infra Platform Team** --------------------------------- The Infra Platform team builds the systems ngrok engineers rely on to build, deploy, and operate ngrok itself. We think about infrastructure the way software engineers think about software: APIs, abstractions, automation, reliability, and developer experience. We own the internal platform that keeps engineering productive and production stable. That includes build systems, deployment workflows, infrastructure tooling, service reliability, and the glue that connects it all together. Our work touches nearly every engineer at the company, which means when we improve something, everyone feels it. You’ll work on systems with real production load, latency constraints, and reliability requirements. We run a modern stack built primarily around Go, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kubernetes, Terraform, Protobuf, nix, and AWS. Most of our infrastructure and application code lives in a monorepo powered by extensive code generation and internal tooling that makes complex workflows feel surprisingly manageable. This is the team people come to when things are scaling, failing, deploying too slowly, or generally behaving like distributed systems tend to behave. **What You’ll Actually Do** --------------------------- * **Build and improve the engineering platform**: You’ll work on the systems engineers use every day to develop, test, deploy, and operate ngrok. Better tooling, smoother workflows, fewer sharp edges. * **Treat infrastructure like software**: You’ll automate operational workflows, improve reliability, and build systems that scale cleanly under production load. SRE and DevOps problems solved with software engineering discipline. * **Improve the developer experience**: You’ll contribute to builder tools, deployment systems, CI/CD infrastructure, and internal abstractions that make engineers faster and safer when shipping changes. * **Help keep production healthy**: You’ll participate in maintaining high uptime and operational excellence by improving observability, reliability, and incident response processes. * **Raise the engineering bar**: You’ll mentor teammates, contribute technical direction, and help evolve the architecture and operational maturity of the platform over time. **You Might Be a Great Fit If…** -------------------------------- * You have 3\+ years of experience as a software engineer * You’ve built and operated distributed systems in AWS or other cloud environments * You’re comfortable in a statically typed, compiled language such as Go, Rust, C\+\+, or Java (with bonus points for Go) * You think operational problems are engineering problems * You care deeply about developer experience and scalable systems design * You enjoy understanding how systems fail, recover, and evolve over time Extra credit if you’ve worked with: * Kubernetes, Terraform, nix, PostgreSQL, Kafka, or gRPC * Observability platforms like Datadog or Honeycomb * Internal developer platforms or builder tooling * Networking, infrastructure, or security\-focused systems **Tech Stack** -------------- ngrok runs entirely on AWS. Engineers develop by using remote development tools and/or ssh to connect to remote EC2 environments that run a full Kubernetes cluster of the ngrok stack, closely mirroring production. The codebase is primarily Go and TypeScript. We use Postgres for persistence, Kafka for streaming, Protobuf for service boundaries, and Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, and Buildkite to operate and ship reliably. React is used for user interfaces, and GitHub supports our development workflows and remembers everything. **Location** ------------ This is a remote position for candidates outside of the Bay Area and a hybrid role for candidates within commuting distance to San Francisco. Our Bay Area employees commute to the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. **Sponsorship** --------------- All candidates must be US\-based, and legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, ngrok is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent, ongoing basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Compensation** ---------------- **Job Title** **Senior Software Engineer** * Tier 1 (SF, LA, Seattle, NYC): $202,500 – $247,500 * Tier 2 (rest of US): $186,300 – $227,700 **Software Engineer III** * Tier 1 (SF, LA, Seattle, NYC): $180,000 – $220,000 * Tier 2 (rest of US): $165,600 – $202,400 Job level and actual compensation will be evaluated based on factors including, but not limited to, qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), internal equity with other team members, market data, and specific work location. We provide an attractive mix of salary and equity. \#LI\-Hybrid **Full Time Employee Benefits** ------------------------------- * **Health stuff that actually matters.** Full premiums covered on base healthcare, dental, and vision for you. Half covered for your dependents. Mental health and well\-being support included, because taking care of your brain is as important as taking care of your teeth. * **Retirement matching that doesn't suck.** 401(k) with 100% match up to 3% of your salary and 50% match up to another 2%. Future you will appreciate present you. * **Actually flexible time off.** We say "open, flexible vacation policy" and actually mean it. Take the time you need. Your manager will bug you if you're not taking enough. * **Parental leave that's realistic.** Up to 16 weeks if you give birth, up to 8 weeks for new parents (birth, adoption, fostering—however your family grows). * **Money to keep growing.** Annual professional development budget for books, courses, conferences, or whatever helps you level up. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Platform Engineering is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Software Engineer, Platform Engineering assignments. * Grade cloud \& platform engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Software Engineer, Platform Engineering work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Cloud \& platform engineering * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who Are We? Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology\-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes. This is precision cardiology, and we know it's within reach. What Will You Do? **The Overview** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and run that pipeline in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the data science/clinical teams, which owns the medical and research questions. You will also work with the Data Architect on platform standards, data models, and governance. **The Specifics** **Build and Evolve the Data Platform (Prolaio Data Ecosystem)** * + Design, build, and maintain batch, streaming, and hybrid pipelines orchestrated with Dagster. These cover ingestion, validation, transformation, enrichment, and publishing of the data. + Develop and maintain dbt models in BigQuery, including staging, intermediate, and mart layers, with tests, documentation, and clear ownership. + Ingest and normalize heterogeneous sources (both structured and unstructured data), including cardiology wearables and device signals, EHR, claims, medication, and patient\-reported data. + Make well\-reasoned decisions about storage, compute, partitioning, cost, and APIs, and contribute to the target\-state architecture and the reference patterns. **Data Quality, Lineage, and Compliance** * + Contribute to data lifecycle controls into pipelines: retention, access control, lineage, provenance, reproducibility, and auditability. + Use Dagster assets and dbt lineage to keep data traceable from source to output. + Support validated operation in a regulated setting by documenting pipelines, keeping traceability, and working with Quality and Security teams. + Back every pipeline change with thorough automated tests and data quality checks. **Enable Data Science and ML** * + Treat data scientists as your customers, and give them the tools and processes to experiment and iterate efficiently. + Contribute to the ML workflows that support feature generation, training, deployment, and monitoring. + Contribute to internal applications and Python libraries **Operate and Monitor** * + Own CI/CD for the data platform using GitLab CI, including dbt and Dagster deployments. + Help monitoring pipeline health, performance, and BigQuery cost with Datadog, and take part in incident response. + Help mentoring other engineers and setting engineering standards for the data team. **Why Prolaio?** * **Impactful Work:** You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology. * **Innovative Environment****:** You will be part of an organization doing something that's never been done before. * **Professional Growth****:** You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow. * **Collaborative Team****:** You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology. **Who You Are?** * 6\+ years in data engineering * Expert Python and SQL * Experience with GCP (or AWS/Azure) * Production experience with dbt, including modeling, testing, macros, and incremental models. * Experience with BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Redshift). * Experience with Dagster or a comparable orchestrator (Airflow, Prefect). * Experience with Docker and large\-scale data processing. * Experience with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, including time\-series data. * Understanding of MLOps concepts and production ML workflows. * Experience collaborating with data scientists, product, and clinical or quality stakeholders. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. **Additional Qualifications (Nice to Haves)** * Hands\-on GCP experience (IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, networking). * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Experience with Datadog * Metadata, lineage, and catalog tools, plus retrieval or vector tooling for AI use cases. * Experience with Databricks * Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, medtech, or other patient data. * Experience in regulated or validated environments (SaMD, FDA, GxP, HIPAA). * Streaming tools such as Pub/Sub or Kafka. **Why You'll Love Working Here** * **Meaningful Compensation**: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build. * **Great Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions. * **Flexible Spending Perks:** HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more. * **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays. * **Family\-First Benefits**: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families. * **Security \& Peace of Mind**: Company\-paid life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Plan for the Future**: 401(k) plan to help you build long\-term financial security. * **Care When You Need It:** Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life's unexpected moments. Starting Salary is at $150,000\.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer — Firmware Team **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking an **Embedded Linux Software Engineer** to join a small, high\-impact firmware team building the embedded software stack for a commercial bench\-top scientific instrument. The platform is an AMD/Xilinx FPGA SoC (Zynq / UltraScale\+) running PetaLinux, with a mix of userspace applications, device drivers, and real\-time control interfacing with custom programmable logic. You'll work alongside an embedded systems architect who owns the Linux application layer, peripheral subsystems, protocol design, and hardware integration. Your core mandate is threefold: share the Linux application workload, own test automation infrastructure, and establish CI/build reliability. You'll write production code and the tooling that proves it works. This is a small, documentation\-driven team, and you'll be expected to write clear design docs and track progress in Jira/Confluence. The role combines hands\-on lab work with prototype hardware and desk\-based software development, following a sequenced release cadence (HDL OS/drivers embedded applications system integration). **What You'll Do** * Develop embedded Linux application software in C (userspace, POSIX) * Develop userspace and kernel\-space drivers for internal and external devices (sensors, actuators, instruments) * Implement and extend application\-level command/control/data protocols over TCP/IP * Implement communication drivers for industrial instruments (mass flow controllers, vacuum gauges, motor controllers) over serial and CAN interfaces * Design, build, and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) automated test systems * Develop host\-side test tooling (Python GUIs, emulators, scripted instrument drivers) * Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reproducible build infrastructure * Participate in hardware bring\-up, board\-level validation, and lab bench debugging * Contribute to architecture decisions, documentation, and design reviews **What We're Looking For** * S., M.S., or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 10\+ years of relevant industry experience * C for embedded Linux userspace, including threading, IPC, and POSIX APIs * Python for test automation (pytest or equivalent framework) and scripted instrumentation * TCP/IP socket programming on Linux (non\-blocking I/O, connection lifecycle, streaming) * UDP for discovery and lightweight telemetry * Bus and serial protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN * RS\-232 and RS\-485, including byte\-level protocol implementation (framing, CRC, state machines, multi\-device arbitration) * Hardware bring\-up and board\-level debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Producer\-consumer and ring buffer patterns for real\-time data flow * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop test development and execution **Nice to have:** * Linux DMA programming (scatter\-gather, buffer pool management, AXI\-DMA) * CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Docker\-based build environments) * Yocto or PetaLinux BSP experience * Unit test frameworks for C (gtest, cmocka, Unity) * Familiarity with FPGA register interfaces (UIO, devmem, register maps) * Performance profiling and network analysis (Wireshark, throughput characterization) * Python GUI development for test/operator tooling (Tkinter, PyQt) * Familiarity with scientific or process\-control instrumentation **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * Health, Dental, Vision plans provided * 401k matching provided * Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, firmware engineers write the firmware for our robots’ mainboards and actuators, and bring up new boards with our manufacturing partners. They work with our mechanical, electrical, and ML teams as new sensors and embodiments arrive. How far firmware can take a robot on its own is still an open question: which faults a board can recover from without a person, and how one design carries across new boards and embodiments. The firmware you write sets how reliable and safe every robot is. The architecture bets you make carry into every robot we build after this one. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Lead board bring\-up with our manufacturing partners, from specification discovery through first boot. * Write the drivers and hardware abstraction layers that run on our microcontrollers and actuators. * Build and run automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests across embodiments. * Build the common firmware base for mainboards and actuators, in Rust and C. * Work with the ML and mechanical teams to prototype and validate new sensors. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have shipped production firmware to millions of devices. * Have written production firmware in Rust, C, or both. * Have debugged communication buses on real hardware. * Have built or operated hardware\-in\-the\-loop test infrastructure. * Have worked with contract manufacturers or OEMs to turn ambiguous requirements into a board layout. * Have worked with electromechanical systems or cameras and optics, electrically, mechanically, or in software. * Have working knowledge of electrical engineering and either field\-oriented control or RF. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Latent Defense** Latent Defense is building the world model for cybersecurity; the product graphs a company's entire system across all layers, identifies all attack paths and assigns criticality rankings, and provides remediation for each path. The team is building an autonomous system that rigorously models attack paths, orchestrates agents to validate each path, and remediates confirmed vulnerabilities at every step of the attack chain. Latent Defense is a small, seed\-stage team scaling from a sharp early product into something that runs autonomously across real\-world environments, from git repos to cloud deployments. **About the Role** Latent Defense is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help take its infrastructure from a scrappy MVP to a hardened, GA\-ready product. This person will own customer deploys (Kubernetes, Docker), the telemetry platform, and the hardening and scaling work that comes with moving real customers into production. They'll operate with significant autonomy on a team that's still building out its staff\-level bench, and will be trusted to redesign systems rather than just add to them. *This role is based in New York City. 3\+ days/week in Nomad office* **What You'll Do** * Own deployment of Latent Defense's product into customer infrastructure, including Kubernetes and Docker\-based environments * Build and harden the telemetry platform that lets the team measure and improve system\-wide reliability and efficacy * Redesign infrastructure and backend systems as the company moves from an early MVP to a scaled, GA product * Operate with significant autonomy — take on ambiguous infrastructure problems and drive them to resolution without heavy direction * Use AI coding agents as a core part of your workflow, while keeping the underlying engineering judgment that agents can't replace * Partner with the rest of the engineering team (currently more junior) to raise the technical bar and unblock hard problems * Work closely with the Director of Engineering on architecture, technical direction, and delivery rigor as the team scales **What You Bring** * 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with real infrastructure/backend depth * Fluency with TypeScript, Python, and Postgres * Experience deploying and supporting software directly in customer\-owned infrastructure, not just centrally\-hosted SaaS * A track record of redesigning or hardening systems as they scale, not just building new features * Comfortable operating with minimal direction in a small, fast\-moving team * Agent\-native — uses AI coding tools fluently, but has the underlying engineering instinct to know when to trust them and when not to * Experience at a seed\-stage startup; founder experience is a strong plus **Nice to Haves** * Prior experience at a cybersecurity or security\-adjacent company * Experience building telemetry, observability, or hardening systems specifically * Experience with agent orchestration frameworks or MCP\-style protocols * Experience deploying in 'bring your own cloud' and on\-premises customer environments **What You'll Get** * Base Salary: up to $240,000\-$250,000 * Equity: 0\.5%\-0\.7% * A staff\-level seat on a small, fast\-moving team at a seed\-stage security startup * Direct partnership with the founders and Director of Engineering * Top of market health insurance and unlimited PTO * Hybrid role based in NYC (Nomad, 26th \& 6th), minimum 3 days/week in office **What We Value** Latent Defense believes cybersecurity should be proactive, not reactive. The team values engineers who think adversarially by default, build mental models of new domains quickly, and care as much about the lifecycle of what they build — observability, testing, scale, trust — as whether it works today.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, infrastructure engineers keep a fleet of robots in the field connected and safe to change. The robots do production work at customer sites and stream real\-time video from their cameras. The same infrastructure carries that video and data to our ML team and the rest of engineering. Changing software on robots that are doing real work, over customer networks we do not control, is a problem the field has not settled: how a change reaches the fleet safely, and how video and data keep moving when a network fails. Our software engineers run this infrastructure today alongside the robot software. You will partner with them, own it full time, and decide what a safe release looks like. Every robot in the field depends on that answer. At Staff, you lead the infrastructure changes that cross teams. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own networking, remote access, and the real\-time video pipelines for the fleet. * Own CI, observability, and alerting for the fleet and the services behind it. * Build the release gate and rollout process for the fleet, and own the bar a change must clear. * Decide where data lives, how it is kept, and what our infrastructure costs to run. * Lead infrastructure changes with the software engineers who run this infrastructure today, and across the ML and fleet operations teams who depend on it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have led an infrastructure change across several teams, or founded the team that owns one. * Have owned production networking or edge traffic for a large system. * Have migrated a large system in stages, through breaking changes, without breaking its users. * Have owned observability and alerting for a production system. * Have built tooling that other engineers rely on every day. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, API Products
jobs.description: **COMPANY** At 0x, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience. Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M\+ transactions and $180B\+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto. When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning. **About the team** Behind every 0x trade is a lot of hard work. We integrate hundreds of liquidity sources, optimize for gas, slippage and latency, split routes and simulate every result to get traders the best possible outcome. The **API Products team** turns that routing logic into easy\-to\-integrate APIs that wallets, exchanges, trading apps, bridges and developers around the world rely on. This team of four built, maintains and continues to evolve our flagship **Swap, Gasless** and **Cross\-Chain APIs**, which have moved billions in volume. Next, they’re building new products that give developers even more tools for building trading apps. **About the role** We’re hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to expand what the API Products team can take on. You’ll lead projects from first idea to production, on new products and on the APIs that are already live, working closely with our product team and some of our biggest customers. controls. * Improve permission\-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints. * Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool\-selection accuracy, tool\-call accuracy, end\-to\-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements. * Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool\-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency. ### **Security, Privacy, and Trust** * Make security a first\-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change. * Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks. * Enforce tenant isolation and user\-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short\-lived, scoped credentials. * Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through outputs, traces, and logs. * Establish runtime guardrails around steps, tokens, execution time, and spend. ### **Customers and Engineering Excellence** * Investigate and resolve customer\-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems. * Participate in customer and partner technical discussions and support enablement teams through guidance, demonstrations, and documentation. * Write design documents, evaluate trade\-offs, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and partic  solutions teams. * Demonstrated success leading multi\-month, cross\-functional signals, entity data, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data platforms. * Experience integrating with external agent platforms, AI assistants, or agent interoperability protocols. * Familiarity with B2B go\-to\-market platforms, RevTech, CRM systems, or intent\-data platforms. * Experience with model routing, caching, cost optimization, and latency optimization. * Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, greenfield build:** These systems already exist in production and support real customers today. jobs.title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands\-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on\-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution. The role is DevOps\-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards. The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants. **Key Responsibilities** **Azure Infrastructure Engineering \& Operations** * Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance. * Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root\-cause analysis and implement durable fixes. * Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on\-call. **Hybrid Networking, DNS \& Application Delivery** * Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub\-and\-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior. * Design name resolution across Azure and on\-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding). * Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints. * Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure\-mode design when an edge service or policy fails. * Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third\-party connectivity. **Migration Execution** * Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift\-and\-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post\-migration support. * Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off\-hours production cutovers. * Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs). * Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads. **Resiliency, Backup \& Disaster Recovery** * Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo\-redundant storage, and region/availability\-zone design against RTO and RPO targets. * Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third\-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results. **Platform Services Infrastructure** * Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring. * Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development. **Automation \& Infrastructure\-as\-Code** * Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift. * Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self\-hosted agents reaching private endpoints. * Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI. **Identity, Security \& Governance** * Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties. * Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud. * Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence. **Observability \& Cost Management** * Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing. * Right\-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines. **Collaboration \& Cross\-Training** * Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise. **Required Qualifications** ***Note:*** *Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.* * Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered. * 5\+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3\+ years of hands\-on production Azure. * Hybrid networking: hands\-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site\-to\-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior. * On\-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post\-migration support. * Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy. * Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets. * Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines. * Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy. * Independent troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of complex Azure issues. * Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements. **Technical Skills** Working knowledge * Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs. * Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel. * AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB. **Preferred Qualifications** * Azure certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-305, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-400\) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current. * AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations. * PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi\-site hybrid environments. * Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting. **Work Details** * Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone. * Regular business hours with scheduled after\-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on\-call as required; participation in change management (CAB). * Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

jobs.title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **We provide technology that community financial institutions use to manage risk and drive growth. Our solutions automate key processes – from anti\-money laundering to fraud detection to CECL readiness to lending workflows – empowering our customers by addressing their Enterprise Risk Management needs.** Abrigo is looking for a Principal Applied AI Engineer to shape how we build and operate AI capabilities across our engineering organization. In this hands\-on technical leadership role, you’ll design and deliver production agent systems that combine models, retrieval, tools, and dependable automation to reduce engineering friction and operational toil. You’ll build reference implementations, establish reusable frameworks and practical standards, and help teams adopt AI safely and effectively by building, reviewing, and mentoring alongside them. Partnering with the AI Engineering Lead and engineering leadership, you’ll translate strategy into scalable architecture, governance, and measurable outcomes that improve developer productivity, infrastructure delivery, and operational effectiveness. This position can be based inRaleigh, NC, Austin, TX, or remote and will report to the Senior Manager, Platform Engineering. **What You’ll Do:** * Lead architecture and delivery for applied AI initiatives across Platform Engineering, Cloud Operations, and product teams. * Build reusable agent frameworks, tool interfaces, skills, and reference implementations that teams can adopt. * Design reliable workflows with explicit state, recovery, bounded autonomy, and human approval suited to the risk. * Set production practices for evaluation, observability, security, reliability, cost, versioning, and controlled rollout. * Embed least privilege, permission\-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, auditability, and safe tool execution into shared patterns. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and build\-versus\-buy options using quality, security, maintainability, latency, and cost evidence. * Influence technical direction across teams through design reviews, clear decisions, mentorship, and hands\-on delivery. * Occasional travel required for team events to support engagement, relationship\-building, and key decision\-making. * You’ll know you’re making an impact when teams adopt shared patterns, AI workflows meet agreed quality and operational targets, and engineering work becomes measurably more efficient and supportable. **What You’ll Need:** * Principal\-level experience leading architecture and delivery of complex software, platform, or infrastructure capabilities used across teams. * 8\+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including substantial technical leadership and production applied AI delivery. * Production experience with LLM workflows or agentic automation, including structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, context management, and orchestration; sound judgment to use simpler automation when it fits. * Strong Python and backend engineering skills, plus experience building APIs and integrations with developer platforms, repositories, CI/CD, and observability systems. * Experience making AI systems dependable: evaluations and regression testing, workflow monitoring, retries and recovery, version control, rollout and rollback, and operational ownership. * Practical knowledge of AI security risks and controls, including prompt injection, data exposure, permissions, secrets, and traceable actions. * Working knowledge of AWS services such as IAM, Lambda, S3, or Bedrock, and ability to turn ambiguous needs into clear technical direction and cross\-team adoption. * Experience in platform engineering, DevOps, cloud operations, or distributed systems is a plus, as is experience with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code tools, container platforms, GitHub Actions, or automation in regulated or security\-sensitive environments. **What****You’ll****Get:** * Market competitive total rewards package * To be part of the Heart \& SOUL of a winning company with an inspiring mission * The opportunity to Make Big Things Happen * Competitive salary along with full health benefits with an HSA option * Flexible PTO and bank holidays * 401(k) plan and company match *We are an equal opportunity* *employer* *and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, age, genetic trait, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Abrigo is**committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at**Careers@abrigo.com**with the subject line accommodation.*

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform and Automations
jobs.description: **About us** AbuvThePar runs an Amazon wholesale education program. Our students learn how to open accounts with real brands, buy inventory at wholesale, and sell it on Amazon. Behind the program are teams for purchasing, brand outreach, and student coaching, plus the software that ties all of it together. **About the role** We run the business on our own apps and automations: a platform for our students, an ops platform for our team, and scheduled jobs that move data between them and the tools we use every day. Most of it was built with AI coding tools, and it has grown past what our current team can keep up with. This role keeps all of it running, fixes what breaks, and ships what's next. If AI\-built code makes you nervous, this isn't the role. If it makes you curious, keep reading. **What's already builtAcre: the student platform** The app our students use to run their wholesale business day to day. * Find brands to work with and build lead lists * Look up the right contacts at each brand (email and phone), from our own brand database and outside data providers * Research a brand before a call: prep notes, talking points, and the brand's products on Amazon * Track every brand from first contact to closed deal, with tasks, notes, and files * Write emails that land as drafts in the student's own Gmail, and pull in the replies * Listing tools: copy checks for Amazon listings and product image generation * A background job system for long\-running work, with usage limits for each student Next up on the roadmap: more Amazon data sources, usage credits, and speed work as more students join. **Ivy: the ops platform** The internal app our team uses to run purchasing, offers, and fulfillment. It is several apps in one codebase. * **Purchasing:** upload purchase orders, check the profit on each product, approve or decline * **Student offers:** turn approved orders into offers for students, with a Google Sheet and a Gmail draft for each student * **Offer tracking:** see which offers were sent, accepted, or declined, with weekly reports * **PO flow:** follow each order from close through supplier payment, warehouse receiving, and invoicing (Xero) * **Account management:** track which products each student is approved to sell * **Brand outreach:** a database of 20,000\+ brands and their contacts, with contact lookup and call queues * **Coach workspace:** student profiles and rosters for our coaching team **Automations** * Offer texts: when an offer email goes out, the student gets a text (through GoHighLevel) and one reminder 48 hours later * Gmail sync that tracks offer emails and replies * Scheduled jobs (GitHub Actions and cron) that keep Ivy, Google Sheets, and our CRM in sync * Email sequences to students and brands (Hunter) * Brand research and contact lookup pipelines in Python and Node, using Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, and LLMs **Tech stack** * **Apps:** Next.js and React. Acre is TypeScript, Ivy is JavaScript (pnpm \+ Turborepo monorepo) * **Database:** Supabase (Postgres, row\-level security, storage) * **Hosting:** Vercel (Acre), Railway (Ivy) * **Code and CI:** GitHub, GitHub Actions * **Testing:** Vitest, Playwright * **Scripts:** Node and Python * **Outside services:** Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), GoHighLevel, Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, OpenRouter for LLM calls, Xero * **AI coding tools:** Claude Code, Codex **What you'll doEvery week** * **Fix bugs** across Acre, Ivy, and the automations. When someone says "it's broken," find which step broke, fix it, ship it, and check it on the live app. Same day when you can. * **Run deploys** on Vercel and Railway, watch the logs, and roll back fast when something goes wrong. * **Change the database safely:** write and apply migrations, keep row\-level security tight, and keep backups current. * **Keep the automations healthy:** notice when a scheduled job or sync stops, find out why, and get it running again. * **Watch usage and limits** on outside APIs (contact lookup, AI, texting) so nothing runs out without warning. **Projects** * Ship Acre roadmap features end to end * Clean up screens that confuse students or staff, in both apps * Speed up slow pages as more students and data come in * Add tests for the parts that break most often * Keep a short doc for each system, so nobody has to guess how it works The bug work matters most. Done means you saw it working live, not "it should work now." **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Get access to everything. Map how Acre, Ivy, and the automations fit together: what calls what, where the data lives, and what runs on a schedule. Fix your first live bugs. * **By day 60:** You own the bug queue and deploys for both apps. * **By day 90:** You ship Acre roadmap features end to end, from the idea to checking it live. **What you're good at** * Reading a system you didn't write and mapping it: what calls what, where the data lives, what runs in the background * Deploys and keeping apps up: GitHub, Vercel, Railway, env vars, logs, rollbacks * Postgres and Supabase: migrations, row\-level security, and never deleting what you can't get back * Next.js, React, and TypeScript, enough to fix it and ship it * A good eye for UX/UI. You can tell when a screen is confusing and make it simpler. * Working with AI coding tools and checking their work instead of trusting it * Clear written updates: what broke, what you changed, and how you checked it **Nice to have** * Experience with Amazon selling, ecommerce, or wholesale * Python for scripts and data jobs * Connecting tools through their APIs: Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, GoHighLevel, or other CRMs * Background jobs, queues, and scheduled tasks **How we work** * Find out why something broke before you fix it. * Small changes shipped often beat big risky ones. * Back up before you change data. Never delete what you can't get back. * AI writes a lot of the code. You check all of it. **This isn't for you if** * You need a full spec before you start anything * "It works on my machine" feels like done to you * You'd rather rebuild a system from scratch than learn the one that's already running **How to apply** Skip the long cover letter. When you apply, send us three things: * One thing you built or fixed, with a link if you can share it * What broke along the way, and how you found it * Your available hours and time zone A resume is fine too, but we read those three answers first. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.** At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** The Motion Controls \& Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro\-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software\-forward motion control role for early\-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high\-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross\-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential duties and responsibilities:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT * Object\-oriented software development and hands\-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities. * Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. Supports the distillation of system\-level requirements into sub\-system and component\-level requirements. * Develops and executes comprehensive test plans, including manual, automated, unit, integration, and system\-level tests, to rigorously verify developed software and hardware against defined requirements and specifications. * Hands\-on, data driven problem solving – commonly working directly with motion hardware to move development efforts forward. Assists with hardware prototype builds and troubleshooting as needed. * Documents, implements and tests applicable design requirements for production. This includes supporting the transfer of relevant design output documents, recommended assembly and test instructions, and service troubleshooting support. * Collaborates closely and frequently with Embedded Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and test teams throughout the software development and product development lifecycle. * Provides subject matter expert input and guidance for field service escalations into engineering. * Supports the Mechanical Systems Manager in establishing or updating project and departmental deliverables. COLLABORATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT * Works collaboratively within project teams and Product Development, seeking input from senior engineers and cross\-functional partners as appropriate. * Communicates technical progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly, and incorporates feedback into design, implementation, and verification of work. * Follows applicable quality processes on projects and within the Mechanical Systems group. * Contributes to process improvement activities as experience grows. SAFETY AND QUALITY * Supports the effective implementation of safety and quality considerations and requirements in product design. * Supports timely investigation, communication, and resolution of safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff. * Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following applicable procedures and documentation practices. **Qualifications** Required * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with coursework or experience in software development for physical systems. * **Software experience:** Professional software development experience is preferred, but strong candidates with substantial internship, co\-op, academic project, research, or personal project experience developing software for physical systems will be considered. Relevant experience should demonstrate hands\-on software developm nd/or Python, including class design, interfaces/abstractions, modular code structure, debugging, and unit/integration testing. * **Software development practices:** Experience using professional software development practices such as version control, code review, issue tracking, build/release workflows, and automated testing. * **Product development exposure:** Exposure to software development, testing, or release activities for products, prototypes, lab systems, or hardware\-integrated software. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present technical concepts to individuals that are not subject matter experts and assist as needed. Preferred or Desired * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Internship, co\-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety\-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high\-reliability engineering environment. * Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements. * Ability to develop system\-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub\-systems into a larger system. * Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low\-level firmware, mid\-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware. * Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety\-critical, or high\-reliability environments. * Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications. * Self\-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed. * Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux\-based environments. * Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications. * Exposure to Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts. * Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial\-link manipulators. * Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design. * Strong foundational knowledge in jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship. This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi\-day engagements. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Build AI\-powered agents and tools end\-to\-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production * Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-augmented workflows * Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain\-specific * Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality * Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client\-specific work into product features * Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines) * Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance #### **Who You Are** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language) * Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs * Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data\-grounded AI workflows * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) * You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified. * A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate. * You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building agentic systems (multi\-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows) * Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment) * Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting) * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container\-based deployments * Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship. This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi\-day engagements. #### **What You'll Do** * Build AI\-powered agents and tools end\-to\-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production * Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-augmented workflows * Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain\-specific * Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality * Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client\-specific work into product features * Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines) * Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance #### **Who You Are** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language) * Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs * Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data\-grounded AI workflows * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) * You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified. * A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate. * You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building agentic systems (multi\-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows) * Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment) * Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting) * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container\-based deployments * Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Issue Engineering Change Orders to Platform Delivery to correct architectural vulnerabilities, ensuring all power distribution and backup generation topologies meet strict fleet reliability standards prior to site deployment. * **Proactive Fleet Auditing:** Conduct rigorous, programmatic audits of active Data Center electrical systems. Ensure strict site compliance with Aligned's electrical MOPs/SOPs, breaker trip settings, arc flash boundaries, and critical maintenance intervals for UPS and generator fleets. * **Innovation \& System Integration:** Evaluate next\-generation electrical technologies (e.g., advanced battery chemistries, high\-density power distribution for AI racks). Partner with the Advanced Cooling Lab to validate the electrical impacts of new mechanical topologies, specifically focusing on VFD harmonics and the power resilience of liquid cooling architectures. * **Executive Advisement \& Incident Response:** Serve as the definitive Tier\-3 technical escalation point for severe electrical anomalies. jobs.title: ML Compiler Engineer, Neuron Kernel Interface
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of AWS innovation. Trainium delivers best\-in\-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the AWS Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) compiler, and a runtime that natively integrates into popular ML frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX. Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare\-metal language and compiler for directly programming AWS Trainium instances. You can use NKI to develop, optimize, and run new operators directly on hardware while making full use of available compute and memory resources. Explore NKI: * https://awsdocs\-neuron.readthedocs\-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html AWS Neuron is used at scale by customers such as Epic Games, Snap, Airbnb, Autodesk, Amazon Alexa, and Amazon Rekognition, along with many others across a range of segments. Amazon's Annapurna Labs is responsible for building innovative silicon and software for AWS customers. We are at the forefront of innovation, combining cloud scale with the world's most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. With such breadth of talent, there is opportunity to learn all the time. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it makes for a unique learning culture. Learn more about our history: * https://www.amazon.science/how\-silicon\-innovation\-became\-the\-secret\-sauce\-behind\-awss\-success Explore the Product: * https://aws.amazon.com/machine\-learning/neuron/ As an ML Compiler Engineer with the Annapurna Neuron team, you develop and scale compilers to handle the world's largest ML workloads on AWS Trainium. You design and ship features across the compiler stack, work directly with Amazon ML partner teams to unblock their workloads, and grow your skills alongside senior engineers. You want to work close to the hardware, help bring new products and features to market, and ship high\-quality code. A background in Machine Learning, AI accelerators, or Kernel performance is helpful, but not required. In order to be considered for this role, candidates must be located near or willing to relocate to Seattle or Cupertino. Key job responsibilities * Design and build compiler features for the Neuron compilers. Your work may span the frontend, intermediate representations, optimization passes, and code generation for the hardware. * Own features from design through production: design, implement, test on hardware and simulation, and support customers. * Work with Amazon ML teams (PyTorch, JAX, and internal model teams) to understand their workloads and unblock them. * Give hardware teams compiler and programmability feedback on upcoming chips. * Review code and designs, and mentor newer engineers. A day in the life You start the day reviewing a teammate's code for a new compiler feature, leaving feedback before it merges. Mid\-morning, you work with a model team whose kernel isn't reaching peak performance on Trainium, and you trace the bottleneck through the compiler's passes. After lunch, you write and test the feature you designed last week, then run it on hardware to confirm correctness. The team moves quickly and you are always in the details. About the team We are the compiler teams behind AWS Neuron, the software that runs machine learning models on Amazon Trainium. Our ML compiler takes a full model from PyTorch or JAX and compiles the graph to run across the chip. Every product decision at IMDb surfaces a question the data must answer. The IMDb data science team's work spans human versus automated traffic detection, moderation classification, abuse modeling, audience demand forecasting, advertising enhancements, content understanding; and the scope continues to expand. We are hiring a data scientist who wants that breadth. You will frame loosely defined business problems as well\-specified science problems and select the method that fits the data and the question rather than the one you know best. Measurement ownership runs end to end: ground truth design, evaluation, and proof that the model moved the metric it was built to move. We expect you to use frontier models to scale your own throughput, not only to embed them in products; fluency with these tools is part of the craft.
