jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , DC Console/InfraMap
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Application deadline: Oct 20, 2026 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon's Data Center Bridge (DC Bridge) organization builds and operates the software that runs AWS's worldwide data centers. The DC Console team is hiring an experienced frontend\-leaning full\-stack engineer to build the platform that lets every builder in DC Bridge ship data center operator experiences — not just the team that owns the console. InfraMap is the UI for AWS data center power and cooling: real\-time and historical visualization from world level down to individual sensors, used by Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), the Facility Operations Center (FOC), Field Engineering, Data Center Capacity Planning, and DCGS management to prevent and remediate Critical Site Events (CSEs) and Large Scale Events (LSEs). It has also become a bottleneck: every new page had to be built by one team, inside one monolith, on one deployment pipeline. DC Console exists to remove that constraint. You should be a strong web engineer with real depth in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React, browser fundamentals, and high\-volume real\-time UX — and you should be genuinely interested in build systems, deployment, and the mechanics of how frontend code gets to a browser, because half of this role is platform engineering. You should have a background in the fundamentals of software development, deep understanding of best practices across languages and technologies, and take personal pride in interfaces that operators trust during an incident. Key job responsibilities * Build the platform that lets engineering teams across the organization ship features into a shared operator console — independent packages, independent pipelines, composed into one product at runtime. * Own the console shell: navigation, routing, page registration, and the shared services that feature teams build against so no team reimplements the same plumbing. * Solve the cross\-origin problems a federated frontend creates — authenticated module loading, edge authentication, content security policy, per\-stage isolation, and graceful fallback when the module registry is unreachable. * Deliver self\-service onboarding: a template that gives a partner team a working module, account, CDN, and pipeline in one step, and support for teams that bring their own backend. * Give each feature team visibility into its own module — health metrics, alarms, paging, and user reports — without them having to own the shell. * Move existing pages out of the monolith as reference implementations, behind feature flags so any rollout can be reversed. * Build and maintain real\-time visualizations of power and cooling data that operators rely on during site events. * Support the teams you onboard: office hours, design reviews, and security reviews that keep a federated frontend from fragmenting into ten different products. Development runs on personal stacks — a Midway\-authed copy of the whole shell per engineer, aps deploy / aps hotswap against a shared CDN. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. \*Diverse Experiences\* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. \*Work/Life Balance\* We value work\-life harmony. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. \*Mentorship and Career Growth\* We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Customer Relationship Management
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) organization is redefining how we understand, anticipate, and serve the needs of hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We sit at the intersection of personalization, predictive intelligence, and large\-scale distributed systems—with a mission to create the most intuitive, relevant, and trusted shopping experience in the world. From deeply understanding households and customer missions, to recommending the next best needs to fulfill, to enabling rich exploratory discovery, CRM drives the intelligence that powers Amazon’s end\-to\-end customer journey. As we enter the next phase of our evolution, we are looking for great engineers to help deliver the next generation of customer and household intelligence across Amazon. This includes developing durable customer memory systems, orchestrating AI agents, building global\-scale data and ML pipelines, and enabling partner teams to innovate safely and rapidly on top of our platform. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on this team, you will be a technical leader shaping the architecture, systems, and tooling that form the backbone of this initiative. You will solve complex, highly ambiguous technical problems—integrating multi\-source datasets, designing LLM workflows, building distributed systems that support hundreds of millions of active customers, and delivering low\-latency, high\-confidence signals to every Amazon experience. You will lead engineering design, influence technical strategy across multiple organizations, and help define the platform that powers customer intelligence for Amazon globally. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our team you will be able to own end\-end feature development from helping with defining feature requirements to design and implementation. You will have the opportunity to talk with customers to understand their needs; you will see them adopt the technology you build; and you will use their feedback to inform future development. You will also get your hands on LLMs, Machine Learning, AWS and big data technologies.. Depending on your interests, you may work on a broad range of technical problems or you may focus on full\-stack development, back\-end distributed systems engineering, space and time optimization, or programming model design and implementation. jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agentic Identity
jobs.description: The core of our company is not just the products we offer, but the personal connections our customers have with our brand. You can create digital experiences, from payments to rewards to servicing, that keep us connected to our customers and serve them at every touchpoint. From digital servicing and lifestyle features to secure, frictionless payment options, you can make a meaningful difference in our customers’ lives and help set us apart in the industry. Find your place in digital products on \#TeamAmex. The Amex Digital Labs team drives innovation at American Express by originating, incubating, and managing products and platforms that are essential to our customers’ digital lives. We are a fast\-paced team that leverages emerging technologies to develop digital payment and financial services products and engaging Membership experiences for Card Members. We often collaborate with technology companies and strategic partners to bring products to the market. We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to help build and evolve consumer\-facing platform capabilities that enable secure agentic experiences for American Express Card Members across AI platforms, partner channels, and personal agents. As AI agents do more on customers' behalf, customers need clear, simple ways to understand and control their access without unnecessary friction. This role focuses on identity, authorization, consent, and agent identity. You will own the roadmap for customer access and consent within the MCP platform, building capabilities that make permissions understandable, enforceable, and easy to manage, including granting, expiring, and revoking access as new experiences launch. You'll help customers connect their accounts and grant, manage, or revoke agent access while making it easier for developers to build on these capabilities. **Minimum Qualifications** * 6\-8\+ years of experience in product management, product development, software engineering, platform products, APIs, developer tools, identity products, AI products, or partner\-enabled digital experiences. * Experience delivering identity, delegated access, authorization, consent, account linking, or secure API integrations, with the ability to translate customer and technical needs into product requirements. * Strong product\-management experience moving platform, API, integration, identity, or infrastructure capabilities from alignment through launch, measurement, adoption, and iteration. * Comfort discussing APIs, OAuth and authorization flows, agent identity, schemas, technical tradeoffs, and platform architecture with engineers and architects. * Experience working with engineering, architecture, security, legal, compliance, privacy, risk, or data\-governance stakeholders to launch customer\-facing or partner\-facing capabilities. * Ability to balance customer, business, partner, technical, and regulatory needs; assess tradeoffs and risks; gain buy\-in; and make evidence\-based decisions. * Strong cross\-functional leadership, relationship\-building, and communication skills in a complex, regulated environment. Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, exposure to high heat and exposure to chemicals. **Emotional Requirements:** * Make quick decisions * Hazard awareness, aware of surroundings * Planning and problem\-solving * Coping with change and other people

jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Competitive salary * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Savings bank * Stock options plan * Vision insurance * Wellness resources **Position Summary** AMPERA is seeking a Nuclear Engineer to join its Reactor Physics team and support the development of our advanced reactor technology. Reporting to the Manager of Reactor Physics, you will contribute to reactor core design, reactor physics calculations, and radiation transport analyses in highly collaborative environment. This position is suited to a recent nuclear engineering graduate with a strong theoretical foundation, hands\-on experience with computational analysis, and an interest in applying modern software and AI tools to engineering problems. The successful candidate will translate physical problems into computational models, evaluate results critically, and contribute to tools and methods that improve reactor design and analysis. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform reactor physics and core design calculations, including assessments of reactivity, neutron flux and power distributions, depletion, and fuel\-cycle behavior. * Evaluate reactor design and fuel management strategies. * Develop and evaluate radiation transport models supporting shielding and related design analyses. * Write and maintain scripts to prepare models, execute calculations, process results, and compare design options. * Apply numerical methods, optimization techniques, and AI\-assisted tools to support design studies and improve analysis efficiency, with appropriate verification of code and results. * Contribute to model and code verification and validation through benchmark comparisons, independent checks, and documented testing. * Support sensitivity studies and uncertainty assessments to understand the factors that influence design performance. * Prepare clear, traceable calculation records and technical documentation supporting design decisions, safety analyses, and licensing activities. * Collaborate with other engineering disciplines and support testing and technology\-demonstration activities as needed. * Follow applicable engineering quality requirements and contribute to a strong nuclear safety culture. **Minimum Qualifications** * MS/PhD degree in Nuclear Engineering * Strong theoretical foundation in reactor physics, transport theory, and numerical methods. * Hands\-on experience with at least one reactor physics or radiation transport code, such as OpenMC, MCNP, or SCALE, through coursework, research, internships, or projects. * Programming experience in Python or another scientific computing language, including writing scripts for numerical analysis and data processing. * Ability to explain modeling assumptions, assess whether results are physically reasonable, and investigate discrepancies. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding or analysis tools, including the ability to review, test, and independently verify generated outputs. * Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with reactor depletion calculations, fuel\-cycle analysis, shielding, or advanced reactor concepts. * Experience applying optimization algorithms, sensitivity analysis, or uncertainty quantification to engineering problems. * Exposure to machine learning or surrogate modeling for design exploration and optimization. * Experience organizing reproducible computational studies using version control, automated testing, and documented analysis procedures. * Familiarity with Linux environments, parallel computing, or high\-performance computing. * Understanding of the interactions between reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, and reactor safety. Base salary dependent upon level of education

jobs.title: Senior PLM Software Engineer, Manufacturing Systems
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **ABOUT THE TEAM** Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software\-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations. This work is anchored by Arsenal\-2, our software\-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6\.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real\-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network. MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory\-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship. This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end\-to\-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out\-build, out\-adapt, and out\-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70\+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up. ### **ABOUT THE JOB** MDP is building the manufacturing digital thread that connects engineering release to the machines and inspection systems on the factory floor. You'll own the Development and integration integration layer between Teamcenter and Anduril's ArsenalOS platform so CAM programs, CAI/CMM programs, tools and fixtures, and inspection results move automatically instead of by hand. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build and own the integrations that carry CAM and CAI data out of Teamcenter and onto the shop floor, including NX CAM outputs, DNC dispatch to machine controls and the return path for as\-run data. * Develop custom Teamcenter extensions using ITK and SOA, along with BMIDE data model changes and Active Workspace interfaces, to support manufacturing workflows that off\-the\-shelf configuration can't reach. * Close the inspection loop by integrating CAI and metrology systems so measured results land back in the digital thread as structured data rather than static reports. * Make EBOM to MBOM propagation and model\-based definition data flow automatically into downstream manufacturing and quality systems. * Unblock partner teams across scheduling, applied AI and manufacturing systems by exposing manufacturing data through APIs they can build on. * Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements. * Write production\-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions. * Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks. * Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices. * Join an on\-call rotation supporting production factory systems. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 8\+ years of experience in a software engineering rol MI, and with QIF for inspection data exchange. * Familiarity with frontier AI tooling, AI coding assistants, and AI\-enabled software development workflows. * Experience in hyper\-growth startup\-like environments, with demonstrated success balancing speed, ambiguity, and long\-term system health. * Familiarity with enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, or manufacturing planning systems. * Experience in manufacturing industries with hands\-on exposure to assembly lines or production environments. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Life Sciences)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI\-native life sciences and biotech startups as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build products on Claude that they sell to the rest of the industry, and others do the science themselves and want Claude woven into how their own research runs, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup engineering and scientific teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own research with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the life sciences. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what the life sciences need, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and pushing the boundaries of AI in science as you go. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your scientific domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable life sciences startups to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential life sciences and biotech startups, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they make discoveries, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI in scientific research and development * Work hands\-on with startup engineering teams and their scientists through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their scientific workflows end to end so that your guidance fits into real research pipelines * Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, scientifically grounded benchmarks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, such as example MCP servers for domain\-specific data sources like genomics platforms, literature databases, and experimental repositories, along with agent skills for common scientific workflows * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about deploying AI in the life sciences such as heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, and the gap between a working prototype and a system that scientists trust, and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team, including feedback on the model capabilities and product features that would most accelerate discovery work * Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Represent Anthropic across the life sciences startup ecosystem and foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, in\-person founder events, and research show and tells * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep experience in the life sciences or biotech, gained through research or industry work in areas such as genomics, drug discovery, molecular design, lab automation, or clinical development, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and what the life sciences need * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, computational biologist, research scientist, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real scientific work in the lab or in research * Experience with startups or high\-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly * Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both enginee itch across scientific domains and use cases, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $280,000 \- $320,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications using modern Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and Python\-based application development. The candidate will work with engineering and business teams to build intelligent applications, integrate AI capabilities into existing systems, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions for real\-world business problems. **Key Responsibilities** Design, develop, and maintain AI\-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models, into enterprise applications. Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document retrieval. Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies. Implement prompt engineering, tool calling, and model evaluation techniques to improve AI response quality and reliability. Develop REST APIs and backend services to integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and external systems. Work with structured and unstructured data to support AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and model inference. Deploy and maintain AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. Test, troubleshoot, and optimize AI applications for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement logging, monitoring, security controls, and appropriate safeguards for production AI systems. Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical AI solutions. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3\+ years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, or application development experience. Strong programming skills in Python and experience building backend applications or APIs. Hands\-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, or machine learning applications. Understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases. Experience with at least one AI development framework, such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex. Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or Azure. Knowledge of Git, software testing, debugging, and collaborative development practices. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or multi\-step AI automation. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, and agent orchestration. Experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Azure AI Foundry. Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB. Knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or MLOps/LLMOps practices. Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, Apache Spark, or PySpark. Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or conversational AI solutions. Knowledge of AI evaluation, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and responsible AI practices. **What We're Looking For** **Mid\-Level Engineers:** Strong hands\-on development skills, a solid understanding of LLMs and RAG, and the ability to build and maintain AI applications with appropriate guidance. **Senior Engineers:** Deeper experience designing production AI solutions, optimizing RAG and agent workflows, making technical decisions, and supporting deployment and performance improvements. Candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed. Strong Python development skills and practical experience building AI applications are the primary priorities. jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. **Role Overview** The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands\-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI\-powered features, including problems with no established playbook. The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person. **Key Responsibilities** *AppSec strategy, standards, and influence* * Lead Apollo’s multi\-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi\-quarter, cross\-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence. * Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross\-department decisions. * Set the secure design, code review, and risk model standards used across the department and adjacent engineering teams, including expectations for AI\-generated and agent\-generated code. * Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise. *Secure architecture and vulnerability depth* * Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high\-scale, multi\-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists. * Design and drive adoption of secure\-by\-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF\-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing. * Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk\-based severity decisions. * Stay hands\-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams. *Tooling, automation, and AI (AI\-native by default)* * Set the standard for AI\-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality. * Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI\-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data\-exfiltration paths. **What Good Looks Like** *(drafted from your mission and success sections)* * Owns AppSec strategy across a multi\-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps. * Solves ambiguous, no\-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow. * Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non\-technical leaders without formal authority. * Builds guardrails, standards, and people so AppSec scales beyond any one person. **Required Skills \& Experience** * A track record of leading AppSec strategy that changed how several engineering teams build, with measurable results, typically backed by 10\+ years in software engineering or application security. * Expert code review, penetration testing, and exploit development skills, with the ability to find design flaws in unfamiliar codebases and land fixes that hold up against bypass attempts. * Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes. * Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt. * Hands\-on experience securing AI\-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security. * The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non\-technical leaders without formal authority. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading security for AI\-native products, internal agents, or AI\-assisted engineering workflows at scale. * Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program. * Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open\-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE. **Example Success Outcomes** * An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps. * A measurable drop in high\-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries. * AI\-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality. **Our Tech Stack** React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud. The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD\&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits. Pay Transparency Range $225,400 \- $281,800 USD ### **We are AI Native** Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here. ### **Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo** At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead. We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we’re **all for one**, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) - Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. The IS\&T Enterprise Business Application group is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with a proven track record of sustaining high\-quality enterprise software solutions. Our group owns Apple's enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) transformation initiative \- delivering a next\-generation Product Information Management (PIM) platform that drives Apple's product innovation across hardware, software, and services lines of business. In this position, you will work closely with key business stakeholders to build an enterprise PIM platform that enables product innovation and collaboration across Apple's product value chain. We are looking for someone with extensive experience building and delivering large\-scale, on\-premise and cloud\-based enterprise solutions \- especially PLM. This individual should have sound technical and functional knowledge of PLM domains and modern test frameworks. A great candidate will create a collaborative work environment that fosters autonomy, transparency, innovation, and learning. **Description** This hands\-on role demands the best and brightest; the ideal candidate will be well rounded and offer a diverse set of skills that aligns with the key qualifications listed below. This is a highly cross\-functional role \- we interact closely with technical and business teams all across Apple and with third\-party partners. Collaboration \& Engineering Partnership Partner with engineering, infrastructure, site reliability, program management, and partner technical and business teams to formulate engineering specifications and testable acceptance criteria. Participate in design and architecture reviews as the quality voice \- surface testability gaps, missing observability, and risky integration points before a line of code is written. Act as the quality advocate in agile ceremonies: refine stories into verifiable behaviors, estimate test effort, and hold the team's definition of done. Test Strategy, Design \& Automation Craft test plans, test cases, and the associated automation for complex full\-stack PLM workflows; set standards, estimate effort, and coordinate execution across functional, integration, regression, and release cycles. Own the automation architecture in TypeScript: build and maintain a strictly typed, reusable, data\-driven UI and API test framework on Playwright Test \- custom fixtures, page\- and service\-object layering, shared typed clients, parallel sharded execution, and no flaky tests tolerated. Treat test code as production code: strict TypeScript configuration, lint and format gates, typed API contracts generated from schema rather than hand\-written, and peer\-reviewed pull requests. Apply the test pyramid deliberately \- push coverage down to unit and service layers, and reserve end\-to\-end UI suites for genuine business\-critical journeys. Build service\-virtualization and mocking capability (Playwright network interception and WireMock stubs) so downstream integrations can be tested without waiting on partner environments. Engineer test data management for PLM: item/BOM/change\-order fixtures, revision and lifecycle states, seeded via API or ITK/SOA rather than hand\-built in the UI; guarantee repeatable setup and teardown. Asynchronous \& Distributed Systems Testing Automate and validate asynchronous, event\-driven, and distributed behavior \- message queues and streams (Kafka), workflow engines, scheduled jobs, and batch/ETL pipelines. Write deterministic assertions over eventual consistency: typed polling helpers with bounded waits and expect.poll\-style retries, idempotency and replay checks, out\-of\-order and duplicate message handling, and dead\-letter/retry paths \- never sleep\-based waits. Verify data integrity end to end across system boundaries \- reconciliation between source PLM, the PIM platform, and downstream consumers, including migration and cutover validation. CI/CD \& Quality Engineering Infrastructure Integrate automated suites into CI/CD (Jenkins and Rio) so every commit and every deployment is gated by meaningful, fast, trustworthy feedback; manage the toolchain, dependency hygiene, and build caching that keeps those runs fast. Manage on\-demand, isolated test environments so suites can run in parallel without contention. Maintain reporting and traceability \- Playwright traces and Allure dashboards, requirement\-to\-test coverage mapping, and clear triage of every failure as product bug, test bug, or environment issue. Non\-Functional \& Resilience Testing Design and execute performance, load, and soak tests for large BOM structures, bulk imports, and peak concurrent usage; define and defend latency and throughput budgets. Validate security and access control: role\- and project\-based permissions, data segregation, authentication/SSO flows, and audit trails \- critical in a system holding unreleased product data. Cover accessibility, cross\-browser, and cross\-platform behavior for the PIM user experience. Defect Management \& Quality Metrics Identify and document defects with crisp reproduction steps, evidence, and impact; collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize and drive resolution. Engage with stakeholders to define and consistently assess metrics that monitor product quality \- automation coverage and pass rate, escaped\-defect rate, mean time to detect and repair, regression cycle time, and environment stability. Drive root\-cause analysis on escaped defects and convert every one into a durable automated test. **Preferred Qualifications** Depth in the Playwright Test ecosystem \- custom fixtures, projects and sharding, network interception, trace viewer, visual comparison, and component testing. Extensive knowledge of back\-end development technologies, particularly Java and related frameworks (Spring/Spring Boot, microservices) \- enough to read the services under test and debug alongside their developers. Working knowledge of browser technologies and frameworks such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, including the DOM and accessibility semantics that make an application testable. Proficiency in relational database technologies such as Oracle or Postgres. Depth in Siemens Teamcenter \- Active Workspace, BMIDE data model, SOA/ITK services, workflows, and Teamcenter Integration Framework (TcIF). Experience with PLM data migration and cutover validation \- extract, transform, load, and reconciliation at scale. Experience with message brokers and streaming platforms (Kafka via kafkajs, JMS/ActiveMQ) and with ETL or data pipeline testing. Experience with performance and resilience testing of enterprise workloads. Familiarity with test management and defect tracking practices, including requirement\-to\-test traceability and Allure\-based reporting. Self\-motivated, proactive, and meticulous individual with excellent written and oral English communication skills. **Minimum Qualifications** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in quality assurance or software engineering. Proficient in developing test plans and automation strategies for intricate full\-stack applications. Experience testing and automating browser\-based applications across platforms using Playwright (TypeScript), Selenium, or equivalent. Experience testing and automating enterprise applications such as Siemens Teamcenter or an equivalent PLM system. Hands\-on experience automating and testing asynchronous and distributed systems. Strong programming ability in TypeScript \- typed interfaces and generics, async/await, clean code practices, code review, and Git\-based workflows. Our automation codebase is TypeScript end to end, with Java used on the services and integrations under test. Experience with API and contract testing (REST/SOAP, JSON/XML) using Playwright's API request client, Postman/Insomnia, or equivalent, including JSON Schema validation. Working knowledge of SQL for test data setup and backend verification. Experience integrating automated test suites into a CI/CD pipeline.

jobs.description: **Job Description – Software Engineering Manager** Reports To \- Director of Engineering **Summary** AxisCare is hiring a full\-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high\-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI. You've been a software engineer, so you know what it takes to build software. But your true calling is creating the environment where engineers thrive, succeed, and grow. That job is changing fast. We're no longer coding everything by hand. We're building the systems that let us bring great ideas to life and solve real customer problems quicker than ever before. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.) There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high\-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and you'll be building and leading the teams that do it. We're looking for a manager who's already internalized this shift. Someone who pushes their team to use AI tools aggressively, but who also has the judgment to know when the AI is producing confident\-sounding garbage, and who's building that same judgment in their engineers. Someone who helps their team develop taste and discipline, not just speed. **What You'll Do** Own the day\-to\-day health of your teams. Help engineers develop great daily habits, strong communication, and reach the next level, including helping them grow from engineers who only write code into engineers who direct AI effectively. Partner with product and design counterparts to quickly get from "important customer problem" to "working software," favoring rapid iteration over upfront resolution of every ambiguity. Partner with staff engineers on technical direction, code design, and systems thinking. Set a high standard of excellence and lead by example, including in how you and your team adopt AI tools and rethink your workflows. If you're asking your engineers to embrace this shift, you'd better be living it yourself. Stay hands\-on by running spikes, prototyping, and exploring ideas your team hasn't had time to chase, without taking on critical\-path work. Coach engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build: when to trust the output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing. Teach them to fish rather than doing it for them. Challenge your team's assumptions about how software gets made. Question old habits inherited from the era of scarce coding time (exhaustive PRDs, excessive backlog refinement, premature mockup fidelity, story\-point ceremony) and encourage cheaper, faster paths to working software. Create an environment where engineers think about the whole problem, not just the code: understanding customer needs, system dynamics, and what it takes to run software reliably in production. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly, so clear thinking about what to build matters more than ever. **What We're Looking For** An **AI power user with substance and good judgment**. You drive agents, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and you're actively rethinking what engineering management looks like when writing code is no longer the bottleneck. You help your team move fast with these tools without becoming dependent on them for the thinking. You know the difference between leveraging AI and outsourcing your brain to it. A **systems thinker**. You look beyond the element at hand to the broader dynamics at play. A **strong writer and compelling storyteller**. Remote work demands clear writing, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI. But clarity alone doesn't motivate people. You know how to tell the story of why the work matters, where the team is headed, and what winning looks like. A **humble, always\-a\-student approach** to management itself. You treat management as a craft you're actively learning, and you treat the changing nature of product development with the same curiosity. **Technical enough to lead engineers credibly.** You don't need to be the best engineer on the team, but you need to earn their respect, ask sharp questions in code reviews and design discussions, and provide real guidance. **Experience required:** * Track record managing software engineers on teams building full stack web applications * Demonstrated, substantive use of AI development tools in your own work, not just encouraging your team to use them * Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones * Qualified to work in the United States **What We'd Be Excited to Find** * Familiarity building and maintaining HIPAA\-compliant software * A track record of leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process. You've helped people navigate real ambiguity and come out stronger. * Concrete examples of how you've changed your team's workflows around AI. Not just "we adopted Copilot." What did you actually do differently, and what happened? **Working Conditions** * Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals. **Compensation and Equipment** * Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level) * Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment **How to Apply** Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter. We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line. **Prompt:** How has AI changed the way you think about engineering management? Not just the tools your team uses, but how you lead, what you prioritize, and what you've stopped doing. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find. **Written:** No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop. **Video:** 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you and your team can ship work you're proud of. **Candidates only. No recruiters, please.** ***About AxisCare*** *According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non\-medical (also referred to as non\-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.* *AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user\-friendly and mobile\-compatible solution. Our product is a web\-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast\-growing company seeking high\-performing individuals looking for a fast\-paced, autonomous working environment.*

jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** This role is responsible for leading efforts to develop and deliver complex data solutions to accomplish technology and business goals. Key responsibilities include code design and delivery tasks associated with the integration, cleaning, transformation, and control of data in operational and analytics data systems. They work with stakeholders, Product Owners and Software Engineers to aid in the implementation of data requirements, analyze performance, conduct research and troubleshoot any issues. These individuals are proficient in data engineering practices and have extensive experience using design and architectural patterns. The candidate is preferred to have knowledge in the cyber security domain. **Responsibilities**: * Partner with stakeholders to refine requirements, define user stories, and estimate delivery effort across the development lifecycle. * Design and develop scalable data solutions using multiple architectural components to meet business and technical requirements. * Build, integrate, transform, and manage complex datasets that support operational and analytical data needs. * Develop and maintain data pipelines, data structures, metadata frameworks, and data quality controls to enable informed decision\-making. * Collaborate with development teams to ensure data architectures are feasible, scalable, and accurately implemented. * Resolve technical challenges, support solution delivery, and drive continuous improvement of data engineering practices. * Contribute to integration, regression, and performance testing by analyzing results, identifying defects, and resolving root causes. * Document deployment, maintenance, support, and business processes while adhering to release management and code deployment standards. * Monitor key performance indicators, maintain internal controls, and identify gaps in data management standards and governance practices. * Lead proof\-of\-concept and experimentation initiatives while mentoring junior engineers and coaching teams on CI/CD, automation, and engineering best practices. Required Qualifications: * 8\+ years of hands\-on data engineer/software development experience * Experience with big data processing systems such as Hadoop and Cloudera * Experience with cloud services/technologies such as AWS and Azure * Python programming with PySpark experience * Strong SQL and UNIX experience * Experience with data stores such as HIVE, HBase and Elastic * Experience with code versioning systems such as Bitbucket * Experience with CI/CD pipelines * Good knowledge of data engineering principles and SDLC processes * Ability to detect early and articulate challenges and gaps in requirements with business partners * Ability to guide junior engineers toward project completion and deliveries Desired Qualifications: * Proven experience building end\-to\-end data engineering solutions * Ability to articulate multiple engineering solution options, including pros and cons, to stakeholders * Desire to mentor and sponsor other associates * Cybersecurity domain experience preferred **Skills:** * Analytical Thinking * Application Development * Data Management * DevOps Practices * Solution Design * Agile Practices * Collaboration * Decision Making * Risk Management * Test Engineering * Architecture * Business Acumen * Data Quality Management * Financial Management * Solution Delivery Process This job will be open and accepting applications for a minimum of seven days from the date it was posted. **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Data Scientist
jobs.description: Date live: 10/16/2026 Business Area: USCB Support Services Area of Expertise: Data \& Analytics Contract: Permanent Reference Code: JR\-0000136246 Salary / Rate **$ 215,000\.00 \- $ 280,000\.00** \_ **Principal Forward Deployed Data Scientist** This is a very senior, hands\-on technical leadership role for a data scientist who has built real, production AI applications for internal teams and for customers and knows what it takes to take an idea all the way from prototype to production within a regulated environment. You'll sit at the intersection of our business, our users, and the bleeding edge of AI. You won't be handed a spec you'll work directly with stakeholders to understand the problem, choose the right approach for it, build the solution, deploy it, and stay with it as it grows. You are the person who turns ambiguous goals into production agentic systems that people depend on, and who keeps us ahead of a technology landscape that changes week to week. WHAT YOU'LL DO * Take ideas from prototype to production. Start from a rough concept or business problem, prove it quickly with a prototype, then do the hard engineering to turn it into a reliable, scalable, production\-grade system people can depend on — and know what each stage demands. * Build agentic AI, end to end. Design, implement, deploy, and evolve autonomous and tool\-using AI systems — agents that reason, plan, call tools, and act on the user's behalf — for both internal and customer\-facing use, owning the full lifecycle and the outcome. * Design agentic architectures. Build agent\-orchestration systems: single and multi\-agent setups, tool and function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent\-to\-agent coordination, planning and reasoning loops, memory, identity and access for agents, and the control and safety mechanisms that keep autonomous behaviour trustworthy. * Match the solution to the problem. No one\-size\-fits\-all. You assess each problem on its own terms and choose the right approach — a different model, agent pattern, or architecture for a different need — rather than forcing everything through a single template. * Live on the bleeding edge. Actively track new models, agentic frameworks, techniques, and tooling as they emerge; prototype quickly, form a view, and bring the ones that matter into production with sound judgement about what's ready and what's hype. * Deliver, dependably. Ship software to production on time and to a high standard, navigating the controls, governance, and compliance expectations of a regulated environment. * Embed with the business. Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with stakeholders, shape the roadmap, and translate business goals into working AI capability. * Set the standard. Define how agentic AI is built here — quality, evaluation, observability, and responsible\-AI practices that others follow — and be the trusted technical authority for AI delivery across the organisation. ESSENTIAL (MUST\-HAVE) * Building AI/LLM applications in production — real systems people rely on, whether internal or customer\-facing, not prototypes or demos. * Taking ideas from prototype to production — a proven ability to move from a fast proof of concept to a hardened, scalable, maintainable production system, and the judgement to know what changes between the two. * A proven track record of delivering software to production in a regulated environment — real, shipped systems with lasting impact, delivered within governance, risk, compliance, and audit controls (e.g. financial services or similar) without losing delivery pace. * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI — building systems where models reason, plan, call tools, and take actions, including multi\-agent and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) coordination, tool and data integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the control and safety mechanisms that keep autonomous behaviour trustworthy. * Identity and access for AI — how agents authenticate, act on behalf of users with delegated authority, and operate under non\-human/service identities, with the authentication, authorisation, and auditability a regulated environment demands. * Strong software engineering fundamentals — reliable, observable, testable, maintainable systems. * Excellent communication and stakeholder skills — fluent moving between a business conversation and a technical design, and comfortable working directly with non\-technical stakeholders. * A forward\-deployed mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, close to the business and the user, biased toward shipping and iterating. STRONGLY DESIRABLE * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) — grounding responses in trusted organisational knowledge. * Evaluation (evals) — defining, measuring, and improving the quality and reliability of AI and agent behaviour. * Guardrails and safety — input/output filtering, hallucination mitigation, control over autonomous actions, and responsible\-AI practices. * Prompt and context design, memory, and other techniques for shaping reliable model and agent behaviour. * Choosing the right approach for the problem — range and judgement to select between different models, agent patterns, and architectures as the problem demands. * Leading architecture across teams — setting technical direction that other engineers build on. * An insatiable pull toward new and emerging technology — you keep up with the frontier because you want to, and you can tell production\-ready from hype. NICE TO HAVE * Experience building customer\-facing AI — delivering AI systems that real external customers interact with, and handling the extra bar for safety, trust, and polish that comes with it. * Exposure to agent\-driven and AI\-generated UI — interfaces that agents render, drive, or adapt dynamically. All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave. Minimum Salary: $235,000 Maximum Salary: $285,000 The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above includes only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer - Data Centers
jobs.description: **About Us:** BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food \& beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology. Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. **Job Description:** Controls Engineer, Data Center **Who You’ll Work With** You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world\-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment. BW Design Group is a leading engineering and technology firm operating at the intersection of digital infrastructure and industrial solutions. As the data center market experiences unprecedented growth, we are expanding our team to support the long\-term deployment of large\-scale, mission\-critical infrastructure across key regional clusters. As a Controls Engineer working on data center projects, you’ll be on the ground executing the structured deployment of control systems, networking infrastructure, and integrated technology solutions. Your work will be hands\-on, configuring hardware, validating system functionality, and supporting commissioning activities. You’ll be part of a high\-performance site team that ensures every deployment is executed safely, accurately, and efficiently in alignment with program standards. You will be joining an established operational effort supporting some of the largest and most advanced data center clusters in the world. Success in this environment requires attention to detail, consistency in execution, and a strong commitment to following established processes. **What You’ll Do** You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals. * Ensure the successful deployment of multiple greenfield data centers; scopes will include BMS and EPMS * Receive the applications from the design team and deploy them to each site * Handle point\-to\-point check out of thousands of devices * Configure communication protocols for multiple types of equipment including switchgear, breakers, and power meters * Configure and calibrate instruments (meters, VFDs, flow meters) * Deploy and commission Ignition applications, Rockwell controls, and other similar control systems involving PLCs and SCADA * Provide on\-site guidance and leadership to BW Design Group subcontractors (electricians) * Become a key contributor on one of the fastest growing verticals at BW Design Group * Develop deep expertise in a major emerging market * Grow your skills in leading a large client and team * Grow new technical skills with cutting edge technology * Be provided with clear opportunities for promotion based on personal and account performance Make an impact day\-to\-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team * **What You’ll Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent experience * 5 \+ years of experience starting up control systems with significant onsite time. * Ability to spend significant time onsite 75\+% * Must be open to travel 90% or open to relocate close to site (relocation assistance offered) * Strong communicator and ability/desire to work within large teams Experience with BMS and EPMS commissioning is highly preferred. * Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Controls Engineer, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world\-class engineer and a highly effective leader. Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Controls Engineer but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into a Design Group Engineering Consultant. *At Barry\-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.* Barry\-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E\-Verify. Applicants may be subject to pre\-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments. **Company:** Design Group
