jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Healthcare Platform - Remote
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a senior AI engineer to help build and operate a production\-grade healthcare GenAI platform for patient\-facing and enterprise conversational experiences. This role will focus on backend AI services, agentic workflows, MCP tool servers, secure clinical data integrations, and AI platform tooling. The ideal candidate is a strong Python/backend engineer with hands\-on GenAI experience who can build reliable agent systems using **Google ADK**, LLM tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, guardrails, and healthcare\-safe integration patterns. This is not a prompt\-only role; it requires production engineering judgment across security, observability, testing, deployment, PHI protection, and operational ownership. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, implement, and maintain backend AI services using **Python 3\.12\+**, async service patterns, and frameworks such as **FastAPI**, **Google ADK**, and **FastMCP**. * Develop and operate agentic GenAI workflows using **Google ADK 2\.x** as a primary orchestration framework. * Build MCP tool servers and domain\-specific tools for healthcare workflows such as care tasks, medications, scheduling, patient profile lookup, clinical record retrieval, and EHR/FHIR\-backed experiences. * Integrate LLM providers and GenAI toolkits including **Google Gemini/Vertex AI**, OpenAI, Anthropic, and related orchestration frameworks where appropriate. * Implement prompt engineering, RAG, structured output validation, tool selection patterns, memory strategies, and AI guardrails to support safe and reliable model behavior. * Design secure clinical integration boundaries for FHIR, EHR, user profile, scheduling, and other healthcare systems. * Protect PHI and sensitive credentials through secure JWT/OAuth flows, delegated authorization, token forwarding, encryption, redaction, and audit\-safe logging. * Leverage cloud services such as problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work with high ownership in a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, jobs.title: Sr. Principal Software and AI Engineer
jobs.description: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. **General Description:** We are seeking a Sr. Principal Software and AI Engineer to serve as the senior technical authority for AI\-powered applications across drug development, with a primary focus on protocol generation and clinical trial execution. In this hands\-on senior technical leadership role, you will help shape the R\&D AI strategy and set technical direction for the engineering team, while building critical components yourself and setting best practices for AI\-native development within a disciplined, validated SDLC. You will architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications and platforms, set standards for evaluation, observability, and GxP compliance, and raise the bar for engineers through design reviews and mentorship. **Essential Functions of the Job:** * Build AI and Agentic Applications: Architect, build, and deploy AI and agentic powered applications that accelerate protocol generation and clinical trial execution, from study design through operational delivery. * Collaborate Broadly: Partner with clinicians, medical writers, statisticians, data scientists, clinical operations, and product teams to embed AI into regulated clinical development workflows. * Shape Architecture: Define scalable, reliable platform architecture for multi\-agent orchestration, model and tool integration, and the full LLMOps lifecycle. * Set Standards: Establish best practices for AI\-native development, evaluation, testing, observability, and continuous performance monitoring within a validated SDLC. * Drive Innovation: Assess frontier and open\-weight models, agent frameworks, and tooling, and make sound build, buy, and model sourcing decisions. * Ensure Compliance: Uphold GxP, data privacy, security, and responsible AI standards, with traceability, auditability, and human oversight built into every system. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * Act as tech lead with full ownership of product development, accountable for technical direction, delivery, and quality from concept through production. * Lead project execution, setting priorities, scope, and timelines for the AI engineering team. * Mentor AI and software engineers through design and code reviews, reference implementations, and hands\-on guidance. * Lead cross\-functional technical workstreams with **Experience:** Software and AI/ML engineering experience, including experience as a tech lead or principal engineer owning large\-scale AI products end to end. Experience with fine\-tuning or post\-training is a plus. * **Knowledge Engineering:** Proven ability to design and manage enterprise knowledge architecture, including ontology design, knowledge graphs, and retrieval, to make domain knowledge structured, governed, and usable by AI systems. * **Evaluation and Reliability:** Proven ability to build multi\-layered evaluation, from expert benchmarks and rule\-based checks to human review and model\-based grading, backed by production monitoring. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Fluency with AI coding tools and practices, applied within a disciplined SDLC with rigorous testing, code review, and CI/CD. * **Platform and Infrastructure:** Strong knowledge of LLMOps, secure cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and observability. **Clinical Development Domain** * **Protocol and Trial Execution:** Experience with clinical protocol development, study design, or clinical trial operations. Familiarity with ICH M11 structured protocols, CDISC standards, or USDM is a strong plus. * **Regulated AI:** Working knowledge of GxP, computer system validation, and emerging regulatory guidance on AI in drug development. **Leadership and Collaboration** * Proven ability to act as tech lead, owning product direction and delivery while mentoring senior engineers. * Strong partnership with clinicians, medical writers, statisticians, and clinical operations, translating complex AI concepts for research, regulatory, and executive audiences. * Deep commitment to data privacy, security, and responsible AI in development and deployment. **Travel:** 10% Global Competencies When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world. * Fosters Teamwork * Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback * Self\-Awareness * Acts Inclusively * Demonstrates Initiative * Entrepreneurial Mindset * Continuous Learning * Embraces Change * Results\-Oriented * Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis * Financial Excellence * Communicates with Clarity Salary Range: $137,400\.00 \- $182,400\.00 annually BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. jobs.title: AI Specialist
jobs.description: **Job Number:** =============== 260000GI)**Description** --------------- **WHY JOIN BEALLS?** At Beall's Inc., we've spent 111 years delivering brands, style, and value while creating exceptional experiences for our guests. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Berry Street is building on the convergence of AI, GLP\-1s, and the consumerization of healthcare — while leveraging insurance to make life\-changing metabolic care as accessible as possible for all. Our platform connects patients with 2,000\+ clinicians and AI tools to treat obesity, diabetes/prediabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, maternal health, and dozens of other chronic and acute conditions, working with major health plans, health systems, and care management companies across all 50 states. We launched in 2023, have served hundreds of thousands of patients, and are Series B — backed by investors like Khosla, Northzone, FJ Labs, and the founders of Revolut, Grow Therapy, and Spring Health. The Role This is a founding\-caliber engineering role. You'll work directly with our founder and leadership team to build the AI\-native infrastructure and consumer experiences you’ve always wished existed in healthcare. You'll be one of a small number of engineers shaping how the system scales from hundreds of thousands of patients in the US to millions across the globe. We move fast. What you ship today will affect real patients and providers tomorrow. That's the job. AI is at the core of everything we build, both internally and externally. What You’ll Work On* Architect and ship AI\-native systems from the ground up: autonomous clinical agents, LLM\-powered workflows that replace manual processes, intelligent tools that make dietitians dramatically more effective and help us prescribe and monitor GLP\-1s at scale * Build the infrastructure that makes AI reliable in a clinical setting: evaluation pipelines, guardrails, feedback loops, the unglamorous stuff that makes the difference between a demo and a product * Set technical direction on our platform, making architectural calls that shape how Berry Street scales from tens of thousands of patients to millions * Own features end\-to\-end across provider\- and patient\-facing surfaces, from scoping and architecture through to production * Be a force multiplier for the engineering team: raise the bar on code quality, tooling, and practices without slowing anyone down * Work directly with our patients and providers to deeply understand what they actually need and translate that into systems that hold up at scale **Requirements** * **5\+ years of engineering experience.** You've built and maintained production systems at scale. You've made hard architectural calls and lived with the consequences — good and bad. * **AI\-led, not AI\-assisted.** We're not looking for someone who uses Cursor / Claude Code / Codex to autocomplete slop faster. We're looking for someone who thinks about how to architect AI\-driven architecture from the ground up: autonomous systems that do things that weren't possible two quarters ago. You've shipped something in this space, you have opinions about where it's going, and you're already building for that future. * **A product brain.** You think about users, not just systems. You push back when a spec doesn't make sense and offer better alternatives. You NEED to understand the ‘why’. * **Full\-stack, back\-end leaning.** You're comfortable across the stack but strongest on the platform and API side. You know our stack well: React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL, AWS. TailwindCSS and TypeScript are not intimidating. * **An ownership mindset.** You take a project from "vague idea" to "shipped and working" without needing someone to hand\-hold you through the middle. You flag problems early, drive decisions, and follow through * **A bias for speed.** You understand the difference between moving fast and cutting corners, and understand when situations call for one or the other. Our Tech Stack* React \& React Native * TypeScript * Next.js / NestJS * TailwindCSS * TypeORM * PostgreSQL * AWS **Benefits** * Competitive base salary * Generous equity package * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited dietitian and GLP\-1 care * 401k with match * Generous PTO * In\-office, Madison Square Park * Citibike and One Medical memberships

jobs.title: Help Desk Specialist
jobs.description: **Important Notice for Applicants:** At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor\-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included. Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. **Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?** If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at talent@bixal.com and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays. ### **Why Bixal?** Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence\-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. **Our values:** * **People\-First**: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work. * **Collaboration and Transparency**: Valuing teamwork and open communication. * **Growth Mindset**: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement. * **Creating Lasting Impact**: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change. **About the role:** Bixal is seeking a Help Desk Specialist to be the first point of contact for users of a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them. You will provide both Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, diagnosing and resolving issues directly, from access and account problems to errors inside complex, role\-based regulatory workflows, and escalating to engineering only when a fix requires a code or infrastructure change. You will also be the team's early\-warning system: spotting patterns in tickets that point to defects, escalating outages immediately, and feeding what users experience back to the engineering team. As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one. This role is technical and service\-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support. This is a full\-time position on an awarded contract with a 12\-month base period and two 12\-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human\-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose\-driven culture and prepares you for future success. ##### **Location** This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. ##### **Compensation:** The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000\. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate. **Responsibilities:** ***User Support \& Issue Resolution*** * Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible. * Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve. * Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day. * Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status. * Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root\-cause findings, and user impact. ***Monitoring, Escalation \& Reporting*** * Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team. * Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity. * Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends. * Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements. ***User Enablement \& Release Support*** * Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates. * Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads. * Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback. * Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change. * Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise\-level web applications, including complex, workflow\-driven or role\-based systems. * Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams. * Hands\-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting. * Experience consistently meeting defined service\-level agreements for response and resolution times. * Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user\-reported issues. * Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers. * Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations. * Experience writing user\-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders. * This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract. **Nice to Have Skills and Experience:** * ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A\+ certification. * Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk. * Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections. * Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks. * Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform. * Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user\-facing content. **How We Support Our Team:** * Flex hours * 401K with matching incentive * Parental Leave * Medical/dental/vision benefits * Flex Spending Account * Company provided short\-term disability and life insurance * Commuter benefits * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 11 Paid holidays Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti\-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Field CTO – Mainframe Modernization
jobs.description: Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups. **Our Culture** --------------- **Who we are:** Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\. **How we work:** * **We move Blitzy Fast:** Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. * **Championship Mindset:** We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission. * **Passion for Invention:** We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. * **We Work for the Customer:** We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. **About the Role** ------------------ Blitzy is looking for an exceptional Field CTO with deep mainframe expertise to help solve one of enterprise technology’s hardest problems: making decades of mission\-critical software understandable, transformable, and ultimately capable of continuous evolution. Mainframes have earned their reputation for extraordinary reliability. Modernizing them responsibly requires much more than translating COBOL. It requires understanding and preserving the intricate relationships among business logic, data, transaction processing, concurrency, recovery, and operational behavior, while removing the architectural constraints that make change so difficult and expensive. Blitzy already reverse\-engineers and transforms complex enterprise software at extraordinary scale, including mainframe applications. Our platform has demonstrated the ability to understand codebases exceeding 30 million lines in days, and modernization programs are underway at Fortune 500 financial institutions. Our ambition goes further. We want to progressively turn the hardest challenges of enterprise modernization into automated software capabilities, making each successive transformation faster, safer, and less dependent on scarce specialist expertise. We are looking for someone who combines the depth of a world\-class mainframe architect with the curiosity and imagination of a builder. Someone who respects why these systems work, understands where conventional modernization approaches fall short, and wants to help invent a fundamentally better way. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Mainframe Architecture and Modernization** * Serve as a senior technical authority on mainframe systems, application and data architectures, transaction processing, and operational resilience. * Lead the architectural understanding of how application logic, data models, transaction boundaries, batch workloads, and runtime behavior interact across complex mainframe estates, ensuring modernization preserves system\-level correctness rather than merely functional equivalence. * Work with customers’ most experienced architects to design target\-state architectures that preserve business logic, concurrency, recovery, and operational guarantees. * Guide decisions about what to translate, rearchitect, or retain, minimizing migration risk and protecting operational continuity. **Platform and Offering Evolution** * Partner with Blitzy’s engineering, product, partnerships, and sales teams to improve how the platform discovers, transforms, and validates complex applications. * Identify the most difficult and recurring challenges in mainframe modernization and work with engineering to turn their solutions into automated, reusable platform capabilities, progressively reducing the need for specialized human intervention. * Help extend Blitzy’s World Model to capture relationships among business logic, application behavior, data, and runtime jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Media API Platform
jobs.description: Bloomberg Media empowers global business leaders with breaking news, expert opinion and proprietary data distributed with global reach. With over 30 million unique visitors each month, our flagship website bloomberg.com is the go\-to destination for those looking to stay ahead of the curve. As one of the top 10 most visited financial and news sites on the web, we take pride in delivering top\-quality content that our audience can trust. The Media API Platform team builds and runs the API layer at the heart of Bloomberg Media's digital products. We empower Media engineers to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure APIs quickly. Our tools and standards make it easy to build, discover, and consume APIs across the org. Our internal GraphQL gateway serves backend services and is composed of more than a dozen subgraphs, spanning user and media domains in one schema. And it's growing, soon aggregating dozens of data sources from product and content teams across the organization. Our public GraphQL gateway serves client\-facing apps secured by pre\-approved queries. We also operate the shared building blocks all our APIs rely on: centralized authentication and authorization, rate limiting, token management and job management. We focus on reliability by building automated regression suites that run nightly and post\-deployment, daily test reports, and observability tooling—including AI\-assisted skills that track down latency regressions. The result is a team with wide impact: when engineers at Bloomberg Media need to build, find, or use an API quickly and safely, they use what we build. We are also excited about leveraging AI tooling to build, monitor, and release software, including agentic workflows for live features. What’s in it for you? * **High\-Impact Scale:** Own and scale the core API layer at Bloomberg Media, serving millions of users worldwide and handling up to 300k requests per minute. * **Modern Tech Stack \& Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Work with TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin, and AWS while pioneering AI\-assisted tooling, agentic workflows, and a rapidly expanding GraphQL ecosystem using various open\-source and in\-house tools. * **Ground\-Floor Agentic Development:** Get in on the ground floor of live agentic development workflows, pioneering AI\-assisted tooling and agent\-driven systems for cross\-organization software development and feature delivery. * **Graph Caching \& High\-Performance Scaling:** Tackle complex federated GraphQL caching challenges by building fine\-grained entity caching systems and optimizing response times to deliver high\-throughput, low\-latency performance for critical, high\-traffic destinations across Bloomberg Media. * **Ownership of Shared Building Blocks:** Build and maintain critical shared infrastructure relied upon by engineers across the company, including API gateways, centralized authentication, rate limiting, and token management. We'll trust you to: * Provide expert GraphQL guidance to client developer teams on best practices. * Grow our graph in a secure way for the future of possible agentic clients. * Develop and promote internal and open\-source GraphQL tooling for seamless deployments and adoption of a well\-governed federated graph. * Implement agentic workflows to ensure graph quality and speed of development. * Drive key initiatives like org\-wide identity and access management (IAM) adoption, advanced observability, and upgraded job scheduling services for critical offline workflows. * Analyze open\-source and vendor products to advise on buy vs. build decisions. * Partner closely with product and content teams across the organization, leading technical decisions, designing robust APIs, and mentoring engineers. What we are looking for: * 5\+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, including ownership of systems relied upon by other teams * Expertise in at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript (Node), Java, Kotlin, or Python * A solid grasp of distributed systems: service\-to\-service communication, caching, rate limiting, failure modes, and designing for reliability at scale * Real, current use of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tools in your own work * Experience debugging production issues at web scale. You are comfortable with HTTP, core networking concepts (DNS, TLS, proxies, load balancers), and observability tools (logs, metrics, traces) to identify the root cause of latency spikes or intermittent failures * Strong cross\-team collaboration. You are happy to dig into another team's codebase, understand their domain,help them design their graph or API well, and build alignment * A habit of making things safer and easier for others: automated testing, CI/CD, clear standards and good documentation * Clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions Nice to have: * Hands\-on GraphQL experience, especially with Apollo Federation, schema design, and subgraph development. * Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) * Experience with authentication and authorization systems (OAuth, JWT, service identity/IAM) * Experience with AWS and container\-based deployment Salary Range \= 160,000 \- 240,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique \- watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success. **Accommodations** ------------------ Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. We may share your information with a third party provider of accommodations services who may use this information to reach out to you for the purposes of accommodating your application. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, self\-identified or perceived sex, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, or parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (each, a “Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Radiology
jobs.description: Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** The Department of Radiology Research is looking for a Data Engineer to join their Research team. * Harmonize contributed cancer imaging datasets (radiology, digital pathology, annotations, AI analysis results) into standard DICOM representation and prepare them for ingestion into IDC. * Develop and maintain open source Python and C\+\+ tools for accessing IDC data and converting between DICOM and research formats (idc\-index, highdicom, dcmqi, wsidicomizer and related packages). * Build and run cloud\-based analysis workflows (Google Cloud, Terra, JetStream2\) that apply open source AI analysis tools to large imaging cohorts and encode results as DICOM. * Develop and maintain agentic interfaces to IDC, apply agentic approaches to support the project and its users. * Contribute to the modernization of the 3D Slicer architecture: implement modules against the revised core libraries, reimplement existing capabilities as reusable packages, and develop tests. * Test and integrate components developed by collaborating institutions (DICOM validator, annotation infrastructure, DICOM standard tooling) and report defects upstream. * Prepare documentation, tutorials, example notebooks and webinar materials; support users on the IDC forum. * Participate in team meetings; track work in GitHub. **Qualifications** The Data Engineer will be responsible for developing advanced diagnostic image reconstruction software, more specifically, advanced software for Magnetic Resonance image generation and motion compensation. Such developments include guiding hardware selection/purchase, setting up said computer equipment with the needed libraries and software environments, developing new software tailored to the needs of specific projects, documenting the methods and procedures used as part of these developments, correcting and validating the software being developed, and creating quality\-assurance tests that evaluate the performance and accuracy of the new software. Although not directly related to programming skills, some degree of past experience in the medical field, especially as it relates to patient care, would be considered important, to help ensure the creation of software that remains well\-grounded in practical needs and directly relevant to clinical objectives **Essential Functions (Key Roles \& Responsibilities)** To understand the projects’ needs, and to design, develop and then validate new software to meet these needs. To analyze and help fill computer hardware requirements associated with the needed software developments. To optimize software performance to achieve levels compatible with clinical objectives. To write diagnostic software to help test and ensure the performance and accuracy of all software solutions developed here. To contribute detailed analyses and diagrams as needed for manuscript preparation and grant submissions. To perform all duties related to onboarding and to maintaining workplace compliance/employability. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education** Bachelors required. Computer Science highly preferred. A Master’s degree in a field related to science and engineering also highly preferred. Experience in advanced MR image reconstruction software developments is considered essential. **Work Experience** Experience in advanced MR imaging reconstruction \> 2 yrs Required Experience in the medical field and patient care \> 1 yr Preferred **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** Proficient in programming languages such as Python, Matlab, C\+\+, and AI frameworks like PyTorch. Proficient in GPU and CPU multi\-threaded programming. Proficient with the Linux, Windows and Mac operating systems. Good knowledge and comfort level with some of the main available MR image reconstruction and analysis packages, such as BART, XD\-GRASP, SigPy, and FreeSurfer. A high level of attention to detail, and good communication skills especially as they relate to documentation. **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **Remote Type** Onsite **Work Location** 75 Francis Street **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **Pay Range** $75,275\.20 \- $109,553\.60/Annual **Grade** 6 At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package. **EEO Statement:** 2200 The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857\)\-282\-7642\.**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework** --------------------------------------------- At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

We strive to provide deeply supportive partnerships to our customers, agents, and each other. Builders is proud to be named among the Great Places to Work. Our award\-winning culture has earned top marks in Company Direction, Employee Appreciation, Work\-Life Balance, Leadership, and Compensation and Benefits. Our strong culture keeps us Built Strong in a forever\-changing world, and our AM Best A Rating is evidence of our financial strength. **Position Summary** The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines that power the company’s Azure Databricks lakehouse for its property and casualty insurance business. Using technologies such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow pipelines, and Databricks SQL, the Data Engineer delivers reliable, high\-quality, well\-tested, and well\-documented data to support key business functions, including underwriting, claims, actuarial, and finance. A key responsibility is developing and supporting data pipelines for the phased migration of data from Guidewire and legacy policy, claims, and billing systems into the Azure Databricks lakehouse. The Data Engineer ensures solutions align with the Unity Catalog governance framework and adhere to the engineering standards and best practices established by the Data Engineering Lead. The role also emphasizes knowledge sharing, technical ownership, and long\-term sustainability by progressively assuming responsibility for contractor\-developed pipelines, strengthening internal expertise, and building lasting in\-house platform capabilities. **Responsibilities** * Build pipelines for the phased data migration from Guidewire (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter) and legacy systems into the lakehouse on Azure Databricks, including historical loads, incremental/CDC (Change Data Capture) loads and reconciliation. * Develop bronze and silver layer transformations in PySpark and Spark SQL on Delta Lake, following the medallion architecture. * Support modeling of property and casualty insurance data: policies, insured risks and exposures, coverages, endorsements, premiums, claims, reserves, payments and recoveries. * Integrate third\-party data sources such as geospatial and weather data. * Schedule and run production pipelines with Databricks Workflows (Lakeflow Jobs) or Azure Data Factory, including job dependencies, parameters, retries and alerting; investigate and resolve pipeline failures. * Apply Unity Catalog controls defined by the Data Engineering Lead and Data Governance lead, including permissions, PII (Personally Identifiable Information) masking, tags and lineage. * Implement data quality checks, error handling and monitoring. * Tune pipeline performance and cost, including partitioning, liquid clustering and right\-sized job compute. * Use Git version control (GitHub or Bitbucket) and CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) with Databricks Asset Bundles to version, review and deploy code across development, test and production. * Write documentation and runbooks, take part in code reviews, and take ownership of contractor\-built pipelines over time. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * Associate degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Certification in Databricks engineering * Three or more years in data engineering, including one or more years hands\-on with Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake) * Experience with property and casualty insurance data, ideally Guidewire data; experience migrating data from legacy source systems * Knowledge of Python/PySpark and SQL (Structured Query Language) * Knowledge of Unity Catalog: permissions, row/column\-level security and lineage * Experience with incremental loading patterns such as CDC, MERGE, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) and Auto Loader * Knowledge of data modeling, including dimensional modeling * Experience scheduling and monitoring pipelines with Databricks Workflows and/or Azure Data Factory * Experience with Git\-based version control (GitHub or Bitbucket), including branching, pull request reviews and Databricks Git folders * Experience with Azure data services such as ADLS (Azure Data Lake Storage) Gen2, Azure Data Factory and Key Vault * Knowledge of CI/CD basics (Databricks Asset Bundles, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines) * Experience with streaming (Structured Streaming, Event Hubs) * Experience with API (Application Programming Interface) and integration tools such as MuleSoft is an added advantage **Let’s talk benefits!** * Competitive Salary * Bonus Structure * Profit Sharing * Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance * Employer Paid Short Term Disability * Employer Paid Long Term Disability * Employer Paid Life Insurance * Voluntary Life Insurance * 401K with Company Match * PTO **About Builders** Builders is a mid\-sized mutual with remarkable strengths. Rated A by AM Best, Builders has forged rock\-solid financial strength and a reputation for reliability and fairness in fulfilling our promises to customers. Kind, collaborative, and customer\-centric, our experienced and passionate teams foster a rewarding atmosphere of excellence, trust, and mutual respect, meriting the “Culture Excellence” honors from Top Workplaces. Flexible and highly personal, our experts leverage deeply supportive partnerships with knowledgeable independent agencies to drive better services and protection for policyholders. Our financial excellence, amazing people, and powerful partnerships build outstanding outcomes and peace of mind for our agents and their clients. This is what we mean by Insurance Built Strong®. **Builders Insurance Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We welcome applicants from all walks of life and don't discriminate based on any protected status. Join us in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: **Compensation:** $130,000\-$160,000 per year **Location:** United States – Remote or Omaha, NE \- Hybrid **The job:** As a Senior Data Engineer\-Data Platform at Buildertrend, you'll lead the migration of our data platform onto a modern Databricks lakehouse built on dbt, replacing today's patchwork of legacy systems with a single, reliable source of truth. You'll design the pipelines that bring in data from tools like Salesforce, SQL Server and Gong, turning it into curated, trustworthy datasets that teams across the business, and the AI tools built on top of them, can rely on without double\-checking the numbers. Your work directly cuts down on the manual firefighting that eats into engineering time today, and sets the technical standards other engineers will build on for years. **What you will do:** * Design, build and maintain Buildertrend's Databricks lakehouse using a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture in dbt, and set the layer standards, naming conventions and build rules other engineers follow. * Build ELT pipelines with Databricks, dbt and Fivetran that bring in data from SQL Server, Salesforce, MongoDB, Gong, OpenTelemetry and vendors like Zonda, turning it into curated, analytics\- and AI\-ready datasets. * Lead the exit from legacy systems like BigQuery, Data Fusion and Cloud Fusion by refactoring pipelines rather than copying them over as\-is, untangling circular dependencies, and repointing tools like Tableau to the new platform with clear owners and deadlines. * Strengthen reliability by improving SQL Server log\-ship replication and Fivetran ingestion, and by building automation like auto\-recovery, full\-refresh jobs and watchdog orchestration that cuts down on manual fixes and outages. * Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring and quality metrics using dbt tests, Unity Catalog and Fivetran metadata, so stakeholders can trust the numbers without double\-checking them. * Design access controls for large datasets, including permission models, per\-team clusters, service principals and scoped access for AI tools, and handle privacy requests through tools like DataGrail to meet CCPA requirements. * Set up data contracts with product engineering so upstream schema changes don't silently break the warehouse, and write documentation (data dictionary, ERDs, spec docs, column notes) clear enough for people and AI tools to use. * Build and improve the curated data products that let stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions. * Partner with data science, machine learning and AI teams to build and curate the datasets their models and experiments depend on, alongside the broader data products that help stakeholders and customers turn raw data into decisions. * Partner with engineers, analysts, business leaders and other stakeholders to prioritize work, manage dependencies and deliver meaningful platform improvements. * Mentor other engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate emerging technologies and grow toward a technical leadership role while using AI thoughtfully to improve productivity and engineering outcomes. **Who you are and what you need:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field is required. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science or data analytics. * Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company is preferred. * Hands\-on, production\-level experience with Databricks, including building and orchestrating pipelines, managing jobs and clusters, and using Unity Catalog for governance is required. * Hands\-on, production\-level experience with dbt, including building and maintaining models, tests and macros in a real production environment is required. * Proven experience leading a data platform migration, such as moving off a legacy warehouse onto a modern lakehouse, from planning through delivery, including setting deadlines and owning the outcome. * Experience partnering with data science, machine learning, or AI teams to build and curate datasets to support model development and experimentation. * Strong proficiency in SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Python and working with APIs and large, complex datasets. BigQuery or FiveTran experience is a plus! * Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL and ELT pipelines, medallion architecture and building analytics and machine learning\-ready datasets. * Experience writing data tests, setting up freshness and alerting monitors, and building access controls or governance policies in a live production environment (not just in a sandbox or one\-off project). * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, especially during a system migration where people need clear, direct answers about what's changing and when. * Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical work and influencing engineering standards. **We are giving you:** * Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability benefits * A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future * Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge * Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments * Volunteer time off – because giving back matters * Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best * Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need * Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home * Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team **Who we are:** Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out: https://buildertrend.com/about/ **Working at Buildertrend:** At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. What makes Buildertrend so special is a commitment to ensuring you can have the best job, work with the best people, and live your best life outside of work. Our goal is to create a culture where everyone can make an impact on our customers, communities, and each other. In short: We want you to be who you are, love what you do, and build your best life. *Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, including natural or protective hairstyle, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions, childbirth, breastfeeding, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, reproductive decision\-making), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics on applicants.* *Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A “reasonable accommodation” is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Buildertrend Solutions, Inc. Please inform the company's personnel representative if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process. To see the complete list of Essential Job Functions, visit* *https://buildertrend.com/essential\-job\-functions\-notice/*

jobs.title: Bldg Engineer - Data Center Night Shift
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About the Role:** As a CBRE Building Engineer, you will be responsible for monitoring, maintaining and repairing building system operations and the performance of various areas including plumbing, electrical, painting, roofing, heating, and cooling. This job is part of the Engineering and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for providing support, preventive maintenance, and repairs on equipment and systems. **What You’ll Do:** * Rounds \& Tours: Perform routine site rounds and facility tours to inspect mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, identifying potential points of failure before they impact operations. * Operations \& Maintenance: Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair critical equipment. Oversee third\-party vendors during specialized maintenance and repairs to ensure strict adherence to data center standards. * Procedure Execution: Review, update, and flawlessly execute Method of Procedure (MOP), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), and Emergency Standard Operating Procedure (ESOP) documents during routine or emergency operations. * Technical Excellence: Utilize your deep knowledge of power infrastructure (UPS, generators, switchgear) and mechanical cooling systems (chillers, CRAHs, cooling towers) to drive operational excellence. * Incident \& Escalation Management: Adhere strictly to corporate policies for incident reporting, and promptly escalate critical facility issues to the Site Lead or appropriate tier management. * Safety \& Training: Complete all required safety and technical training modules. Actively monitor the safety of site staff and contractors, ensuring total compliance with OSHA and critical environment safety guidelines. * Explain difficult or sensitive information.**Why CBRE** When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. **Our Values in Hiring** At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications. **Applicant AI Use Disclosure** We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process. **Disclaimers** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. **Qualifications** **What You’ll Need:** * Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5\+ years of experience in critical environment operations, specifically within tiered data centers, critical hospitals, or high\-reliability industrial plants. * Education/Certifications: Universal EPA Refrigerant certification, licensed electrician/HVAC credentials, or equivalent military training (e.g., US Navy Nuke). * Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in operating and managing Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). * Availability: Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, shift coverage, to support a 24/7/365 operational model. **Additional Information** If you require any adjustments or support in connection with your application or the recruitment process, please contact Candidate.Care@cbre.com. We are committed to ensuring that all candidates can participate fully in the process.

This Software Engineer will develop and operate software across the workforce analytics product. The work spans Python services and automation, SQL transformations, workflow code, deployment tooling, and BI integrations. The Software Engineer will partner with data and HR specialists to translate requirements into maintainable code, tests, and releases. Deep expertise in every part of the analytics stack is not expected; the role builds that domain knowledge with support from experienced teammates. Key Responsibilities: ***Develop Workfoce Insight Software*** * Design, implement, test, and maintain well\-scoped software features across Python, SQL, and workflow code, following team architecture and coding standards. * Translate product and operational requirements into technical tasks; collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and HR partners on expected behavior and acceptance criteria. * Participate in code reviews, improve existing code where appropriate, and write automated tests for business logic, data contracts, and integrations. * Build and maintain BigQuery transformations and models as part of the product, following established conventions for grain, keys, history, and query efficiency. ***Integrate Data and Metrics*** * Implement approved workforce metric definitions in SQL and application or BI integrations, keeping logic understandable and testable. * Preserve metric behavior when changing data models or interfaces; reconcile affected outputs to agreed reference numbers and investigate discrepancies with metric owners. * Document changes that affect reported numbers and obtain definition\-owner approval before release. * Contribute to Superset datasets and dashboard integrations, and support evaluation of APIs, caching, SSO, or scheduled\-report behavior. ***Build with Security and Quality*** * Follow established access\-control, BigQuery policy\-tag, BI row\-level security, and small\-cell suppression patterns in code and data product. * Keep PII out of tables, logs, and outputs where it does not belong; Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Staff Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of our core applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex backend data systems, emerging AI capabilities, and intuitive frontend experiences. As a hands\-on technical leader, you will be responsible for designing rich, interactive dashboards, building resilient backend microservices, and orchestrating deep integrations with diverse data objects and third\-party systems. You will champion our DevOps culture and lead the charge in embedding AI\-driven features into our product suite to automate workflows and deliver intelligent insights. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles. This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration. You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites. **What you'll do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems. * Write and maintain production\-quality C\+\+ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms. * Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors. * Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive\-by\-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components. * Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior. * Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment. * Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions. * Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real\-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack. * Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software. **Priorities: 3\-6\-12 Month Goals** **First 90 Days** * Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s autonomy architecture, simulation environment, vehicle platforms, development workflow, and deployment process. * Partner with engineers across autonomy, infrastructure, hardware, QA, and operations to trace representative vehicle behaviors, build working relationships, and identify high\-value reliability, integration, and test\-coverage risks. * Deliver one scoped production improvement—such as fixing a well\-understood autonomy defect, adding a regression scenario, or improving diagnostic tooling—and validate it in simulation and, where appropriate, on a vehicle. * Propose a prioritized plan for addressing one or two larger cross\-stack risks, including candidate success metrics, data sources, and how each metric will be measured. **By 6 Months** * Complete a production\-quality autonomy improvement that spans two or more subsystem boundaries and has been accepted into a release candidate and/or at production customer sites. * Establish the agreed baseline metrics and demonstrate early improvement, such as improved scenario pass rate, fewer interventions, reduced tracking error, or faster failure resolution. * Add reusable simulation scenarios, regression tests, diagnostics, or validation tools that are incorporated into the team’s release\-candidate testing. * Publish a technical design or process improvement that is reviewed and adopted by the affected teams. **By 12 Months** * Demonstrate sustained, measurable ics, and CI/CD infrastructure for robotic systems. * Familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, CMake, and modern software development workflows. * Experience taking robotics functionality from prototype through validation and production deployment. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(HQ \- Terra Bella)

and maintain backend services, workflows, integrations, and APIs supporting commerce applications. * Develop services primarily using C\#/.NET, Java/Spring Boot, and TypeScript/Node.js based on platform and business needs. * Apply object\-oriented design and established software engineering principles to create maintainable, scalable, and testable systems. * Build services supporting order jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in Richmond, Virginia in 1997, CapCenter exists to help individuals and families achieve one of life's most meaningful milestones—homeownership. By bringing mortgage, realty, and insurance services together under one roof, we provide a simpler, more transparent experience designed to save clients time and money. Our commitment to innovation, including our Zero Closing Cost mortgage, has earned the trust of thousands of clients and fueled our growth through repeat business and referrals. At CapCenter, our mission extends beyond serving clients. We foster a collaborative, high\-impact environment where employees are empowered to do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make a real difference in the lives of the people we serve. **Job Overview:** We are seeking an innovative **AI Software Engineer** to design, build, and deploy advanced software solutions that transform both internal mortgage operations and external customer experiences. This role combines software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud\-native infrastructure, and mortgage\-industry problem\-solving to deliver tools that increase efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. **Key Responsibilities:** ***AI\-Driven Software Development*** * Architect, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications for internal operations (e.g., loan processing tools, underwriting automation, compliance checks, workflow optimization). * Build customer\-facing and marketing\-facing software such as intelligent chat assistants, personalized loan recommendation engines, automated prequalification tools, and interactive calculators. * Integrate AI models (LLMs, predictive models, generative AI) into new or existing products using modern development frameworks and APIs. ***Cloud Infrastructure \& Deployment*** * Design, deploy, and operate applications on Microsoft Azure, using services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, and Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry. * Containerize applications with Docker and run them on Kubernetes. This includes writing and maintaining manifests and Helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably. * Manage cloud resources with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates). * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics) to keep production AI services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up. * Apply cloud security best practices, including Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and role\-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. All of this should meet the data\-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information. * Optimize cloud cost and performance for AI workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and GPU/compute usage. ***Collaborative Product Engineering*** * Partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high\-impact use cases for AI and translate them into scalable products. * Work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation. * Develop secure, compliant, and well\-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements. ***Model Development \& Optimization*** * Train, fine\-tune, or customize AI models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows. * Implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for AI models in production. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization. ***Technical Leadership \& Best Practices*** * Establish development standards for AI\-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance. * Provide guidance on responsible AI usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments. * Contribute to long\-term AI strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 3–5\+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning or generative AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, LangChain, vector databases, etc.). * Proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C\#. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including hands\-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and Key Vault). * Solid experience with containers and Kubernetes (preferably AKS), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications. * Understanding of APIs, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns. **Preferred:** * Experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems. * Familiarity with mortgage workflows: LOS, POS, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations. * Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204 Developer, AZ\-104 Administrator, AZ\-305 Solutions Architect, or AI\-102 AI Engineer) and/or Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD). * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or Bicep) and GitOps or Helm\-based deployment workflows. * Experience deploying and scaling AI/LLM workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, or self\-hosted models on AKS). * Knowledge of MLOps tools and frameworks for model deployment. * Experience building customer\-facing digital experiences. **Key Competencies:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions. * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non\-technical teams. * Ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response. * Curiosity and eagerness to explore new AI capabilities. * Commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible AI use. **Compensation:** The estimated range of $90,000 – $115,000 reflects the budgeted amount for this position. Individual compensation will be determined based on job\-related business considerations, such as relevant qualifications, experience, location, education, certifications, skills, and other job\-related reasons. Where applicable, this position is eligible for incentive compensation and/or discretionary bonus opportunities. **Benefits:** CapCenter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, and other programs designed to support the well\-being and professional growth of our employees. **Physical Requirements and Work Environment:** Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may involve extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, and telephone or virtual communication. The position may require managing competing priorities, responding to time\-sensitive matters, maintaining accuracy and attention to detail, and working effectively in a fast\-paced environment. **Reasonable Accommodation:** As required by law, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** CapCenter is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Veteran/Disability). All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
