Our environments evaluate and improve AI models on complex, long\-range, multi\-step workflows across high\-value domains such as Finance, Sales, Retail, Developer Tools, Collaboration, and Customer Experience. Our work includes: * Software engineering environments for coding agents * UI environments for computer\-use and browser\-use agents * MCP\-based environments for function\-calling agents across enterprise and consumer applications We are looking for Staff Research Engineers to advance our understanding of frontier AI systems and develop practical innovations in data, algorithms, evaluation, and training. You will investigate high\-impact questions, design rigorous experiments, build research\-grade prototypes and tooling, and collaborate with Research, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to translate promising ideas into scalable applications. You will contribute to areas including synthetic and agentic data generation, reinforcement learning, post\-training, model understanding, benchmarks, and evaluation. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Conduct Research on Frontier AI Systems** * Investigate the capabilities, limitations, and training methods of frontier AI systems. * Formulate research questions that inform products, platforms, and technical strategy. * Explore new approaches to synthetic and agentic data generation, reinforcement learning, post\-training, model understanding, benchmarks, and evaluation. * Stay current with advances in machine learning and identify opportunities for meaningful technical contributions. **Build and Evaluate Research Systems** * Develop research\-grade datasets, experiments, prototypes, tooling, and evaluation frameworks. * Train, test, and evaluate models using modern AI and machine learning tools. * Analyze experimental results and draw clear, evidence\-based conclusions. * Establish strong practices for experimental rigor, data quality, reproducibility, and interpretation. * Iterate quickly from initial hypotheses to validated technical insights. ### **Translate Research into Practical Impact** * Collaborate with Research, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams. * Translate research findings into improvements for products, platforms, and AI capabilities. * Identify which ideas are ready to move from exploration into scalable, real\-world applications. * Communicate technical findings clearly to both specialized and jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
jobs.description: ### **About CircleCI Engineering** CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. ### **About the Query Team** Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it. The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain\-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing. ### **What You'll Do** * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how we store data at scale.** Own and harden our ClickHouse\-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production\-scale data. * **Build the pipelines that move our data.** Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it. * **Serve data to the product and to customers.** Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand\-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant. * **Set technical direction.** When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how. * **Champion observability.** Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response. * **Keep things moving.** You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too. You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through. ### **What You'll Bring** * **AI\-native engineering practices.** You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. * **Hands\-on data experience.** You've built or owned data\-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event\-driven architectures, or analytical and time\-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high\-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus. * **Backend depth in Go.** You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data. * **Distributed systems judgment.** You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own. * **Technical leadership.** You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. Department of Transportation; TDEC (Tn. jobs.description: **Applications Development Manager** **Clark Construction Company \| Lansing, MI \| Full\-time** We buy the big systems. We build everything else. Clark has 28\+ internal apps built with AI, used by 300 people every day, replacing paid tools one at a time. We are hiring the person who will own that platform and help lead the company on AI. If you have built apps on your own and learned that building was the easy part\-and finding users was the hard part\-this is the job where that problem is already solved. The users are here, and they have been asking for it. **About the Role** This is a builder\-first, manager\-second role. You will develop on an AI\-native application platform using the best\-fit models and tools, ship working versions in days, and define what a Clark application should look like for employees in the field and the office. You will lead a growing applications group, currently with one developer, and serve as Clark's technical lead on AI alongside the Director of IT. The applications team is one of three IT divisions, with direct access to the people you build for and no unnecessary layers. **Based in Lansing \- Ideal candidates may live near Lansing, East Lansing, Jackson, DeWitt, Potterville, Charlotte, Howell, Brighton, or other surrounding areas** **What You'll Do** * Build, test, and launch practical business applications and AI\-enabled features. * Set standards for user experience, quality, security, and maintainability across Clark\-built applications. * Lead and grow the applications team while remaining hands\-on in development. * Own application security, risk management, support, bug resolution, and the change queue. * Partner directly with employees to understand operational problems and translate them into useful solutions. * Explain technical choices, opportunities, and risks clearly to employees and executives. **What You Bring** * A track record of shipping business applications that people use. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Network Engineering
jobs.description: The Team / Who We Are We build and operate the infrastructure backbone that powers one of the financial services industry's most demanding SaaS platforms. Our Platform Infrastructure Engineering team manages both the network engineering and systems engineering functions, sitting at the critical intersection of carrier\-class networking, data center operations, cloud integration, and financial technology — ensuring that mission\-critical investment accounting, portfolio analytics, and data connectivity services run with carrier\-grade reliability, 24/7, for over a thousand of the largest hedge funds, asset managers, family offices, insurers and corporations. This is a hands\-on manager role where you lead through technical depth and strong network engineering expertise. You'll drive infrastructure strategy, mentor your teams, and spend significant time on the network engineering challenges that define our platform's reliability. Your domain expertise in network architecture, routing protocols, and data center operations is as critical as your leadership capabilities. What We Need We're looking for an experienced engineering leader who brings strong hands\-on network engineering expertise to manage both Network Engineering and Systems Engineering squads. You'll be the strategic lead for our entire infrastructure platform—from edge routing and firewalls through data center LAN design, all the way up through Linux systems, virtualization, container orchestration, and cloud integration. This is not a purely people\-management role. You'll stay deeply involved in architecture decisions, technology evaluations, and hands\-on problem\-solving—especially in network engineering. You need to be credible technically with your teams, capable of diving into BGP routing issues, MPLS configurations, data center network design, and cross\-vendor integrations with the same rigor you apply to team leadership and hiring. You'll work with our software engineering, security, DevOps, data operations, and client connectivity teams to architect and operate a hybrid on\-premises/public\-cloud environment where network reliability is non\-negotiable. You'll be both a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and an organizational leader setting direction and mentoring high\-performing teams. Primary Responsibilities In this role, you'll own and contribute to the following: * Lead, mentor, and scale both the Network Engineering and Systems Engineering squads; set technical direction, hire high performers, and create a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. * Own network infrastructure strategy: design and implement scalable data center LAN architectures on Cisco, edge routing on Arista, and edge security on Palo Alto; drive BGP routing strategy for external connectivity with clients, vendors, and partners. * Drive MPLS strategy, implementation, and optimization across our hybrid on\-premises/public\-cloud environment; ensure MPLS\-based traffic engineering and failover mechanisms meet carrier\-grade reliability standards. * Lead data center network operations: manage LAN/WAN/MAN networks, oversee connectivity provisioning, handle infrastructure technology reviews and purchasing decisions. * Own full\-stack systems engineering: Linux systems administration, hypervisor/VM operations, Kubernetes cluster strategy and operations, CI/CD pipeline architecture, and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks. * Drive observability and reliability: design monitoring, alerting, and log aggregation strategies; establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs aligned with financial platform requirements. * Architect and operate the platform's hybrid cloud footprint: manage on\-premises infrastructure, AWS integration, co\-location facilities, and ensure seamless connectivity and failover across environments. * Champion infrastructure automation and tooling: drive adoption of Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC frameworks; evangelize configuration management and infrastructure versioning practices. * Support financial data connectivity: ensure robust integration patterns for market data feeds, custodian integrations, FIX/SWIFT/SFTP protocols, and third\-party data vendor connectivity. * Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure infrastructure adherence to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and applicable financial industry regulatory requirements. * Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor solutions; make architectural recommendations grounded in operational maturity, business impact, and team capability. * Lead incident response for platform\-level outages; drive root cause analysis and permanent resolution of systemic reliability issues. You Are a Great Fit If You're a hands\-on technical leader with deep expertise in network engineering. You can design a data center network, explain BGP configuration trade\-offs with conviction, and dive into a production incident without needing context from your team. You take ownership, ship c s and vendor\-specific configurations. * Strong expertise in MPLS design, implementation, and troubleshooting; experience with MPLS\-based traffic engineering, Fast Reroute (FRR), or segment routing is expected. * Experience with layer 2 technologies (VPLS, multicast, spanning\-tree, VXLAN, dark fiber terminations); understanding of next\-generation data center network architectures. * Hands\-on Linux systems administration with RHEL and Debian\-based distributions; strong command\-line proficiency and systems\-level diagnostic ability. * Production\-grade experience with Kubernetes cluster operations, workload scheduling, resource governance, and service mesh configuration. * Proven infrastructure automation experience: Ansible, Terraform, Salt, or equivalent IaC tooling—not just scripting, but designing automation frameworks. * CI/CD platform expertise: GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker, or equivalent; solid understanding of software delivery pipeline design. * Hands\-on observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack (ELK/EFK), CheckMk, or equivalent enterprise monitoring and log aggregation tooling. * Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/PKI, load balancing, VPN, security architectures—especially as applied to host\-based and data center environments. * Experience working with Tier 1/Tier 2 global ISPs and configuring BGP routing with external partners and clients. * Familiarity with financial data connectivity: FIX protocol, SWIFT messaging, SFTP/FTPS file transfer workflows, market data feed management, and custodian integration patterns. * Experience with SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, or equivalent compliance frameworks; understanding of audit evidence, access control, and change management. * Solid scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Perl, or equivalent; comfort with API\-driven infrastructure management. * Strong communication skills: ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders, lead technical discussions, write clear documentation. Preferred * Experience with hybrid and public cloud platforms (AWS EC2/EKS/RDS/S3\); cost governance and FinOps awareness. * Familiarity with server virtualization platforms (ProxMox, VMware vSphere, or equivalent). * Hands\-on experience with extranet providers and services (TNS, MegaPort, ECX). * Working knowledge of relational database systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and time\-series data stores in financial contexts. * Java application understanding: JVM internals, tuning, GC analysis (given financial platform prevalence of Java services). * Exposure to financial regulatory environments: SEC, FINRA, MiFID II, or similar. * Experience with secrets management and certificate lifecycle tooling (HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, Let's Encrypt). * Leadership certifications or training (Certified Scrum Product Owner, leadership coaching, etc.). * Industry certifications: CCNP, CCIE (highly desired), JNCIP\-\*, JNCIE\-\*, RHCA, CKA/CKAD, or equivalent. * Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. **Salary Range** $171,000\.00 \- $244,150\.00*This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
jobs.description: Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side \- one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k\+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through. We've protected 10M\+ identities, screened 50M\+ calls, and removed 1B\+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action \- for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people. **About the Role** We're looking for an **Analytics Engineer** to own the semantic layer at Cloaked \- the governed set of metrics, entities, and relationships behind every dashboard, self\-serve analysis, and AI\-driven answer across the company. Every number at Cloaked should mean the same thing, no matter who asks or which tool they use. You'll make that true. This is a builder's role. Experience building semantic models for LLM\-driven analytics is a plus, not a requirement * Clear communication, and comfort pushing back on a vague metric until it's well defined **What do we like?** * **Demand Clarity** \- push back on a vague metric until it's well defined. Then… * **Build Value** \- we ship insights and value to our stakeholders over fancy tech / dashboards. * A value add mindset. Cloaked is hungry for insights. We must feed everyone with data. * Startup or growth\-stage company experience * Care and respect for our customers' privacy as if it were your own * **“Work hard and be nice to people”** is a way of working. Not nice to have. **What we offer** ----------------- Cloaked is a well\-funded Series B startup based out of NYC. Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day. The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials! **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market's best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity. For full\-time US employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package: medical, dental and vision with Cloaked covering the majority of employee premiums, company\-paid basic life, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role). **Perks** --------- **Competitive PTO:** PTO, floating holidays and sick days \- and we push people to actually use them. We see time off as a preventative burnout measure, not a balance to hoard. **Parental Leave:** Paid leave for all new parents \- birth, adoption, or foster placement \- because the people building privacy deserve time with their families. **Monthly wellness \& meals stipend:** Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you'd like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer \- plus lunch and coffee during the workday. **Professional Growth:** Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. Additionally team members are encouraged to regularly attend conferences and industry events. We are really excited about having you join our mission\-driven team and help us build the future of online privacy! Compensation Range: $160K \- $180K

equivalent combination of education and 6\+ years of experience in another engineering discipline will be considered * 6\+ years of hands\-on machine vision experience, including smart camera technology and/or higher\-level vision systems * Programming experience in Python, C/C\+\+, or C\# * Exposure to ML methodology and its application in a manufacturing or automated production environment **Experiences/Education \- Desired** ------------------------------------ * Experience with Cognex and/or Keyence platforms, including algorithm development, industrial camera configuration, and coding * Experience with Halcon, Cognex Vision Pro, or LabView * PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) coding experience, particularly Allen Bradley ladder logic * Experience with electrical controls systems and practical application of process control and data analysis * Familiarity with Databricks, AWS platform services, or Six Sigma/DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) * 4\+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $105,622\.00 \- $145,231\.00 assuming full time status. jobs.title: Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: Corteva Agriscience’s Information Security team is seeking a seasoned professional to advance our Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program. As a Data Security Engineer, you will design, implement, and maintain technical data protection solutions—primarily within Microsoft Purview—to safeguard sensitive information across a large\-scale hybrid environment. This role involves close collaboration with IT teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to identify risks, enforce data handling policies, and ensure regulatory alignment. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in data security engineering, a strong understanding of best practices, and a creative approach to identifying and closing gaps in data protection. You will play a key role in shaping the future of data security at Corteva and must be comfortable working across technical and project management domains. The successful candidate may be located in Indianapolis, IN, Johnston, IA, or, for highly qualified individuals, remotely within the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** ============================ * Develop, configure, and maintain DLP policies and labeling solutions across endpoints, email, cloud, and network environments using Microsoft Purview. * Build out new and continuously improve current DLP policies based on customer feedback, business needs, and regulatory requirements. * Manage configuration, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of DLP and data classification policies. * Integrate DLP solutions with SIEM, CASB, endpoint protection, and other security platforms. * Monitor and optimize technical components of the Data Protection program, tuning DLP rules to reduce false positives and manage exceptions. * Drive change management for DLP and data protection initiatives, ensuring smooth adoption and compliance. * Collaborate with security, IT, and business teams to understand data flows, integrate Purview capabilities, and align controls with business needs. * Partner with vendors to ensure alignment with industry best practices for data protection. * Analyze data protection risks in both persistent and transit layers; design sustainable mitigation strategies. * Document complex process flows and communicate technical details to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Stay current with emerging threats, technologies, and regulatory changes; recommend updates to DLP strategy. Develop and execute test plans for DLP solutions across multiple environments (development, staging, production) to ensure robust deployment and minimize risk. * **Qualifications** ================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred but not required). * 5\+ years of experience in data loss prevention or data security engineering. * 7\+ years of experience in information security. * 2\+ years of experience in a senior\-level engineering role. * Hands\-on experience with: * Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MIP labels, Purview DLP). * Enterprise DLP administration and configuration. * Integration of DLP with SIEM, CASB, and endpoint protection platforms. * Ability to lead technical projects and collaborate in a global environment. Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) * CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft O365 * VISA sponsorship is not available for this position. \#LI\-AB1 **Benefits – How We’ll Support You:** * Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills * Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place * Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment * Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well\-being pay per year, plus paid holidays * Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father * Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program * * Check out life at Corteva! www.linkedin.com/company/corteva/life Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team. Corteva Agriscience is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Through a partnership\-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless. We are on a mission to build and foster a world\-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B\+ market, we’re excited to talk to you! **What will the Sr Software Engineer (Backend) do?** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software systems that support organizational goals. This role provides technical direction, contributes to architectural decisions, and ensures the quality, scalability, and performance of engineering solutions. The Senior Software Engineer mentors team members, drives continuous improvement, and collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable and efficient software aligned with business needs. All engineers are granted a Claude Code premium license and are encouraged to leverage AI in their work **Key Responsibilities:** * Designs and implements complex systems; mentors others * Owns end\-to\-end delivery of significant features * Ensures code quality, scalability, and maintainability * Influences technical direction and team practices. **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years software engineering experience * 5\+ years working in the insurance industry * 5\+ years building production ready APIs in C\# with .NET 5\+ * Experience working within a micro\-services architecture in a containerized environment. * Experience working with cloud\-based SQL and NoSQL Databases, and other cloud\-based services to build scalable applications. * Experience using Git and GitHub to collaborate and review code. * Experience writing Unit tests and automated integration tests (Postman or equivalent) * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug issues and improve system performance. * Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams and participates in code reviews. * Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to continuous improvement. **Our interview process:** Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well! * **Phase 1**: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high\-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position. * **Phase 2**: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length. * **Phase 3**: Top candidates will be invited to interview with members of our engineering team via Teams video. This series will include participating in live coding exercise/discussion. This series is expected to be 2 hours in length. * **Phase 4:** Final candidates will receive an invite to interview with our CTO. This video interview is expected to be 30 minutes in length. **What's in it for you:** Coterie has excellent benefits for all full\-time employees. We offer the following: * 100% remote * Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums) * Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums) * Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums) * Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans) * 401K plan (up 4% match with immediate vest). Must be 21 years of age or older to participate * Flexible PTO policy offering employees up to 4 weeks of PTO in their first 12 months. Thereafter, PTO usage aligns with company standards and typically does not exceed 5 weeks per calendar year. * 12 company\-paid holidays each year * Continuing education annual stipend * Annual salary estimated between $140,000\-$165,000 based on national data. Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc. **Work Authorization:** At this time, Coterie Insurance is unable to consider candidates who require current or future visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Falsification of an application, including work authorization status, is immediate grounds for dismissal from consideration.

We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Job Overview** Coupang relies on technology to provide on\-time, fast delivery of products to customers every day. Inventory Platform organization comprises critical services and platforms that take care of delivering customer orders optimally right from the moment the order is placed up until it is successfully delivered at the doorstep of the customer. Building highly available and scalable systems to handle billions of order \& delivery transactions and support Coupang's rapidly growing Product Commerce business is a complex architectural challenge. We are responsible for delivering products to millions of online shopping customers by improving order reconciliation with technology. To deliver this challenge, we are looking for an experienced and passionate engineer who can design and build large\-scale, multi\-tiered, distributed services. **Key Responsibilities** Demonstrate excellence resulting in scalable systems and services with the highest quality architecture and design. Responsible for benchmarking the Platform, collecting metrics \& publishing results. Responsible for measuring \& ensuring reliability and uptime of the Platform with 99\.995% guarantees. Responsible for capacity estimation \& provisioning of cluster for different customer workloads. Responsible for production incident Monitoring \& Alerting for the Platform. Detail oriented and hands on engineer who can analyze OSS Platform components and code. Dive deep into critical system issues, proactively addressing similar root causes, and raise the bar on Operational Excellence. Exposure to one of the SQL or NoSQL database systems. (Cassandra, MySQL etc.) Collaborate with other teams to make the platform open and extensible to unlock innumerable opportunities for innovations. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field * 8 years of experience in backend software development * Experience working in cloud environments, particularly AWS * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining highly available, distributed systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in developing and operating backend services and web applications. * Experience building complex, high\-performance, and highly available distributed software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers. * Strong familiarity developing with Java and Spring Framework as well as experience in an AWS environment. * Extensive experience in managing mission critical services with high throughput and low latency. * Solid engineering skills as a lead engineer to coach and lead high performing software engineers and keep them motivated. * Excellent communication skills to shepherd communication with end users, technical \& business teams to collect requirements, describe product features, and develop technical designs to achieve business goals. * Knowledge of Agile software engineering practices \& patterns for the full software development lifecycle including coding standards, code reviews, build processes, testing, and live site operations. * Demonstrated leadership in cross\-functional, highly collaborative environment. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $164,000/year to $282,000/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Annual bonus is 0\-20% of the base salary. General Description of All Benefits * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD\&D insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Account (HSA) * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program * 401K Plan with Company Match * 18\-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure * 12 Paid Holidays * Up to 6 weeks of Paid Parental leave * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * MTV \- \[Free] Electric Car Charging Station **General Description of Other Compensation** "Other Compensation" includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy\-policy/ *Coupang is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, transgender status), national origin, age, disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, marital status, military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities, or affiliations, citizenship, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at* *usrecruiting@coupang.com**.* Job Requisition ID: R0080580

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Essential Job Functions** * Write production code every week across the storefront, backend, and front end, and carry a meaningful share of the team's delivery personally. * Own the production portal end to end: uptime, page performance, checkout reliability, and defects that affect orders or conversion. Lead incident response and drive durable fixes rather than one\-off patches. * Serve as the primary technical contact for Bag Caddie stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical scope, surface risks early, and commit to realistic delivery dates. * Design the architecture that connects Shopify with Crane's systems: order, inventory, shipment, and tracking data flows, API contracts, and the backend services that support them. * Build and customize the Shopify storefront and custom apps using Liquid, theme architecture, and the Shopify Admin, Storefront, and GraphQL APIs. * Implement and maintain payment processing and credit card handling to tokenization and PCI standards. * Build and lead the team: define hiring needs, interview and select engineers, onboard them, set expectations, give feedback, and run performance and career conversations. Scale the team up or down as the customer's roadmap requires. * Set and uphold engineering standards for testing, code review, security, observability, secrets handling, feature\-flag hygiene, and formal change management for production releases. * Use storefront analytics (GA4, Shopify Analytics, heatmaps) to find conversion and usability problems, and prioritize fixes with the customer and product. * Run the team's agile cadence: sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, and release planning, with clear ownership for each piece of work. * Partner with the Application Engineering, Client Integrations, and platform teams so the portal uses Crane's shared tooling and patterns instead of one\-off solutions. * Document system design, deployment procedures, and runbooks so the portal does not depend on any single person. * Participate in the on\-call rotation and provide extended coverage during customer peak sales periods. * Other duties as assigned. **Physical Requirements** * Talking, hearing and using hands to operate computer equipment * Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus * Job may require extended sitting or standing, use of standard office equipment. * Job may require punctual attendance and regular presence on\-site at the assigned work location. **Other Skills \& Abilities** Shopify expertise: building and customizing Shopify storefronts; Shopify Liquid and theme architecture; the Admin, Storefront, and GraphQL APIs; custom app and custom functionality development; storefront performance and conversion optimization; an understanding of e\-commerce UI/UX and customer experience. Payments and post\-purchase integrations: online payment processing and credit card handling practices, including tokenization and PCI compliance; direct experience with PaySafe or a comparable processor (Stripe, Braintree, Authorize.net); experience integrating shipping, tracking, or e\-commerce services through REST or GraphQL APIs, with AfterShip or a similar tracking platform as a plus. Backend fluency on Crane's stack: C\# or F\# on .NET, REST API design, SQL Server and PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning, AWS services, event\-driven messaging (Kafka, SQS, or Azure Service Bus), CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (Terraform). Experience with Node.js or another runtime commonly used for Shopify apps is a plus. Front\-end fluency: React and TypeScript, state management (Redux, Context, Zustand, or similar), advanced CSS/SCSS, responsive and mobile\-first development, component systems, and the ability to turn rough wireframes into pixel\-accurate production UI without a design handoff. Working knowledge of accessibility practices. Operations: GitHub and GitHub Actions, feature flagging and progressive delivery (LaunchDarkly or equivalent), dashboards and alerting (Grafana or equivalent), incident management tooling and process (Incident.io or equivalent), and a track record of supporting a production e\-commerce site independently. Leadership: hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers; running an agile team; setting technical direction and aligning a team behind it; working directly with customer and business stakeholders; and communicating technical trade\-offs clearly in writing and diagrams. * **Leads from the keyboard**: stays hands\-on in the code while building and directing the team. * **Thinks Analytically**: weighs the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success when making a decision. * **Is Proactive**: takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm. * **Focuses on Performance**: holds self and others accountable to meet commitments. * **Develops Talent**: gives direct feedback, creates growth opportunities, and builds a team that can operate without constant supervision. * **Collaborates**: builds partnerships internally and externally to meet shared objectives. * **Influences**: gains support for ideas and proposals through clear, audience\-aware communication. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field preferred. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience * 2\+ years leading engineers as a manager or technical lead, * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production Shopify storefront. **Certification \& Licenses** Professional certification may be required in some areas, CHB license preferred Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) Preferred. **WHY SHOULD YOU WORK FOR CRANE?** At Crane, we believe in providing our employees with excellent benefits at a Great Place to Work. We offer: * Quarterly Incentive Plan * 136 hours of Paid Time Off which equals 17 days for the year, that can be used for Sick Time or for Personal Use * Excellent Medical, Dental and Vision benefits * Tuition Reimbursement for education related to your job * Employee Referral Bonuses * Employee Recognition and Rewards Program * Paid Volunteer Time to support a cause that is close to your heart and contributes to our communities * Employee Discounts * Wellness Incentives that can go up to $100 per year for completing challenges, in addition to a discount on contribution rates Come join the leader in logistics and take your career in the right direction. **Disclaimer:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** The Principal Data Engineer holds a pivotal role in enabling data\-driven decision\-making across CTS. This position involves designing, building, and maintaining the processes that collect, store, and process data for analysis and business use. This individual is responsible for creating data pipelines that transform raw data into usable formats for analysts, data scientists, visualization engineers, and other stakeholders. This includes developing and maintaining databases, data warehouses, and other data infrastructure. The Principal Data Engineer collaborates closely with stakeholders to deliver and support business operations, with a focus on democratizing data and building robust analytics solutions. This role will develop data solutions, enhance internal analytics platforms, and streamline processes to drive efficiently. **Job Description** **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Conceptualizes and implements foundational data models, Data Lake, ETL pipelines and curated layer servicing multiple reporting platforms. * Writes and optimizes SQL queries for high performance and cost\-effectiveness in large\-scale data environments. * Develops and manages data engineering architecture, and designs and implements Lakehouse and analytics solutions. * Develops and coordinates cloud architecture across diverse areas including application development, identity and access management, network and data management, and security. * Implements data management best practices including cleansing, deduplication, validation, and governance to ensure data integrity and quality. * Designs, develops, and maintains robust scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines across multiple data sources and destinations. * Collaborates with data analysts, data scientists, and software engineers to understand data needs and translates them into technical solutions. * Optimizes data workflows for performance, scalability, and reliability. * Builds and maintains data models and warehouse schemas in support of analytics and business intelligence initiatives. * Optimizes query performance and database operations * Ensures data quality, integrity, and compliance across all systems. * Participates in architectural discussions and help drive best practices in data engineering. * Collaborates with fellow data \& analytics colleagues to foster a culture of teamwork and innovation. * Mentors junior data engineers and contributes to the development of team standards and practices. * Monitors data pipelines and resolves production issues in a timely manner. * Partners closely with DevOps and platform teams to manage infrastructure and deployment of data tools. * Performs all assigned duties in compliance with internal SOPs and external regulations. Brings compliance issues to the attention of management. * Assures quality customer service to all customers. * Maintains good attendance and punctuality per the absence policy. * Performs all other duties, at the discretion of management, as assigned. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or related field of study, or equivalent technical experience. * Experience: A minimum of ten (10\) years of data engineering related experience; To include: + Experience designing and implementing Data Warehouse Architectures, preferably in a lead or architect capacity. + Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, to\-and\-from various datastores (incl. operating systems, network share protocols, web APIs, and databases), as well as for data processing automation. + Advanced experience with database concepts; solid understanding of query languages (e.g., SQL), data transformation techniques, data modeling, warehousing concepts, and best practices. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Knowledge of Azure cloud platform, Fabric data platform, ADF and DevOps is highly preferred * Professional database certification **SKILLS \& ABILITIES** * Strong business acumen, critical thinking, and ability to work cross functionally through collaboration with engineering and business partners. * Ability to read and understand various data structures. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Strong analytical, technical, and troubleshooting skills. * Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance standards. * Must possess the skills and abilities to successfully perform all assigned duties and responsibilities. * Must be able to maintain confidentiality. * Ability to work in a team environment and participate as an active team member. * Effective oral and written communication skills. * Able to organize, prioritize, and execute a variable workload and multiple priorities. **PHYSICAL \& TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** * Office work environment * Travel: \< 10% * 5\+ hours per shift: Sitting, finger dexterity, reaching waist to shoulder * Up to 3 hours per shift: Standing, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, handling, driving, reaching above shoulders, reaching waist to shoulder, reaching knee to waist, reaching floor to knee, grasping items, lift/carry/move items up to 40 pounds, push/pull items up to 10 pounds ### ***The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. The job description reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified and shall not necessarily be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be inherent in the job. Creative Testing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** **Additional Job Details:** This is a remote role, but you must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (API/Agentic)
jobs.description: **Company Description** Cricut® empowers people to make and personalize almost anything—from custom cards and apparel to everyday items and home décor. Our smart cutting machines, design apps, and materials make creativity easy and accessible for everyone. We believe everyone is born creative, and our mission is to put the power of handmade into the hands of all. With a passionate community of Makers around the world, Cricut helps turn inspiration into real, tangible creations—one project at a time. Let’s make. **Job Description** * Spend most of your time writing, reviewing and shipping production backend code. * Use agentic coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including AI\-assisted code review, automated test generation and AI\-augmented development, while keeping code quality, security and human oversight in place. * Design and build APIs and services end to end, from technical approach and API contract through implementation, testing and release. * Contribute to backend architecture across our C\#/.NET and Python services, keeping them modular, maintainable and testable. * Define clear, versioned API contracts that client teams on iOS, Android and desktop can consume easily. * Work closely with Product Management, UX and client engineers to take defined features from spec to shipped, raising technical tradeoffs and feasibility early. * Optimize service performance and scalability, including latency, throughput, database query efficiency, caching, concurrency and cloud cost. * Write and maintain automated unit, integration and contract tests for your services. * Drive CI/CD automation, release quality and deployment processes for containerized cloud services. * Ship behind feature flags with progressive rollout and kill switches, and validate new behavior with production telemetry before ramping up. * Own service health through observability, tracking SLOs, error rates, latency budgets and defect trends, and take part in on\-call and incident response. * Take part in code reviews and share knowledge with other engineers. * Evaluate new backend, cloud, AI and tooling technologies, and recommend adopting them where they would meaningfully improve the team's work. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years of professional backend software development experience, with deep, production\-level expertise in either C\#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) or Python (FastAPI/Django). * Proven experience designing and running backend architectures at scale: microservices or modular monoliths, event\-driven and asynchronous messaging (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus), and distributed systems patterns. * Strong API design skills using REST, including versioning, pagination, idempotency, error handling and OpenAPI documentation. * Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), including schema design, indexing and query tuning. * Strong understanding of the concurrency model in your primary language (async/await and the Task Parallel Library in .NET, or asyncio in Python). * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or equivalent). * At least one year of hands\-on, practical use of modern AI engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), with experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into backend services where relevant (agentic patterns, evals, and latency/cost/reliability tradeoffs). * Experience with architectural patterns such as Clean Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, CQRS or hexagonal architecture. * Strong debugging, profiling and performance optimization skills with tools such as dotTrace/PerfView, py\-spy/cProfile and APM tracing. * Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, contract, load) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). * Experience instrumenting services with observability tools (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana). * **Bonus:** experience with both C\# and Python. * **Bonus:** experience working with client engineering teams (iOS, Android, Electron/Angular) to design APIs that fit mobile and desktop needs. Soft Skills * Communicates clearly in writing and in person with engineering, product and design. * Works well with Product Management, UX and client teams, and builds agreement on scope and tradeoffs. * Shares knowledge readily and helps other engineers on the team grow. * Stays curious about new tools and techniques, especially in AI\-assisted development, and brings practical improvements to the team. **Additional Information** **We’ve Got You Covered** At Cricut, we take care of our people. Enjoy competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, a 401(k) match, generous PTO, tuition reimbursement, and a yearly lifestyle stipend to support your wellness and passions. You’ll also receive exclusive employee discounts—and best of all, you’ll be surrounded by some of the most talented, creative, and curious minds out there. **A Quick Note Before You Apply…** Cricut is in an exciting chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across everything we do. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone. We’re looking for A\-players—people who thrive in dynamic environments, turn challenges into momentum, and consistently deliver their best work. If that sounds like you, read on. **Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):** * You move with urgency. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act—you start, learn, and adjust. * You set high standards. You take ownership, deliver quality, and hold yourself accountable. * You stay focused when things move fast. You prioritize what matters most and tune out the noise. * You collaborate like a pro. You elevate others, communicate clearly, and bring a low\-ego, high\-output energy. * You embrace AI as part of your toolkit. From idea exploration to data analysis and creative problem\-solving, you leverage AI to accelerate innovation and amplify impact—because technology and creativity go hand\-in\-hand here. **One More Thing (It’s a Big One)** This role is in\-office at least 4–5 days per week. We believe real collaboration, innovation, and culture are built face\-to\-face. If you’re energized by working alongside smart, kind, creative people—and love those hallway conversations that spark the next great idea—you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for a fully remote role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re excited by challenge, purpose, and building something better—let’s make something amazing together. **Relocation Statement:** * This position is eligible for relocation assistance. **What to Do Next:** Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut® is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information. Cricut® is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E\-Verify.

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: Cross Catholic Outreach is a Catholic ministry with an ecumenical staff of Catholic, Protestant, and Eastern Orthodox believers working in unity to provide food, water, housing, education, orphan support, medical care, micro\-enterprise, disaster relief, and the love of our Lord Jesus Christ to the poorest of the poor in more than 30 countries around the world. We believe strongly in unifying Christians in this mission of mercy, and we believe that creating a welcoming work environment for all Christian faiths is essential to achieving our ministry goals. **Best Christian Workplace 2026** **U.S. Residents Only** **Position****Title:** Web Developer **Department:** Technology Services **Reports to:** Associate Director of Web Development **Position Location:** Remote **Position Type:** Exempt or Hourly (As determined by Human Resources) Position Summary: The Web Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization’s web platforms through daily maintenance, security, and feature delivery across public websites, e\-commerce back\-end systems, and related integrations. The role focuses on strong PHP development (Laravel preferred), middleware services, and full\-stack engineering across backend systems, integrations, and application architecture, as well as operational tasks such as DNS configuration, email deliverability, patching, monitoring, backups, and access controls. Typical work includes designing and developing new applications and tools, implementing features, fixing defects, integrating APIs, monitoring jobs and webhooks, and troubleshooting production issues. The position also supports SharePoint Online updates and basic PowerApps changes. This role contributes to secure, performant, and accessible digital experiences that advance fundraising and engagement goals and requires the ability to independently deliver technical solutions from concept through production. **Educational or Certiﬁcation Requirements:** ============================================= * Degree in Computer Science, information technology, or equivalent experience * Relevant professional certifications are a plus * Ability to provide code samples or a portfolio demonstrating applications built from scratch **Experience Requirements:** ============================ * 4 to 7 years building and maintaining production web systems, including experience architecting applications from concept through deployment * Strong proficiency in PHP with experience building production\-grade applications (Laravel preferred), including deep understanding of the Laravel ecosystem (Eloquent ORM, queues, jobs, events, middleware, APIs, service container) * Proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework, Next.js strongly preferred (React or Vue acceptable), including component architecture, API routes, and server\-side rendering concepts * Solid front\-end skills in HTML, CSS (SCSS/SASS), and vanilla JavaScript, plus basic Node.js where applicable * Proven ability to build applications and systems from scratch, not just modify existing platforms * Experience designing database schemas, writing optimized queries, and handling complex datasets in SQL/MySQL * Experience with e\-commerce platforms, shopping cart technologies, and payment service providers or gateways * Hands\-on experience configuring SharePoint lists, libraries, and permissions, plus building basic Power Automate flows * Proficient with Git/GitHub, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review workflows * Experience with automated testing practices and CI/CD deployment pipelines * Knowledge of email infrastructure: DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, and deliverability best practices **Knowledge, Skills, \& Character Required:** ============================================= * Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ; maintains a courteous, Christ\-like attitude in * dealing with people within and outside of the ministry. * Feels a calling to serve God through serving Cross Catholic Outreach in this capacity. * Believes in and supports the mission and ministry of Cross Catholic Outreach and agrees with the conduct policies and conduct expectations of Cross Catholic Outreach. * Understanding of e\-commerce operations, including PCI considerations, tokenized payments, refunds, chargebacks, fraud checks, reconciliation, and reporting * Good grasp of web security, performance, accessibility, and SEO fundamentals * Ability to translate technical issues for nontechnical audiences * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and proactive mindset * Clear communicator and effective collaborator across teams * Familiar with providing tier 3 support for issues involving unexpected interface behavior or back\-end code defects * Knowledge of building and integrating APIs, REST patterns, and secure webhooks * Strong understanding of backend architecture patterns and API design (RESTful and/or event\-driven) * Knowledge of serverless approaches such as Netlify Functions or Cloudflare Workers * Knowledge of hosting environments and servers, DNS, SFTP/FTP, SSL, and CDNs * Knowledge of and working experience with WordPress and site builders * Ability to work across the stack, with a backend\-heavy focus and modern development practices * Ability to effectively interface with technical and nontechnical staff at all organizational levels * Able to work in a team environment while working independently as needed * Ability to engage vendor support on technical and functional issues * Competent at analyzing issues and determining practical solutions * Ability to produce clear written documentation such as procedures, summaries, and reports **Duties:** =========== * Design, build, and maintain WordPress sites, custom PHP/Laravel applications, and middleware services, with an emphasis on scalable architecture and clean code practices * Build and manage secure API integrations, including designing and implementing services between CRMs, fundraising systems, and marketing tools * Design and develop custom web applications, internal tools, and backend systems from the ground up * Design and build standalone web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks where PHP/WordPress is not the right fit for the use case * Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, data models, and system designs * Own end\-to\-end integration development, including data flows, transformation logic, orchestration, and failure handling * Support and extend e\-commerce platforms: manage webhooks and background jobs, payment flows and gateways, subscriptions, coupons, tax and shipping rules, error handling and retries, fraud checks, reconciliation and reporting, and security compliance * Implement and monitor analytics, event tracking, and marketing tags, including Meta Pixel and Conversions API * Manage DNS and email reputation settings (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to support campaign deliverability * Support SharePoint Online and PowerApps projects as needed * Troubleshoot and resolve tier 3 production issues quickly and effectively * Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver new features, templates, and site improvements * Participate in code reviews, maintain version control standards, and document development processes * Research and recommend improvements in tools, frameworks, and workflows * Other duties as assigned * This position may require occasional domestic and/or international travel to attend meetings, trainings, conferences, or organizational events. Travel may be conducted by airplane, automobile, bus, or other reasonable means. Travel frequency is expected to be limited and scheduled in advance when possible.

jobs.title: AVP, Engineering
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Cross River builds the infrastructure behind the world's most innovative financial products. Our technology and capital solutions power payments, cards, lending, and digital asset capabilities that move money safely, instantly, and inclusively — trusted by leading fintechs, enterprises, and disruptors across the globe. Our mission is simple: to build the financial infrastructure that expands access and opportunity for all. You'll be a technical leader who balances hands\-on engineering expertise with people management, driving reliable platforms and scalable solutions across complex domains. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer and people leader who is passionate about building high\-performing teams that deliver mission\-critical lending infrastructure at scale. **Responsibilities:** * Lead, mentor, and grow an engineering team while supporting recruiting, hiring, and career development * Partner with Product Management and cross\-functional stakeholders to set priorities and deliver high\-impact features * Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security * Own delivery from design to deployment and champion strong engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, and code review * Promote operational excellence and continuous improvement through monitoring, incident response, post\-mortems, and data\-driven decisions **Qualifications:** **Required:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3\+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles * Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, C\#, or similar), with experience in SQL/NoSQL databases and caching * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms and event\-driven systems * Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling high\-performing engineering teams * Experience delivering complex, distributed systems in production environments * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels **Preferred:** * Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or other regulated industries, ideally with Banking\-as\-a\-Service or financial technology platforms * Experience with high\-availability, high\-throughput transaction processing systems \#LI\-AL1 \#LI\-Remote Salary Range: $170,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 Cross River is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Cross River does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. The mandate is broad: understand where AI is going, identify new approaches to cybersecurity, and build systems that fundamentally improve how defenders operate. You will build against what is possible today while anticipating what advances in models and agentic systems could make possible over the next 12\-24 months. That means thinking about the entire application and the systems behind it, from models and agents to security data, tools, and execution environments. The work may span autonomous investigation, threat hunting, adversary simulation, detection, response, and remediation. Some of the most important use cases have yet to be defined. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be one of the senior technical leaders of the Lab. You will make original technical contributions while setting direction for teams working on these problems. You will identify important research questions, develop new approaches, build prototypes, establish rigorous evaluations, and help turn successful research into capabilities that operate at CrowdStrike scale. **What You'll Do:** * Define the future of cybersecurity AI. Use investigations, adversary behavior, simulations, and expert feedback to improve system behavior. Explore how offensive validation and defensive outcomes can generate better evidence, evaluations, and training signals. Work directly with threat researchers, incident responders, red teamers, and other security experts to keep the research grounded in real\-world defense. * Establish rigorous evaluations. Build benchmarks, cyber environments, and evaluation harnesses that expose capabilities and failure modes. You can formulate hypotheses, design meaningful experiments, establish credible baselines, and follow the evidence. * Experience taking sophisticated ML or AI systems from research prototypes to real\-world deployment. * Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including setting research and engineering direction, mentoring senior technical talent, and influencing major decisions through technical depth and evidence. * Research or engineering experience with autonomous or multi\-agent systems, long\-horizon reasoning, adversary simulation, or closed\-loop security systems. * Experience with adversarial learning, reinforcement learning, model post\-training, synthetic data, or other methods for improving AI systems through interaction and feedback. * Experience building AI systems for high\-volume, latency\-sensitive cybersecurity environments. * Experience architecting and building extensible AI or agentic platforms that enable teams to develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy sophisticated AI applications at scale. * Contributions to influential research, open\-source software, or technical communities spanning AI and cybersecurity. \#LI\-AM1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** Product Engineering at Decagon builds all aspects of the platform our customers use to create, operate, and improve their AI agents. We turn work that currently requires an engineer into product that a CX team can run themselves. This team is core to how Decagon scales. The frameworks we build support every agent we have in production, each with its own workflows, data, and constraints. We build the agents too, and that’s what keeps the platform honest: a failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, an eval, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere. Our agents run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS. **About the Role** You’ll design and build the systems that let customers configure, train, test, and monitor sophisticated AI agents with confidence. That means strong engineering underneath, and abstractions on top that hold up across different use cases without forking per customer. You’ll work day to day with product and design: joining discovery, defining requirements, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their use cases in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them. Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. **In this role, you will** * Eliminate manual work by building self\-serve functionality for agent configuration, training, and deployment * Design configuration abstractions that balance power and simplicity, handling diverse enterprise use cases while staying usable by non\-technical teams * Build AI\-powered tooling that lets CX and ops teams create and manage complex agent workflows without writing code * Build monitoring, tracing, and analytics that surface actionable signal, so customers can see where an agent is failing and why * Handle agentic systems at scale; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies. * Run evaluations on new text and voice models, then integrate the ones that win into production traffic **Your background and skillset look something like this** * 4\+ years building software products, with strong product thinking * Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack * Experience translating complex technical capabilities into simple, usable interfaces * Complex systems instincts, including asynchronous programming and the failure modes that only appear at scale * A high degree of comfort debugging system failures in deep technology stacks, using whatever tool gets you to the answer * A knack for turning customer asks into clear, well\-scoped product and technical specs * Judgment about when to ship fast and when to slow down and build it correctly **Even better** * Background with LLMs, prompt engineering, evals, or AI agent systems * Experience building developer tools, APIs, platforms, or internal tools that became customer\-facing * Experience with observability, data visualization, or analytics products * Experience building security\-sensitive product systems, such as authentication and data access controls * Work with multi\-modal or voice models **Compensation** $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States. **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K
