jobs.description: Defibtech is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer responsible for production tools, databases, platforms, and test station software used in the manufacture of medical devices, which are deployed both on site and at Defibtech’s contract manufacturers. This role is primarily focused on software design and maintenance to support new products, sustain products, and make process improvements to our production tools and systems. This role is based onsite at our Branford, CT manufacturing location, hybrid capable. **Core Responsibilities:** * Supports and implements updates on\-site and at contract manufacturing sites to support Defibtech production systems. * Develops and maintains production tools and systems, which are used to interface with Defibtech devices and test equipment, program and test the devices, generate labels, and automate recording of test data. Software development is inclusive of coding, sandbox testing, documentation, writing and executing test protocols, and managing release of the code through the Engineering Change process, all according to quality and regulatory requirements. * Performs test station environment and database qualifications and supports verification and validation testing as required. * Serves as central contact for production and pilot test station setup and troubleshooting. * Generates and executes data queries in support of production investigations. * Participates in cross\-functional teams and facilitates the transfer of development projects into the manufacturing production test environment. * Identifies and implements improvements in both database and software development processes and develops and implements new software for new product rollouts, as required. * Supports and leads investigations, including identification of root cause and implementation of corrective or preventative actions using various Defibtech processes (CAPA, PAF, SCAR, etc.). * Creates and manages documentation utilizing Defibtech’s Change Control process, including ECR/ECO, station specifications, documents, and test protocols. * Demonstrates Defibtech’s values on the job. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Technology Behind Medical Imaging \- This role is not hybrid or remote, must be able to work in office in Bloomingdale, IL location. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control? Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real\-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production. We are particularly interested in engineers who understand what happens below the application layer—people who can write efficient firmware, debug hardware\-software interactions, and develop dependable embedded solutions rather than relying exclusively on high\-level software frameworks. What You'll Do * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using C and/or C\+\+. * Develop bare\-metal firmware for microcontroller\-based systems and real\-time applications. * Design and improve motion\-control functionality involving motors, encoders, sensors, and actuators. * Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including CAN/CANopen, RS\-232, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet. * Collaborate with electrical engineers on PCB bring\-up, electronic interfaces, and hardware\-software integration. * Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve complex technical problems. * Develop software verification tests, investigate failures, and improve system reliability. * Document software architecture, interfaces, requirements, testing, and engineering changes. * Support prototype development, production troubleshooting, and ongoing product improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and product engineering teams. What We're Looking For Required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 7\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience. * Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C\+\+. * Demonstrated experience with bare\-metal programming and microcontroller\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues. * Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software. Highly desirable experience: * Motor control, motion\-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real\-time control. * Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability\-critical products. * Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation. * RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics. * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements. What Makes This Opportunity Different? * Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment. * Hands\-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems. * Cross\-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals. * Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability. * Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise. Benefits: * Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * STD, LTD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off, including holidays and vacation. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Who Will Succeed Here? You are a hands\-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines. You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion. Candidates whose experience is limited to application\-level software development without hands\-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit. Apply Today If you have embedded firmware, electronics, and motion\-control experience to make a difference, we want to hear from you. Please submit your résumé highlighting your embedded development experience, microcontroller platforms, communication protocols, and a few examples of challenging technical problems you have solved. Del Medical is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and applicable law. Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you require sponsorship at all now or in the future to work in the United States? Work Location: In person

With team members located in more than 15 countries, you will have an exceptional opportunity to influence Dell's security culture while advancing your career. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Manager, Agentic AI Product Security Engineering** on our Security and Resiliency team in **Round Rock, Texas**. Relocation assistance is available. **You will:** * Lead and develop a team of engineers responsible for building, evaluating, and operating AI\-native security capabilities * Drive delivery execution and accountability, ensuring commitments are met through sustainable engineering practices and operational excellence * Establish and maintain a high engineering bar through direct involvement in architecture reviews, technical design, and code review * Define and continuously evolve the technical vision and roadmap for AI\-native security capabilities as business needs and technology advance * Hire engineers through an interview process that tests real production experience, and grow their capability and scope through coaching **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 10\+ years, or equivalent skill, of software engineering experience delivering production\-scale systems; must include 3\+ years of experience in an engineering management role * Strong technical depth with the ability to review architecture, evaluate technical designs, assess code quality, and lead technical decision\-making across complex engineering initiatives * Hands\-on experience building and operating artificial intelligence (AI)\-native systems, including agentic systems, large language model (LLM) applications, evaluation frameworks for non\-deterministic systems, and production AI environments * Proven track record of driving delivery accountability, setting technical direction, managing execution against commitments, and communicating priorities, trade\-offs, and risks to senior leadership across large, complex, matrixed organizations * Demonstrated success hiring and developing engineers in a competitive talent market, including building an interview process that predicts performance and growing engineers' capability and scope **Desired Qualifications** * Experience leading engineering teams developing artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) systems for production environments, preferably within cybersecurity or security engineering organizations * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation methodologies, and the challenges of establishing and scaling new engineering functions in rapidly evolving technology domains **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**. Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

workstreams** * **Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment** * **Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor** * **Ability to meet deadlines** and services that apply AI, data, and engineering to modernize HR experiences and outcomes.** **Qualifications** **Required:** * **Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science)** * **2\+ years building and delivering large language model (LLM) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) solutions with Claude/GPT(Codex)/Gemini\-class models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration; and 2\+ years implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)/retrieval, including document processing, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and enterprise governance controls.** * **2\+ years of data and artificial intelligence engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals; and 2\+ years building production, real\-time inference services, including application programming interface (API) design, latency/performance, and reliability patterns.** * **2\+ years leading platform/integration engineering across enterprise systems, including API/integration experience with Representational jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** **This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert** We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI\-assisted features and internal tooling. You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS\-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them. * Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on\-call participation, incident root\-causing, and the follow\-through fixes. * Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter. * Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed. * Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services. * Integrate third\-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI\-backed features where they genuinely improve the product. * Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI\-generated code alike. * Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room. **What you will have** * 6\+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred). * Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Terraform. * Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod. * CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience. * Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards. * Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security). * OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi\-tenant identity providers. * C\# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home. * Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling. * Large\-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them. * Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life jobs.title: Sr. AI Solution Architect
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** You will embed with various business functions (Sales, Support, Finance, Legal, HR, Procurement, Marketing), learn how the work actually gets done, and build the AI solutions that change it: automated workflows, agents on our systems of record, and AI\-native tools wired into the platforms people already use. You work in a pod with a Senior Business Architect (who owns the problem framing and business case) and an operator from the function (who owns adoption). You own the solution: design, build, launch, measure, iterate. This is not a research role and it is not a traditional software engineering seat. It is the person who can sit in a Finance close review on Monday, prototype an agent against NetSuite and Salesforce data by Wednesday, and walk the CISO through the access model on Friday. You will be measured on production value the business can point to, not pilots. **What you will do** **Embedded problem solving and delivery.** Sit inside a function for the length of an engagement. Map the workflow, find where AI removes friction or creates capacity, and ship the fix. Own each solution end to end, from discovery through production monitoring. Three to four production launches a year is the bar. **Automation, agents, and AI\-native tools.** Build on our orchestration and platform layer (Salesforce and Agentforce, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Slack, AWS and frontier model APIs, and the integration tooling that connects them). Design agent workflows with retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop review built in. Configure and extend vendor AI tools before building custom. Know when each is the right call. **AI infrastructure and vendor architecture.** Partner with IT, Security, and Engineering to design the shared foundation every production agent needs: model access, identity and permissions, data connectivity, logging and observability, evaluation. Lead the technical side of vendor evaluations and proofs of concept. Turn one\-off wins into reusable patterns the next pod can pick up. **Enablement for everyday users.** Design the services that help regular employees use AI well: templates, guided workflows, office hours, a path from "I have an idea" to "it runs in production." Coach power users so workflows outlive the person who built them. Success is the business owning and extending what you built. **Intake and governance, the technical half.** Serve as the technical reviewer in DigiCert's AI intake and governance process. Assess proposed use cases for data exposure, security posture, and feasibility. Recommend the right build path (vendor tool, configuration, custom). Keep every AI deployment safe, auditable, and inside DigiCert's security and compliance requirements, including FedRAMP\-adjacent constraints where they apply. **ROI and measurement.** Instrument what you build. Every solution ships with a baseline, a metric, and a dashboard the sponsoring executive can read. Feed results into the company AI measurement program run with the CFO. **First 90 days** ----------------- * Days 1 to 30: learn the stack and the governance process. Shadow the current pod. Review in\-flight intake requests. * Days 31 to 60: ship a first production workflow or agent with the pod. * Days 61 to 90: second engagement in flight. First enablement service live (template library, office hours, or guided intake). Present measured results from the first launch to the sponsoring executive. **What great looks like** ------------------------- * Business leaders ask for you by name because the last thing you built is still running and still measured. * You can explain a permissions model to the CISO and a workflow change to a sales rep in the same afternoon. * You default to the smallest solution that works, and you know when a vendor tool beats a custom build. * You leave behind patterns, documentation, and trained operators, not dependency on you. * You treat governance as a design input. **What you will have** * 5\+ years building and shipping technical solutions in a business context: solutions engineering, business systems, integration, automation, or forward\-deployed work. * 2\+ years hands\-on with LLM\-based systems in production or near\-production: agent frameworks, retrieval, tool calling, prompt and evaluation design. * Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript and comfort with APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, and authentication (OAuth, SSO, role\-based access). You do not need to be a career software engineer, but you need to build and debug without waiting on one. * Experience with enterprise platforms: Salesforce, Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Jira, and modern data warehouse.s * A track record of working directly with non\-technical teams and translating messy processes into working systems. * Judgment in security\- and compliance\-sensitive environments. You know what data cannot leave the building and design accordingly. * Clear written and spoken communication. You can write a one\-page architecture memo an executive will actually read. **Nice to have** * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions architect, or embedded consulting experience. * Hands\-on with Agentforce, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic or OpenAI APIs, or MCP\-based tool integration. * Experience with intelligent automation or workflow platforms (Power Automate, Workato, n8n, UiPath). * Exposure to SOX, FedRAMP, or similar control environments. * Experience in a security or PKI company, or another business where trust is the product. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** "We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world\-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks \& Resorts. We are responsible for the end\-to\-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital\-led initiatives across Food \& Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business. This role sits within the Retail \& Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large\-scale, distributed, event\-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android\-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience. The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering. What You Will Do * Lead and personally build (hands\-on coding expected) scalable, well\-documented backend services and APIs across our polyglot platform — PHP and Go microservices today, with a growing Java/Spring footprint — from technical specification through production delivery. * Set architectural direction for the POS platform: translate complex functional, technical, and business requirements into solution and system designs, produce architecture diagrams and proof\-of\-concepts, evaluate technology choices, and ensure new solutions integrate cleanly with surrounding Disney systems. * Drive the modernization roadmap, playing a leading technical role in the migration of existing PHP and Go microservices into Java/Spring applications — defining migration patterns, sequencing, coexistence strategies, and quality gates so we modernize without disrupting daily park operations. * Own the full software development life cycle for your team's deliverables: planning, estimation, design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, production support, and post\-incident root\-cause analysis. * Lead and mentor a team of backend Software Engineers — provide day\-to\-day technical direction, unblock engineers, review designs and code, grow junior talent, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and psychological safety. * Assess and communicate risk: identify technical, delivery, and operational risks early; give clear direction on trade\-offs; and escalate to leadership with well\-formed options and recommendations when decisions exceed the team's authority. * Design and operate event\-driven and streaming integrations using Amazon Kinesis and RabbitMQ, ensuring our transaction, inventory, and reporting flows are resilient, idempotent, and observable. * Steward our data layer, designing performant schemas and access patterns on Amazon Aurora (MySQL\-compatible), guiding ORM usage, and safeguarding transactional integrity for a system where every record represents real money and a real Guest. * Champion AI\-assisted engineering, embedding tools such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex into the team's daily workflow — from design and coding to testing and troubleshooting — and shaping responsible adoption practices that raise both velocity and quality. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with product owners, program management, architecture, QA, hardware/terminal teams, and vendor partners to align solutions with current and future business needs, and represent the team in tactical and strategic forums with all levels of leadership. * Support production, participating in on\-call rotations and go\-lives for a platform where availability matters most during the moments our Guests are creating memories. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Data Protection
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As a Lead Software Engineer on the Data Protection team, you'll be a key player in building the cryptographic foundation for Docusign's global infrastructure. You'll drive the engineering for our enterprise key management platform \- owning the systems that enable customers to control their own encryption keys and extending cryptographic protection across our data stores and services. Looking ahead, you'll help define how key management and cryptographic controls evolve alongside Docusign's platform \- ensuring our data protection posture stays ahead of industry standards and enterprise customer expectations. Our team is passionate about delivering high\-quality, fully\-tested code to ensure the level of security and reliability our customers depend on. This is a hands\-on role where you'll help drive technical direction, secure our platform, and directly enable Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management by delivering trusted data protection solutions to enterprise customers. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Sr. Manager, Software Engineering. **Responsibility** * Design and build cryptographic key management systems that support the full key lifecycle generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and expiry across cloud environments at enterprise scale * Build and maintain operational tooling for the health, observability, and reliability of cryptographic services and key integrations * Drive adoption of encryption best practices across Docusign's platform, establishing and evolving standards for data\-at\-rest and data\-in\-transit protection * Collaborate with engineering teams across the company to ensure their systems correctly support data protection requirements \- advising on encryption patterns, key management constraints, and data isolation boundaries * Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for new platform initiatives, identifying cryptographic and data protection risks early in the development lifecycle * Develop high\-quality, ship\-ready code covered by a full test suite * Conduct design and code reviews with a focus on security and availability not just coding to a spec **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 12\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C\# or other object\-oriented languages * 12\+ years of software engineering experience in high\-scale distributed systems * Experience with cloud Key Management Services (KMS) AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, or equivalent \- including key lifecycle management (rotation, revocation, expiry) and cross\-tenant or cross\-account key access patterns * Experience with encryption fundamentals key wrapping (DEK/KEK model), asymmetric key operations, and cryptographic key lifecycle management * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience **Preferred** * Experience with .NET microservice architecture (C\#) in a high\-scale production environment * Hands\-on experience with Azure Key Vault RBAC authorization model, Managed Identity integration, Encryption Scopes, and CMK\-enabled data services * Experience with cloud infrastructure provisioning at scale \- IaC tooling (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent), per\-tenant resource automation, and multi\-region deployments * Experience building monitoring and alerting for cryptographic services, including key access health and resource state observability * Experience building large\-scale, highly available, and reliable applications * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices * Strong organizational, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington: $178,900\.00 \- $262,825\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data - Experimentation
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash's three\-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash's experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI\-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design\-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study, Power\-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments, CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash's Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high\-quality decision\-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering. Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high\-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross\-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting\-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will...** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Set the scientific direction for Curie and shape the Decision Systems roadmap with engineering and product partners, identifying where better science, tooling, or automation can materially improve decision quality and velocity. * Own the statistical contract for experiment analysis, including how metrics, populations, exposure windows, covariates, ratio metrics, and edge cases are defined. * Ensure production systems faithfully implement those contracts by reviewing analytical SQL, validating statistical parity, and raising the bar for correctness across engine migrations. * Develop and productionize advanced methods such as CUPED/CUPAC, ratio\-metric and delta\-method inference, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, switchback designs, and difference\-in\-differences for marketplace interference. * Build approaches that hold up in high\-scale, high\-noise, three\-sided marketplace data, including power analysis, multiple\-testing correction, winsorization, quantile metrics, and other robust measurement techniques. * Advance AI\-assisted analysis workflows, including trustworthy automated experiment readouts, risk detection, and hypothesis generation, with the same rigor expected of statistical methods. * Advise and mentor data scientists, product teams, operators, and engineers on experimental design, metric strategy, causal analysis, and interpretation of results. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * 6\+ years of industry experience, or equivalent applied research experience, developing statistical, causal inference, machine learning, or experimentation systems with measurable business impact. * Deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with production experience in methods such as variance reduction, ratio metrics, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, marketplace interference, or quasi\-experimental designs. * Strong coding and data skills, including the ability to reason about production data pipelines and review complex analytical SQL for statistical correctness. * Experience translating statistical or machine learning methods into reliable, scalable platform capabilities in close partnership with engineering and product teams. * A track record of setting technical direction, influencing cross\-functional teams, and mentoring senior technical contributors without relying solely on formal authority. * The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to scientific, engineering, product, and exec  bias for impact: you know how to balance methodological rigor, product velocity, engineering constraints, and customer needs. We expect this position to be filled by 10\-17\-2026 **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI New
jobs.description: **Our Why At Dotmatics** At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision\-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. **We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.** We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best\-of\-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi\-dimensional decision\-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. **Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics** Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote\-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud\-based scientific research R\&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. **We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.** **What do we need** We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Software Engineer (Agentic AI), to build the AI agent at the core of Dotmatics Luma platform. You will own the agent end to end: how it reasons, which tools it uses, what it remembers, how it recovers from failure, and how we know it is working. You will work in a small, high\-trust engineering team alongside Product, scientists, and the wider Dotmatics organisation. This is also an AI\-native engineering role. Your success won’t be measured by how many lines of code you write. It will come from how well you decompose work for coding agents, give them the right context, tools, and constraints, verify their output with tests and review, and ship production software faster than a traditional senior engineer without lowering the quality bar. Coding agents are your default path for implementation, and you stay accountable for architecture, correctness, security, and review. We want someone who thinks like the engineers who build frontier AI products: rigorous about quality, curious about how agents fail, and quick to adapt as models improve. You use AI tools daily to build AI tools, and you ship agents that work in production, not just in demos. **In this role you will get to** * Develop the agent itself: the loop, harness, and control flow connecting the model, tools, and state, including subagents, long\-running tasks, checkpointing, and recovery. * Practice context engineering: decide what goes into the context window, when to compact or summarize, and how to keep the agent coherent over long\-running experiments. * Design tools for the agent, with clear interfaces and descriptions, covering instrument orchestration, scheduling, data capture, and developer tooling such as GitHub, repositories, CI/CD, and workflows. * Give the agent memory and state persistence so it learns from and builds on earlier work. * Implement permissions and sandboxing that define what the agent can do on its own, what needs human approval, and how mistakes are contained. * Defend the agent against prompt injection and untrusted content, with auditability and data isolation suited to regulated environments. * Evaluate the agent end\-to\-end on real multi\-step tasks, then debug its behavior by reading traces and finding root causes, fixing the harness, tools, or prompts to improve reliability, tool\-use accuracy, cost, and latency. * Adapt the harness as models improve, and remove scaffolding that is no longer needed. * strong written and verbal communication skills ernal partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations * Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures * Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes * Ability to work collaboratively across Product, Launch, Partner Success, and technical teams to accomplish shared partner outcomes in a fast\-paced environment * Commitment to a continual learning environment and to a dynamic, welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration *If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.* **Compensation:** The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $85,500 – $110,000 per year. jobs.title: Embedded Hardware Engineer III
jobs.description: **Build the Future with Us —** **EquipmentShare is Hiring a Embedded Hardware Engineer III** ============================================================================================ At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real\-time support, and a team that truly cares. We're hiring a **Embedded Hardware Engineer III** at our Corporate Headquarters in **Columbia, MO** and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. This position is fully remote. The Embedded engineer will design, develop, and deploy software that is built into the hardware of various IoT devices, such as GPS trackers and keypads. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Design, build and maintain software for embedded systems on vehicles and equipment * Immerse yourself in the full engineering lifecycle of embedded applications * Plan and create system architecture, and integrate embedded systems * Read schematic and layout files to design and debug software * Collaborate with leadership, engineering and product teams to build solutions * Conduct testing and analyses * Focus on the continuous improvement of technology and processes * Assist in architecting software for modularity and reusability across hardware platforms * Design and document API's, user guides and testing procedures * Analyze and enhance efficiency, stability, and scalability of system resources * Interface with hardware design and development teams * Document design process and report systems results * Support customers in the integration and deployment of the system * Ensure the robustness and security of wireless communication with other devices * Ensure that the firmware is as protected and tamper\-proof as the hardware platform can provide ### **Why EquipmentShare?** Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people\-first company powered by cutting\-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward. We're a team of problem\-solvers, go\-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**. #### **Perks \& Benefits** Competitive compensation * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees * Generous PTO \+ paid holidays * 401(k) \+ company match * Gym membership stipend \+ wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!) * Company events, food truck nights * 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home * * Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities ### **About You** You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. Our initiative — *A Workplace For All* — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life. We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do. **EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.** ***Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.***

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead (Principal Engineer)
jobs.description: **AI Technical Lead** **Location:** Cambridge, MA / Hybrid *(This role requires working in\-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)* **About us:** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** As our Technical Lead, you will design and build a new kind of product: an insurance marketplace that AI agents use to shop on a person's behalf. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from the models and how they run to the MCP server and tools that other AI platforms connect to. This is a hands\-on senior role on a small team, and the decisions you make early will shape what agentic insurance shopping looks like before the market arrives. You own the technical architecture for the agent: where the model's reasoning runs, how we tune and serve it, how we keep cost and speed under control, and how the whole system stays reliable. We intend to run and tune our own open\-weight models rather than depend only on hosted APIs, so we control cost, speed, and behavior as volume grows, and owning that is central to this role. You own the MCP server, the tools, and the data the agent works with, and you set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You are the person who decides, with testing to back it up, how this is built, and then builds it. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture: decide where the agent's reasoning runs, which models we use, how they are packaged, and how AI platforms connect to us, and back those calls with testing. * Build and tune the models: fine\-tune open\-weight models for our use, and decide when tuning, retrieval, or prompting is the right tool. * Stand up the serving and infrastructure: deploy the agent and MCP server so they are reliable, fast, and affordable to run, with versioning and a way to roll back. * Build the testing into the system: programmatic eval sets, guardrails, and monitoring for quality, drift, cost, and speed, so we catch problems before agents do. * Design the data model and tools with the AI product lead: the request and response payloads, the reasoning we expose, and the trust signals. * Set the engineering patterns and standards the team builds on, and keep the code and architecture documented. * Keep cost and speed honest: watch what inference costs, and make the trade\-offs that keep it sustainable as volume grows. * Work in the open. Help publish our code, architecture, and findings. * Mentor the engineers on the team and give leadership clear, regular visibility into technical progress and risks. **What You Bring:** * Deep, current, hands\-on experience in the AI and LLM space. You work on this every day, not from the sidelines. * Real experience with open\-weight models: you have fine\-tuned them (LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, or similar) and run them yourself, not just called a hosted API. * Experience owning an LLM system in production: you have served models reliably, pinned versions, rolled back a bad change, and explained why the bill moved. * Enterprise\-level design and architecture experience, with a track record of leading large, ambitious projects and delivering them. * Strong grasp of evaluation and guardrails: building eval sets, catching failure modes, and monitoring quality, drift, cost, and speed. * Fluency with the serving and ops stack: model serving, containers and orchestration, and monitoring, on at least one major cloud. * Strong communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to an engineer and to a non\-technical leader, and lead with data. * Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action in a space where the standards change month to month. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years in engineering, with senior or lead ownership of complex technical systems, including hands\-on work in machine learning or LLMs. * A track record of leading large, ambitious projects with a small team and delivering them. We care more about what you have shipped and the judgment you showed than the revenue the project generated. * Hands\-on fine\-tuning and deployment of open\-weight or open\-source models, with real production experience. * Enterprise design and architecture experience for complex, high\-reliability systems. * Strong Python, Rust, and fluency with the modern LLM stack (serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring). * Strong strategic thinking paired with methodical execution. You can set the technical direction and then deliver it. * Excellent communication across all levels of an organization, technical and non\-technical. * A history of teamwork and a bias for action. Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process.
