jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: **We don’t build rockets. We make the machines that cut the metal they’re made from.** Somewhere today a bar of superalloy is being cut to length before it becomes a turbine blade in a jet engine, an electric generator, or a rocket engine part. Someone designed the machine that made that cut, built it in a shop in Ohio, programmed it to optimize its cutting operation without user intervention, and made it run every shift for twenty years. That’s what we do. We also want to know what you do when no one is paying you. The person who rebuilt a motorcycle engine in the garage. Who runs a 3D printer at home. Who took the dishwasher apart to find out why it quit. Who spent last weekend building a tool no one asked for. If that sounds like you, keep reading. **Who We Are** Everett Industries has built abrasive cut\-off saws in Warren, Ohio for more than sixty years. Our saws and wheels run in foundries, forges, and investment casting houses, and in the shops that build jet engines and launch vehicles. We cut what other machines can’t: superalloys, titanium, tool steel, risers off castings. We make basic tool room or fab shop saws, automated systems, and one\-off cutting cells built around a customer’s part. We operate the way the best of our customers do. The engineer who designs a machine watches it get built, stands next to it when it first runs, and fixes what went wrong. There are no layers between you and the result. You’ll see your work in steel within months, not years. Orders are growing and the problems are getting more complex. We need a mechanical design engineer who will own a project from the first sales call to the day it ships...and for the balance of its useful life. **Who You Are** We’re not screening for a resume. We’re screening for a type of person. These are the things that matter to us: * **You are curious.** You want to know how things work and why they fail, and you go find out. Your engineering degree gives you the tools to do that. Your instinct to keep digging is what makes all of that useful here. * **You finish what you start.** You take an idea, design it, analyze it, and see it through to a working result yourself. You do not hand off and wait for someone else to close the loop. * **You direct your own learning.** You identify what you need to know, you go learn it, and you bring it back. We fund that and support that. We do not prescribe it… although we encourage and expect it. * **Undocumented work is incomplete work.** If your projects could not be picked up by someone else in your absence, that is a gap — not an explanation. * **You build things on your own time.** A project car, a CNC router in the basement, a robot, a boat, a house you are renovating yourself. We want to hear about it, because it tells us more than a transcript does. * **You speak up through the right channels.** When something is wrong, you say so, to the person who can act on it. Concerns that go sideways instead of upward help no one. * **You work well in a small company.** Requirements evolve, priorities shift, and there is no bureaucracy between a good idea and trying it. You find that energizing rather than unsettling even though it means you are responsible for the results. **The Role** This is a hands\-on design role at the center of what we do. You will take a customer’s requirements from concept through detailed design, analysis, production release, and support on the floor — and you will own that whole arc. Nobody hands off to a project manager here. The person we hire sees the job through. **Everyone here should know where your projects stand without asking. That is not a report we want from you. It is part of doing the job well.** **What You Will Do** **Design \& Engineering** * Turn customer’s process requirements and sales requirements into fully constrained, producible mechanical designs in Autodesk Inventor. * Identify the need for and perform engineering calculations behind every design: load analysis, component sizing, and material selection. * Produce complete 3D models and GD\&T\-compliant production drawings under appropriate revision control. * Work with our controls and electrical engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and automation components into designs that are safe, functional, and buildable. * Release complete engineering packages to the production floor — models, drawings, BOMs, and supporting documentation the shop can build from without coming back with questions. **Collaboration \& Ownership** * Sit with the sales team during quoting and proposals to give technical input and translate customer processing needs into machine requirements. * Lead design reviews with the engineering team before release, not after a problem shows up… and be able to accept the “best” concept, even if it is not your baby. * Keep project status current and visible at all times. If a deliverable is at risk, raise it before it becomes a problem… protect your team’s commitments. * Support the machinists, fabricators and builders throughout the build, and stand on the floor with them when the machine runs for the first time. Remember, their skills may not have been acquired in a university, but they are just as essential as yours to our customer who pays us all. * Document your work so that someone else could pick up any project of yours tomorrow and so that our customer’s maintenance team can support their operation. **Continuous Improvement** * Look for better ways to design, document, and build — including new automation and AI\-assisted engineering tools — and bring them to the team. * Apply your engineering judgment to operational problems, not only design problems. The person who notices the process is wrong and proposes a better one is the person we want. * Travel occasionally (4\-8 days per quarter) for customer site visits and professional development. **What You Need** **Required** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited institution. * Demonstrated experience developing mechanical systems from concept through detailed design and documentation. * Proficiency with Autodesk Inventor or a comparable parametric 3D CAD platform… but understand that we work in Inventor. * Working knowledge of GD\&T standards, ANSI/ISO/EN and other standards and engineering drawing practices. * Ability to identify the need for, perform, and document mechanical engineering and safety calculations for sizing, load analysis, and material selection. * Working understanding of controls and control theory including sensors, actuators, and automation components and how they integrate into mechanical assemblies. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, engineering, and production. **Preferred** * Three to five years of mechanical design experience in machine design or industrial equipment. * Experience with engineered\-to\-order or custom automated machinery. * Exposure to abrasive cutting, milling, turning, grinding, material handling, and similar material removal and processing environments. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted design and engineering tools, and a habit of bringing new, productive technology into your workflow. **Short on years? Apply anyway. If you are early in your career but you have built things, taught yourself things, and can show us, we will weigh that against experience. An indomitable work ethic and a genuine drive to get better count here. We invest in and will develop people who invest in themselves.** **How We Work** Everett is a small company with a clear point of view about what makes someone excellent here. These are not values on a wall — they are how we evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, and have honest conversations when something isn’t working. **Accountability \& Ownership** *You own your work, your outcomes, and your communication. Ownership is not assigned by title. It is the baseline expectation for everyone in this building. Accountability is not a talk out behind the barn after the fact… it is clear expectations and frank communications… both ways… throughout the process.* **Innovation \& Continuous Improvement** *We want people who see a better way and say so — then do something about it. That applies to your design work and to how the work gets done. The intersection of engineering skill and operational thinking is where we grow.* **Self\-Directed Learning** *This is a learning organization. We fund development and support it actively. But the direction comes from you. Identify what you want to build, make a case for it, and pursue it. The people who thrive here do not wait to be told what to learn next.* Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **This role is intended for candidates based in Austin, TX** ============================================================ **Introduction to the Team** Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Software Development Engineer II position is part of the Consumer Payments team within Expedia Global Payments, under the Book\-to\-Trip division. This team builds and maintains critical systems that power backend APIs for consumer and B2B payment processing, administrative tools for payment configuration, and support for a variety of payment methods across the platform. Our services are designed with security, scalability, and availability in mind, supporting credit card processing and payment routing at global scale. As an engineer on this team, you'll apply your passion for backend development, cloud computing, and modern engineering practices to solve real\-world challenges that impact millions of travelers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an engineer who demonstrates strong ownership, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in building reliable systems that perform well in production. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable backend payment services that support Expedia’s global travel platform * Apply software design principles, data structures and/or design patterns and computer science fundamentals to write code that is clean, maintainable, optimized, modular with good naming conventions * Implement secure data handling practices to protect payment information and meet compliance standards * Recommend and apply architectural patterns or GenAI capabilities to improve system design and innovation * Enhance service reliability through observability, automation, and continuous operational improvements Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact features aligned with Expedia’s strategic goals * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or Master's in a related technical field, or equivalent related professional experience * 2\+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud\-based and distributed systems at scale * Proficiency in **Java or Kotlin** , with hands\-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working on payment platforms or implementing backend services leveraging GenAI technologies * Experience contributing to multiple multi\-quarter, cross\-team projects * Experience supporting complex distributed systems in production through monitoring, debugging, incident resolution, and root\-cause analysis * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services on AWS A Master's degree in a related technical field * Please note that **this role is only available in Austin, TX** . We follow a flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $119,000\.00 to $166,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $190,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Web Development & Maintenance Provider
jobs.description: ### **Request for Proposals:** ### **Web Development \+ Maintenance Provider** Issued October 16, 2026 Proposals due Friday, October 30 5:00 PM ET Washington, DC **At a glance** **Issuer:** FAS (Federation of American Scientists) **Engagement:** Enhancements to FAS.org, heatagenda.us, cri.fas.org, essentialdata.us, followed by an optional ongoing maintenance retainer. **Term:** December 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 for the enhancement project. A maintenance retainer may follow at FAS’s option. **Budget:** Not to exceed $14,500 for initial 6\-month engagement **Proposals due:** Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET **1\.Background and Strategic Foundations** ------------------------------------------- The Federation of American Scientists (FAS) is seeking a new provider of web development and maintenance services to lead an update of our current website. FAS is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3\) that has around 60 FTEs, a network of Senior Fellows and Advisors, and is supported largely by philanthropy. We are looking for a WordPress developer with strong design judgment who will learn how FAS works and recommend improvements to our main website and growing number of sister sites. If the initial project goes well, we expect to continue with the same provider for ongoing maintenance and future enhancements. Current website environment Bidders should use the following to estimate effort. FAS will share additional details with bidders on request. * **Platform:** WordPress 7\.1\.3; Custom theme; Page builder: Standard Wordpress with some custom blocktypes, including TablePress * **Hosting:** Gravitate. Hosting costs are not in the scope of this RFP. * **Original site build**: And–Now, 2023\. Current maintenance is provided by Gravitate, who will be available for handoff. * **Content volume:** approximately \~150 pages and 5,703 posts/publications; 1,140 staff and fellow bio pages. * **Key plugins and integrations:** YoastSEO (trial), TablePress plus custom dataviz embedding with Tableau and Datawrapper, Google Analytics 4, Meta Box \+ Meta Box AIO, Relevanssi Premium, SAR Friendly SMTP, Akismet Anti\-spam, Headers Security Advanced * **Existing microsites:** heatagenda.us and cri.fas.org, and essentialdata.us, plus legacy subdomains like nuke.fas.org, sgp.fas.org. * **Brand guidelines and design source files:** PDF available here. **2\. What we are asking you to do** ------------------------------------ **Scope of work** ----------------- All work applies site\-wide to FAS.org, heatagenda.us (static site), cri.fas.org (static site), essentialdata.us unless stated otherwise. For each item, the "Done when" line describes what FAS will accept as complete. The provider may recommend changes to these items during discovery; the approved plan (see Timeline) becomes the binding scope. ### **Base scope (required)** **A. Photo, video and data visualization components.** Reusable WordPress blocks or templates for carousels, image grids, video embeds and featured data visualizations, consistent with the current design language. * *Done when:* FAS staff can add and edit these components on any page or post without developer help, and they display correctly on mobile. **B. Social media integration.** Display of FAS social content on the homepage, staff and fellow bio pages, and publication pages. Platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn, X. Bidders should state whether they propose embeds or automated feeds, and note any third\-party API or subscription costs. * *Done when:* Content from the named platforms appears on the specified page types and updates without manual work, or with a documented manual process FAS approves. **C. Microsite template and navigation.** A reusable template for program microsites \[bidder to recommend , with consistent navigation between microsites and FAS.org. * *Done when:* FAS staff can launch a new microsite from the template, and one pilot microsite (highlighting our ‘Future of Science’ work), is live. **D. Miscellaneous improvements.** Ability to update footer (currently we lack ability to add social platforms or other outward links; CMS/WordPress\-managed redirects (currently we have to ask developers to do this; visible tags on publications * *Done when:* These items are present or alternative solutions are operational on FAS.org. ### **Optional items (price each separately)** FAS will decide which of these to fund during the planning phase, based on cost and remaining budget. * **Search across microsites**: a single search that returns results from FAS.org and all microsites. * **Bulk tag editing** in the WordPress admin. * **Google Analytics 4 improvements**: pass publication date and other post metadata to GA4; an analytics dashboard for staff. * **Data visualization**: improved DataWrapper embedding or native charts and tables in WordPress. * **Footnotes for publications**: ability to include “sidenotes” or “margin\-notes” (i.e. footnotes that don’t interrupt the reading experience). ### **Requirements that appl adlines. * FAS will provide staging and admin access, brand assets and content within \[5] business days of the provider's request. Delays on FAS's side extend the schedule accordingly. * We expect the provider to recommend better approaches when they see them, including telling us when a request is a poor use of budget. **Budget and pricing** FAS's budget for the base scope is not to exceed **$14,500**, as a fixed fee. Proposals should include: * A fixed fee for the base scope, broken down by phase and by item (A through D), with estimated hours and hourly rates. * A separate fixed price for each optional item. * Proposed maintenance pricing after May 2027: monthly retainer, hours included, what is covered (for example, WordPress core and plugin updates, security monitoring, backups, small content fixes), response times, and the hourly rate for work beyond the retainer. If a bidder believes the base scope cannot be delivered within the budget, the proposal should say which items or features should be reduced and why. **Payment schedule.** 20% on FAS approval of the plan; 50% on staging approval of all base\-scope features; 30% on final acceptance. Optional items are invoiced on acceptance. **Bidder qualifications** ------------------------- * Demonstrated WordPress development experience, including custom blocks and templates. * Past work for nonprofits, think tanks or policy organizations. * Both design and development capability in\-house: the ability to design components and then build and deploy them. Bidders who plan to use subcontractors must name them. **Proposal requirements** ------------------------- Submit a single PDF (maximum 10 pages, excluding team bios and appendices) to jwilson@fas.org by Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET. Include: * **Cover letter** signed by an authorized representative, naming the proposed project lead. * **Understanding and approach.** How you would address the base scope, and how you would extend the existing design language rather than replace it. * **Workplan.** Activities, milestones and dependencies by phase, consistent with the timeline above. * **Team and capacity.** Named individuals and their roles, and the project lead's expected hours per month on this engagement. * **Work samples.** Links to 3 to 5 live websites you designed or built, preferably WordPress sites for nonprofits or policy organizations. * **Case studies and references.** Three relevant client case studies and three client references FAS may contact. * **Pricing,** as described in Budget and pricing. * **Disclosures.** Current or recent work for organizations that closely overlap with FAS's mission or audience, and any other potential conflicts of interest. **Evaluation criteria** ----------------------- **Criterion** **Weight** Understanding of FAS's needs and fit with our working style 25% Design quality, based on work samples and case studies 25% Technical approach and WordPress capability 15% Team quality and committed capacity 15% Budget realism and value, including maintenance pricing 20% FAS may invite finalists to a 60 to 90 minute interview with the Chief of Staff, Communications Associate Director, Digital and Design Senior Manager. **RFP schedule** ---------------- RFP Released October 16, 2026 Proposals Due October 30, 2026 by 5:00 pm ET Finalists Interviews November 5 \- November 20, 2026 Selection Announced November 25, 2026 Contract Executed On or before December 4, 2026 Project Kickoff Week of December 7, 2026 **Terms** --------- * FAS will own all code, designs and other work product created under this engagement, and will receive full access to source code and credentials at handoff. * FAS may reject any or all proposals, request clarifications, or negotiate scope and price with any bidder. * FAS will not reimburse costs of preparing proposals. * Proposals will be kept confidential and used only for this selection. * The selected provider will sign FAS's standard services agreement. 94ORpnHfSs

jobs.title: Senior Economist (Hybrid)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== We are seeking a Senior Economist to join our team in Washington, D.C. This role is ideal for an economist who combines rigorous economic analysis with strong data and technology skills, intellectual curiosity, and an interest in public policy and industry issues. The Senior Economist will conduct applied economic research and quantitative analysis using First American's proprietary and external data, develop analytical models and frameworks, and translate complex findings into clear insights for a range of internal and external audiences. The role will work across disciplines and partner closely with economists, data scientists, Government Affairs, business leaders, and other stakeholders on research and analytical initiatives that inform business, industry, and policy discussions. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing an empirical model, working with large and complex datasets, evaluating an economic or policy question, and communicating the implications clearly in writing or in a presentation.**What You'll Do:** * Conduct rigorous economic and quantitative research on issues relevant to First American, the title and real estate industries, and broader business, risk, operational, and policy questions. * Develop, implement, validate, and interpret economic, statistical, forecasting, and predictive models to support research, strategic analysis, and business decision\-making. * Work directly with large, complex, and proprietary datasets, using SQL and other analytical tools to extract, validate, transform, and analyze data for research and business applications. * Apply economic reasoning, statistical methods, and data science techniques to identify relationships, trends, risks, and emerging issues and translate findings into actionable insights. * Independently investigate ambiguous or unfamiliar business, economic, and policy questions by formulating hypotheses, identifying relevant data sources, and developing appropriate analytical approaches. * Partner closely with data scientists, data engineers, and technical teams to access, understand, and leverage data across modern data and cloud environments. * Collaborate with Government Affairs and other internal stakeholders to provide objective, data\-driven economic analysis related to industry, regulatory, and public policy issues. * Translate complex quantitative findings into clear conclusions, recommendations, research briefs, presentations, and written materials for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Evaluate external research, public data, economic literature, regulatory developments, and industry information to develop well\-supported analytical perspectives and recommendations. * Present research findings and analytical insights to senior leaders, business partners, and other stakeholders, tailoring communication to a variety of audiences. * Develop clear documentation of analytical methods, assumptions, data sources, model results, and limitations to support transparency, consistency, and repeatability. * Manage multiple analytical and research projects simultaneously while exercising sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and critical thinking in ambiguous or evolving problem areas. **What You'll Bring:** * Master's or PhD in Economics, Applied Economics or a closely related quantitative discipline preferred. * Candidates with a bachelor's degree and substantial relevant applied economic and quantitative experience may also be considered. * Typically 5 or more years of relevant professional experience in economic analysis, applied research, econometrics, quantitative analytics, data science, policy analysis, or a related field. * Experience in financial services, insurance, housing, real estate, government, public policy, or another highly regulated or data\-intensive industry is helpful but not required. * Demonstrated ability to frame complex or ambiguous business, economic, or policy questions and develop rigorous analytical approaches to address them. * Experience working directly with large, complex, and raw datasets using SQL and statistical programming languages such as Python or R, including data extraction, validation, transformation, and analysis. Strong SQL proficiency is required. Familiarity with modern cloud\-based data and analytics environments such as AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with GitHub or similar version control tools preferred. * Prior coding experience and use of code version control systems is a plus. * Comfort using AI\-enabled analytical and productivity tools to support research, coding, data exploration, and synthesis, with appropriate judgment around data quality, confidentiality, and validation of results. * Hands\-on experience developing, evaluating, and interpreting statistical, econometric, forecasting, predictive, or machine learning models to address real\-world business, risk, operational, or policy questions. * Familiarity with modern data platforms, cloud\-based analytical environments, and data workflows; ability to work effectively with data scientists and technical teams. * Ability to independently explore unfamiliar datasets, assess data quality and limitations, and determine appropriate analytical methods. * Strong critical\-thinking and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish correlation from causation, evaluate competing explanations, and identify the limitations of an analysis. * Interest in public policy, regulation, financial or insurance markets, housing, real estate, or related industry issues. * Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex economic and quantitative analysis into concise, persuasive, and accessible written materials. * Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and senior leaders. * Ability to synthesize information from quantitative analysis, academic or industry research, public data, and policy or regulatory materials. * Strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and sound analytical judgment. * Ability to collaborate effectively across economics, data science, policy, legal, business, and other functional areas while also working independently. * Ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. **Location Requirement** This position is based in Washington, D.C. and requires regular in\-person work in the Washington, D.C. office multiple days per week. Pay Range: $141,000\.00 \- $188,000\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.**What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

RESTful APIs that power business\-critical applications * Implement microservices following established architectural patterns, collaborating with senior engineers on service boundaries, data jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Flexi Software is hiring Junior and entry\-level Full\-Stack Software Engineers to help build the next generation of our platform. You will work across C\# services and modern web front ends built with Node.js, React, and Next.js, backed by Microsoft SQL Server, and you will build, test, and deliver enterprise\-grade software for financial institutions. We are looking for engineers who embrace an AI\-empowered software development lifecycle. At Flexi, AI is part of how we design, code, review, test, and document. You will work with agentic tools every day, and you will learn to direct them with good judgment, verify what they produce, and hold the result to the standards our banking, insurance, and financial services customers depend on. Your primary focus will be delivering our next\-generation web platform. On a limited basis, you may also work on Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, which gives you broad exposure to how enterprise software evolves. This role is a strong starting point for an early\-career engineer who wants to grow quickly, learn from experienced engineers, and ship real software at scale. This is a hybrid position, working in person with the team in our Atlanta, GA office. **About Flexi** Flexi Software has been a trusted provider of accounting solutions for over 30 years, offering both cloud\-based and on\-premise software purpose\-built for organizations with the most complex accounting requirements — multi\-entity and intercompany accounting at scale. Our comprehensive suite includes modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Fixed Asset Management, Project Accounting, Workflow Automation, Financial Reporting, and Budget Software. Serving industries including banking, insurance, financial services, credit unions, healthcare, and business process outsourcing, Flexi is renowned for its robust features, flexible deployment options, and exceptional customer support. In January 2025, Flexi was acquired by Quality Standard, a permanent capital holding company that acquires and grows fintech and govtech software businesses with a long\-term ownership mindset. Quality Standard is actively investing in Flexi's people, product, and operations. Flexi's office is located in Atlanta, GA. Quality Standard is headquartered in New York, NY. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Build, test, and deliver full\-stack features for Flexi's next\-generation platform, working across C\# back\-end services and APIs and Node.js, React, and Next.js front ends * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, including unit and integration tests, as part of every change you ship * Work with Microsoft SQL Server: write queries and stored procedures, design tables, and learn to tune for application and database performance * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, code review, testing, and documentation, and learn to direct them effectively * Review and verify AI\-generated code with care, owning correctness, security, and quality for everything you commit * Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build skill and uphold team standards * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release practices so changes move to production safely and often * Build with the security, reliability, and data integrity expected of enterprise financial software, including input validation, error handling, and audit\-friendly design * Investigate and resolve defects, tracing issues across the front end, services, and database * Write and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and developer notes * Partner with Product, QA, and senior engineers to turn requirements into shipped customer\-facing software * Contribute on a limited basis to Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, while next\-generation web platform delivery remains your primary focus, and learn how the new platform integrates with these existing products and our DevOps environment * Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and regular feedback, and share what you learn about AI\-assisted development with the team Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience, such as a bootcamp, internship, or substantial project work * 0–3 years of professional software development experience; internships and strong personal or academic projects count * Working knowledge of C\# and the .NET platform, including object\-oriented programming fundamentals, and a willingness to work in legacy C\+\+ and C\# Windows desktop code on a limited basis * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands\-on experience building applications in React * Experience or coursework with Node.js and Next.js, including routing, server\-side rendering, and API routes * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with exposure to Microsoft SQL Server preferred * Familiarity with building and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Git and a collaborative, pull\-request\-based workflow * Active, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in your own work, with a clear sense of when to trust their output and when to question it * A solid grasp of software testing fundamentals, including writing unit tests * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to ask good questions and take feedback well **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, or Web API development * Experience with Vite, modern build tooling, and component libraries or design systems * Experience delivering web applications in a B2B software environment using modern AI\-accelerated tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, including prompt and context engineering for coding tasks * Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and containerization * Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud platforms * Interest in or exposure to secure coding practices, including OWASP guidance * Experience with ERP, accounting, financial, or other enterprise systems of record, especially B2B enterprise software, and prior experience in the financial services industry or financial accounting **Personal Characteristics** * AI\-curious and AI\-forward; you actively use AI tools in your own work, enjoy experimenting with agentic workflows, and share what works * Rigorous about quality; you treat AI output as a draft to be verified, not a result to be trusted blindly * A builder; you like turning an idea into working software and seeing it used * Eager to learn; you ask questions, seek feedback, and improve quickly * Hands\-on and persistent; you stay with a hard bug until you understand the cause * Security\- and detail\-minded; you understand that accuracy and data integrity matter in financial software * Collaborative and low ego; you work well with engineers, QA, and Product * High integrity and sound judgment; trusted with sensitive customer and product information * Positive attitude and sense of humor; work is way more fun with people you enjoy! **What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** * Fully onboarded to Flexi's codebase, tooling, and AI\-assisted development workflow, and contributing confidently * Shipping production\-ready features and fixes across the C\# back end, SQL Server, and the React/Next.js front end * Delivering well\-tested work that passes review with steadily fewer corrections * Using AI tools effectively and responsibly, with changes that are verified, secure, and understood * Contributing meaningfully to code reviews, tests, and documentation * Understanding how the new platform fits with Flexi's existing C\+\+/C\# Windows desktop products and delivery pipeline, and contributing to them when needed * Developing a clear growth plan with your manager and mentor, with growing independence on well\-defined tasks Flexi provides excellent benefits including paid holidays and paid time off, a 401(k) Plan with company match, health and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, and a vision discount plan. **Location:** Hybrid • Atlanta, GA area only Only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon positive criminal background check. No phone calls, please. Principals Only. Drug\-free workplace. M/F/V/H EEO

jobs.title: Physical Security Systems Designer
jobs.description: Faith Group, LLC is a women\-owned business headquartered in St. Louis, MO, with eight regional offices nationwide. We are a recognized leader in systems engineering, consulting, and professional services for clients whose facilities are their business. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Integrity, Dignity, Quality, Impact, Collaboration, and Innovation. We have supported thousands of projects across Aviation, Transit \& Rail, Federal, State \& Local Government, Data Centers, Education, and Commercial markets. From planning through design, engineering, construction, and commissioning, Faith Group supports clients throughout the life of the project, from start to finish! **Role Specific Introduction:** The Physical Security Electronic Systems Designer is responsible for the planning, design, and documentation of electronic security systems including video surveillance, access control, intrusion detection, intercom, perimeter detection, and integrated security management platforms. This role supports consulting and engineering teams by translating client security requirements into detailed system designs, specifications, and drawings. The Designer works closely with project managers, engineers, and consultants to ensure that electronic security solutions are technically sound, compliant with codes and standards, and aligned with client needs. **Location: Remote** **Experience:** * 3–5\+ years of experience in electronic security systems design (consulting, engineering, or integration background). * Proficiency with design software (AutoCAD required; Revit/BIM preferred). * Familiarity with security technologies (video surveillance, access control, intrusion detection, intercom, perimeter systems, PSIM/VMS). * Understanding of IT networks, cabling infrastructure, and system integration. * Knowledge of industry standards (UL, NFPA, BICSI, ASIS). * Detail\-oriented with strong technical accuracy. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to manage multiple design packages simultaneously. **Responsibilities:** System Design \& Documentation * Develop detailed designs, schematics, riser diagrams, and system layouts for electronic security systems. * Produce construction drawings, specifications, and technical submittals for project deliverables. * Ensure designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and client specifications. * Maintain design consistency and quality across multiple projects. Technical Support * Evaluate and select appropriate security technologies, equipment, and vendors. * Conduct site surveys to verify conditions and inform design decisions. * Support integration of electronic security systems with IT, AV, and building management systems. * Review contractor submittals and shop drawings for compliance with design intent. Project Collaboration * Work closely with consultants, engineers, and project managers to align technical design with project goals. * Participate in coordination meetings with internal teams, architects, and external stakeholders. * Provide technical input during project scoping, design phases, and construction administration. Quality Assurance \& Innovation * Stay current with emerging technologies, manufacturers, and industry trends in physical security. * Contribute to the development of design standards, templates, and best practices. * Ensure accurate as\-built documentation at project closeout. **Education and Professional Certifications:** * **Education**: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Security Technology, or related field. Equivalent experience considered. * **Certifications**: PSP (ASIS Physical Security Professional), NICET Level II/III in Low Voltage Systems, or manufacturer certifications. **Compensation:** * $100,000\-$150,000 – depending on experience, education \& experience, and location **Benefits**: * 100% employer paid healthcare * 50% employer paid spouse/domestic partner/dependent healthcare * Dental * Vision * 401k * Short Term Disability * 100% employer paid Long Term Disability * 100% employer paid Life/ADD Insurance * Additional Life/ADD Insurance Available * FSA

jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it We're looking for passionate \& experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. We're looking for the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others as a Senior Software Engineer working for our Sportsbook domain. You will be working with the FanDuel Sportsbook application, providing our customers with a best\-in\-class experience as a frontend proficient Software Engineer. You'll play a pivotal part in making our platform highly usable and will write clear, scalable, and high\-quality code. You will work continuously to improve architecture and processes to improve quality and efficiency. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Your work is consistently of high quality. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You demonstrate responsibility for the state of the code you both inherit and produce. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent work experience. * 5 or more years of Software Development experience in creating and maintaining mobile applications with experience in React and React Native. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and core web technologies (HTML and CSS) * A fundamental understanding of data structures and algorithms with experience working with backend for frontend (BFF) architectural patterns. * Proficient with prompting AI\-powered development tools Claude or Cursor to accelerate coding workflows, improve code quality, and increasing efficiency. * Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS). * Experienced with optimization utilizing monitoring and alerting tools like DataDog or Sentry. * Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tooling, preferably Jenkins or Buildkite. * Familiarity with Git, GitLab, Atlassian suite preferred. * Experience with unit testing, testing tools, integrating testing and best\-quality practices into an SDLC. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About this Role** =================== Fandom is growing! We're looking for a **Senior Cloud Engineer** to help evolve and support the infrastructure that powers our platform for over 300 million fans around the world. This is a hands\-on role focused on building reliable, scalable systems in a Linux and Kubernetes\-based environment. As part of the **TechOps team**, you'll report to the **Manager of TechOps** and work closely with developers, product engineers, and other infrastructure teams. You'll contribute to our CI/CD, monitoring, automation, and cloud efforts — helping ensure Fandom's platform remains fast, stable, and secure as we grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, improving deployment systems, and enabling engineering teams to move faster and safer. **You Will...** =============== * Design, architect, and scale high\-availability routing architectures to seamlessly balance and secure global user traffic across a hybrid footprint of on\-premise datacenters, AWS, and GCP. * Manage and automate cloud and edge infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Chef, ensuring consistent configurations for Kubernetes, global Cloudflare services, and CI/CD pipelines. * Maintain and optimize large\-scale production environments, orchestrating high\-availability MySQL replication, automated failover, robust disaster recovery, and system monitoring. * Develop internal tools for operational automation, system/data backups, performance tuning, and comprehensive security monitoring. * Drive operational excellence by leading planning meetings, retrospectives, and RCAs, while continuously evaluating systems against industry best practices. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to maintain production stability, handle incident responses, and collaborate with/mentor cross\-functional engineering teams. **You Have...** =============== * 5\+ years of experience in Technical/Network Operations, DevOps, or SRE roles managing large\-scale production platforms (e.g., 10M\+ monthly active users). * Deep proficiency in Linux systems administration, networking protocols (TCP/IP, routing), secure systems practices, and scripting/programming (Go, Python, or Bash). * Proven hands\-on experience with core infrastructure tech: Kubernetes/container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and monitoring/reliability systems (e.g., Prometheus). * Practical experience managing production MySQL database environments, including deep familiarity with replication topologies, failover mechanisms, and performance tuning. * Demonstrated capability using generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) to enhance productivity, paired with the ability to critically audit and verify outputs for accuracy, security, and context. **Bonus Points...** =================== * Advanced Cloudflare expertise, including CDN optimization, WAF security, DNS management, edge performance tuning, and Cloudflare Tunnels. * Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, edge caching, and centralized log management using the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana). * Experience defining SLOs and instrumentation, implementing meaningful metrics, logs, and traces to reduce alert noise and drive postmortem action items. **Benefits \& Perks** ===================== * Salary Range \= $122k \- $204k (*Actual salary available will vary based on location and market factors.)* * Vibrant team culture * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision * Training (unlimited Udemy \+ more) * Flexible working hours and time off * Equity \& Retirement Programs including 401K match * Paid Parental Leave * International work environment with start\-up culture **About Fandom** ================ Fandom is the world's largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. jobs.title: CAD Specialist
jobs.description: **About Fervo Energy** ---------------------- Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next\-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon\-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around\-the\-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber\-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility\-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon\-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world\-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future. **Position Description** ------------------------ The CAD/PLM Administrator is an individual contributor role with high potential for shaping future organizational structure. This role is responsible for CAD/PLM implementation and upkeep, CAD and drawing standards and workflows, and system architecture for connection with ERP and other enterprise software. The role will support the hiring of designers and drafters for the engineering organization, manage vendor relationships for PLM and CAD software upkeep, handle transmittal and document control alongside the document control team, and model plant systems where we have resource gaps. CAD, PLM, document control, and transmittal are a single ecosystem, and the ideal candidate approaches them that way. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **CAD Standards:** Build Fervo's CAD standards, including drafting conventions, title blocks, drawing templates, and file management protocols across all engineering modules. Drive 3D model\-based approaches where they create leverage, such as clash detection, constructability reviews, and as\-built capture. * **PLM Administration:** Govern Fervo's Siemens Teamcenter PLM environment, including part numbering, BOM structures, revision workflows, and ECR/ECO/ECN processes. Define integrations between PLM and enterprise systems (ERP, procurement, asset management) so design data flows cleanly across the digital thread without manual re\-keying. * **Document Control and Transmittal:** Ensure the EDMS and transmittal workflow is integrated with CAD/PLM end\-to\-end, including outgoing submittals, vendor drawing review, RFI tracking, and redline incorporation into the as\-built record. Define and/or enforce document numbering, revision conventions, and distribution matrices, and review and approve all deliverables before IFC issue or external distribution. * **Standardization:** Drive standardization across all engineering modules so that every plant benefits from the drawing and data work done on the last one. Find the best process to close the feedback loop between design and field execution, applying redline patterns and constructability issues forward to future plant designs. * **CAD and Plant Design:** Use Fervo's CAD tools (Siemens NX, Autodesk, and Revit) or similar with a deep understanding of the CAD process to ensure good data governance and design practices. * **PLM/PDM and EDMS:** Hold workflow design and PLM administration in Siemens Teamcenter, or a similar system, to the highest standard. Evaluate whether a standalone EDMS or PLM\-native document control is the right fit at Fervo's scale, and make that call with a clear rationale. * **Enterprise Integration:** Understand how BOMs, part masters, and procurement data connect between PLM and ERP (SAP, Oracle, or similar), and where integration breaks without governance. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### ***Required*** * 7\+ years in CAD, engineering data management, or design delivery in industrial, energy, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing * Demonstrated experience building CAD standards, drawing templates, and document governance systems from scratch * Expert in at least one major CAD platform (AutoCAD, Plant 3D, NX, CATIA, or equivalent), and fluent across multiple drawing types: P\&IDs, general arrangements, civil/structural, electrical, and mechanical * Direct PLM or PDM experience: data model configuration, revision workflows, BOM management, or enterprise integration * Full drawing lifecycle ownership from early design through IFC, construction, and as\-built ### ***Preferred*** * Siemens NX and/or Teamcenter experience * Background in aerospace, automotive OEM, or semiconductor, where PLM is foundational to the engineering process * EDMS experience in capital project environments and familiarity with PLM\-ERP integration (SAP or Oracle) * Background building something that had to scale, where the standard you set mattered far beyond the project in front of you **Location** ------------ Fervo Energy is headquartered in Houston, TX with growing offices in Golden, Oakland, Reno, and Salt Lake City. The preferred location for this role is Houston, TX. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options * Employer\-paid basic life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * A 401(k) plan with a dollar\-for\-dollar company match * Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave * Family\-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot * A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses * An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care * Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as stock option grants and bonus opportunities for eligible roles Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change. **Our Workplace** ----------------- Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in\-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

You will own our arrays of three\-component geophones and broadband seismometers — sited at the surface, in shallow vaults and boreholes, and downhole in monitoring wells — from network geometry and instrumentation through calibration, data quality, and continuous processing. The central deliverable of this role is a high\-precision, defensible earthquake catalog. Proficiency with HypoDD and GrowClust is required, and you will build, relocate, quality\-control, and defend the catalogs that feed fracture\-network characterization, reservoir models, induced\-seismicity mitigation protocols, and regulatory and community engagement. Fervo also operates fiber\-optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) in a number of wells, and you will incorporate DAS alongside the conventional sensor network as a complementary observing system. Familiarity with DAS is valuable, but it is not the focus of the role and is not required at hire — the conventional network and the relocated catalog come first. **Responsibilities** -------------------- *Surface and Borehole Geophone \& Seismometer Networks* * Design, deploy, and maintain surface and borehole geophone and seismometer networks. * Set network geometry and instrumentation to meet detection, location\-accuracy, and completeness targets. * Own instrument response, sensor orientation and calibration, timing, and continuous data QC. * Run automated detection, phase picking, and event association across the network. * Build and maintain 1D and 3D velocity models and station corrections. * Manage field campaigns, vendor scopes, and data\-delivery standards. *Earthquake Location, Relocation, and Catalog Development* * Run HypoDD for double\-difference relocation. * Run GrowClust for relative relocation and hierarchical clustering. * Generate waveform cross\-correlation differential travel times and maintain automated relocation pipelines. * Determine source parameters — magnitude, focal mechanism, moment tensor, and stress drop. * Interpret relocated seismicity as fracture geometry, stimulated volume, and fault reactivation. * Maintain a versioned production catalog with documented magnitudes, completeness, and uncertainty. *Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) — complementary observing system* * Incorporate DAS data from instrumented wells alongside the conventional network. * Perform joint DAS and sensor processing where it improves the catalog. * Interpret DAS response in a borehole setting, including its resolution limits. *Induced Seismicity, Hazard, and Risk* * Track b\-value and magnitude of completeness, and forecast seismicity rates and maximum magnitude. * Develop real\-time hazard algorithms using physics\-based, statistical, and machine\-learning methods. * Maintain traffic light protocols and mitigation strategies with operations. * Link observed seismicity to Thermo\-Hydro\-Mechanical\-Chemical reservoir models. * Represent Fervo with regulators, partners, and communities on induced\-seismicity questions. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### ***Required*** * Ph.D. in Geophysics, Seismology, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field. No minimum years of industry or post\-doctoral experience are required — recent and upcoming graduates are encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency with HypoDD and GrowClust, including generation of waveform cross\-correlation differential travel times, parameter selection, and assessment of relocation uncertainty. This may have been developed through thesis work, post\-doctoral research, or industry practice. * Solid grounding in surface and borehole seismic monitoring — network geometry and detectability, instrument response, sensor orientation and calibration, and earthquake detection, picking, and location. * Knowledge of earthquake source analysis, including moment tensor inversion, focal mechanism determination, magnitude estimation, and stress drop estimation. * Understanding of induced seismicity and seismic hazard concepts — magnitude of completeness, b\-value, Gutenberg\-Richter statistics, and ground\-motion estimation. * Python proficiency for seismic data processing (ObsPy, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, or equivalent tooling) and comfort working in Linux environments with shell scripting and version control. * Ability to build velocity models and to produce, quality\-control, and defend earthquake catalogs that others rely on. * Willingness to travel to field sites for network deployment, commissioning, and troubleshooting up to 20%. ### ***Preferred*** * High Performance Computing and large\-scale distributed processing of continuous seismic data. * Machine learning applied to seismological problems, including deep\-learning phase pickers. **Location** ------------ Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Fieldpiece** is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day \- and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named***one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years***, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers. We're looking for a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer** to help us turn the potential of AI into practical solutions that help teams to increase their efficiency, speed, and accuracy in their everyday jobs. This is a unique opportunity to become our first dedicated AI engineering hire and help shape how AI and automation are used across the organization. You'll partner with teams throughout the business—from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR to Product Development, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Experience, and IT—to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that deliver measurable value. This position is in our Park City, UT office with an exciting move to Heber City, UT in 2027\. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in\-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.**Why This Role?*** This isn't a role where you'll spend your time simply evaluating AI tools or developing proofs of concept that never make it into production. You'll sit down with business teams, understand what they're trying to accomplish and where their processes are slowing them down, translate those needs into technical requirements, determine the right solution, and then build, deploy, and improve it. * The projects will vary widely. One may involve automating a manual workflow; another could involve creating an AI agent, improving access to company knowledge, connecting AI to an enterprise system, or building a decision\-support application. The common thread is using technology to solve meaningful business problems. * We're technology agnostic and want someone who can choose the right solution for the problem rather than force every problem into the same technology stack. That said, experience within the Microsoft ecosystem—particularly Dynamics 365 Business Central, Azure, Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365—is highly valuable in our environment. **What You'll Do*** Partner with teams across Fieldpiece to understand their workflows, pain points, and business needs and identify opportunities where AI, automation, or better technology can make a meaningful difference. * Take business requirements from concept to solution—designing, developing, implementing, and supporting production\-ready applications and automations. * Build AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, decision\-support tools, and other practical AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge systems, APIs, and agentic workflows. * Connect AI solutions with ERP, CRM, PLM, customer support, analytics, knowledge management, productivity, and other enterprise platforms. * Reengineer processes to improve speed, accuracy, quality, service, cost, revenue enablement, and employee productivity. * Establish testing and evaluation approaches to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, scalable, and effective. * Work closely with Information Systems, business leaders, data owners, and security stakeholders to implement appropriate governance and controls. * Help users successfully adopt new AI tools and continuously improve solutions based on feedback and results. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and make practical recommendations based on business value, implementation requirements, cost, risk, and scalability. * Bachelor’s degree in CS, AI, or related fields. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions using modern AI technologies, including large language models. * Experience taking ambiguous business problems and translating them into practical technical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with prompt design, retrieval architectures, AI application testing, and model/system evaluation. Experience building AI agents, multi\-agent systems, tool\-using agents, RAG solutions, or complex agentic workflows. * Experience integrating APIs, cloud services, enterprise applications, and data sources. * Strong proficiency in Python or another modern language used for AI application development. * Experience with data engineering, analytics, BI, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, or cloud deployment. * Experience with source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and modern software delivery practices. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions in business terms. * A practical, curious mindset \- you enjoy learning how a business works, asking the right questions, and figuring out how technology can make it better. **Even Better If You Have*** Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or integrating solutions with ERP systems, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, or Dataverse. * Experience working in a product, manufacturing, distribution, or field\-service environment. * Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, or business process reengineering. **Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece*** As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short\-term results. * Make a meaningful impact with a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business. **Benefits \& Perks**We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth.* Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting * Generous paid time off and paid holidays * Hire to Retire philosophy \- Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Music program – music rooms in all US offices with onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California (classes can be streamed for other offices) * Recognition programs, launch parties and team building events to share successes **Our Culture** At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day. We use the TURTL acronym to show that we believe in:* **TRIBE** – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team. * **Upfront Homework** – We come prepared, begin with the end in mind and address obstacles with creativity, grit and tenacity. * **Right Stuff** – We deliver innovative solutions by seeing through the eyes of our customers and use purposeful critical thinking to lead to greatness. * **Trust** – We build strong relationships through credibility, accountability and transparency. * **Lean** – We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, learning from failures and delivering results. * **No Ego –** We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect. At Fieldpiece, we're building more than innovative products \- we're building careers. If you're looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we'd love to meet you. *EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability*

Across Teams**: Demonstrated experience driving cross\-team technical initiatives and influencing engineering direction. * **Deliver Through Ambiguity**: A track record of taking high\-impact problems from definition through execution. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with data platforms or data engineering systems, along with an understanding of application security principles. \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-EM1
