jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The **AI \& Automation Engineer** is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company\-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI. **This position will require regular (every week) in\-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work\-from\-home opportunity. At this time, fully\-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.** **What you will do:****Solution Design and Development*** Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams. * Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model\-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams. * Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365\) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections. * Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions. * Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or JSON) where low\-code tooling falls short and use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization. **AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering*** Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company\-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations. * Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role\-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries. * Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release. **Security, Governance, and Responsible AI*** Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least\-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations. * Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end\-user, maker, and agent\-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content\-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions. * Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation. **Operations, Support, and Enablement*** Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend. * Provide third\-tier support and root\-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after\-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures. * Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices. * Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production. * Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders. **Our ideal candidate:*** Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, automation, low\-code/no\-code development, and practical business process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role\-based access control as they apply to AI workloads. * Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git. * Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels. * Must be well\-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail. * Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required. * Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes. **Work Environment** (The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling. **What We Can Offer You:*** Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution * 401(k) with matching * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans * Basic Life \& AD\&D, short\-term disability, \& and long\-term disability * Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year * Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work\-life balance and personal growth * Casual dress attire * Family\-owned company where you’re more than just another employee Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. With a dedicated team of over 1,000 employees, we are committed to delivering exceptional service, top\-quality parts and rentals, and unparalleled sales support across a comprehensive range of Caterpillar and allied construction equipment, power generation solutions, and cutting\-edge SITECH construction technology. As we continue to empower our customers' success, we invite you to explore the endless opportunities that await you at Foley. To learn more about our company and join our team of industry leaders, please visit www.FoleyEq.com.* *At this time Foley does not participate in any Visa sponsorship programs.*

jobs.description: In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next\-generation AI capabilities. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare\-metal targets, architecting safety\-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real\-time targets and richer application environments. **What You'll Do** * **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C\+\+ firmware for safety\-critical embedded devices. * **Real\-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS\-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter\-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis. * **Bare\-Metal and Drivers:** Write Linux user\-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product. * **Pipeline \& Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on\-target and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test execution. * **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint. * **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508\) while maintaining development velocity. **What You Bring** * interrupt\-driven design. * **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code. * **Linux Exposure:** We support product, design, engineering, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions by improving the tools, workflows, and technology experiences they rely on every day. Our goal is to provide secure, reliable, and seamless technology that helps employees spend less time navigating friction and more time solving the problems that matter most in their domains. ### **The Role** At General Motors, we are using AI to simplify how work gets done—reducing manual effort, removing friction, and helping engineers and business teams focus on higher\-value outcomes. As a Principal Engineer, AI Acceleration, you will identify high\-leverage opportunities, then design, build, and scale AI\-powered tools that measurably improve how people work. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, AI/LLM capabilities, product thinking, and organizational change. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. This isn’t a research or advisory role. You’ll ship tools people use every day and aim for step changes of 10x to 100x, not incremental gains. For example, our design team’s brand guidelines live in Figma. Instead of maintaining static templates, we built an AI skill that reads the guidelines directly, drafts on\-brand presentations, and runs a linter that catches off\-brand choices. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Enterprise Brain
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. The project involves using both LLM and other advanced ML techniques, agent orchestration and cutting\-edge ranking techniques. **You will:** * Work on deeply challenging ML problems involving user understanding and task prediction. * Invent new LLM workflows and signals to improve reasoning, planning, and personalization. * Design and optimize reinforcement learning and fine\-tuning approaches to improve the quality of understanding, prediction and other agentic systems. * Lead development of scalable evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization loops. * Build and maintain robust ML pipelines for enterprise and knowledge graph construction. * Drive initiatives to measure, monitor, and improve data quality, model quality, and end\-to\-end system performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deeply understand customer pain points and deliver high\-quality, production\-ready ML solutions. * Mentor junior engineers or learn from experienced ones in a tight\-knit, high\-velocity environment. **About you:** * You bring 6\+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering. * You hold a BA/BS in computer science, math, sciences, or a related field. * You have a proven ability to design, build, and ship production\-ready models and systems. * You bring demonstrated expertise in ML evaluation, benchmarking, and data quality. * You are proficient in an ML framework of your choice, such as TensorFlow or PyTorch. * You thrive in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment, turning open\-ended customer and ML problems into clear priorities and production\-ready solutions. * You balance speed with quality, making pragmatic tradeoffs to deliver measurable progress without losing sight of production readiness. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $280,000 annually. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position:** Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Booking Platform \& APIs **Duration:** FTE **Shift:** Monday \- Friday / Standard **Annual Salary:** $190,000 to $210,000 **Location:** New York City, four days per week in the office. We are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to lead the technical work and be the primary hands\-on builder for the client's API. In your first year, multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent should complete real bookings through the same versioned API. You will evolve a production Rails and Postgres booking system used by millions of guests. The hard work is keeping prices and inventory correct, preventing overselling, surviving retries and partial failures, and reconciling systems when they disagree. **Your ownership and team** You will own the API’s day\-to\-day technical roadmap and design decisions. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will write production code, lead focused designs, guide migrations, and operate what you build. You will partner with our Staff Engineer on foundational domain and architecture choices. You will be the primary builder, but you will not work alone. Other backend engineers will contribute and build supply, PMS, and POS connectors using the patterns you establish. Product, Partnerships, and hotel operations will work with you from requirements through production launch. **What you’ll do** * Build and launch the external client 's API. Define stable, versioned contracts for live pricing, availability, holds, booking creation, changes, and cancellations. * Make booking operations safe under real failures. Design idempotency, recovery, webhooks, and reconciliation for retries, timeouts, duplicates, and partial success. * Evolve the core booking domain. Create clear models and invariants for products, schedules, prices, inventory, holds, carts, and bookings. * Make the platform extensible. Prove that a new category such as events or food and beverage can use the shared booking model instead of requiring a separate system. * Own the architecture for supply, PMS, and POS integrations. Create reusable connector patterns so other engineers can add partners without reinventing failure handling and reconciliation. * Define the data contracts that keep inventory discoverable through OpenSearch. Search is supporting technology for this role, not its primary ownership area. * Operate what you build. Set reliability and latency targets, and add the tests, metrics, dashboards, alerts, tracing, and runbooks needed for a critical booking path. * Turn partner needs into durable platform capabilities, explain tradeoffs clearly, and raise the engineering bar through practical reviews and mentoring.. **Tech stack** * Backend: Ruby on Rails, Node.js * Data: Postgres, MongoDB * Search: OpenSearch * APIs and integrations: REST, OpenAPI, webhooks * Infrastructure and observability: AWS, Datadog * Testing: RSpec, Playwright **Who you are** We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not match every line below. * You have 6\+ years of software engineering experience, or a track record of equivalent impact. * You have designed transactional systems, built external APIs or integration platforms, and safely evolved data models in production. * You understand relational modeling, concurrency, consistency, asynchronous workflows, and distributed failures. * You turn complex business rules into clear boundaries, lifecycle states, contracts, and invariants. * You can lead an important system as its primary builder while collaborating on foundational decisions. * You care about correctness, testing, observability, and safe rollouts. * You communicate directly, listen well, and improve the work of engineers around you. Ruby on Rails experience is useful, but not required. Experience with marketplaces, reservations, inventory\-constrained commerce, public APIs, or third\-party booking systems is also helpful. We care most about your backend judgment, track record, and ability to learn. **What success looks like in 6–12 months** * Multiple distribution partners and an authorized AI agent complete real bookings through one reusable API. * The full booking lifecycle meets agreed targets for correctness, success rate, latency, overselling, recovery, and reconciliation. * Reusable contracts and connector patterns materially reduce the work required to onboard the next partner. * The shared booking model supports at least one new category without a separate booking system. As the API becomes a company\-wide platform, this role can grow toward Staff through demonstrated impact across the booking domain, integrations, and distribution. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision coverage, with contributing to monthly premiums * Stock options * 401(k) plan * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $190,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Experience: * backend/platform engineering: 6 years (Required) * transactional system design: 6 years (Required) * Ruby on Rails/Node/Postgres/AWS/Datadog/Redfis/Kafka: 6 years (Required) * external API and integration: 6 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * New York, NY 10040 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in silicon design or architecture (e.g., logic design, power architecture, performance, or SoC design). * Experience with power design, power modeling, power architecture, or power reduction methodologies/techniques. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. * Experience defining and implementing chip\-wide power management architectures and designs. * Experience in power modeling, measurement, and correlation across the pre\- and post\-silicon phases. * Understanding of modern power and thermal management techniques at both the silicon and system levels (including Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), turboing, thermal management, and system\-level tradeoffs). * Ability to solve open\-ended power and performance problems under ambiguity. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Our model powers many impactful Google products, including Busyness, Transit Crowdedness, Maps Timeline, Commute Notifications, User Generated Content (UGC) for Maps, and Ads measurement. The team is a machine\-learning\-heavy team whose mission is to improve the quality of the model and the products it powers through better signal acquisition, feature engineering, model architecture, data cleaning, and ground truth data. Our model runs on 100s of millions of Android and iOS devices and is built by large\-scale, parallel training pipelines on Google servers. As the Engineering Manager for the team, you will lead a team of software and machine learning engineers in their development of Google's foundational Semantic Location engine. You will also collaborate with our key clients across Maps, Ads, Android, and other product areas to align on joint priorities, identify opportunities for impact, and unlock new use cases for Semantic Location across Google. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives. The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Labs is a group focused on incubating early\-stage efforts in support of Google’s mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team exists to help discover and create new ways to advance our core products through exploration and the application of new technologies. We work to build new solutions that have the potential to transform how users interact with Google. Our goal is to drive innovation by developing new Google products and capabilities that deliver significant impact over longer timeframes. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and build Minimum Viable Tests (MVTs) and functional prototypes to rapidly de\-risk novel AI agent concepts. Execute targeted technical spikes to prove core feasibility and overcome critical architectural hurdles within strict, 4\-week exploratory sprints. * Apply deep expertise in agentic systems, including planning, memory, context management, tool\-use, and loops, to rapidly prototype and evaluate novel solutions for design, coding and product building. * Operate with a "rolled\-up mindset" by seamlessly blending the responsibilities of Software Engineering, Product Management, Research, Data Science and UX Research. * Prioritize learning and prototyping over perfect code. Design clever, high\-speed tests too validate User Value, Strategic Value, and Feasibility, generating raw signal before committing to heavy infrastructure. * Analyze early technical and user signals to evaluate the project viability. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience coding in one or more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C\+\+, or Go) focused on backend system architecture. * Experience building automated LLM evaluation pipelines, automated rating systems (AutoRaters), or defining LLM\-specific reliability metrics (e.g., measuring grounding, helpfulness, safety, and hallucination/error reduction). * Experience with backend, distributed systems, or AI/ML systems infrastructure. * Experience managing software engineers, including performance management, mentoring, and team growth. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization. * Experience developing, calibrating, and productionizing LLM\-based AutoRater frameworks or automated regression testing. * Experience designing agentic tooling and integrating agents with commerce platforms. * Experience in conversational AI architectures, agent orchestration harnesses, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) for knowledge libraries. * Track record of technical leadership partnering with Product Management, Data Science, and UX to build "Ground Truth" datasets and performance\-tracking dashboards. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. The Business Agent team powers Google’s Agentic Commerce strategy by building the AI platform behind seamless merchant\-consumer interactions across Search, YouTube, Ads, and Messaging. We turn conversational AI into measurable commerce outcomes for millions of businesses worldwide. We solve complex, high\-scale AI issues to build fast, reliable, and intelligent agent experiences. Optimize multi\-turn AI reasoning loops and tool\-calling pipelines for real\-time responsiveness. Develop robust data pipelines for the Merchant Knowledge Library to power accurate Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). Build automated evaluation frameworks and AutoRaters to continuously measure conversation quality and factuality at scale.People shop on Google more than a billion times a day \- and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers \- from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience \- and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Manage and mentor a Software Engineering team, owning the roadmap and architecture for applied AI, low\-latency scoring, and automated evaluation. * Lead Knowledge Library and merchant control engineering, building advanced RAG integrations (PDF ingestion, auto\-learning) for custom agent behavior. * Oversee autonomous execution tooling and Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) integration to enable active user journeys (catalog lookups, universal carts, reservations). * Advocate prompt tuning and loss diagnosis while scaling LLM\-based AutoRater frameworks to reduce hallucinations and measure conversation factuality. * Partner with Product, Data Science, UX, and core Google platform teams to define Ground Truth datasets, investigative dashboards, and model upgrade standards. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.** **Job Summary** As a Data Engineer at Grady, you’ll be a key player in building and optimizing our data infrastructure. You’ll design scalable pipelines, integrate diverse data sources, and deliver actionable insights that empower clinical and operational teams across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities: * Design and develop scalable ETL pipelines to support enterprise data needs * Integrate data from clinical systems, APIs, warehouses, and external sources * Build and maintain BI solutions to monitor performance and drive strategic decisions * Ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality through validation and cleansing * Optimize workflows for performance and scalability * Collaborate across departments to support data\-driven initiatives Troubleshoot and resolve data/reporting issues with precision and urgency * **What You Bring** Required Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent experience * 6\+ years of experience in data engineering, integration, and optimization * Hands\-on experience with big data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) * Proficiency in SQL and Python * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data tools (Databricks, Snowflake) * Familiarity with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, Oracle, Hadoop, Teradata) * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills * Excellent communication and business acumen Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with data orchestrating and automation tools like Airflow or Jenkins following CI/CD pipelines * Certification in EPIC Caboodle or EPIC Clarity ***While this position is remote, we’re only able to hire candidates who reside in Georgia, Texas, Tennessee, North Carolina, Florida, South Carolina, Michigan, or Colorado.*** **Core Competencies** These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high\-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment. 1\. **Patient\-Centered Care** – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high\-quality care that prioritizes the well\-being and satisfaction of patients and their families. 2\. **Integrity \& Accountability** – Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and accepts responsibility for actions, decisions, and outcomes. 3\. **Collaboration \& Teamwork** – Builds positive relationships, works effectively across departments, and supports colleagues to achieve shared goals. 4\. **Communication** – Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with patients, families, colleagues, and leadership. 5\. **Respect \& Inclusion** – Creates an inclusive environment by valuing diversity, treating others with dignity, and ensuring equitable care and opportunities for all. 6\. **Quality \& Safety** – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high\-quality outcomes. 7\. **Adaptability \& Resilience** – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure. 8\. **Continuous Improvement** – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback. 9\. **Leadership \& Professionalism** – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency. 10\. **Employee Experience Focus** – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care. **Grady Total Rewards** At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well\-being, and growth of every team member. Our **Total Rewards** package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including: * Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage. * Financial Security: Retirement savings plans with employer contributions, life insurance, and disability coverage. * Work\-Life Balance: Paid time off, holidays, and family leave benefits. * Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, professional development programs, and opportunities for advancement. * Employee Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and discounts on services. Grady’s Total Rewards are designed to ensure our employees feel valued, supported, and empowered, both at work and beyond. **Why Join Grady?** Grady Health System is more than a hospital — we are a vital part of Atlanta and the surrounding communities. For over 125 years, Grady has been committed to providing exceptional care, advancing health equity, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve. When you join Grady, you become part of a team that values excellence, compassion, innovation, and collaboration. Here, every role matters. Whether you provide direct patient care, support our operations, or lead teams, you play an important part in fulfilling our mission. We offer opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career in an environment where your contributions are recognized and valued. At Grady, we don’t just work, we make an impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:** Grady Health System is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Grady is dedicated to creating an accessible work environment and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to ensure equitable opportunities for success.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account** Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more. **About the Role** ------------------ Happen Bank is building a modern enterprise data and AI platform on Databricks. Our Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Analytics teams build the pipelines. This team builds what they build on. As a Principal Data Engineer, you'll own the technical architecture and development of the platform frameworks and infrastructure that make downstream pipelines faster, safer, and more consistent. This includes configuration\-driven ingestion frameworks, secure connectivity to source systems, reusable data protection libraries for anonymization and tokenization, and the infrastructure\-as\-code foundation that brings these capabilities together. This is a framework and platform engineering role, not a pipeline\-delivery role. Success means enabling teams to onboard new data sources, protect sensitive information, and promote work to production through configuration rather than custom code.**What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own ingestion architecture:** Define the technical vision and architecture for a declarative, configuration\-driven ingestion framework that brings data from relational databases and object\-store files into the raw data layer. Establish reusable patterns and contracts for downstream teams while evaluating tradeoffs between ingestion approaches * **Build scalable platform frameworks:** Lead the design and implementation of reusable, versioned libraries that support policy\-driven data protection, including configurable rules, governed access, consistent outputs, secure\-by\-default failure behavior, and audit trails. Maintain backward compatibility across shared capabilities used by multiple teams * **Set infrastructure and deployment standards:** Define infrastructure\-as\-code practices for safe deployment, replacement, rollback, and lifecycle management, including data ownership considerations for managed pipeline objects. Establish compute, cost, and sizing guidance for large initial loads and steady\-state incremental processing at billion\-row scale * **Drive platform reliability and observability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, recovery, and data validation capabilities that ensure reliable operations from source to destination. Identify and address observability gaps in underlying platform tools * **Lead evidence\-based technology decisions:** Conduct structured proofs of concept with measurable success criteria, document architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and engage technology vendors to resolve product gaps and influence future capabilities * **Drive cross\-functional platform delivery:** Translate ambiguous technical challenges into clear requirements, interfaces, dependencies, and phased delivery plans. Partner with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Information Security, DBAs, and source\-system owners to deliver early solutions while building scalable long\-term capabilities and driving framework adoption * **Raise engineering standards:** Mentor senior and staff engineers, lead technical design and code reviews, and establish best practices for testing, documentation, release management, and maintainability across shared platform capabilities **About You** ------------- * 10\+ years of software or data platform engineering experience, including designing and delivering platform\-level frameworks, libraries, or infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams * Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong experience with infrastructure as code, including Terraform and CI/CD pipelines for data platforms * Deep experience building ingestion capabilities across diverse data sources, including relational databases, files, APIs, and custom systems, with expertise in incremental processing, change data capture (CDC), schema evolution, and protecting production source systems from excessive load * Advanced programming skills in Python, SQL, and a JVM language such as Scala or Java, with experience developing Spark UDFs and reusable libraries using strong testing, packaging, and versioning practices * Deep hands\-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader, workflows, compute configuration, and governance capabilities, or equivalent data platform experience * Strong knowledge of security and priva * Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles or equivalent deployment tooling **Work Location** San Francisco The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in\-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in\-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In\-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level. **Time Zone Requirements** Local hours (PT) While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary. **Travel Requirements** As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed. **Compensation** The target base salary range for this position is 197,000\-230,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long\-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings). We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-BC1 Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Infrastructure)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $265\.2K – $331\.5K We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Engineering at Headway** -------------------------------- Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!). **About this role** ------------------- You'll lead the Infrastructure team — one of three teams in Engineering Foundations, alongside Agentic Engineering and Eddy, Headway's internal AI platform — that every other team at Headway builds on. You'll own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, LLM infrastructure (gateway, multi\-provider failover, per\-team rate limiting), the database platform, observability, and incident response, while hiring and growing a high\-performance team shipping at AI\-accelerated velocity. As AI dramatically increases code velocity across the org, our mandate is to make every change safe from the start and build systems that get safer as they get faster, working toward a model where routine infrastructure is self\-serve and the team spends the majority of its time on strategic platform work. That means owning the reliability, performance, and scalability of Mamba, Headway's FastAPI/Python monolith, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on. This is a technical leadership role: you'll set strategy and vision for the team, report to the Head of Engineering Foundations, and lead through credibility in design reviews and incident response, not through distance from the work. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **An engineering team:** hiring to a high bar into a growing team, developing engineers through the senior and staff levels, and running an effective on\-call rotation for a team the rest of engineering depends on. **The infrastructure platform:** a system every other Headway team builds on, and a roadmap spanning cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, LLM infrastructure, the data layer, and observability. **The shift from reactive to strategic:** driving the team's operating model toward self\-serve infrastructure, so the team spends more time on strategic platform work and less on routine support requests. **Blast\-radius reduction:** leading the architectural and deployment validation work that contains the scope and duration of incidents when they happen. **The org interface:** defining production readiness expectations for AI workloads, co\-owning container security and secrets management with the Security team, and making sure the platform is accessible and well\-understood by the product engineering teams that depend on it. **Principles that guide us:** ----------------------------- **Focus on the mission:** We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing. **Ship small, learn fast:** We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration **Everything is a product:** Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we tre  feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes. **Who You Are** --------------- We're looking for experienced engineering team leaders and people managers who are relationship\-obsessed, drive results, and enable their teams to build for technical excellence. As a Senior Engineering Manager at Headway, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership, Security, and product engineering teams across the org to help shape the future of the engineering organization. You are an infrastructure leader who is as comfortable in a postmortem as you are in a planning doc. You know how to run a team that carries a support queue while still making progress on strategic platform work. You hold the technical bar yourself and earn credibility with the team through the quality of your judgment, not your title. * 5\-7\+ years of experience of engineering leadership experience, with experience leading infrastructure or platform teams. * 5\+ years of experience as a Software or Infrastructure Engineer, with enough depth to lead credibly in design reviews and incident response * You've personally led the shift from "infra team owns everything" to a self\-serve platform other engineers build on themselves — not just inherited or operated a system where that transition had already happened. * Experience managing the interface between a platform team and the product engineering teams that depend on it, including setting ownership boundaries and building self\-serve tooling * Comfortable managing through competing demands: a support queue, a strategic roadmap, an on\-call rotation, and fast\-moving external dependencies all at once * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS), observability tooling (Datadog or similar), and deployment pipelines at companies where reliability is a product requirement. * You're personally hands\-on with AI coding tools day to day — not just driving your team's AI adoption as a program. Every candidate goes through a hands\-on AI coding interview as part of this loop * Experience owning a platform strategy and representing it to senior leadership: setting measurable goals for infrastructure work, and making the case for foundational investment in terms the business understands **Below are additional experiences we think help engineering managers succeed at Headway:** * You have led a team through a significant architectural transition, such as moving from a monolith toward service isolation, or from manual to automated operations * You have experience building or governing LLM infrastructure and AI platform primitives * You have experience in healthcare or another regulated environment We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Frontier AI Data Labeling
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Frontier models are only as good as the data they learn from. At Hippocratic AI, that data decides whether an AI agent safely guides a patient through a medication change at 2 a.m. Our data powers Polaris, a constellation of models with a 700B\-parameter core and specialized safety supervisors. In our evaluations, Polaris reaches 99\.95% accuracy on drug\-safety benchmarks versus 87\.9% for the closest voice\-deployable frontier model. The labeling, evals, and rater calibration behind it are how we earn and defend numbers like that. We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to run the human\-in\-the\-loop data labeling engine behind our frontier healthcare AI. That spans audio and conversation annotation, clinician\-labeled training data, preference and RLHF data, and the evaluations that decide what ships. You’ll work daily with ML researchers, applied scientists, and licensed clinicians. The data you produce feeds directly into our model training and evaluation loops. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Run the data pipelines behind our models.** Own end\-to\-end delivery of labeling and annotation programs, including audio and voice\-conversation labeling, supervised labeling, and preference and RLHF data. You’ll manage scoping, task design, execution, QA, and delivery against live model\-development cycles. * **Turn evals into products.** Work with ML and Applied Science to turn evaluation and training\-signal needs into concrete labeling tasks, rubrics, and success criteria. Your evals become the benchmarks that gate releases. * **Build and scale an expert rater workforce.** Source, screen, and onboard clinicians and specialized raters through marketplaces, vendors, and in\-house teams. This includes designing qualification tasks, setting rates, and scaling pools up and down as programs change. * **Write the guidelines that shape model behavior.** Author and iterate labeling guidelines and annotation rubrics, especially for subjective, high\-stakes clinical judgment. * **Engineer data quality at scale.** Design QC systems using gold sets, calibration sessions, spot checks, and inter\-rater agreement tracking. Catch rater drift and annotation bottlenecks before they reach training. * **Drive velocity and accountability.** Track throughput, cost, and quality. Manage vendor relationships (SOWs, performance reviews), choose labeling and QA tooling, and keep Engineering, Clinical, and Infrastructure aligned on dependencies and timelines. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * **By Day 90:** You own a live data labeling or eval program through a major delivery milestone. You’ve cleared a critical bottleneck in the pipeline and shipped one measurable quality or throughput improvement. * **By 12 months:** You run multiple concurrent labeling and eval programs. Your calibrated rater bench is trusted by ML teams, and you can trace model improvements back to the data you delivered. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years in technical program management or data operations in an AI/ML or data\-intensive environment (3\+ years considered for exceptional candidates) * 2\+ years hands\-on with data labeling, annotation, or model evaluation, including writing guidelines and managing quality at scale * Experience sourcing and managing contractor or expert annotator workforces through marketplaces (e.g., Mercor, Upwork, Toloka) or labeling vendors * Working knowledge of how annotation quality affects model training, including preference data, pairwise comparisons, and rater calibration (RLHF) * A strong grasp of quality metrics (IAA, precision/recall on gold sets, throughput vs. accuracy tradeoffs) * A track record of owning critical data or eval projects under time pressure, working with ML engineers and applied scientists, and driving results without direct authority * Comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-moving, healthcare\-adjacent AI environment **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience running or supporting RLHF or other training\-data pipelines at an AI lab or applied ML team * Clinical, healthcare, or other regulated, high\-stakes data experience * Familiarity with Label Studio, Scale AI, Surge AI, or SageMaker Ground Truth * Experience qualifying specialized raters such as clinicians or bilingual SMEs * Exposure to reward hacking and specification gaming, and how annotation design can mitigate them **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote#### **Little more about the team:** The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you. #### **What you’ll do in the role:** * Own end\-to\-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in\-product visualizations. * Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product. * Build systems that analyze and surface AI\-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies. * Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows. * Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads. * Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures. #### **What you’ll bring to the role:** * Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end. * Experience shipping customer\-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling. * Full\-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React). * A track record of working closely with product managers and designers. * Regular, hands\-on use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days. * A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast\-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job. * Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent\-powered features in production. * Bonus: Hands\-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry. Base Salary based on level of experience $183,340 \- $206,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage - Highrise AI
jobs.description: **About Highrise AI** Highrise AI is a GPU\-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance\-critical and security\-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments. Highrise combines bare\-metal performance with full\-stack orchestration, API\-driven access, and hardware\-enforced isolation to support training, fine\-tuning, and production\-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise\-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale. Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on\-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise\-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third\-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own. Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next\-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a mid\-level AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer to provide Tier 2 operational support for large\-scale GPU compute and storage platforms. This hands\-on role focuses on owning technical tickets, restoring service, investigating recurring issues, and maintaining reliable day\-to\-day operation of production AI clusters. Working closely with the NOC, on\-site data hall technicians, SRE teams, and senior infrastructure engineers, the engineer will troubleshoot Linux\-based compute nodes, GPU systems, storage services, and their supporting software. Complex or systemic issues will be escalated to Tier 3 engineering with clear diagnostics and supporting evidence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Tier 2 Incident and Ticket Management** * Own and manage escalated incidents, service requests, and problem tickets from initial technical triage through resolution, escalation, or documented handoff. * Diagnose compute and storage faults using system logs, monitoring dashboards, management interfaces, and approved diagnostic tools. * Assess severity and customer impact; coordinate with the NOC and site teams to restore service within operational and SLA targets. * Produce clear troubleshooting records, timely ticket updates, shift handovers, and actionable Tier 3 or OEM escalations. **Compute and GPU Platform Operations** * Troubleshoot Linux servers, GPU health alerts, boot failures, firmware/driver issues, hardware faults, and resource availability problems. * Support node provisioning, reimaging, configuration changes, routine maintenance, and return\-to\-service validation using established automation and runbooks. * Investigate Kubernetes and Slurm node or workload failures, working with platform engineers when application or scheduler\-level escalation is required. * Perform first\-level analysis of connectivity or GPU communication symptoms and engage network or Tier 3 engineers for deeper fabric and performance investigation. **Storage Operations and Troubleshooting** * Monitor and troubleshoot distributed and high\-performance storage systems, including capacity, throughput, availability, and client connectivity. * Investigate filesystem mount failures, storage\-node or disk alerts, degraded services, and access or performance complaints. * Execute approved recovery, maintenance, and component replacement workflows with storage vendors and data hall technicians. * Support operational tasks across file, object, and block storage platforms as deployed at Highrise sites. **Operational Readiness and Continuous Improvement** * Assist with upgrades, planned maintenance, cluster expansions, and validation activities following established change controls. * Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and ticket records; improve runbooks, troubleshooting checklists, and knowledge articles. * Identify recurring incidents and automate repeatable operational work with scripts and existing infrastructure management tools. * Collaborate with remote engineering teams, on\-site technicians, OEMs, and vendors to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **ABOUT YOU** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3–6 years of experience supporting Linux servers, HPC, cloud, or data center infrastructure in a production environment. * Practical troubleshooting experience with enterprise compute hardware, BMC interfaces (iDRAC/iLO or equivalent), operating systems, and monitoring tools. * Working familiarity with storage technologies such as NFS, distributed filesystems, object storage, and storage performance fundamentals. * Experience using ticketing systems, change management procedures, and Bash or Python scripting for routine diagnostics and automation. * Exposure to NVIDIA GPU systems, InfiniBand/RDMA, Kubernetes, Slurm, or AI/HPC storage platforms is a strong advantage. **Core Competencies** * Structured, evidence\-driven troubleshooting with sound judgment on when to remediate, collaborate, or escalate. * Strong ownership of tickets, attention to operational detail, and commitment to reliable customer service. * Ability to work effectively across NOC, SRE, hardware, network, storage, and Tier 3 engineering teams. * Clear written and verbal communication in English. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, engineering role supporting large\-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large\-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform. At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting * Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government * Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team * Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting\-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

jobs.title: PNT Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description**: IS4S is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to support the development of embedded software for Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems working on\-site in our Auburn, AL or Huntsville, AL location. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of navigation algorithms, sensor interfaces, platform integration, and software testing for resilient navigation solutions operating in challenging environments, including conditions where GPS/GNSS may be degraded, denied, or unavailable. This role offers the opportunity to work across the embedded software development lifecycle, from algorithm implementation and hardware interfacing to integration, testing, and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate has strong modern C\+\+ programming skills, experience developing software in Linux environments, and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, and well\-tested software. **Key Responsibilities** Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C\+\+. Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources. Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms. Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues. Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level tests to verify software functionality and performance. Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization. Use Git\-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows. Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience developing software in modern C\+\+, including object\-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices. Experience developing, building, debugging, and testing software in a Linux environment. Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well\-documented software. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with embedded software development on Linux\-based platforms. Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies. Experience interfacing with hardware using serial communications, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, or similar protocols. Experience with unit testing frameworks and software quality tools, such as static analysis, code coverage, and automated linting. Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD. Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis. Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing. **Benefits Summary:** Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits Dynamic and collaborative work environment Employee ownership Medical, dental, and vision care plans Paid time\-off and parental leave programs Group term life insurance 401(k) retirement plan Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings
