The Machine Learning Operations Manager is a hands\-on and results\-oriented leader responsible for overseeing the deployment and monitoring of machine learning products. Specifically, this role supports Machine Learning Operations at Select Health and will consistently deliver measurable reductions in healthcare costs and improvements in member's health while improving the member experience. This role leads and mentors a talented team of machine learning operations engineers and data engineers who enable deployment and monitoring of enterprise machine learning solutions at scale. This role fosters a culture of excellence, agility, and innovation. **Essential Functions** * Accountability for strategic direction of MLOps tech stack. * Manage AI and ML engineering, data engineering, software engineering, cybersecurity, cloud operations and other team partnerships and strategic alignment with business and technical leaders across the company. * Ensure efficient application of Responsible AI values to monitor and assess internal and 3rd party machine learning solutions. * Engage team to execute on AI and ML strategic vision and roadmap. * Coordinate machine learning operations and data engineering product development and product management. * Build and train effective machine learning engineering teams, foster employee engagement, ensure best practices, and strategic alignment. * Mentor and coach machine learning operations engineering leads in developing team culture and project execution. * Manage and execute the machine learning operations projects portfolio, ensuring timely and quality delivery of solutions that meet the organization's clinical, business, and technical needs. * Integrate machine learning solutions into key enterprise business processes and decisions, following best practices and frameworks for algorithm governance, ethics, and explainability. * Keep up to date with industry trends and advancements in machine learning, applying the latest practices and technologies to enhance the organization's capabilities and competitiveness. * Support innovation by conducting research initiatives and exploring new methodologies and applications of machine learning. * Recruit, train, and coach machine learning operations personnel, building a strong and skilled team. **Skills** * Machine Learning Operations * Cloud Platforms * Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Development * Team Leadership * Programming and CI/CD Best Practices **Location** This position can be performed remotely with business travel as\-needed. Intermountain Health maintains employment registration in Utah, Idaho, Nevada, Colorado, Montana, and Wyoming. Candidates in other locations may be considered. Currently, we are not hiring remote workers in the following states: CA, CT, HI, IL, MA, MN, NY, PA, RI, VT, and WA. Please note that a video interview through Microsoft Teams will be required as well as potential onsite interviews and meetings. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Demonstrated experience of delivering and implementing successful machine learning operations infrastructure and solutions. * Experience with DevOps best practices such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Git. * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles. * Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide high\-performing teams. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with experience engaging with senior\-level stakeholders. * Solid understanding of machine learning methodologies, algorithms, and frameworks including agentic systems. * Experience with machine learning tools and programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, etc. Experience with machine learning production frameworks including Spark, Tensorflow, MLFlow, \& LangChain, etc. * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in AI, ML, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 5 years of experience in machine learning, data science, data engineering, or software engineering * Experience deploying Generative AI products into operational workflows. * Experience in health insurance, population health, or related industry with solid understanding of medical economics. **Physical Requirements** Interact with others by effectively communicating, both orally and in writing Operate computers and other office equipment requiring the ability to move fingers and hands See and read computer monitors and documents Remain sitting or standing for long periods of time to perform work on a computer, telephone, or other equipment May require lifting and transporting objects and office supplies, bending, kneeling and reaching **Additional Information** This is an exempt, full\-time position. Awards are paid out based on attainment of selected Board\-approved goals. **Location:** SelectHealth \- Murray **Work City:** Murray **Work State:** Utah **Scheduled Weekly Hours:** 40 The hourly range for this position is listed below. jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - Intuit Intelligence, ML & AI
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **About the role** We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer to shape the technical and scientific direction of Intuit Intelligence. You will combine deep expertise in AI science and machine learning with hands\-on experience building agents that solve meaningful customer problems. You will connect research, model development, agent engineering, and production delivery across multiple organizations. Your work will establish reusable foundations for intelligent products and demonstrate where emerging AI capabilities can create durable business value. At least 40% of your time will be devoted to technical contributions, including experiments, prototypes, agent development, evaluation, and production problem\-solving. **Responsibilities** **What you’ll do** * Define the long\-term AI and ML strategy, connecting scientific advances to customer needs, product opportunities, and production constraints. * Architect and build agents that reason over context, retrieve information, use tools, coordinate workflows, and complete tasks with appropriate human oversight. * Establish reusable approaches for agent orchestration, context and memory management, capability integration, and recovery from failures. * Guide model selection, adaptation, training, and inference decisions using scientific evidence and explicit tradeoffs in quality, latency, and cost. * Build evaluation systems that measure model quality, end\-to\-end task completion, robustness, safety, and customer value. * Establish production practices for monitoring, experimentation, model and agent lifecycle management, and continuous improvement. * Address difficult challenges in grounding, uncertainty, generalization, permissions, privacy, and reliable execution. * Develop firsthand judgment through research and implementation, advancing promising ideas from experiments into validated product capabilities. * Partner with engineering, product, design, data science, and security leaders; mentor senior technical talent and model responsible agent\-driven development. **Qualifications** **What you’ll bring** * Deep expertise in AI science and ML, including statistical learning, deep learning, experimental design, and rigorous evaluation. * Demonstrated experience building and operating production AI systems and agents that perform consequential workflows. * Strong understanding of foundation models, retrieval, tool use, agent orchestration, and techniques for adapting models to domain needs. * The ability to distinguish improvements in model behavior from improvements in system reliability and customer outcomes. * A record of translating research into scalable products and reusable technical capabilities. * Strong software and systems engineering judgment, with the ability to influence technical direction across organizations. * The ability to explain scientific uncertainty and technical tradeoffs clearly to executive and technical audiences. **What success looks like** AI and agents complete customer tasks with measurable quality and reliability. Scientific advances translate into adopted product capabilities, reusable foundations accelerate delivery, and teams improve customer outcomes while managing operational cost and risk. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Architect
jobs.description: **What you will do** * Lead discovery with business users and technology teams. Map current workflows, identify bottlenecks, assess data and system readiness, and agree on a focused problem and measurable success criteria. * Translate customer priorities into a practical solution design and delivery plan. Make informed choices about where AI adds value, where conventional software is sufficient, and where human review is needed. * Build production\-quality AI applications, agents, and supporting services. Develop APIs, retrieval pipelines, tool integrations, orchestration logic, and user interfaces where required. * Connect solutions to enterprise applications and data sources. Address authentication, permissions, data quality, and reliable execution of actions across systems. * Establish evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria. Test task completion, output quality, failure modes, latency, and cost; use findings to improve the solution before and after deployment. * Own production readiness with customer and Jade teams. Implement access controls, auditability, monitoring, safe fallbacks, human approvals, and operational handover; troubleshoot issues after launch. * Provide technical direction to the delivery team while writing and reviewing code. Manage dependencies, surface risks early, and explain scope, architecture, and delivery tradeoffs clearly to customers. * Measure adoption and business impact against the agreed baseline. Turn successful patterns into reusable components and contribute field feedback to Jade Orbit and Jade's FDE delivery methods. **What you bring** * 6\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building LLM\-powered applications or agentic systems. Demonstrated ownership of multiple production deployments, with the ability to explain the code you wrote, architecture decisions, failure modes, and results. * Strong Python engineering skills, including asynchronous programming, API development, automated testing, and debugging. Solid grounding in SQL, data structures, distributed systems, and application design; ability to contribute across backend and user\-facing components. * Deep understanding of LLM application architecture, including model selection, embeddings, context management, structured outputs, tool calling, and inference tradeoffs. Ability to balance model quality, latency, cost, and privacy requirements. * Hands\-on experience engineering agents and orchestration using a framework or custom implementation. Ability to implement explicit state, persisted checkpoints, retries, idempotent tool execution, human approvals, and recovery from partial failures. * Ability to build and tune retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking, and access\-aware retrieval. Experience diagnosing retrieval quality and grounding failures. * Experience developing rigorous AI evaluations using representative datasets, task\-level metrics, regression tests, and adversarial cases. Ability to measure factual accuracy, tool\-use correctness, task completion, and failure rates rather than relying on subjective demonstrations. * Strong enterprise integration skills across APIs, authentication, databases, and event\-driven systems. Ability to expose business capabilities as secure tools and implement permission boundaries for agents that read data or execute actions. * Hands\-on production deployment and operations experience on a major cloud platform, including containers, CI/CD, secrets management, tracing, monitoring, and incident diagnosis. Ability to control concurrency, rate limits, inference costs, and operational reliability. * Practical experience securing AI applications against prompt injection, sensitive\-data exposure, and unauthorized tool execution. Ability to implement least\-privilege access, audit trails, validation, and human review where consequences require it. * Ability to lead technical discovery and architecture discussions directly with customers, turn incomplete requirements into working software, and guide distributed engineers while continuing to write and review production code. **Experience that would be valuable** * Previous work as an FDE, customer engineer, hands\-on technical consultant, technical founder, or solutions architect with substantial coding and deployment ownership. * Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, Model Context Protocol integrations, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, or model selection and fine\-tuning when justified by the use case. * Experience building enterprise AI foundations, modernizing applications with AI, or working with open\-source models and private deployment requirements. Delivery experience in manufacturing, high\-tech, or healthcare and life sciences, and collaboration with distributed engineering teams. * **How success will be measured** * Time to a useful first release and progression to reliable production use. * Adoption and measurable improvements in customer workflows, such as cycle time, quality, productivity, or cost. * Solution reliability, evaluation results, and effective management of operating costs. * Customer trust, clear technical ownership, and reusable engineering assets that improve future delivery. **Why join Jade Globa** l You will help shape a growing AI Engineering Services business, work directly with enterprise customers, and build solutions that become part of their daily operations. You will have access to Jade's engineering practices and our evolving suite of AI platforms and reusable solutions, while contributing to how we deliver FDE\-led engagements.

jobs.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Quality Engineer** Location: Remote \| USA **About the Jaeb Center for Health Research** The Jaeb Center is a nonprofit organization based in Tampa, Florida, serving primarily as a Coordinating Center for multi\-center clinical trials. To learn more about current projects and research initiatives, please visit www.jaeb.org. **Summary** The Senior Software Quality Engineer serves as the technical leader responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of JCHR’s software quality engineering capabilities. This role owns the technical strategy and architecture for software quality engineering across JCHR’s internally developed applications. The role partners closely with Software Engineers, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and leadership to ensure software systems are reliable, maintainable, validated, and fit for use in regulated clinical research environments. This is a hands\-on engineering role. The successful candidate will spend significant time writing code, building automation, developing testing infrastructure, analyzing systems, and improving engineering tooling—not defining testing processes or managing test execution. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Quality Engineering Leadership** * Own Jaeb's technical strategy and architecture for software quality engineering. * Define and maintain software testing standards, practices, and governance. * Establish quality metrics and reporting used to measure product health and release readiness. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives across development, testing, and deployment processes. * Act as the organization's subject matter expert for quality engineering. **AI\-Enabled Quality Engineering** * Use AI coding and agentic development tools to accelerate test creation, maintenance, analysis, and defect investigation. * Evaluate emerging AI\-native software engineering practices and determine where they can safely improve software quality, development velocity, and engineering effectiveness. * Explore autonomous and semi\-autonomous testing approaches, including AI\-generated test cases, browser\-based testing, and intelligent regression analysis. * Develop controls and validation practices for software and tests produced with AI\-assisted engineering tools. * Establish practical patterns for incorporating AI into the software development lifecycle while maintaining appropriate human oversight and regulatory controls. **Test Architecture \& Framework Ownership** * Design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade automated testing frameworks. * Develop standards and reusable components for automated testing across unit, integration, API, system, and end\-to\-end testing, with appropriate approaches for performance, accessibility, security, and other specialized testing needs. * Define testing architecture patterns used across software products. * Evaluate and implement testing tools, frameworks, and platforms. * Ensure testing capabilities scale with business and technical growth. **Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities** **Software Engineering** * Strong software development practices * Object\-oriented design * API architecture * SQL/database concepts * Git * CI/CD **Quality Engineering** * Test architecture * Automated testing * Risk\-based testing * Test data management * Test observability **Infrastructure** * Containers * CI/CD infrastructure **AI** * AI\-assisted software development * AI coding tools * Agentic development/testing concepts **Regulated Environments** * FDA/GxP * 21 CFR Part 11 * Software validation **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. * Five or more years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, test automation, software engineering, or a closely related field. * Demonstrated experience with modern software engineering and test automation technologies; experience with .NET, Azure, Azure DevOps, Playwright, or similar technologies is desirable. * Experience designing and implementing automated testing frameworks. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with source control, automated builds, and deployment automation. * Demonstrated ability to architect scalable automation solutions. * Strong understanding of software design principles and application architecture. * Experience supporting FDA\-regulated or GxP environments. * Knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. **Work Environment** This position operates in a professional office and/or remote (home\-based) work environment. The role routinely uses standard computer\-based equipment such as computers, monitors, keyboards, telecommunication tools (e.g., phone, video conferencing, and secure electronic fax tools such as Sfax), and related technology. Some positions may require periodic in\-person attendance or travel based on organizational or project needs. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to remain in a stationary position for extended periods (sitting and/or standing) and operate a computer and other standard office equipment. The employee frequently uses hands and fingers for keyboarding and handling documents or other work materials. The employee must be able to communicate effectively and exchange accurate information with others, including through phone, video, and in\-person meetings. The employee may occasionally be required to move or lift items up to 25 pounds, consistent with role and business needs. This role requires the ability to view and interpret information on a computer screen and in written materials for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation. **Position Type / Expected Hours of Work** This is a full\-time position. The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday. Core hours are generally 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern time (ET). Work hours may be adjusted for employees in other time zones or to meet operational needs, with supervisor approval, to ensure appropriate coverage and collaboration. Occasional additional hours may be required. **Equal Employment Opportunity / Drug\-Free Workplace** Jaeb Center for Health Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug\-Free Workplace. **Note:** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description: Affiliated Office Address Baltimore, MD, United States Requisition ID 122721 Date Created October 09, 2026 Job Family Information Systems, IT Job Subfamily Applications Development Job Function Information Technology Exempt Status Exempt Shift Type Full Time Schedule Mon\-Fri, 8\.30am\-5\.00pm Worksite 04\-MD:School of Medicine Campus Work Modality Remote: Not on\-site or \< 10% of hours worked on\-site The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine is seeking a ***Software Engineer*** to support the Medvitals Team. The Software Engineer is responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise\-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code. Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions. **Specific Duties \& Responsibilities** * The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position. * Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility. *Analysis \& Requirement Gatherings* * Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications. *Design \& Development* * Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards. * Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions. * Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks. * Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge\-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support. * Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff. * Provide thought leadership in designing and developing innovative integrated solutions. *Testing \& Documentation* * Create and document complex test scenarios using the appropriate testing tools to validate and verify application functionality. * Test all changes by using the appropriate complex test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way. * Author and maintain documentation by writing audience\-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end\-user references. * Mentor junior staff in testing tools and technologies by reviewing their work. *Implementation \& Maintenance* * Implement changes by adhering to the change management policies and procedures for any given project to communicate to all parties the nature, significance, and risk factors of the solution. * Monitor changes and resolve complex problems by responding as they occur, by reviewing all processing and output of the newly implemented solution, and by proactively ensuring the solution works successfully to satisfy the customer requirements and to provide a smooth transition to the new solution. * Provide support by investigating and resolving issues, including complex issues to ensure prompt, effective service. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree (or foreign equivalent) in computer science, computer information systems, information technology, electronic engineering, or a related field. * Five years of related work experience with computer systems and applications. * Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond HS Diploma/Graduation Equivalent, For more information about workplace accommodations or accessibility at Johns Hopkins University, please visit: https://accessibility.jhu.edu/. ***Vaccine Requirements*** Johns Hopkins University requires all faculty, staff, and students to receive the seasonal flu vaccine. Exceptions to the flu vaccine requirements may be provided to individuals for religious beliefs or medical reasons. jobs.title: Tier II Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced **Tier II Support Technician** to support our clients in the Tampa/St. Petersburg area while taking primary responsibility for equipment and depot operations from Medovent Solutions' main office. This is a hands\-on technical support position that combines Tier II help desk responsibilities with device provisioning, hardware troubleshooting, equipment handling, and onsite support. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, taking ownership of escalated technical issues, and managing the physical lifecycle of client equipment from receipt and configuration through deployment and replacement. **Responsibilities:** * Serve as an escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved at Tier I. * Diagnose and resolve more complex Windows workstation, application, Microsoft 365, printing, peripheral, and connectivity issues. * Troubleshoot network connectivity, VPN, wireless, and basic switching\-related issues. * Troubleshoot line\-of\-business applications and work with software vendors when appropriate. * Perform advanced endpoint troubleshooting before escalating issues to Tier III or System Administration. * Determine the appropriate escalation path when an issue requires involvement from networking, security, Microsoft 365, or other administrative teams. * Take ownership of assigned issues and follow them through to resolution. * Clearly document troubleshooting steps, findings, resolutions, and escalation details in the ticketing system. * Communicate technical issues and resolutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical users. * Assist Tier I technicians with troubleshooting and provide guidance when appropriate. **Depot \& Equipment Operations** * Take primary ownership of day\-to\-day equipment and depot activities at the Medovent office. * Receive, inventory, organize, stage, and prepare desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, and other IT equipment. * Provision and configure Windows computers for new users, replacements, and equipment refreshes. * Perform hardware troubleshooting, upgrades, repairs, and component replacement when appropriate. * Prepare equipment for deployment and ensure devices are properly configured before being provided or shipped to users. * Process returned equipment and determine whether devices should be redeployed, repaired, stored, or retired. * Maintain an organized and accurate inventory of equipment entering and leaving the depot. * Coordinate equipment shipments, pickups, replacements, and onsite deployments. * Maintain an orderly and professional depot/workbench area. * Identify equipment shortages, damaged equipment, or other inventory concerns and communicate them to the appropriate team. * Maintain accurate documentation for device assignments, equipment movements, and completed work. **Onsite \& Field Support*** Provide onsite technical support at Medovent and other client locations throughout the Tampa/St. Petersburg area when required. * Install and replace workstations, monitors, printers, network equipment, and peripherals. * Assist with office moves, workstation deployments, equipment refreshes, and other onsite technical projects. * Perform hands\-on troubleshooting when an issue cannot be resolved remotely. * Travel to client locations as business needs require. ### **What We Expect From a Tier II Technician** * Ability to independently troubleshoot issues beyond standard Tier I support. * Strong understanding of Windows desktop administration and troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and common Microsoft applications. * Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and endpoint/device management concepts. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi\-Fi, VLANs, and basic network troubleshooting. * Ability to diagnose hardware failures involving desktops, laptops, docks, monitors, and peripherals. * Ability to research unfamiliar issues and work toward a solution without immediately escalating. * Ability to recognize when an issue requires escalation and provide the receiving technician with complete troubleshooting documentation. * Strong attention to detail when provisioning, inventorying, or handling client equipment. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining ownership of assigned work. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Customer\-focused attitude and professional demeanor. * Willingness to assist with lower\-tier work when workload and business needs require it. ### **Qualifications** * **2\+ years of IT help desk, desktop support, or technical support experience preferred.** * Previous Tier II or escalation\-level support experience strongly preferred. * Hands\-on experience supporting Windows 10/11 environments. * Experience troubleshooting Microsoft 365 applications and services. * Experience provisioning and deploying Windows computers. * Experience diagnosing PC hardware and peripheral issues. * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, or similar endpoint\-management platforms preferred. * Experience working in an MSP or multi\-client support environment is a plus. * Experience maintaining IT inventory, equipment staging, or depot operations is a plus. * CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Microsoft, or similar certifications are preferred but not required. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to client locations as needed. ### **Physical / Equipment Requirements** Because this role owns significant depot and equipment responsibilities, the technician must be comfortable:* Regularly handling desktops, laptops, monitors, and other IT equipment. * Unpacking, staging, organizing, and preparing equipment for deployment or shipment. * Maintaining an organized equipment storage and work area. * Performing hands\-on installation and removal of workstation equipment at client locations. ### **Schedule** * Monday through Friday * Primarily onsite * Participation in the Tier II on\-call rotation as assigned * Occasional after\-hours or weekend work based on client needs * Agencies or Submissions Will Be Accepted.* *Our company is committed to creating a diverse environment. This role combines technical leadership, team management, and strategic planning to drive innovation and enhance product capabilities through artificial intelligence and machine learning. **Key reliability, monitoring, cost management, and incident response * Establish guardrails for responsible AI: data privacy, model risk, transparency, bias awareness, and auditability * Drive continuous jobs.title: IT Support & Systems Coordinator — Part-Time, Onsite
jobs.description: IT Support \& Systems Coordinator — Part\-Time, Onsite **Location:** Las Vegas, NV — Onsite **Department:** Information Technology **Position Type:** Part\-Time **Level:** Junior / Entry\-to\-Mid Level **Reports To:** Management / IT Manager Position Summary We are looking for a dependable and hands\-on **part\-time IT Support \& Systems Coordinator** to provide technology support for our office and employees. **This position requires working onsite at our Las Vegas office. Remote or hybrid work is not available.** The part\-time schedule and weekly hours will be discussed during the interview process. This position will be responsible for setting up new employees with computers, email accounts, company applications, iPads, and mobile phones, as well as troubleshooting everyday computer and technology issues. The ideal candidate should have good working knowledge of Microsoft products, Windows computers, Microsoft 365, email administration, mobile devices, printers, basic networking, and general office technology. Some basic knowledge of servers and network infrastructure is preferred. This is a hands\-on position for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping employees, and keeping company technology organized and operational. Key Responsibilities * Provide IT support to office staff and management during scheduled onsite hours. * Set up computers, laptops, monitors, printers, and other office equipment. * Set up new employees with company technology and system access. * Create and manage Microsoft 365 and company email accounts. * Configure Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and other Microsoft applications. * Reset passwords and troubleshoot employee login and access issues. * Set up and maintain company iPads, tablets, and mobile phones. * Install and configure company applications on computers and mobile devices. * Maintain an inventory of company computers, iPads, cell phones, chargers, and other IT equipment. * Issue equipment to employees and maintain records of who is responsible for each device. * Recover and reset company equipment when an employee leaves the company. * Troubleshoot Windows computer problems, software errors, internet connectivity, printers, scanners, and other office equipment. * Install software, updates, drivers, and security patches. * Assist employees with basic computer and technology questions. * Troubleshoot Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, VPN, and basic network connectivity issues. * Assist with company printers and network\-connected equipment. * Provide basic support for company servers and server\-related issues. * Assist senior IT vendors or outside IT providers when more advanced server or network work is required. * Maintain proper backups and help monitor company systems. * Help maintain antivirus, security software, and device protection. * Make sure company computers and devices remain updated and secure. * Help manage employee access to company systems and coordinate prompt removal of access when employees leave. * Maintain organized documentation of passwords, equipment, licenses, software subscriptions, and IT procedures using company\-approved secure systems. * Communicate with outside IT vendors, internet providers, phone providers, and software companies when technical support is required. * Help troubleshoot company phone systems and office telecommunications. * Maintain an organized IT storage area with spare computers, phones, cables, chargers, and equipment. * Coordinate unresolved or urgent issues with management and the outside IT provider to maintain continuity outside scheduled hours. Preferred Knowledge \& Experience Candidates should have working knowledge of: * Microsoft Windows 10/11 * Microsoft 365 * Microsoft Outlook * Microsoft Teams * OneDrive * SharePoint * Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory basics * Email account administration * Windows computer setup and troubleshooting * iPhone and iPad setup and support * Android devices * Printers and scanners * Wi\-Fi and basic networking * Routers, switches, and access points * Basic VPN troubleshooting * Basic cybersecurity practices * Antivirus and endpoint protection * Basic server administration or Windows Server knowledge * Computer hardware troubleshooting Knowledge of mobile\-device management (MDM) platforms such as Microsoft Intune is a plus. Qualifications * 1–3 years of IT support, help desk, desktop support, or similar experience preferred. * Ability to reliably work onsite at our Las Vegas office on an agreed part\-time schedule. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working directly with employees who may have limited technical knowledge. * Good organizational skills. * Ability to manage multiple IT requests and prioritize urgent problems within scheduled working hours. * Ability to document equipment, accounts, passwords, licenses, and technical procedures accurately. * Professional and trustworthy when handling confidential company information. * Able to work independently and know when an issue needs to be escalated to a senior IT professional. * Good verbal and written communication skills. This person does not need to be a senior network engineer or server administrator. However, they should be comfortable handling the majority of everyday office technology problems without requiring outside IT support for every small issue. The right person should be able to walk into an employee’s office, identify the problem, troubleshoot it, and get the employee working again as quickly as possible. Position Goal The goal of this position is to keep our employees productive by making sure our computers, mobile devices, Microsoft systems, email, and office technology are properly set up, maintained, organized, and supported.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Applications Developer
jobs.description: About Knovo Knovo is an award\-winning retail branch design and architectural services firm. We specialize in 3D site surveys, architectural drawings, BIM coordination, digital installations, and data\-driven asset management that help brands design smarter, operate better, and deliver standout customer experiences. We're a fast\-moving, highly collaborative team that thrives on precision, creativity, innovation, and execution. We partner with leading retailers and financial institutions to deliver complex, data\-driven programs at scale. Technology and data are a big part of how we work, and we're continuing to invest in the platforms, automation and AI capabilities that connect our teams, projects and clients. If you're a hands\-on developer who enjoys solving real business problems, connecting systems, and turning ideas into practical applications that people actually use, this role is for you. ‍ The Role We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Applications Developer to help design and build the next generation of Knovo's enterprise and operations platform. This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys understanding how a business actually works and turning those requirements into practical technology. You will work directly with our leadership and operations teams to help shape the technical approach and then build it, developing connected applications, workflows, integrations, automation and AI capabilities that improve how we manage projects and deliver work to our clients. Our current direction uses Quickbase as the operational backbone and system of record, with Microsoft technologies supporting areas such as AI, automation, identity, security, collaboration and reporting. This role will help bring these pieces together into a simple, secure and scalable platform. This isn't about introducing technology for the sake of technology. We're looking for someone who can understand the problem, recommend the right technical approach and then build it. ‍ Key Tasks and Responsibilities * Design, develop and continuously improve Knovo's enterprise and operations applications. * Develop and enhance our Quickbase environment, including project databases, workflows, relationships, interfaces, reporting and business logic. * Build integrations between Quickbase, Microsoft and other core platforms using APIs, connectors, middleware and automation tools. * Develop project workflows that connect projects, locations, tasks, milestones, deliverables, issues, assets, resources and other operational data. * Build automation using tools such as Power Automate to reduce manual work and move information between systems. * Help develop our Microsoft Copilot Studio and AI capabilities, including agents that can securely access project information, answer questions and perform approved actions. * Develop user\-friendly applications and interfaces for internal teams, with the ability to extend these capabilities to clients and partners over time. * Integrate SharePoint/Microsoft 365 for documents and collaboration and Power BI for operational, client and executive reporting. * Build security and permissions into applications from the beginning, including role\-based access, authentication, data segregation and auditability. * Work directly with business users to understand how projects actually operate, identify pain points and translate those needs into working solutions. * Test, troubleshoot and maintain applications and integrations to ensure they are reliable, accurate and scalable. * Evaluate new technologies and tools and help determine where they provide real value within our platform. What Success Looks Like You'll know you're making an impact when: * Our core project and operations workflows are connected through a reliable, easy\-to\-use platform. * Quickbase provides a clean and trusted operational backbone rather than a collection of disconnected applications and data. * Information moves between Quickbase, Microsoft and our other systems without unnecessary manual work. * Teams spend less time updating systems, searching for information and completing repetitive administrative tasks. * Employees can easily understand project status, priorities, risks and next steps. * AI and automation are being used in practical ways that improve how we work without compromising client data or security. * Applications are built with the security, reliability and scalability expected by the large enterprise clients we serve. * You can take a business problem from "here's what we need" to a working solution and continue improving it based on real\-world use. Qualifications What You'll Bring * Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience developing business applications, enterprise applications or workflow\-based solutions, with demonstrated experience taking applications from concept through development and deployment. * Strong experience with APIs, REST integrations, JSON and connecting cloud\-based applications. * Experience with Quickbase development and administration is highly preferred; strong experience with comparable low\-code/database platforms will also be considered. * Experience with the Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Automate and ideally Power Apps and/or Copilot Studio. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments. * Experience with relational data structures and designing applications around connected business data. * Development experience with SQL and at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or C\#. * Experience with AI/LLM integrations, AI agents or enterprise AI applications is a strong asset. * Understanding of application security, authentication, permissions, APIs and enterprise data protection. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand a business process and translate it into a practical technical solution. * Comfortable working directly with business users and explaining technical concepts in straightforward language. * Able to work independently, take ownership of solutions and move from concept through development, testing and deployment. * Curious and adaptable, with an interest in continually improving how technology can support the business. Benefits * Competitive salary * Health plan * 401(k) * Paid Time Off * Opportunities for growth and advancement Location This position is in the Hollywood, Florida office, with an opportunity for a hybrid work model (office and work from home) Pay: From $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hollywood, FL 33020

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Leader
jobs.description: Are you ready to move your career forward and help shape our company’s and customers’ futures? If you aspire to challenge yourself, work with the best in the industry and join a successful team where you can make a meaningful contribution, then we invite you to join us at Ketjen Corporation, a provider of advanced catalyst solutions to leading producers in the petrochemical, refining, and specialty chemicals industries. Together, we can create a legacy marked by innovation, excitement, and energy. JOB DESCRIPTION Ketjen is seeking a Continuous Improvement Leader to advance operational excellence, productivity, and continuous improvement across the global organization. Reporting to the Senior Continuous Improvement Manager, this role will partner with leaders and cross\-functional teams to identify, prioritize, execute, and sustain high\-impact improvement initiatives. The successful candidate will lead projects from concept through implementation, deliver measurable business results, and help embed continuous improvement into the way Ketjen operates. KEY JOB DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES • Lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of Continuous Improvement initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in safety, productivity, cost, quality, service, working capital, and overall business performance. • Develop and execute CI strategies and roadmaps aligned with Ketjen’s business objectives. • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, Technology, Finance, Procurement, and other functions to identify opportunities, prioritize resources, and build a pipeline of high\-value initiatives. • Conduct value stream assessments, process analyses, and root cause investigations to identify and quantify improvement opportunities. • Lead complex, cross\-functional projects using Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, structured problem\-solving, and other CI methodologies. • Coach and mentor CI Champions, project leaders, Green Belts, and functional teams to strengthen execution capabilities and sustain project results. • Lead change management efforts that build stakeholder commitment, address resistance, and support the adoption of new processes and behaviors. • Establish portfolio governance, project management disciplines, and stage\-gate reviews to ensure initiatives remain aligned, appropriately resourced, and effectively executed. • Develop organizational CI capability through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and certification programs. • Establish and monitor KPIs to measure project performance, financial benefits, productivity improvements, and sustainability. • Manage CI portfolio reporting and provide leadership with clear visibility into project status, risks, results, and business impact. • Partner with Finance to validate project savings, productivity gains, working capital improvements, and other realized benefits. • Collaborate with global stakeholders to share best practices, replicate successful improvements, and integrate CI principles into daily operations. • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement consistent with Ketjen’s core values. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ LakeFusion is seeking a **Software Engineer \- Backend** to build and scale our real\-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault\-tolerant, high\-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high\-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms. A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer\-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Scale the real\-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high\-throughput, low\-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes. * Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C\#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores. * Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes. * Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments. * Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low\-latency queries. * Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers. * Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real\-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers. * Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer\-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks. * Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of backend engineering experience building production\-grade services and microservices. * 2\+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands\-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6\+ (C\#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components. * 2\+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo). * Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns. * Resilience and fault\-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns. * Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers. * Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside. * Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge). * Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer\-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints). * Experience with dual\-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases. **About LakeFusion** -------------------- LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Staff / Principal Security Engineer, AI Safety and Security
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Lila is developing AI systems for scientific discovery, connecting advanced models with scientific tools and automated laboratories. As these systems become more capable, we need to understand how they could be misused or compromised, which protections matter most, and how to establish that those protections work together. We're hiring an experienced security practitioner to lead this work at the boundary between AI safety and security. You will investigate real systems, develop threat models, test important assumptions and recommend the protections needed for particular capabilities and deployments. Your work will address both dangerous misuse and the protection of sensitive models, data and research. This is an opportunity to help shape a developing area of AI safety through security practice. You will combine technical investigation with careful analysis and clear writing, working closely with our established Security team, researchers and engineers to turn findings into implemented improvements. You will bring security depth and develop your understanding of model capabilities, evaluations and safeguards through that work. Prior experience in AI safety is welcome, but not required. **What You'll Be Building** * **Threat\-model consequential systems and capabilities.** Investigate how dangerous misuse or compromise could occur across models, deployed services and scientific workflows. Identify the relevant actors, access routes and failure paths, and the protections that could interrupt them. * **Test the assumptions behind our defenses.** Examine architectures, code, configurations and operational evidence. Run focused adversarial tests, build prototypes and investigate weaknesses, including situations where several protections depend on the same underlying system. * **Shape the protections needed for safe deployment.** Turn dangerous\-capability assessments into concrete security requirements. Assess how compromise of models, sensitive assets or supporting systems changes the safety assessment, drawing on personnel, physical and other security specialists where relevant. * **Make evidence\-based recommendations.** Define what evidence would demonstrate that important controls and safeguards work together. Combine findings from model evaluations and security testing, explain the remaining uncertainty, and recommend improvements or conditions for use. * **Carry findings through to practical improvements.** Work with Security, Safety and engineering owners to prioritize changes, specify acceptance criteria and verify the results. Make clear recommendations about which gaps require attention first and why. * **Anticipate what more capable systems will require.** Identify where changes in capability, access or deployment call for stronger protections. Help teams plan security work with long lead times, and update assessments as systems change or new evidence emerges. * **Develop methods that others can use.** Turn your investigations into clear threat models, assessment methods and technical guidance. Help Safety and Security colleagues apply the approach to new problems and build a shared understanding of the evidence behind decisions. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * **Substantial hands\-on security experience and deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline**, such as security architecture, application or infrastructure security, offensive security, or incident response. You can reason across disciplines and identify when specialist judgment is needed. * **A record of resolving consequential security problems.** You have investigated ambiguous risks, challenged designs and followed improvements through to validation, including work involving several teams. * **Strong technical judgment.** You can examine unfamiliar systems, scrutinize code and configurations where relevant, and use technical investigation or testing to distinguish plausible claims from demonstrated protection. * **Curiosity about AI safety and scientific systems.** You want to understand how model capabilities and safeguards are evaluated, can learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and reason carefully when evidence is incomplete. * **Clear writing and effective collaboration.** You can explain a technical argument precisely, work through disagreements with specialists and turn a complex investigation into an actionable recommendation. **Bonus Points For** * Securing ML infrastructure, model assets, research environments or AI agents. * Evaluating safeguards, adversarial robustness or defenses against sophisticated threats. * Translating risk assessments into technical requirements, assurance evidence or deployment decisions. * Working in scientific or other environments where digital access can have significant real\-world consequences. jobs.description: **Standard Job Description** ---------------------------- As an F\-35 Classified Cybersecurity Security team member you will be supporting Special Access Programs (SAPs) and ensure classified Information Systems (IS) meet cybersecurity requirements and government directives by interpreting the Joint Special Access Program (SAP) Implementation Guide (JSIG) in determining technical Information Assurance (IA) requirements and ensure proper security implementation of the Risk Management Framework (RMF). Develop system documentation for information system authorization, security management, and continuous monitoring of both networked and standalone classified systems. Ensure security tool functionality across interconnected WANs, ISOLAN, standalones, and Lab environments. Determine technical Information Assurance (IA) requirements and ensure proper security implementation of the Risk Management Framework (RMF). Identify systems and tools to improve security. Work through procurement and with the administration teams to deploy the security tools, configure, and maintain them. Develop technical solutions to complex problems which require extensive technical expertise and ingenuity. Provide cybersecurity education and training for all system users on risk mitigation strategies. Conduct required internal IA assessments of the F\-35 Classified networks and SAP Facilities (SAPFs) along with interpreting and implementing the policies and procedures required to maintain an Authority to Operate (ATO) and coordinate the destruction of classified material and media. Collaborate with F‑35 supplier organizations to prepare, review, and submit ATO documentation; facilitate monthly meetings, train ISSOs on SAPF Equipment Removal Packages, software/hardware approvals, and ATO evidence; act as liaison between government customers and suppliers. Represent the organization as a Subject Matter Expert in Information Assurance requirements. Perform other associated duties as required. Ensure compliance to governing documents and security policies and assist in regulatory periodic assessments. Implements and tests state\-of\-the\-art secure operating systems, networks, and database solutions. Stays current with system vulnerabilities and provides current security training to all system users. Conducts risk assessments and provides recommendations for secure implementation and compliance in accordance with government regulations and information assurance/cybersecurity guidelines. Creates, maintains and submits information system security documents and reports to regulatory agencies. Assesses and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle; validates system security requirements definition and analysis; establishes system security documentation; assists with the implementation of security procedures; verifies information system security requirements; performs information system certification and accreditation planning, testing, assessing and liaison activities. Familiar with information system security architectural documentation standards. Able to apply information assurance / cyber security standards, directives, guidance and policies to an architectural/risk based framework. Provide architectural / risk based analysis of information assurance / cyber security features and relate existing system to future needs and trends and requirements. For engineers providing security information assurance, use Info Assurance Engineer (E254, L254\). jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:**Lowenstein Sandler is a one of the most sophisticated law firms in the United States, with over 400 lawyers and 300 business services professionals serving clients from offices in New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Wilmington. We recruit candidates who seek a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that prioritizes our clients, our colleagues, and the communities where we work and live. Committed to career development and to an inclusive workplace, the firm offers many programs and opportunities for personal and professional growth. We seek professionals for our business services group who share these values. **What You Will Do:**The Data Engineer plays a central role within the Software Engineering team, responsible for building and maintaining the data pipelines that feed the firm's Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse. Working closely with the Data Architect, this role ingests, transforms, and curates data from the firm's core business systems through a medallion architecture to deliver trusted, analytics\-ready datasets that power reporting, business intelligence, and AI\-driven applications across the firm. This role requires an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is rigorous about data quality and governance, and actively integrates AI tooling into their development workflow. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, build, test, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from the firm's enterprise systems into the Microsoft Fabric Data Lakehouse, using Data Factory pipelines, and Spark notebooks. * Implement and maintain the bronze, silver, and gold layers of the firm's medallion architecture, covering raw ingestion, cleansing and conformance, and curated analytics\-ready models. * Partner with the Data Architect to translate logical data models into physical implementations, including star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and Power BI semantic models in the gold layer. * Build and maintain source\-system integrations across Aderant Expert, Intapp, iManage, InterAction, Dayforce, SharePoint Online, and third\-party APIs, applying incremental load and change data capture patterns and normalizing key entities to the SALI/LMSS taxonomy. * Develop transformation logic in T\-SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark, with built\-in data quality validation, reconciliation to source, exception handling, and alerting. * Diagnose and trace data discrepancies end\-to\-end — from source system through bronze, silver, and gold layers to the final DAX measure or report — identifying and resolving root causes. * Monitor, tune, and optimize pipeline performance, refresh windows, and Fabric capacity consumption to control cost and meet business service levels. * Implement data governance and security controls with the Data Architect and Information Security, including workspace permissions, row\-level security, sensitivity labeling, and law firm confidentiality and ethical wall requirements. * Partner with Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, practice groups, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, and support business intelligence developers and self\-service users with reliable, well\-modeled, documented datasets. * Manage data artifacts through source control and deployment pipelines, using Fabric Git integration and Azure DevOps to promote changes across development, test, and production workspaces. * Leverage Claude Code and other AI\-powered development tools to accelerate pipeline development, testing, and documentation, and build the curated datasets that power the firm's AI and agentic applications. * Maintain data dictionaries, lineage, and operational runbooks, and provide production support and escalation\-level troubleshooting for failed or degraded data loads. **Essential Job Requirements:** * 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on ETL/ELT or data engineering experience building and supporting production data pipelines. * Microsoft Fabric experience is preferred but not required; equivalent experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, SSIS, dbt, or other modern ETL frameworks will be considered. * Working knowledge of medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold), lakehouse and data warehouse concepts, and dimensional modeling. * Strong T\-SQL skills, with proven hands\-on experience in MS SQL Server including query optimization and performance tuning. * Proficiency in Python and PySpark, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on Spark\-based transformation. * Experience with incremental load, change data capture, and slowly changing dimension patterns. * Experience ingesting data from REST APIs, JSON and XML payloads, flat files, SFTP sources, and direct database connections. * Rigorous approach to data quality, including validation, reconciliation, and alerting. * Familiarity with source control (Git) and CI/CD practices for data artifacts. * Experience building, maintaining, and supporting analytics models for reporting. * Power BI development experience a plus, including semantic models, DAX, and report delivery. * Ability to deliver high\-quality work quickly in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment, with a track record of managing competing priorities effectively. * Willingness to adopt AI\-assisted development tooling as part of a regular engineering workflow. **Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience of 5\+ years in data engineering. * Data Platform: Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, Direct Lake), Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks. * Languages: T\-SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL; KQL a plus. * Architecture: medallion architecture, dimensional modeling and star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, Delta Lake and Parquet formats, partitioning. * Integration: REST APIs, JSON, XML, flat file and SFTP ingestion, ODBC/JDBC, OAuth 2\.0, change data capture. * BI and Semantic Layer: Power BI, semantic models, DAX, row\-level security. * Cloud and Security: Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Key Vault, Microsoft Purview, data sensitivity labeling and classification. * Tools and DevOps: Git, Fabric Git integration and deployment pipelines, Azure DevOps, VS Code, SQL Server Management Studio. * AI Development: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent AI\-assisted tooling a plus. * Legal data standards: SALI/LMSS taxonomy experience a plus. * Law firm data experience (Aderant, Intapp, iManage, InterAction, Dayforce) a plus. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. * Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders. * Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment. * A continuous learner who actively tracks and experiments with emerging tools, especially in the data and AI space. **Office Location:** Roseland, New Jersey (Hybrid) **Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM **Amount of Travel Required:** None The expected salary range for candidates meeting the requirements of this position is $125,000 to $140,000\. The range provided is the salary that Lowenstein Sandler in good faith believes at the time of this posting that it is willing to pay for the advertised position. Exact compensation will be determined based on individual candidate qualifications and location. Our benefits package includes coverage options for medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, life insurance, disability, FSAs, 401K, and paid time off. **Disclaimers:** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required by employee. Lowenstein Sandler LLP is not accepting resumes from search firms for this position. Regardless of past practice, all resumes submitted by search firms are to be deemed the sole property of Lowenstein Sandler LLP, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Lowenstein Sandler LLP as a result of the referral. Lowenstein Sandler LLP is committed to equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Knowledge for large language models (LLMs) and AI/ML is a plus. * Experience bringing products to life that are built for embedded systems that communicate with cloud infrastructure. * Experience building and shipping iOS/Android mobile apps at a global scale. * Proven record of authoring detailed product strategy, analyzing build vs buy, and making cost and revenue projections * Successfully launched digital experiences related to entertainment and productivity at a global scale. * Deep empathy for users. Experience with converting user pain points into detailed user stories. * Strong communication and presentation skills with a clear and logical thought process.
