jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform and Integrations
jobs.description: Luminate Bank is redefining what modern banking can be. In just five years under its current leadership, the company has grown from a $62 million community bank into a $500 million financial institution, the fastest\-growing state\-chartered bank, while building one of the fastest\-growing mortgage platforms in the country. The momentum has been extraordinary: * Grew bank assets from $62 million to $500 million in five years\- the fastest\-growing state\-chartered bank * Ranked a 2026 Top Workplace in Minnesota by the Star Tribune and \#1 among large companies in Colorado Top Workplaces 2026 * Named a 2026 Top Workplaces Culture Excellence winner in eight categories and a Top Workplace nationally in Financial Services * Surpassed $4 billion in mortgage originations in 2025 * Ranked among the Top 30 Mortgage Lenders nationally by Scotsman Guide * Maintain a 4\.9\-star average rating across 45,000\+ customer reviews * Recognized by Freddie Mac with two 2026 Home Possible RISE Awards® for Greatest Volume and Fastest Growth * Honored by the Minnesota Mortgage Association as 2025 Leaders of the Year But the story is bigger than growth metrics and awards. Luminate Bank is building a culture designed for ambitious, high\-performing people who want to shape the future of banking. We move quickly, think boldly, and invest deeply in our people. Innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer experience are at the center of everything we do. What began as a rapidly growing lending and banking platform is now entering its next phase: building a nationally recognized financial brand that redefines how modern banking is experienced. For leaders who want the opportunity to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact, this is a rare moment to join a company with startup energy, national momentum, and a long runway ahead. **Position Overview**: Luminate Bank is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to design, build, secure, and run the proprietary applications and integrations that connect our banking and mortgage platforms. You'll ship priority business software hands\-on—using AI coding agents such as Claude Code to accelerate delivery—while setting the team's standards for secure delivery, reliable operations, and responsible use of AI tools in a regulated environment where most of our applications handle nonpublic personal information (NPI). This is an individual contributor role. You'll provide technical direction and coaching to a small team of engineers and specialists; people management stays with the EVP, Technology or a designated manager. Most of your time will be hands\-on engineering, with protected time for design, mentoring, documentation, and cross\-training. Early priorities include moving from Azure DevOps to GitHub, improving the reliability of key integrations, and building applications that fill gaps in our vendor platforms. **Responsibilities and Duties:** **Application \& Integration Engineering** * Design and build production applications, services, and extensions for priority banking and mortgage needs, working with business owners to define scope and acceptance criteria. * Build and support integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, events, and scheduled batch exchanges. Evaluate vendor capabilities and find maintainable ways to close gaps between third\-party software and how Luminate operates. * Make integrations safe under failure with authentication, input validation, idempotency, bounded retries, rate limiting, and safe replay, and use reconciliation to confirm business outcomes. * Own architecture and technical quality for assigned services, including API contracts, automated tests, and support documentation. **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use the bank's approved AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) to speed up implementation, testing, and documentation, while owning what ships: review generated code and verify its behavior with meaningful tests. * Create reusable agent skills, instructions, and patterns for the team, with approved model services, scoped tool permissions, and clear rules for sensitive data and production access. * For prioritized business use cases that use AI agents, define permitted actions, evaluation criteria, human approval points, monitoring, and recovery before anything goes live. **Software Factory \& DevOps** * Shape and maintain GitHub\-based development and release practices, including the migration from Azure DevOps, in partnership with internal teams and implementation partners. * Build reusable repository templates and CI/CD workflows with automated tests, code and dependency scanning, secret detection, required reviews, and controlled promotion between environments. * Provision and maintain application infrastructure as code, using the bank's approved hosting, identity, networking, and secrets services. * Keep engineering documentation alongside the code. Automate API and release documentation where practical, with named owners reviewing operational procedures. ** ration** * Mentor engineers and specialists through pairing, design and code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Cross\-train the team so every service can be supported by more than its original author. * Help with recruiting, technical interviews, and onboarding, and give technical feedback that supports team members' development plans alongside their people manager. * Work with the EVP, Technology and delivery stakeholders to sequence priorities, flag capacity constraints, and balance product work, reliability, security remediation, and technical debt. * Partner with Data \& Analytics, Business Solutions \& Delivery, and IT \& Infrastructure. Define integration contracts and shared delivery patterns with Data \& Analytics, which owns the lakehouse and data quality. **Qualifications and Skills:** **Required Experience** * Typically 8\+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of designing, delivering, and supporting production applications. * Technical leadership through architecture, mentoring, code review, and cross\-functional delivery. Formal people management experience is not required. * Hands\-on experience developing applications with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code), with the judgment to review generated code, test its behavior, protect sensitive information, and recognize the tools' limits. * Experience shipping through a reviewed delivery pipeline in GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar, and the ability to build GitHub\-based CI/CD and infrastructure automation. * Experience deploying and operating services that handle sensitive data, with sound practices in application security, identity, secrets management, and incident response. * Hands\-on experience building API and webhook integrations, including authentication, error handling, data consistency, and production troubleshooting. * Experience solutioning gaps between third\-party vendor platforms and internal business processes. **Core Competencies** * **Modern Development:** Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C\#, plus relational databases, SQL, and API design. * **Security Mindset:** Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, identity and access management, and the protection of NPI. * **Systems Thinking:** Ability to understand data flows and dependencies across multiple platforms and design solutions that scale and remain supportable. * **Communication:** Ability to explain technical tradeoffs, delivery risks, and operational needs clearly to business stakeholders and executive leadership. **Preferred Experience (Strong Plus)** * System configuration and development experience in banking or mortgage technology, such as Encompass, Vesta, or Jack Henry, and related point\-of\-sale, pricing, or document systems. * Building or governing production AI agents, including agent skills and instructions, evaluation frameworks, MCP integrations, and runtime controls. * Setting up engineering practices for a small team, improving developer workflows, or leading a migration to GitHub. **Education**: * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related software development field required; bachelor's degree preferred. * Cloud, security, or DevOps certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS, CompTIA Security\+, GitHub) are a plus. **Benefits****:** * Competitive compensation reliant on ability and experience * Excellent benefits package including health, pretax HSA, FSA accounts and dental \& vision * Life and AD\&D Insurance, as well as additional voluntary benefit possibilities * 401K with robust company match * Flexible PTO program * Earned Sick \& Safe Time (ESST) * The opportunity to work for the Midwest’s fastest growing lender We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description: **The Opportunity** We’re looking for a **hands\-on Lead Agentic AI Solutions Architect** to turn complex business needs into high\-impact, production\-ready Agentic AI solutions. deployment, and operational handoff. * Partner with business and domain experts to understand and redesign insurance workflows, assess data, knowledge, integration, and process readiness, and identify integrations, context and state management, execution boundaries, recovery and fallback mechanisms, and human oversight. * Remain hands\-on from prototyping through implementation, integration, limits, monitoring, and auditability. * Coordinate rollout, business readiness, operational support, and continuous improvement while developing reusable patterns that accelerate future AI delivery. * LLM\-based applications** and experience deploying multiple agentic systems into production for real users. * Strong hands\-on **Python and software engineering expertise**, including designing, non\-deterministic systems. * Deep practical knowledge of agentic architectures and patterns, including **tool calling, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP, A2A or similar agent interoperability approaches, RAG, context and state management, structured outputs, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows**. * Hands\-on experience with an agent framework or SDK, with **LangGraph strongly preferred**, jobs.title: Master Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Master Data Engineer owns the accuracy, consistency, and governance of Marco's core master data by building and running the pipelines that create it \- across ERP, CRM, Microsoft Fabric data warehouse, and other system repositories. This role sets and enforces Marco's formal data ontology in partnership with the data architecture team, and turns raw operational data into governed, machine\-readable master data through engineered pipelines rather than manual review alone. The Master Data Engineer partners directly with Finance, Sales, Procurement, Internal Systems, and Business Unit leadership to keep master data clean, de\-duplicated, pipeline\-delivered, and thoroughly documented for aligned data definitions across the organization. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines (Microsoft Fabric Dataflows Gen2, notebooks/PySpark, SQL) that consolidate and reconcile master data across e\-Automate, Salesforce, and Marco's Fabric data warehouse. * Serve as the primary engineer and steward of core master data domains — customer, item/equipment, vendor, and location — ensuring pipelines enforce accuracy, completeness, and de\-duplication at the source, not after the fact. * Define and enforce Marco's formal data ontology, MDM standards, naming conventions, and business rules, implemented as automated validation and match/merge/survivorship logic within pipelines. * Partner with the data architecture team to model business concepts and real\-world entity relationships, turning raw data into machine\-readable, query able knowledge. * Lead recurring data quality audits and build automated profiling and reconciliation jobs across ERP, CRM, and Fabric repositories; engineer remediation workflows for ancillary data that lives outside core systems. * Build and maintain the intake and approval workflow for create/change/merge/deactivate requests on master records as a governed, auditable process, partnering with requesting departments to validate before load. * Document data governance standards, field definitions, lineage, and stewardship procedures in a living data dictionary; publish self\-serve documentation that lets business users understand the data they use. * Partner with the BI/reporting function to catch master data quality issues via automated checks before they reach downstream dashboards and reports. * Train and support cross\-functional teams (Sales, Service, Procurement, Finance) on master data intake standards and the technical and business impact of poor data quality. * Track and report data quality and pipeline KPIs (duplicate rate, completeness, accuracy, cycle time, pipeline SLA) to the Director of Enterprise Data and Analytics. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, master data management, or a related data\-operations role, including experience setting standards or leading initiatives with minimal supervision. * Strong proficiency in Python (including PySpark) and SQL for pipeline development, data profiling, validation, and reconciliation * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining pipelines in Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, Lakehouse) or a comparable modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake). * Hands\-on experience integrating MDM processes with ERP and/or CRM platforms (e\-Automate, Salesforce, or comparable systems). * Experience designing match/merge/survivorship logic and automated data quality rules. * Working familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for pipeline development and documentation. * Excellent attention to detail, documentation habits, and written/verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional data governance and engineering initiatives and influence stakeholders without formal authority. **Pay Range:** $80,796 \- $125,234 annually *The pay range listed for this position is based on candidate's skill level, experience, relevant licenses, and educational background. For detailed information about our benefits, please visit our careers page at* *www.marconet.com/careers**.* **Location:** This is a remote\-eligible position, however, Marco Technologies requires employees to reside within one of the following states: DE, FL, IA, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, ME, NE, ND, NJ, PA, RI, SD, TX, WI **Application Deadline:** Applications are continuously accepted until the position has been filled. Compensation: $80,796 \- $125,234 annually

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large\-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross\-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large\-scale, distributed environment. ### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:** * Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams * Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution * Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet * Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on * Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud * Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers * Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power \& Cooling * Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact * Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers * Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met * Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams * Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams * Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales * Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities * Move to MINIMUM\_QUALIFICATION section ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or jobs.description: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000\-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi\-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally\-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values\-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await! **Job Description:** ### **Help define the next generation of Microchip's precision analog and mixed\-signal products. The Mixed Signal \& Linear Division builds the complete precision signal chain: op amps, comparators, voltage references, current\-sense amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, and digital potentiometers. One applications team supports all of it.** ### **As a Principal Applications Engineer, you'll drive device specifications, work with design engineering on architecture trade\-offs, and bring a system\-level view of the customer to products that ship for 10\+ years. We're looking for depth in either precision linear/analog or data converters, and an understanding of how the two work together. Depending on your background, your initial focus will be either ADCs (primarily SAR) or linear products such as op amps, comparators, voltage references, and current\-sense amplifiers. From there you'll have room to broaden across the signal chain and a clear path to product\-family ownership.** ### **The position works closely with product marketing, architecture, design engineering, product engineering, validation, and test throughout the** **new\-product\-development** **lifecycle. It also supports sustaining and lifecycle activities for assigned devices.** ### **Core responsibilities** ### ***Definition*** * ### **Author and maintain device specifications for assigned new products and** **derivatives. Drive them through defined milestones, capturing product** **goals, key features, specifications, and application requirements.** * ### **Translate customer needs, market input, and application use cases into** **clear requirements and key specification parameters, including the specs** **that can't be compromised.** * ### **Work with design engineering during early specification phases to evaluate** **architecture trade\-offs and refine block\-level definitions.** ### ***Application evaluation and system enablement*** * ### **Perform hands\-on application\-level evaluation of new silicon, testing** **device functionality in real\-world use cases and reference circuits from** **the customer's perspective. Feed findings back to design, validation, and** **product teams ahead of release.** * ### **Design, review, and bring up reference and evaluation hardware, with a** **focus on complete signal\-chain solutions (sensor front end, amplification,** **reference, conversion).** * ### **Develop application collateral: application notes, design guides,** **reference designs, and evaluation board documentation. Support** **simulation\-model releases (SPICE macromodels, behavioral models) for** **accuracy in application use.** * ### **Write and review datasheets and spec\-derived collateral for technical** **accuracy and consistency ahead of product release.** ### ***Customer and team*** * ### **Resolve complex, escalated design issues with customers and field** **applications teams.** * ### **Deliver technical training on product operation and system\-level** **signal\-chain design.** * ### **Provide technical guidance to junior applications engineers.** **Requirements/Qualifications:** ### ***Minimum Qualifications*** * ### **BSEE, MSEE, or PhD with 10\+ years of experience in analog/mixed\-signal applications, design, validation, or systems engineering** * ### **Deep hands\-on expertise in at least one of the following:** + ### **Precision linear/analog: op amps, comparators, voltage references,** **current\-sense amplifiers. Includes stability and compensation, noise,** **offset and drift, input/output stage trade\-offs, and capacitive\-load** **behavior** + ### **Data converters: SAR and/or delta\-sigma ADCs, DACs. Includes input drive and settling, reference design, anti\-aliasing, and converter metrics** **(INL/DNL, ENOB, SNR/SFDR/THD)** * ### **Working knowledge of the other area as it applies to precision** **signal\-chain design (for example, how amplifier and reference choices** **affect converter performance)** * ### **Experience contributing to product requirements or device definition** * ### **Solid bench evaluation and debug skills with standard lab instrumentation;** **experience with PCB design and hardware bring\-up** * ### **Proficiency with SPICE simulation and tools for circuit analysis and** **design verification** * ### **Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical** **documentation such as datasheets and application notes** * ### **Able to manage multiple projects, work independently, and collaborate** **across teams** ### ***Preferred Qualifications*** * ### **Depth in both linear/analog and data converters** * ### **Embedded programming for MCU\-based device evaluation over standard serial** **interfaces (e.g., SPI, QSPI, I2C, I3C)** * ### **Data analysis or lab automation (Python, MATLAB)** * ### **Analog mixed\-mode simulation (AMS), behavioral modeling, or SPICE** **macromodel development** * ### **Direct technical engagement with customers (design\-in support,** **requirements discovery, training)** * ### **Published application notes or articles, or experience delivering** **technical workshops** * ### **Domain knowledge in an end market such as industrial, energy metering,** **medical, or automotive** **Travel Time:** 0% \- 25%**Physical Attributes:** Hearing, Seeing, Talking, Works Alone, Works Around Others**Physical Requirements:** 10% Standing 90% Sitting 100% Inside Microchip Technology Inc is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - IAM
jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** **About the Role** We are seeking a **Software Engineering Manager \- IAM** to lead a high\-performing engineering team driving our enterprise Identity \& Access Management (IAM) platform. In this role, you will balance technical leadership, team management, and operational execution—ensuring our central authentication, single sign\-on (SSO), and infrastructure automation deliver high performance, strict SLA adherence, and bulletproof security. While a background in IAM or security infrastructure is a major advantage, we value strong technical fundamentals, deep architectural acumen, exceptional organization, and a fast\-learning mindset above all. You will work closely with our Technical Product Owner and Staff Engineer, diving deep into our platform functionality, actively participating in acceptance testing, and ensuring high\-quality software delivery. **What You’ll Do** * People \& Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, accountability, and psychological safety. * Deep Product \& Quality Ownership: Dive deep into our identity services and Keycloak extensions to thoroughly understand feature workflows and business logic. Actively assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality validation before releases. * Architectural Oversight \& Challenge: Participate in design reviews and technical discussions—evaluating system trade\-offs, keeping up with senior engineers, and challenging architectural assumptions to ensure scalable, resilient design. * Testing \& CI/CD Standards: Drive a strong culture of automated testing (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end) and robust CI/CD practices to ensure reliable, zero\-downtime deployment pipelines. * Engineering Execution \& Delivery: Partner with the Technical Product Owner to drive delivery schedules, manage engineering velocity, unblock team members, and navigate technical dependencies. * SLA \& Performance Focus: Establish and track operational metrics to ensure our platform consistently meets or exceeds strict uptime and latency SLAs. * AI\-Accelerated Leadership: Encourage and guide the team in adopting AI\-driven software development tools (e.g., Claude Code, LLM\-based testing automation) to boost engineering efficiency and quality. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Security, Compliance, and Product leadership to ensure alignment on security standards and platform delivery goals. **What We’re Looking For** * Experience: 3\+ years of engineering management experience leading backend or platform software development teams, backed by 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience. * Strong Technical \& Architectural Foundation: Solid background in object\-oriented language design and backend systems (experience in Java or C\# is a strong plus). Must possess strong software architectural knowledge to guide design decisions and challenge technical approaches. * Testing \& CI/CD Literacy: Deep understanding of modern software testing methodologies, automated test frameworks, and modern CI/CD deployment workflows. * Product Depth \& Hands\-On QA Mindset: Willingness to roll up your sleeves, learn the intricacies of our products, and actively engage in acceptance testing to maintain a high bar for release quality. * Organizational Excellence: Exceptional track record of managing competing priorities, planning capacity, and keeping complex technical initiatives organized and on schedule. * Fast Learner: Proven ability to rapidly ramp up on complex technical subdomains (such as identity protocols, authorization models, or security infrastructure). * Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating engineering updates to leadership and advocating for your team's needs. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Strong Pluses** * Prior background as a Software Architect or Lead Engineer. * Experience with continuous process improvement informed by data, particularly using Kanban or Agile metrics. * Proven track record of driving engineering teams to meet and exceed operational SLAs. * Prior exposure to Identity \& Access Management (IAM), OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, or Keycloak environments. * Experience with cloud\-native deployment practices, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code concepts (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, ArgoCD). * Experience promoting AI developer tool adoption within an engineering organization. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, * Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, * Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, * Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, * Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles, * Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. **PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Job** We are seeking a world class, self\-directed Software Design Engineer to build software solutions from the ground up to support the development, manufacturing, and testing of cutting edge high\-speed electrical interconnects. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas including scientific programming, information/databases, test \& verification. As a software engineer you will employ Python and innovative development techniques, working collaboratively with other team members and our global manufacturing centers to build software solutions to solve challenges in any area of the business. To succeed in this role, a candidate must utilize entrepreneurial thinking and a strong passion for software engineering. **Our Team** Join the Software Solution Group (SSG), the central nervous system of the Copper Solutions Business Unit (CSBU) within the Datacom \& Specialty Solutions (DSS) division. As the core software team, we collaborate across the organization to deliver production setup applications for product families and stand\-alone tools that address challenges in every area of the business. We value creative thinking, problem\-solving, and teamwork, offering opportunities to make a real impact while working with innovative applications. **What You Will Do** * Apply software expertise and entrepreneurial thinking to solve business challenges across design, manufacturing, testing, and verification. * Design, develop, modify, and maintain Python software modules for product testing and qualification throughout product development and manufacturing. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and signal integrity engineers to create software solutions for testing high\-speed and low\-speed electrical performance. * Build and enhance desktop software (Python) to optimize and expand capabilities in global manufacturing centers. * Partner with engineering teams to develop tools that improve the design process and engineering efficiency, focusing on feature implementation, configuration, and application development. * Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to keep software skills current. * Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and unit testing to improve software reliability and performance. * Analyze test results, prepare reports, and implement necessary software modifications. * Document software solutions and share knowledge internally with other engineers. * Demonstrate proficiency in Python development and standard software verification and validation techniques. * Explore and contribute to new concepts and innovative solutions. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical or Electronics/ Computer Science/Systems Engineering. * 3\+ years of experience designing Python based desktop applications. * Minimum 2 years of practical software development experience in Python with demonstrated ability to design and build tools and applications that support testing and validation workflows. * Knowledge of software architecture and design principles, emphasizing usability, extensibility, and performance for tools. * Extensive experience with source control tools such as Git or SVN. * Understanding of bug tracking software (i.e. JIRA). * Ability to develop/maintain software in Python. * Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of standard techniques for software verification and validation. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Exposure to hardware systems, electrical interconnects, or manufacturing processes, especially related to testing and quality assurance. * Exposure on writing strong test cases. * Experience with scientific Python libraries and tools like NumPy, Pandas, and Anaconda. * Proven ability to develop reusable software libraries, APIs, and frameworks designed for use by other engineers and testers. \#LI\-MM1 At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading\-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Monaco is building an AI\-native revenue platform that replaces the fragmented GTM stack \- CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, pipeline management with one unified system, consolidating 6–10 disconnected tools into a single platform built for the AI era. We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product\-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1\. We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari. Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software. **The role** ------------ You'll own the Spark pipelines on Databricks that power Monaco's analytics products, working directly with product teams to turn what they need into reliable, cost\-conscious data. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for a mid\-level to senior engineer (roughly 2–6 years of experience). **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build, deploy, and operate production Spark data pipelines on Databricks. * Partner with product teams to turn analytics\-product needs into pipeline requirements, including data quality and freshness expectations. * Set up monitoring and observability so pipeline reliability is measured, not assumed. * Diagnose performance and cost problems and fix their root causes. * Recommend pragmatic standards for running pipelines as our data and platform scale. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * Hands\-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production Spark pipelines. * Deep understanding of how concepts like clustering, shuffles, different join strategies, and batch versus stream processing create tradeoffs in performance, freshness, and cost. * Experience with reliability, monitoring, and observability, and the ability to explain how you diagnosed a real pipeline failure or bottleneck. * Strong SQL. * Basic programming skills in any language (Python is a plus). * Comfort working as an individual contributor, directly with product teams, and through ambiguity. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem. * Experience with streaming pipelines and logical replication, such as replicating Postgres into Databricks. * Experience building RAG pipelines. * AWS infrastructure experience. * Platform administration experience: roles, permissions, access controls, and visibility management. **Location** ------------ * San Francisco. We're an in\-person team \- 5 days in the office. At this stage, proximity genuinely accelerates product quality and team cohesion. Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** The AI Accelerator team sits at the center of Morningstar’s Generative AI strategy for the Direct Platform. We build and scale core systems such as the Morningstar MCP Server, MCP Gateway, and Morningstar Agent. Our team is responsible not only for delivering GenAI capabilities, but also for solving the underlying challenges that make them production\-ready—document vectorization, caching strategies, system scalability, security, and reliability. We work closely with the Morningstar Responsible AI Council to ensure our systems meet strict standards around guardrails, PII filtering, moderation, and anonymized evaluation pipelines. We operate with a strong engineering culture: we question assumptions, prioritize impact over process, and focus on solving meaningful problems rather than executing predefined tasks. Collaboration, shared ownership, and continuous learning are central to how we work. **About the Role** As an Associate Software Engineer on the AI Accelerator team, you will help design, build, and scale the core services powering Morningstar Directs’ GenAI capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer - Safety-Layer
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** The Safety\-Layer Team is responsible for ensuring the Motional Autonomous Vehicle executes appropriate dynamic trajectories in both nominal and safety\-critical scenarios. This team focuses on refining upstream motion plans to guarantee compliance with safety\-driven requirements, executing highly dynamic evasive maneuvers at the AV's physical limits, and implementing system\-wide safety overrides. The team pursues these goals through a process of rigorous algorithmic design, implementation, validation, analysis in simulation, and comprehensive closed\-course and public road evaluation. As the team's responsibilities are growing to support more complex scenarios and the scaling of Motional's deployment area, we are looking for a Senior Motion Planning \- Safety\-Layer to help build a robust motion planning safety\-layer. You will work on enabling cutting\-edge capabilities for Motional's AV, including algorithm design and documentation, software development, metrics definition, simulation implementation and evaluation, and in\-vehicle testing. As part of this role, you will maintain cross\-functional relationships across the organization to help understand and communicate the impacts of their work on overall AV performance. **What you will work on:** * Design, implement, and test algorithms for synthesizing trajectories and selecting trajectories across asynchronous generation sources to ensure AV behaviors adhere to safety\-critical requirement specifications. * Develop evasive maneuver planning algorithms in conjunction with low\-level control systems to safely use the full actuation capacity of Motional's AV for collision avoidance. * Evaluate the role of multiple perception sensor modalities in refining the safety\-layer's identification of safety\-critical scenarios. * Construct test/analysis tooling for isolated and system\-level evaluation of safety\-layer components and processes, select test parameters, and analyze test results. * Utilize, validate, and improve dynamic simulation environments to accelerate the design and analysis of safety\-critical motion planning algorithms, including validating simulation models against real\-world data. * Define and implement performance, comfort, and safety metrics for motion planning and safety systems, and perform quantitative analysis of fleet\-wide vehicle data to validate design improvements and identify key areas of improvement. * Build a system\-wide understanding of Motional's autonomy stack components by supporting root\-cause analysis of simulation, closed\-course, and public road events from a motion planning and safety perspective. * Travel for in\-person vehicle testing at Motional's and our partner's deployment and test track locations, typically once every 4 to 6 months. **Desired Background:** * MS, PhD preferred, in one of Control Theory / Robotics / Computer Science / Applied Math or a related field * 3\+ years of experience developing motion planning and collision avoidance related algorithms and components in an industrial setting, preferably the AV industry * Strong background in modern C\+\+ programming (C\+\+17, C\+\+20\), with an emphasis on developing high\-performance and reliable systems * Experienced with concepts from motion planning including trajectory generation through numerical optimization and sampling\-based approaches, cost and heuristic\-based methods for trajectory selection, multi\-modal prediction models, geometric and physics\-based collision detection, time\-series data processing, and data visualization * Familiarity with dynamic collision modeling, convex set processing, state machine logic, and multi\-rate decision\-making processes * Familiarity with agentic\-based development tooling * Familiarity with Linux\-based operating systems **Bonus Points:** * General familiarity with machine learning, including supervised learning, reinforcement learning, training/test validation, etc. * Familiarity with vehicle dynamics modeling, including standard longitudinal/lateral vehicle dynamics models * Publications in Robotics/Controls or Autonomous Driving conferences/journals (IROS, ICRA, CoRL, RAL, TRO, CDC, ACC, TAC, CSL, Automatica, IV, ITSC, T\-ITS) * Familiarity with SQL\-based queries * Familiarity with Python * Familiarity with Gitlab, Bazel, VSCode / CLion * Familiarity with AV industry simulation tooling \#LI\-BP1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. jobs.description: ***Start with the data pipeline, range across the full stack, and help take a mature, revenue\-earning platform to the next level, with AI at the center of how you build.*** About Northern Light Northern Light provides the world's most sophisticated machine learning\-powered competitive intelligence platform for market research. For over 25 years, we've been helping Fortune 1000 enterprises make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions through our award\-winning SinglePoint knowledge management platform. Our clients include global leaders across technology, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and life sciences who depend on us to transform fragmented data into strategic clarity. We're a company that takes pride in our compulsive drive to provide exceptional client support. We wake up each day ready to tackle the challenges of knowledge management and we never stand still. Our recent innovations include generative AI capabilities, machine learning insights, and advanced competitive intelligence automation. The Product: Search Over Content Nobody Else Has Assembled SinglePoint is an enterprise search and market\-intelligence platform. We license content from a large number of publishers and research vendors, combine it with each customer's own internal documents, normalize all of it, enrich it, index it into per\-customer search databases, and serve it through a customer\-specific portal with search, analytics, NLP enrichment, and AI summarization and Q\&A. Our customers are research and strategy teams at large enterprises. When they can't find something, it costs them a decision. The Opportunity Northern Light is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to start in our content pipeline and grow into ownership across the full platform. The pipeline brings in content from well over a hundred vendor feeds, makes it consistent, and makes it searchable for every customer. From there, the whole platform is open to you: services, search, AI features, and the customer portals. It all works, it earns real revenue, and it's ready for its next chapter. We're looking for someone who sees a 25\-year\-old platform as an opportunity, reaches for AI tools by default, and gets genuinely excited about making something proven dramatically better. What You'll Do * Build and maintain ingestion for new vendor feeds and new customers, from the vendor's delivery quirks through to documents appearing in a customer's search results. * Shape how vendor content is transformed into a consistent, reliable format customers can trust. * Migrate legacy pipelines onto the current stack, including an ongoing Perl\-to\-Python effort and a newer move toward containerized, contract\-bound services. * Help replace convention\-driven job scheduling with explicit, durable workflows. * Track down production content problems and fix them at the root. * Bring AI into the pipeline itself, using ML, NLP, LLMs, and AI tooling to classify, enrich, and validate content, and to speed up how we build and migrate. * Work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the customer portals (PHP and React/TypeScript), following problems and ideas all the way from the vendor to what the customer sees. Who We Hire: AI\-First Builders Who Finish What They Start You can take a task that isn't fully specified, go find the missing context yourself, and drive it until it is running in production, verified against the behavior it replaced, and the thing it replaced is switched off. Not “my part is done.” Done. Transforming a mature system takes creativity and energy as much as rigor. We want someone who brings fresh ideas, shares them freely, and makes the people around them better. What We're Looking For * **A track record of delivering production software.** Things you built that real users depend on, and that you kept running. * **Comfort in code you didn't write.** Much of this estate is older than the people working on it. You can read an unfamiliar system, form an accurate model of it, and change it safely. * **Strong data pipeline instincts.** You build pipelines that are reliable and repeatable, and you can prove a new one matches the old one before you cut over. * **Operational comfort.** Containers, CI/CD, and enough production instinct to know whether your change is actually live. * **An AI\-first way of working.** You use AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agents every day, and you have ideas about where they can make a pipeline smarter. * **Collaborative energy.** Small team, big ambitions. You share ideas freely, write down what you learn, and make the people around you better. * **Judgment about scope.** You know when to fix the root cause and when to ship the narrow thing and record the debt. Languages: No Language Requirement What runs here today is mostly Python, Rust, PHP, and React, plus some long\-lived Perl. New backend work is mostly Python and Rust; the portals are PHP and React. We don't require any of these on your résumé. We hire for judgment, for the ability to pick up whatever the problem happens to be written in, and for finishing. If you have been strong in two or three languages, you'll be fine in ours. One honest note: you will read Perl in this job. You don't have to love it. You do have to be willing. Helps, But Not Required * Building with LLMs, embeddings, or AI agents in production * Web crawling and scraping at scale (Scrapy or equivalent) * Search and information retrieval: indexing, relevance, faceting * Durable workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow * Rust * Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform * PHP * Working with licensed third\-party data feeds Job Details **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Location:** Hybrid in the Boston, MA area, with regular time at our Somerville office, Eastern Time working hours. **Work authorization requirements:** Must be authorized to work in the United States (unfortunately, we cannot sponsor visas). Why Join Northern Light * Join a company shaping the future of competitive and market intelligence. * Work with a collaborative, high\-performing team that values creativity, experimentation, and measurable results. * Put AI at the center of how you build, with the room to bring new ideas into a platform customers already rely on. * Range across the full stack, from vendor feeds to the customer\-facing portals. * Competitive salary, benefits, and professional growth opportunities. * Regular team offsites and opportunities for cross\-functional collaboration. Working at Northern Light Northern Light is based in the Boston, MA area. jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for outstanding Senior High Performance AI Engineer to build groundbreaking multi\-agent systems for the CUDA ecosystem. We build innovative agentic runtimes and compiler\-integrated orchestration that work together with NVIDIA's software stack to provide comprehensive acceleration for modern agent workloads powered by foundational models. As a member of the team, you will develop new agent abstractions, GPU\-centric runtimes, and compiler\- or runtime\-driven system solutions to accelerate agent planning, tool\-use, code generation, and other high\-impact AI workloads. You will collaborate closely with internal NVIDIA software and hardware teams to push the latest developments into NVIDIA products. **What you'll be doing:** * Design, build and optimize agentic AI systems for the CUDA ecosystem. * Co\-design agentic system solutions with software, hardware and algorithm teams; influence and adopt new capabilities as they become available. * Develop reproducible, high\-fidelity evaluation frameworks covering performance, quality and developer productivity. Collaborate across the AI stack—from hardware through compilers/toolchains, kernels/libraries, frameworks, distributed training, and inference/serving—and with model/agent teams. * **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience); MS or PhD preferred. * 8\+ years of industry or academia experience with AI systems development; exposure to building foundational models, agents or orchestration frameworks; hands\-on experience with deep learning frameworks and modern inference stacks. * Strong C/C\+\+ and Python programming skills; solid software engineering fundamentals. Experience with GPU programming and performance optimization (CUDA or equivalent). * **Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:** * Track record building/evaluating deep learning models, coding agents and developer tooling. * Demonstrated ability to optimize and deploy high\-performance models, including on resource\-constrained platforms. * Deep expertise in GPU performance optimizations, evidenced by benchmark wins or published results. Publications or open\-source leadership in deep learning, multi\-agent systems, reinforcement learning, or AI systems; contributions to widely used repos or standards. * With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD \- 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . jobs.title: Cyber Security Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview NCS is a leading industrial products, services and technology company whose primary end\-market is car wash operators. NCS provides a full suite of manufactured equipment, installation project services, aftermarket parts and services, chemicals (detergents, protectants, etc.), and software. More specifically with equipment, NCS provides tunnel equipment, IBA (In Bay Automatic), vacuums, dryers, water systems, doors, signage, arches, and related components. NCS also sells a range of brands – on both equipment, chemicals and software today – including Armor All, Rain\-X, Blue Coral, TSS, VacuTech, NCS, AMP, etc. The company sells primarily in N. America, operates 6 manufacturing plants across N. America, and has \~1600\+ employees. The Company operates numerous Distribution Centers and has sales/HQ offices across N. America, with its primary corporate offices in Des Moines, Iowa and Dallas, TX. NCS is currently owned by Berkshire Partners, a leading Boston\-based PE firm **We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not currently able to sponsor work visas.** **POSITION SUMMARY** The Cyber Security Cloud Engineer is the hands\-on engineer responsible for implementing, operating, and maturing security controls across NCS's cloud environment, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and the enterprise SaaS platforms that run the business. NCS operates within an established set of NIST\-based enterprise security requirements that define the controls, reporting cadences, and audit expectations for the business. This role implements the security controls that protect our cloud, SaaS, identity, workload, and data environments, and serves as the security lead for integrating newly acquired companies into the NCS security framework. As NCS invests in AI to transform how we serve customers and run the business, this engineer ensures those initiatives are deployed with the required safeguards in place. The engineer also partners with Product Engineering and DevOps teams to put required security controls into practice across the software development lifecycle for NCS products, connected equipment, and customer\-facing platforms. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Networking, Data, Application Development, and business stakeholders, and provides security leadership with clear visibility into control status, gaps, and remediation progress. Success in this role means delivering required controls on schedule, demonstrating their effectiveness, and reducing enterprise risk without slowing the business. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Cloud Security Implementation \& Operations** * Implement and maintain security controls across Azure and AWS in accordance with NCS security requirements and the enterprise security framework, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection. * Deploy and operate cloud security posture management (CSPM/CNAPP), infrastructure\-as\-code guardrails, policy\-as\-code, and automated compliance checks that enforce required baselines and provide continuous evidence of control effectiveness. * Operate and tune cloud\-native security services (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID Protection, AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, IAM Access Analyzer) and integrate cloud telemetry into enterprise SIEM detection and response workflows. * Execute detection engineering and incident response for cloud\-hosted and identity\-centric threats, including alert triage, investigation, root cause analysis, containment, and remediation coordination with managed security providers, following established playbooks and escalation paths; track emerging cloud attack techniques and recommend updates to detections, hardening, and response procedures. **Acquisition Integration \& Migration** * Support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions by executing technical assessments of target environments and documenting gaps against NCS security requirements to inform prioritized integration plans. * Execute the secure integration and migration of acquired companies onto NCS platforms, including identity consolidation into Microsoft Entra ID, tenant\-to\-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations, workload migrations to Azure and AWS, network and endpoint onboarding, and decommissioning of legacy infrastructure. * Maintain and follow repeatable, documented integration playbooks and security baselines that bring acquired entities to the required security standard within defined integration timelines, with status reporting throughout. **DevOps \& Product Security** * Implement and operate required security controls across the CI/CD pipeline in partnership with Product Engineering and DevOps teams, including static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container image scanning,  encryption and key management, logging, and workload protection. * Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation), CI/CD platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab), and application security tooling (SAST/DAST, SCA, secrets and container scanning), with a track record of partnering with development teams to embed security into the SDLC. * Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and experience supporting PCI\-DSS compliance and audit or assessment processes, including evidence collection and remediation tracking. * Clear, professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to report control status, gaps, and remediation progress to technical and non\-technical audiences. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * One or more current, industry\-recognized security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\); equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered. * Direct experience executing security workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures, including tenant\-to\-tenant migrations and identity consolidation. * Experience securing AI/ML platforms and services (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise data platforms) and familiarity with the NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, or similar frameworks. * Experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms, container and Kubernetes security, and secrets management. * Experience implementing or maturing a product or application security program, including familiarity with OWASP ASVS and SAMM, NIST SSDF, or similar secure development frameworks, and tooling such as GitHub Advanced Security or equivalent integrated DevSecOps platforms. * Experience securing embedded, IoT, or payment\-enabled products, including PCI\-DSS considerations for software and device design. * Scripting and automation proficiency (PowerShell, Python, etc.) for detection engineering and security tooling. * Experience in manufacturing, distribution, or field service environments, including connected equipment and payment systems. **CORE COMPETENCIES \& LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS** * Takes ownership of assigned controls and initiatives and follows through to measurable, documented completion. * Executes with discipline against established standards while exercising sound judgment on how to implement them with minimal business friction. * Demonstrates calm, decisive leadership during incidents and high\-pressure situations. * Provides clear, pragmatic implementation guidance to peers and leadership on cloud, product, and AI risk. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS \& WORK ENVIRONMENT** * Primarily office\-based or remote\-office work using a computer and standard office equipment for extended periods. * Ability to communicate effectively through phone, video, and in\-person meetings. * Periodic participation in after\-hours incident response or maintenance windows. * Occasional travel to NCS facilities and acquired\-company locations to support integration activities. Grow your career supported by an energized and passionate team, professional development, training, flexibility and opportunities for advancement. We offer competitive wages and benefits including comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, and more. National Carwash Solutions is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are a drug free, EEO employer committed to a diverse workforce. We will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, national origin, sex age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity, family responsibilities, disability, education, political affiliation or veteran status. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Low Voltage Design Engineer- Data Center
jobs.description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Center Infrastructure Engineer to support the planning, design, and delivery of telecommunications and physical IT infrastructure for new construction projects, facility expansions, and existing infrastructure upgrades. This position works closely with facilities teams, architects, construction partners, and technology stakeholders to ensure that network rooms, structured cabling systems, equipment spaces, and supporting infrastructure are designed and delivered according to established engineering standards. The ideal candidate combines strong telecommunications design knowledge with practical experience supporting construction projects, reviewing technical documentation, coordinating vendors, and validating completed infrastructure. What You Will DoInfrastructure Planning and Design * Translate business and technology requirements into practical telecommunications infrastructure designs for new facilities and existing buildings. * Evaluate network room layouts, equipment locations, rack arrangements, cable pathways, fibre distribution, and copper cabling requirements. * Review construction drawings and provide technical recommendations, redlines, and design corrections. * Establish requirements for cable containment, grounding, bonding, fire\-stopping, labelling, and infrastructure testing. * Ensure proposed designs align with TIA\-942, applicable TIA standards, BICSI practices, and relevant building codes. Construction Coordination and Technical Oversight * Partner with facilities, construction management, electrical teams, and low\-voltage contractors throughout project execution. * Review contractor submittals, technical proposals, installation plans, RFIs, and proposed scope changes. * Develop material estimates, Bills of Materials (BOMs), preliminary cost estimates, and project documentation. * Monitor construction progress through onsite inspections and technical reviews. * Identify design discrepancies, workmanship issues, and project risks, and coordinate corrective actions with responsible contractors. * Track project milestones and help ensure infrastructure work meets approved specifications and delivery schedules. Infrastructure Validation and Project Closeout * Review fibre and copper cable testing results and verify that completed work meets acceptance requirements. * Coordinate defect resolution, punch\-list completion, and final infrastructure acceptance. * Maintain accurate records of as\-built drawings, equipment layouts, cable schedules, test results, and warranty documentation. * Support operational handover by ensuring infrastructure information is recorded in CMDB, NetBox, Nautobot, or equivalent inventory platforms. * Recommend improvements to engineering standards and construction delivery processes based on project findings. Capacity and Lifecycle Support * Assess rack capacity, available ports, fibre strand utilization, cable pathways, power distribution, and available equipment space. * Identify infrastructure limitations before they affect upcoming deployments. * Support cable plant upgrades, network room expansions, rack replacements, and other infrastructure lifecycle projects. * Assist with infrastructure risk assessments and planning for scheduled power shutdowns or maintenance activities. Required Experience and Skills * Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in telecommunications infrastructure, low\-voltage engineering, structured cabling design, or IT infrastructure construction. * Mandatory working knowledge of TIA\-942 and its application to data center infrastructure. * Strong understanding of TIA\-568, TIA\-569, TIA\-606, TIA\-607, and BICSI industry practices. * Experience with fibre optic and copper cabling systems, pathways, cable trays, racks, grounding, bonding, and network room infrastructure. * Ability to interpret and mark up architectural, electrical, and telecommunications drawings. * Working experience with AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Revit, or comparable drawing review tools. * Proven ability to coordinate low\-voltage contractors, construction vendors, and cross\-functional project teams. * Familiarity with technical specifications, material estimates, quality inspections, testing documentation, and construction closeout. * Strong communication, documentation, coordination, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work onsite in Santa Clara, California. Preferred Qualifications * RCDD certification or equivalent telecommunications design experience. **RCDD certification is not mandatory.** * Experience supporting ground\-up construction, commercial building deployments, large campus expansions, or data center fit\-outs. * BICSI credentials such as DCDC, OSP, or RTPM, or PMP certification. * Familiarity with CMDB, DCIM, NetBox, Nautobot, or infrastructure capacity reporting tools. * Experience in large enterprise technology, laboratory, cleanroom, or high\-density computing environments. Important Requirements * At least basic TIA\-942 knowledge is required. * This is an onsite position in Santa Clara, CA. * The role emphasizes infrastructure engineering, design review, and construction coordination rather than hands\-on cable installation. Candidates with a background in telecommunications design, structured cabling programs, data center infrastructure, or low\-voltage construction engineering are encouraged to apply. Pay: $50\.00 \- $52\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person
