Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **About the role** ------------------ Our engineering teams build the software that powers clinical care delivery at Oak Street Health — patient scheduling, care coordination, clinical records, and the integrations that connect our systems to health networks across the country. As a Sr Software Engineer, you'll own complex workstreams, drive technical decisions within your domain, and mentor the engineers around you. The work needs to be reliable, maintainable, and built to evolve — and in a healthcare environment, the quality of the design has direct clinical consequences. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Design robust system prompts using LLM frameworks * Partner with product teams and business stakeholders to understand and automate workflows * Design and implement robust file\-ingestion pipelines using Databricks * Own a domain or service area end\-to\-end, including its data model and integration contracts * Lead code reviews, set technical standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers * Hold the team accountable for test coverage, observability, and the production health of the services you own **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ * 5\+ years building distributed backend systems in production * Proficiency building system prompts and utilizing AI frameworks * Hands\-on experience with MongoDB or comparable document stores * Track record of leading technical work across a team — not just executing it * Experience with cloud\-native deployment (Azure, AWS, or GCP) **Preferred Requirements** -------------------------- * Experience building extract, transform, load (ETL/ELT) workflows using Databricks * Deep familiarity with domain\-driven design and bounded context modeling * Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7\) or EMR integrations * Background in high\-throughput, low\-latency service design at scale * Experience with event sourcing, CQRS, or other advanced event\-driven patterns **Education** Bachelor's degree preferred/specialized training/relevant professional qualification. * **About Oak Street Health** --------------------------- Oak Street Health delivers value\-based primary care to Medicare\-eligible adults through a network of clinics across the U.S. Our engineering teams build the platforms that make that care possible — from the clinical workflows providers use every day to the data systems that power population health. We are part of CVS Health. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $83,430\.00 \- $222,480\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. jobs.title: Mortgage Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions. Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state\-of\-the\-art open\- and closed\-source AI models with our human\-in\-the\-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system. Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world’s most innovative lenders do business. We’re looking for a **Mortgage Forward\-Deployed Engineer (Encompass)** to join our team and be the bridge between our product and our customers. This is not your standard engineering role, you’ll be out in the field, working directly with clients, writing production code, and helping them reimagine how they run their business with our platform. You will be working directly with our Account Management team, implementation team and onboarding team. This role reports to the VP of Account Management. As an FDE, you’ll wear different hats: engineer, architect, and trusted advisor. One day you might be prototyping a custom integration; the next, you’re running a proof\-of\-value with a C\-suite exec; the next, you’re feeding back product insights that shape the roadmap. If you like variety, ownership, and making real\-world impact, you’ll love this role. This role will report to our Lead Forward\-Deployed Engineer and be a part of the Account Management team. **What you'll do:** * Act as a **technical expert and trusted advisor** during the post\-sales process, embed with customer teams to understand their workflows and demonstrate how Ocrolus’ technology improves efficiency in mortgage origination. * Review and consult on technical solutions, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and integrations that solve real business problems. * Build and support technical solutions and integrations for mortgage clients using Ocrolus, Encompass, and other POS/LOS mortgage platforms. * Run proof\-of\-concepts and proof\-of\-value engagements that demonstrate ROI fast. * Troubleshoot gnarly technical issues in live environments and get things back on track. * Partner with the Account Management and Product teams to deliver value, and influence the roadmap. * Travel occasionally (\~30–50%) to customer sites and industry events **Who we're looking for: (Skill Sets and Qualifications)** * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting. * 3\+ years of a background in mortgage, or lending workflows. * Strong understanding and experience with Encompass * Strong consultative sales/account management approach—able to map technology to business challenges and drive change management conversations. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior mortgage executives. * Backend: Python; APIs; Encompass Developer Connect; SQL. * Frontend: React/TypeScript; JavaScript with ICE Secure Scripting Framework (SSF) for Encompass custom form and workflow logic. * Supporting: Familiarity with mortgage LOS/POS platforms (Encompass, Blend, SimpleNexus, Floify); Git; cloud basics (AWS/Azure). * Thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments where you figure it out and get it done. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with SaaS integrations or loan origination systems. * Additional mortgage LOS/POS experience * Exposure to AI/ML or generative AI. ### **Why You’ll Love It Here** * You’ll have **ownership from day one**, our FDEs lead projects end\-to\-end. * You’ll work directly with customers and see the immediate impact of what you build. * You’ll shape the product by bringing the voice of the customer straight to engineering. * You’ll work directly with a team focused on creating an excellent client experience * You’ll have fun working with a highly proactive, collaborative team **Note:** The full\-time salary range for this role is between $150,000 \- $170,000 \+ commission \+ equity \+ benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. Disclosure as required by N.Y.C. Admin. Code §§ 8\-102 and 8\-107(32\) of the full time salary compensation range for this role when being hired into our offices in New York City. **Life at Ocrolus** We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast\-growing, remote\-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact. **Our culture is grounded in four core values:** **Empathy –** Understand and serve with compassion **Curiosity –** Explore new ideas and question the status quo **Humility –** Listen, be grounded, and remain open\-minded **Ownership –** Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic. We look forward to building the future of lending together.

jobs.title: Junior R&D Software Engineer
jobs.description: Research \& Development *8000 Marina Blvd \#300, Brisbane, CA 94005, Verenigde Staten* As an employee of our company, you will **collaborate with each department to create and deploy disruptive products.** Come work at a growing company that offers great benefits with opportunities to moving forward and learn alongside accomplished leaders. We're seeking an experienced and outstanding member of staff. This position is both **creative and rigorous** by nature you need to think outside the box. We expect the candidate to be proactive and have a "get it done" spirit. To be successful, you will have solid solving problem skills. **Technical Expertise** **Personal Evolution** **Autonomy** ***To help us provide the best candidate experience, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AS A PDF and limit your applications to a maximum of 3 within a 12\-month period.*** ***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship responsibilities for employment visas at this time.*** ### **About the Role** **Hybrid (4 days onsite, 1 day remote) – Brisbane, CA** As a Software Developer in our Research \& Development department at Odoo, you will take part in the design and development of new features and technologies that enhance our all\-in\-one business management software. You'll also help improve and maintain existing modules, with a strong focus on innovation, usability, and scalability. Our San Francisco R\&D department focuses on adapting Odoo to the entire Americas region: especially accounting, along with payment acquirers, e\-commerce, delivery carriers, point of sale. We develop open source integrated business apps to help millions of employees save time in their day\-to\-day tasks. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain Odoo features and applications * Improve existing code to increase performance, usability, and reliability * Ensure the quality and consistency of developments through testing and reviews * Be responsible for what you develop * Work directly on the software you code for ### **Must Have** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science * Any programming language * Strong problem solving skills * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues ### **Nice to Have** * 1\-3 years of professional experience (internship experience is acceptable) * Experience with Odoo or similar ERP systems * Open source contributions to established projects * A proactive learning mindset ### **What's great in the job?** * Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, 401K Matching, and Commuter Benefits * PTO (Paid\-time\-off), paid sick days, and paid holidays * Employee Assistance Program: 3 X 1\-hour telehealth calls with certified mental health professionals * Evolve in a nice working atmosphere with a passionate, growing team! * Snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap! * Chef\-prepared lunches \- snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap! * Company\-sponsored events for groups of 6\+ employees The estimated annual compensation range for this role is $120,000\-$140,000\. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location. *Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Odoo's values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment\-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records**.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. **The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity** The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co\-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000\+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company. You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust. **About You** *Production builder*: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it. *Careful evaluator*: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality. *Strong owner:* You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use. **What you will be doing** * Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long\-running work. * Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling. * Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state. * Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete. * Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding. * Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests. * Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory. * Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine\-tuning or other post\-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved. **What you will bring to the role** * Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools. * Hands\-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool\-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation. * Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant. * Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain. * Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action. **Scope by level** Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster. **Our stack** Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan. We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts. **And extra credit for** * Open\-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data. * Fine\-tuning, preference data, post\-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets. * Identity and security workflows. Foundation\-model research experience is optional. P26074 \#LI\-Inperson \#LI\- BB1 **The Okta Experience** * Supporting Your Well\-Being * Driving Social Impact * Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws. If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation. Notice for New York City Applicants \& Employees: Okta may use Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT), as defined by New York City Local Law 144, that use artificial intelligence, machine learning, or other automated processes to assist in our recruitment and hiring process. In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, if you are an applicant or employee residing in New York City, please click here to view our full NYC AEDT Notice.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Development
jobs.description: As Manager, Software Development, you’ll be the hands\-on leader of OnLogic’s software development strategy and a global team of about 10 engineers who build applications our business and customers run on. You’ll set how the team builds with AI, from coding tools to agentic systems, and be the leader engineers learn from. You’ll ensure our team of software developers can achieve their highest potential, raising the bar on speed and quality while delivering measurable business results. We believe in the power of in\-person collaboration and the benefits of a strong workplace community. As a member of our IT leadership team, this role requires an onsite presence at our South Burlington, VT or Cary, NC office. We encourage candidates who are able to relocate or comfortably commute to apply. **In this role, you’ll be responsible for:** * Setting the software development strategy for OnLogic’s internal and customer\-facing applications. * Leading a high\-performing team that plans against real capacity and delivers measurable business results on its commitments. * Increasing delivery speed while maintaining quality, using deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate and time to restore service to find and remove friction and blockers. * Leading the team’s adoption of AI coding tools and agentic systems, with reusable patterns, and reviewing standards for AI\-generated code and automation of repetitive work. * Keeping business\-critical and customer\-facing applications stable and secure through strong release practices, monitoring and technical debt reduction. * Developing each engineer through clear goals and regular coaching, and building a culture of trust, accountability and direct feedback. * Raising code quality and maintainability through design and code reviews, clear standards, architecture guidance and hands\-on coding when needed. * Aligning priorities and tradeoffs with business owners, and representing software development in IT leadership decisions. **The team you will be joining:** Our Information Technology team touches every aspect of our business and each of our day to day lives here at OnLogic. Made up of software developers, infrastructure and security experts, systems and network engineers and business technology professionals, our IT team is constantly working to improve our internal systems to make our lives easier, while optimizing our website to do the same for our customers. From the technology we use to do our jobs, to the infrastructure that supports the way we build, test and ship our products, our IT team keeps our business running smoothly. * Learn more about Life at OnLogic. **Requirements** * You have a Bachelor's degree in business, computer engineering or other technical field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience in software development with at least 4 years of experience managing and growing a team of 6 or more developers. * Hands\-on experience building with AI coding tools and agentic systems. Experience building platforms and guardrails for team\-wide agentic AI deployment, preferred. * Experience owning multiple production applications the business depends on, including release management, monitoring and incident response. * Strong command of modern engineering practices: continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, code review and version control (Git). * Ability to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now and in the future. **Who we're looking for:** * A leader who measures success by team results delivered with quality, not personal output. * A coach who gets energy from helping engineers grow. * A builder who still enjoys code and keeps current on AI by using it daily. * A problem solver who turns complex, unclear work into clear plans. * An organized leader who keeps several priorities moving and meets deadlines. * A direct communicator who raises problems early and welcomes pushback. * A partner who explains technical tradeoffs in plain business terms. * Someone who understands how software runs on real systems, from operating systems to infrastructure, and wants to build it at a hardware company. **Who we are:** OnLogic employees have the opportunity to shape our future and drive impactful change. We design and manufacture specialized edge computing solutions for companies all over the world, helping them to make the seemingly impossible possible. Our computers are designed to work where others fail, and it's our vision to be the first choice in edge computing. To make that vision a reality, we've built a team of ambitious problem solvers, guided by the company's core values of Open, Fair, Innovative, and Independent. We have an open office, open salaries, and strive to be fair and transparent in our decision making. We encourage input and feedback from every member of our team and look to improve ourselves and our business every single day. Diversity is an essential element of our core values. Not just respecting, but actively embracing a variety of backgrounds, life experiences, and opinions, helps us foster innovation, enhances our problem\-solving capabilities, and promotes learning and engagement among the members of our team. We strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds to apply. We are committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and harassment\-free workplace for all employees. We do not tolerate any form of harassment, discrimination, or bias based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. To learn more about our values, our mission and what it's like to work at OnLogic, visit www.onlogic.com/careers. **Benefits** The salary range for this role is $170,000 to $200,000\. We determine final compensation based on discussions with applicants and their experience in similar roles. * A competitive Salary based upon your experience and the requirements of the role * A comprehensive Benefits package * 401k Plan with 3% Employer Contribution * An Annual Profit Share Bonus * Paid Maternity \& Paternity Leave, and Short \& Long Term Disability * A personal development plan created to help you (and us) grow \#LI\-AC1 \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.title: Lead SOC Engineer
jobs.description: OnTrac is hiring a Lead SOC Engineer! Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and excel at problem\-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter! Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same\-day and next\-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e\-commerce and product\-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S. **Location:** Remote \- This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals. **Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $156,000 \- $195,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $156,000 \- $234,000\. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job\-related factors. **Employment Logistics:** We are seeking a Lead Cyber Security Engineer, a senior\-level individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust security architectures. This is a "hands\-on\-keyboard" role that requires the ability to pivot between deep technical engineering and assisting in strategic support. You will act as a primary technical enabler for the Security Operations Center (SOC) by optimizing detection capabilities and for the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team by translating complex jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading\-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer\-scale transistors to micron\-level die\-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient. **Job Summary \& Responsibilities** **About the role** ================== Onto Innovation designs and manufactures the inspection and metrology tools that the world’s leading chipmakers rely on. We believe AI will be a key enabler of faster, more reliable measurement and decision\-making in semiconductor manufacturing. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will work closely with system engineers, algorithm developers, and applications teams to understand complex metrology workflows and data flows. You will set the vision and architecture for AI in metrology, then design, build, and productionize AI systems, including agentic ones, that speed up setup and troubleshooting and improve measurement quality. The emphasis is on agents grounded in real tools and data, with the right human oversight. You will also set technical direction and mentor the AI and ML engineers around you. **What you’ll do** ================== * **Set the vision and own the architecture.** Define the AI strategy and reference architecture for metrology, choose what to build and what to buy, and keep the roadmap tied to the problems customers actually have. * **Build it yourself.** Write, test, and ship production code — prototypes, agent workflows, evaluation tooling, and the systems that run them — and set the standard by example. * **Design agent workflows for the metrology lifecycle** — guided recipe and model setup, qualification runs, tool matching, and root\-cause triage when a measurement drifts. * **Give agents real tools.** Connect them to our simulators, solvers, and tool data so the agent orchestrates and the physics computes. * **Ground agents in fab knowledge:** retrieval manuals, recipes, service tickets, and historical measurement outcomes, with provenance on every answer. * **Design for trust.** Human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, confidence and uncertainty carried through every step, full audit trails, and refusal when the evidence is thin — a number without an error bar is not a measurement. * **Deploy where fabs allow it.** On\-premises and air\-gapped inference, with local or hosted models chosen on latency, cost, and data\-control constraints, and a release path that survives customer change control. * **Build the evaluation harness:** golden task sets, tool\-call correctness, agent\-built versus expert\-built recipes compared against the TMU budget, and regression tests on every model or prompt change. * **Keep the measurement science sound.** Surrogate models, parameter inference, tool calibration, and calibrated uncertainty remain the engines agents call. Own the ML behind them where it matters, including domain shift across tools, layers, and fabs. * **Lead technically.** Set standards, run design and code reviews, mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, and make the approach and build\-versus\-buy calls. Raise software quality with unit testing, test automation in CI/CD pipelines, refactoring of legacy code, and static and dynamic analysis. * **Set the practice for AI\-assisted development.** Apply AI coding tools responsibly to coding, debugging, documentation, and test generation, and maintain secure, reliable workflows for evaluating AI\-generated code: human review, automated testing, static analysis, security scanning, and validation against requirements. Spot gaps in team processes and toolchains, and drive improvements. * **Translate between fab and model.** Turn a customer’s setup or yield problem into a tractable agent workflow, then explain the result to engineers who will judge it against a reference technique. **Qualifications** **What you’ll bring** ===================== * MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 6\+ years of applied ML/AI experience in production, including 3\+ in technical leadership, leading projects or owning the technical direction of a significant AI system. * Experience defining AI strategy and system architecture, and getting a technical vision adopted across engineering. * Hands\-on depth in LLM\-based systems: agents, tool calling, retrieval, and prompt and model evaluation, shipped to real users and monitored after release. * Strong ML foundations: deep learning in PyTorch, plus regression, anomaly sted production code every day. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools: writing clear prompts, critically reviewing generated code for errors and incorrect assumptions, and turning it into maintainable production code. * A working understanding of software security, intellectual property, data privacy, and responsible AI when using AI in enterprise software. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex software systems, and the ability to research and solve hard technical problems independently. * Experience developing software on Windows with Visual Studio and Azure DevOps confirm toolchain. * A record of owning AI systems in production after launch: monitoring them, diagnosing failures, and shipping updates. * Clear technical writing, and the patience to explain an AI system’s decision to a process engineer who will not accept “the model decided” as an answer. **What would make us especially interested** ============================================ * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, C\#, or CUDA where the model meets the instrument are a plus. * Semiconductor process control experience — metrology, inspection, SPC, yield analytics, or time spent in a fab. * Scatterometry or OCD, ellipsometry, reflectometry, interferometry, or e\-beam imaging. * Tool\-calling and MCP frameworks, multi\-agent orchestration, vector and hybrid search, LLM fine\-tuning, and on\-premises LLM serving. * Security and IP protection for AI systems, and shipping inside a regulated release process or with customer data that can never leave the site. * Physics\-informed ML, surrogate modeling, physics\-based modeling and numerical simulation, or Bayesian inverse methods such as MCMC or variational inference. * Parallel or high\-performance computing. * Experience in integrating AI into the software development process, such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test creation, and requirements analysis. **Working here** ================ This role is on\-site by design: it depends on close, daily collaboration with applications and system engineering. Expect regular time in the office, and occasional time at a fab or customer site. Our customers do not tolerate surprises, neither do we. Work here is reviewed, documented, and qualified before it ships — and once it does, it runs in production lines measuring wafers around the clock. Why Join Onto Innovation? At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well\-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting\-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized. **Compensation \& Growth** * Base Salary Range: $129,600\.00 \- $194,400\.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long\-term incentives tied to both company and individual success. Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future: Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential \- without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team. Important Note on Export Compliance For certain positions requiring access to technical data, U.S. export licensing review may be necessary for applicants who are not U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or other protected persons under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: Parallax Innovations is a civic communications lab building modern persuasion infrastructure for the movement to improve American democracy and elections. We support organizations and campaigns advancing nonpartisan democracy reforms through our narrative intelligence platform. We combine technology, data, and services to help our partners reach, engage, and persuade voters in our fast\-evolving information ecosystem. We enable partners with strategic guidance and hands\-on production and editing support to build strong vertical\-video operations across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Our products make it easier for campaigns to mobilize supporters as creators, equipping them with tools that draw on our intelligence and predictive capabilities to improve content before it ships. And our data assets – including an enriched voter file with audience\-specific insights – help campaigns deploy and amplify the right content to the specific voters they need to reach. Our primary focus is solving the Primary Problem—a system of party primaries that excludes millions of voters and rewards elected leaders for answering to a narrow partisan electorate. We help advance open primaries that give voters more voice and choice and leaders stronger incentives to represent their communities. Parallax is incubated by Unite America, and is based in Denver. As *Chief Technology Officer,* you will own the ongoing development and improvement of Parallax's primary competitive advantage: a narrative intelligence platform that learns what persuades Americans on reform issues, and how. You own everything engineering, AI, data, privacy \& compliance, infrastructure, security, with strong influence over adjacent workflows. You also serve as an organizational leader, driving strategy and organization prioritization. We approach persuasion like infrastructure: a lasting capability that helps the movement learn, improve and win across campaigns and election cycles. Our ambition is to build a closed\-loop learning system that gets smarter every time we speak. Its AI core will connect the content we create with engagement data, audience research and experiments to learn which messages, messengers and formats work with which voters—and feed those lessons back into how we create, target and distribute the next communication. Over each election cycle, Parallax will support a number of reform campaigns, many of them ballot initiatives. Each campaign has to reach different audiences: progressives, conservatives, independents, and the large group of Americans who are disengaged or simply worn out by politics. Our product lowers the barrier for supporters to become compelling content creators, and our platform provides guidance on frames, formats, messengers and messages are likely to work. This is an executive role requiring technical depth and a hands\-on approach to using modern engineering tools, as well as broader organizational leadership skills. You’ll craft the product vision, lead the contract engineers in developing the platform, and be the decision\-maker about architecture, models, data and resources. You’ll also champion the technical vision, progress, and investment requirements to executive leadership, the Board, and potential investors. You will inherit a contract data and engineering team, and from there you will determine how the team develops, including budget development and hiring. You will serve as a senior executive responsible for the technical integration of Parallax’s data, products, and services. Alongside the *Chief of Staff* and *VP of Product \& Partnerships*, you will develop and drive organizational strategy, translate priorities into work plans and budgets, and align the team around measurable results. Ideal candidates for this role will have the judgment and management ability to assume broader organizational leadership as Parallax grows. This role reports to the President, and is based in Denver. Relocations welcome. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere will be considered if they can commit to periodic trips to Denver. These will be your accountabilities: Own the development of Parallax’s core technology and competitive advantage.* Set platform strategy and capabilities roadmap: what it should measure, what its learning agenda will be, what inputs it expands to include, and how it learns and improves quarter over quarter. * Define the scoring framework: how content engagement and persuasion are quantified for Parallax, how they are weighted, and how scores connect to real outcomes. * Extend our intelligence platform beyond transcript\-analysis so that it evaluates videos, including visuals, presenters, format and production choices. * Make the model decisions: which commercial and open models to use and route between, whether fine\-tuning or custom components are worth it, and the tradeoffs in cost, speed and accuracy. * Build the data loop so that performance data from platforms, partners, audience surveys and exper ments, learn from results, and make each round of communications smarter. **First six months:** a working feedback loop connecting content, audience and outcome data; initial scoring and predictive capabilities tested against results; and initial integrations with the partner voter file and Partner Portal. The team should be using findings to improve communications, with clear measures of progress and priorities for what comes next. **Requirements** Background in technical leadership and executive accountability.* **12\+ years in engineering, machine learning, AI or data product roles, including several years leading technical teams**. A recent record of shipping AI or data products, using frontier tools and methods, that people have used to make real decisions. * **Demonstrated executive leadership beyond a technical team**: experience aligning multiple functions, managing senior leaders, making resource tradeoffs, and communicating strategy and results to a board or investors. * Experience taking a data or AI product from an early version to something an organization relies on. * **High integrity**. AI\-assisted persuasion work in a democracy needs someone who will not overstate what a model knows, and who takes accuracy, privacy and responsible use seriously. * **Low ego, default\-curious**. You let results overrule your favorite hypothesis, and give credit freely. * **A builder who leads.** You would rather show a prototype than describe one, and you raise the bar for the team by working alongside it. You are comfortable in a small, early organization where the plan is still being drawn. * Bonus points if you have supported founders or principals in raising capital or philanthropic funding. Relevant backgrounds include AI startups, intelligent platform engineering, AI\-assisted political analytics, media analytics, or adtech engineering. Political or ballot\-initiative experience is helpful but not required. Mission\-drive and political savviness.* **Genuine motivation for democracy reform, healthy elections, and electoral integrity.** Experience in govtech, civic tech, or political or ballot initiative work is a strong plus, but not a requirement. If you don’t have this type of experience, your motivation for our mission must be truly palpable. * **A cross\-partisan outlook.** You can come from any political camp, but you do not demonize the others. The Parallax team includes people from across the spectrum who share the democracy mission, and that is by design. * **A political messaging lens**, i.e. an understanding that progressives, conservatives, independents and disengaged voters hear the same idea differently, and curiosity about the science of persuasion. (You do not need political relationships to be competitive for this role.) Hard skills:* **Fluency with modern AI tools:** LLM APIs, multimodal models for video, image and audio, retrieval, prompt and agent design, model routing, and the tradeoffs of fine\-tuning. You keep up with new models, harnesses, and other tools, and have some method for testing and experimenting with new tools as they are released. * **Evaluation and measurement in practice:** Building eval sets, back\-testing, A/B testing and experimental design, and enough causal inference to know the difference between content that gets engagement and content that changes minds. * **Hands\-on technical depth:** You can write Python and SQL, design data pipelines, and review the code and architecture your team ships. * **Product sense:** You can turn what creative teams and partners need into a roadmap and specs, and decide what not to build. * **Ability to explain to nontechnical (creatives, leadership, funders) how a given product or tool works**, and what its current limits are. **Benefits** Generous benefits package including: * Competitive base salary * Unlimited PTO; generous parental leave * Health, vision, dental insurance * 401K with 3% match * Company issued laptop/equipment, and reimbursements

We hire critical thinkers. This role is designed to build a strong foundation in security operations, giving the analyst hands\-on exposure to threat detection, incident response, and enterprise security tooling. The Operations team gives analysts access to powerful AI models purpose\-built for cyber work — tools that accelerate investigation, surface relevant context, and compress the learning curve for new analysts. Candidates should expect to use AI tooling from day one as a core part of how the team investigates, learns, and responds, not as an optional add\-on. The ideal candidate is curious, detail\-oriented, and eager to build technical depth across cybersecurity platforms, policies, and procedures. They will learn to assess evidence, triage alerts, and escalate significant events to Engineers and Incident Responders, while progressively taking on greater ownership of the incident lifecycle. Beyond incident response, the analyst will rotate through a variety of SOC workflows — event monitoring, correlation, and behavioral analysis — gaining broad exposure that supports growth into more senior analyst or engineering roles. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Incident Response \& Threat Detection** * Respond to Cyber incidents with increasing independence, applying documented playbooks and escalation procedures. * Investigate and triage security alerts, correlating data across multiple tools to determine scope and severity. * Use AI\-assisted investigation tools to accelerate triage, enrich context, and identify patterns across incidents. * Escalate significant or ambiguous events to senior Engineers and Incident Responders with clear, well\-documented findings. **AI\-Accelerated Learning \& Response** * Leverage the team's AI models as a primary learning tool — using them to research unfamiliar threats, understand tooling, and build technical depth faster than traditional self\-study alone. * Apply AI tooling directly to response work: drafting investigation notes, summarizing log data, and accelerating root\-cause analysis. * Identify repetitive or manual tasks on the team and use AI tooling to automate or streamline them, actively working to reduce the operational load carried by the Operations team. * Document and share effective AI\-assisted workflows and prompts with teammates to raise the bar for the whole team. **Security Operations \& Monitoring** * Perform continuous monitoring of security events, logs, and behavioral indicators across the environment. * Support Phishing Email Response, including analysis, remediation, and user follow\-up. * Contribute to and maintain runbooks, knowledge\-base articles, and standard operating procedures. **Stakeholder Communication \& Support** * Provide customer\-facing support for Cyber\-related questions and issues via email and messaging platforms. * Promote good personal and professional cybersecurity hygiene through regular engagement with staff. * Set and manage expectations with sup  emerging cyber threats and industry trends. * Participate in team knowledge\-sharing sessions and post\-incident reviews to build institutional knowledge. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong organizational skills and self\-sufficiency; able to operate with minimal supervision during active events. * Working knowledge of core cybersecurity toolsets: Endpoint Detection \& Response (EDR), Email Security Gateway, SIEM, Vulnerability Management, Identity \& Access Management, and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB). * Genuine enthusiasm for using AI tools (e.g., LLM\-based assistants, AI\-driven investigation platforms) as a core part of daily workflow — comfort experimenting with and adopting new AI tooling quickly. * Ability to spot manual, repetitive work and a natural inclination to automate it rather than absorb it as routine toil. * Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment. SC\-900, AWS Security Fundamentals) * Prior hands\-on experience with AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for research, writing, or automation **Additional Notes** -------------------- This Given the accelerating effect of the team's AI tooling on ramp\-up, analysts are expected to progress toward greater autonomy within 6–12 months and toward specialization within 12–18 months. jobs.description: PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI\-first digital operations. with business strategy. #### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption:** Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value * **Build and contribute core agent capabilities:** Scope, design, and build reusable directly into the product. * **Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery:** Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI\-assisted to autonomous operations. * **Set technical direction and feedback insights:** Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team. #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** * **8\+ years** of production, including agent development, tool\-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design. * **Customer\-facing skills.** You can run a technical design session with a customer's engineers and present the business case to their leadership. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role. * **A record of shipping software that got adopted,** and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build. * **Infrastructure \& Deployment expertise:** Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods). * **Willingness to travel 25–50%** during active customer engagements. #### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on\-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting). * Customer\-facing technical consulting, forward\-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background. * Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem\-solving. * Experience with policy\-as\-code, fine\-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent\-driven automation. * Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms. * Active open\-source contributions to the AI agent or M Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian. People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance. **What we offer** As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country\-specific offerings, on our benefits site. **Your package may include:** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive benefits package * Flexible work arrangements * Company equity\* * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)\* * Retirement or pension plan\* * Generous paid vacation time * Paid holidays and sick leave * Dutonian Wellness Days \& HibernationDuty \- companywide paid days off in addition to PTO * Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non\-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)\* * Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year * Company\-wide hack weeks * Mental wellness programs * Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure **About PagerDuty** PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI\-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two\-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always\-on digital experiences to modern businesses PagerDuty is Great Place to Work\-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2\. jobs.description: Remote, Washington, United States of America Global Customer Services Ref ID: JR\-023457 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As an AI Deployment Strategist (Customer Outcome Leader) within Forward Deployment Engineering, you are the single\-threaded business owner responsible for driving realized value, user adoption, and long\-term expansion across our enterprise AI engagements. Deploying enterprise AI is fundamentally different from traditional software delivery—it mutates operational workflows, alters decision\-making rights, and spans multiple complex technical streams. Working directly alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who build and optimize the technical architecture, you own the business realization. You will bridge the gap between executive AI vision and day\-to\-day operational reality, ensuring our solutions deliver clear, measurable ROI while insulating technical teams from reactive firefighting and unmanaged scope creep. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Single\-Threaded Business \& Value Ownership** * Own end\-to\-end business success, ROI realization, and user adoption across high\-impact enterprise accounts (e.g., global consultancies, Fortune 500 enterprises). * Establish baseline metrics, define target KPIs, and continuously measure, track, and present realized financial and operational value to client executives. * Serve as the primary peer and strategic advisor to client executive sponsors (CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, Business Unit Leads). **2\. Multi\-Stream Governance \& Scope Control** * Unite and govern complex, parallel workstreams (agent orchestration, guardrails/security, data pipelines, UI integration, and change management) under a single strategic roadmap. * Act as the strict gateway for engagement scope—eliminating unmanaged scope creep, managing client expectations, and translating ad\-hoc requests into structured roadmap decisions. * Prevent technical teams from falling into reactive firefighting by maintaining clear operational boundaries and structured delivery cadences. **3\. Workflow Redesign \& Operational Change Management** * Deeply analyze client operating models to identify high\-value business problems and redesign operational workflows around AI capabilities. * Manage organizational change, address user inertia, and re\-align decision rights to ensure end users actively adopt AI tools into daily workflows. * Conduct user feedback loops to refine the business solution, ensure outputs meet operational standards, and drive change management programs. **4\. Partnership with Technical Delivery (FDEs)** * Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to translate business requirements into actionable technical user stories. * Protect engineering bandwidth by owning executive stakeholder management, business politics, and operational blockers, allowing FDEs to focus proactively on core technical architecture, evaluations, and system reliability. **5\. Account Expansion \& Value Scaling** • Proactively identify adjacent, high\-value enterprise use cases to expand account footprint post\-initial deployment. • Turn successful proofs\-of\-concept (POCs) into multi\-year, enterprise\-wide production deployments. **Qualifications** * 6–10 years in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), forward\-deployed engineering, technical account management, or forward\-deployed strategic roles in high\-growth B2B SaaS/AI companies. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of enterprise AI deployments, large language models (LLMs), multi\-agent systems, and digital workflow transformation. * **Executive Presence:** Proven track record of aligning, advising, and holding accountability with C\-suite executives and senior enterprise stakeholders. * **Business Acumen:** Demonstrated ability to construct business cases, model ROI, design KPIs, and re\-engineer complex operational business processes. * **Technical Literacy:** Ability to speak fluently with engineers, understand technical trade\-offs (e.g., latency vs. accuracy, guardrail evaluation, data integration patterns), and translate technical complexity into business impact. * **Change Management:** Strong background in organizational design, user adoption, and driving behavioral change across large operational teams. **Core Competencies \& Leadership Attributes** * **Single\-Threaded Accountability:** Takes complete ownership of business outcomes without deflecting to technical or operational complexity. * **Scope Discipline:** Firmly manages client expectations and resists unmanaged feature creep while maintaining high\-trust executive relationships. * **Strategic Clarity in Ambiguity:** Able to bring order to fragmented, multi\-stream AI initiatives and establish clear direction amidst rapid technological change. * **Cross\-Functional Catalyst:** Bridges the cultural and operational gap between technical engineering teams and non\-technical business leaders. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $112,900\.00 \- $182,600\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer

Since our founding almost a century ago, we’ve been committed to improving peoples’ lives and making the world a better place–one customer, one business, one innovative leap at a time. Come join our journey! Responsibilities: **AI Research Engineer** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=0tMgKm\_71qs (*by clicking this link you are being referred to an external site that is not part of Panasonic*) **What You'll Get To Do:** At this Lab., one of the first groups to adopt deep learning for autonomous systems in the Silicon Valley, we work at the leading edge of deep learning and collaborate with the world’s best universities and research centers. We are looking for passionate engineers and researchers who want to contribute in this exciting fast\-moving field. This role focuses on developing physical AI technology, especially for manufacturing. **Major Responsibilities** * Develop effective techniques and infrastructure, from the initial idea to the running prototype and product * Write code, use the latest machine learning tools, run experiments, and generally develop techniques and processes to enable intelligent abilities on industrial applications * Partner with teams across the company to implement your ideas into their products * Remain connected to the broader research community by partnering with internal and external collaborators and science community * Visualize and explain the work through presentations and notebooks * Work with other teams including business division to accelerate AI application in company\-wide business processes * **Participate in publication, patent, and conference activities alongside senior research staff** * Write, test and maintain production\-quality code * **Works under the guidance of senior researchers to design, evaluate, and refine machine\-learning models.** * **Contributes technical expertise to ongoing research initiatives and supports the transition of research outcomes into prototypes and production environments.** * Design, experiment and evaluate models * Research, design and implement novel, highly scalable AI algorithms with focus on various kinds of data (e.g., Qualifications: **What You'll Bring:** **Education \& Experience:** * **Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Math or related discipline** * AI publications, patents, or industry innovation activities** * Good oral and written communication and teamwork skills * Worked with general ML libraries and toolkits * Experience working in multidisciplinary scientific collaboration * Experience with accelerators (GPU) and high\-performance computing systems * Excellent programming skills in Python, C\+\+, Tensorflow, PyTorch or similar languages * Internships/work experience with machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning * Background in machine learning techniques with large amounts of noisy or partially missing data, curiosity in applying it to industrial applications * Relevant research experience (publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR or similar are preferred) * Experience with cloud environments and multi\-machine setups * Proven experience, either in industry or a research lab, working on complex ML problems and engineering workflows * Proven knowledge of machine learning and/or statistics e.g., Neural Nets, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning etc. * Strong knowledge of algorithm design \- with a proven ability to write ML algorithms from scratch * A passion for AI **Benefits \& Perks \- What's In It For You:** Panasonic prioritizes total well\-being and offers comprehensive benefits options to support physical, emotional, financial, social, and environmental health: * **Health Benefits** – Offering medical, dental, vision, prescription plans, plus Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options. * **Voluntary Benefits** – Life, accident, critical illness, disability, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance. * **Panasonic Retirement Savings \& Investment Plan (PRSIP)** – 401(k) plan with company matching contributions and immediate vesting. * **Paid Time\-Off Benefits** – Vacation, holidays, personal days, sick leave, volunteer, and parental \& caregiver leave. * **Educational Assistance** – Tuition reimbursement for job\-related courses after six months of service. * **Health Management and Wellbeing Programs** –Lifestyle Spending Account, EAP, virtual health management, chronic condition, neurodiversity, tobacco cessation, substance abuse support, and life stage and fertility resources. Available to eligible employees starting the first day of the month following your start date. Eligibility for each benefit may vary based on employment status, location, and length of service. * **Employee Recognition Program** \- High5 employee recognition and awards platform, quarterly and annual employee recognition * **Annual Bonus Program** \- Opportunity for an annual performance\-based bonus. **We Take Opportunity Seriously:** At Panasonic, we are committed to a workplace that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. Fairness and Honesty have been part of our core values for more than 100 years and we are proud of our diverse culture as an equal opportunity employer. The wage range of $130,000 \- $145,000 is just one component of Panasonic’s total package. Actual compensation varies depending on the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, and location. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses and incentives. We understand that your career search may look different than others and embrace the professional, personal, educational, and volunteer opportunities through which people gain experience. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! *Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law. All qualified individuals are required to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.* *Due to the high volume of responses, we will only be able to respond to candidates of interest. All candidates must have valid authorization to work in the U.S.*Thank you for your interest in Panasonic. \#LI\-HD1
