jobs.title: Junior Support Engineer
jobs.description: Partner One is a long\-term investment group specializing in the acquisition and growth of successful software companies. With over 30 years in business, we own and operate some of the fastest\-growing enterprise software companies globally. More than 2,000 of the world’s largest corporations and governments rely on our software for their most critical operations and to safeguard their most valuable data. We are looking for a Junior Support Engineer to join our team based at our Riverside Data Centre, California – this DC hosts infrastructure and equipment supporting multiple companies across our portfolio. This is a hands\-on, junior technical role, ideal for someone looking to build their experience across IT support, hardware, networking, and data centre operations. You’ll work alongside our existing Data Centre Engineer and wider IT teams, helping with day\-to\-day requests and providing on\-site support when physical access to equipment is required. We’re not looking for someone who knows everything already; our goal is to identify someone practical, reliable and keen to learn, who is comfortable working with IT hardware and following technical instructions **Responsibilities:** * Install, rack and cable servers, switches and other network equipment * Assist with basic installation and decommissioning of Data Centre hardware * Provide ‘Smart Hands’ support for our wider IT teams and portfolio companies * Carry out tasks such as power cycling equipment, checking connections, reseating cables and replacing basic components * Supporting our existing Data Centre Engineer when additional resource is needed * Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues, including checking cabling, ports, connections and device status * Escalate more complex infrastructure or networking issues to the appropriate engineer or technical team * Assist with laptop and end\-user device management * Receive returned equipment and ensure assets are correctly recorded and stored; wipe and securely prepare laptops and other devices for re\-use or disposal; configure and prepare devices to be shipped to new or existing users * Assist with IT asset and inventory management, including tracking equipment entering and leaving the Data Centre * Follow documented processes and maintain accurate records of work completed, and assist with other hands\-on IT and Data Centre tasks as required **Requirements** * A basic understanding of computer hardware and networking * Confidence working with laptops, desktops and other IT equipment * A basic understanding of network concepts such as IP addresses, switches, network ports and Ethernet connectivity * An interest in learning more about servers, networking and Data Centre infrastructure * The ability to follow technical instructions and documented processes carefully * Good organization, attention to detail and problem solving skills * A willingness to ask questions and escalate when something is outside your knowledge or experience. * Good communication skills and a helpful, service\-focused attitude with the ability to work collaboratively with engineers and IT teams who may be based remotely **Preferred Requirements** Experience in any of the following would be useful, but is not essential: * Working in an IT Help Desk, Service Desk or desktop support environment * Installing or replacing computer hardware * Basic network troubleshooting * Server or network rack installation and cabling * Laptop imaging, configuration or device management * IT asset management * Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 * Working with a ticketing system such as Jira * CompTIA A\+, Network\+ or similar entry\-level IT certifications **Benefits** This role offers an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across a broad range of technologies and environments. You’ll work with infrastructure supporting multiple companies, giving you exposure to Data Centre operations, networking, servers, end\-user computing and IT support. For someone at the beginning of their IT career, it’s a great opportunity to develop practical skills while working alongside more experienced engineers and gradually taking on greater technical responsibility. **Compensation** The estimated compensation range for this role is $40,000 \- $60,000/ year Gross USD. Actual compensation will be based on local market benchmarks and relevant experience. **This recruitment process may use automated or artificial intelligence to screen or assess applicants** **This job posting is for an existing vacancy.**

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Description** Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines. Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work? * Entity: Corporate * Department: PennDNA Data Science * Location: Remote based out of 3535 Market St. Philadelphia, PA * Hours: 8hr Days **Summary**: The Senior Data Scientist will work closely with Machine Learning (ML) Engineers and be responsible for participating in the solving of complex problems from large sets of data, utilizing statistical analysis, machine learning, language models, and programming to develop solutions and drive innovation to address complex healthcare challenges. You will optimize research data tools and design scalable architecture to support our system clinical, operational and research efforts. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data science and architecture, machine learning, statistical analysis and healthcare analytics, with experience in developing and deploying machine learning products to improve patient care and outcomes. **Responsibilities**: * Predictive Analysis and Modeling: Build and validate algorithms to address complex healthcare problems. Develop proof\-of\-concept models and then iteratively improve the model. Design and utilize experimentation to quantify opportunity and outcomes. Maintain, implement and advance best practices as relevant for the data science discipline. * Utilize advanced statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to extract deep insights from complex clinical, operational, and research datasets. Lead and execute moderately complex projects with minimal oversight. Serve as an expert in one or more sub\-domains. * Data Collection and Assessment: Work closely with administrators, clinicians, and informatics teams to evaluate existing data sources and identify potential gaps. Propose strategies for improving data integrity and collecting new data that minimize disruption to clinical workflows and operational processes. * Collaboration: Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including ML engineers, site reliability engineers, vendors, clinicians, administrators, researchers, and others, to understand project requirements and develop solutions that meet organizational needs. Exhibit exceptional domain and data context awareness, stakeholder engagement, and ability to frame problems. This collaboration aims not only to advance healthcare technology but also to drive significant improvements in patient outcomes and operational efficiencies, demonstrating the tangible impact of our work. Provide subject matter expert review, guidance and consultation. Receive, triage, and refine requests from internal clients. * Monitoring and Compliance: Actively monitor and evaluate the performance of analytical projects, ML models or research studies, to ensure they meet high standards of quality, effectiveness, and reliability. This role involves integrity and ethical use of data, adherence to legal and safety standards, and the proactive identification and mitigation of any form of drift or deviation from expected outcomes. This position does not entail on\-call operations but requires a consistent commitment to maintaining the highest standards of operational and research integrity. * Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data architecture, database development, machine learning, statistical analysis and healthcare analytics. Look for opportunities to optimize the team’s processes and workflows.: **Education or Equivalent Experience:** * Bachelor of Arts or Science Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or related field (Required) * And 4\+ years Experience in data architecture, database development, machine learning, statistical analysis and healthcare analytics. Proven track record of leading and executing moderately complex projects with minimal oversight. (Required) * Master of Arts or Science Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or related field (Preferred) We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives. Live Your Life's Work We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Sr Developer Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: At PennEngineering, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. You can contribute to work that matters with a company where diversity, equity and belonging are shared values. We're committed to fostering an environment for every employee that's welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. PennEngineering is seeking a motivated, excited, individual to be a part of**Information Systems Team.** As the **Senior Developer Security Operations Engineer** at PennEngineering, you'll collaborate with teams that do truly amazing things. Join us as we build the future in Manufacturing and Engineering! **Perks and Benefits:** * Medical \& Employer Paid: Dental and Vision * Parental Leave * 401k and Employer Match * Paid time off and holidays * Tuition reimbursement * Community Volunteering * Talent Referral Bonus Program * Onsite Fitness Center * Employee Centric Culture * Company Provided Technology (laptop, phone, monitors for office and home environment) **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** **About the Role** As PennEngineering accelerates its Speed of Now transformation (respond in 1 hour, quote in 1 day, samples in 1 week, finished product in 1 month), we are rapidly expanding our cloud\-native, AI\-powered application portfolio. Delivering at this pace demands that security is not a checkpoint at the end of development, but an engineered capability embedded into every layer of how we build and deploy software. The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for building and operating the security guardrails, tooling, and automation that enable PennEngineering's engineering teams to ship code safely at high velocity. This is a hands\-on leadership role: part builder, part automator, part platform engineer. You will own the security posture of our global AWS cloud environment and customer\-facing platforms, automate the guardrails that protect organizational assets, and ensure that our CI/CD pipelines enforce security by design, without creating friction that slows our teams down. As PennEngineering's AI application portfolio grows, including AI\-powered workflows, agentic systems, and customer\-facing digital platforms, this role will play a critical part in implementing, and helping to shape, the security architecture and governance frameworks that allow those systems to operate reliably, safely, and at enterprise scale. **Key Responsibilities** **Cloud Security Posture \& Remediation** * Continuously assess, harden, and elevate the security posture of PennEngineering's AWS cloud infrastructure, covering both customer\-facing platforms and internal enterprise systems * Design and build custom security tools, frameworks, and policies tailored to protect PennEngineering's internal and external organizational assets * Own the end\-to\-end vulnerability management lifecycle, including triage, tracking, prioritization, and automated remediation of identified vulnerabilities and cloud misconfigurations * Establish a continuous posture improvement program with defined baselines, remediation SLAs, and executive\-level reporting on security health **Pipeline Security \& CI/CD Integration** * Design and implement automated security scanning (SAST, SCA, and DAST), embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring checks are high\-fidelity and low\-latency to support our daily deployment cadence * Configure pre\-commit hooks, pull request checks, and branch protection rules that automatically detect and block secrets, misconfigurations, or vulnerable dependencies before they reach production * Partner with AI engineering teams to secure AI/LLM workloads within the pipeline, including prompt injection protections, model input/output validation, and agentic system guardrails * Establish security gate standards and developer\-friendly documentation so engineering teams understand what is enforced, why, and how to resolve failures quickly **Automated Governance \& Policy\-as\-Code** * Replace manual security audits with automated policy enforcement using infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, AWS Config), ensuring non\-compliant infrastructure cannot be provisioned * Build event\-driven automation to detect and auto\-remediate common security issues in near real\-time, reducing mean time to respond across the environment * Define and maintain security governance standards, including access controls, secrets management, encryption policies, and data classification frameworks * Establish audit\-ready documentation and evidence collection practices to support internal compliance reviews and external assessments **Cloud Operations \& Threat Response** * Maintain the operational security health of PennEngineering's AWS environment, using automation to manage scaling events, configuration drift, and self\-healing infrastructure * Operationalize CrowdStrike and Zscaler telemetry by automating the correlation of security alerts to reduce noise and trigger rapid, automa ortfolio evolves * Partner with the Principal Systems Architect and AI engineering teams to embed security requirements into solution designs from the earliest stages * Stay current on emerging threats relevant to AI systems, cloud\-native architectures, and manufacturing/industrial environments, and translate findings into actionable security guidance **Key KPIs** * Vulnerability remediation SLA compliance: % of identified vulnerabilities resolved within defined timeframes by severity tier * Pipeline security gate effectiveness: % of CI/CD pipelines with automated security scanning enabled; false\-positive rate maintained below threshold to avoid developer friction * Mean time to detect and respond (MTTD / MTTR) for security incidents across the cloud environment * Policy\-as\-code coverage: % of infrastructure provisioned through automated, policy\-enforced pipelines vs. manual processes * Cloud security posture score: continuous improvement trend against defined baseline using AWS Security Hub or equivalent * AI workload security coverage: % of AI\-powered applications and agentic systems operating under defined security standards Location: Danboro, PA (hybrid) \#LI\-BS1 Requirements: **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in cloud security, DevSecOps, or security engineering * Deep expertise in AWS cloud architecture and security services, including IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, KMS, VPC design, and CloudTrail * Proven experience integrating automated security tooling (SAST, SCA, DAST) into modern CI/CD pipelines without degrading deployment velocity * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and policy\-as\-code approaches using Terraform or AWS CDK * Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Go, or Bash, with the ability to build custom security tools and integrate systems programmatically * Experience securing containerized workloads including Docker, Kubernetes, and ECS/EKS deployments * Practical knowledge of vulnerability jobs.description: **About Phylo** Phylo is an applied research lab building agentic intelligence to accelerate discovery for every biomedical scientist. We believe AI agents will fundamentally transform how biomedical research is done. Our fast\-growing team brings together researchers and engineers across AI and biology, commercializing the Biomni platform. Our growing team brings together world class researchers and engineers across AI and biology. Backed by a $13\.5M seed round led by a16z, Menlo Ventures and Anthropic, and advised by Nobel Prize laureate and pioneering biologists, Phylo is building the next generation of AI systems for the life sciences. **About the Role** This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You’ll shape priorities with the founding team, build the foundations for how we bring products to market, and help define how product marketing contributes to Phylo’s overall brand and marketing strategy. You’ll own work from the initial idea through writing, launch, and follow\-through, working closely with product, engineering, scientific, and commercial colleagues. There is plenty of opportunity to take on broader brand and marketing ownership as the company grows. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Develop positioning grounded in customer work.** Understand the problems scientists are trying to solve, how they work today, and why they choose Biomni Lab. Turn those insights into clear messages for scientific users and pharma decision\-makers. Bring a recommendation, test it in conversations, and refine it as the product develops. * **Build customer stories from evidence.** Work directly with customers and our Forward\-Deployed Strategists to identify useful workflows, document the starting point and results, and understand what we can credibly say. Personally write case studies, use cases, and walkthroughs; coordinate scientific review and customer approval; and get them in front of the right audience. * **Own product launches**. Define the audience, message, and launch plan with the product team. Write the copy, develop demos and supporting materials, coordinate contributors, and learn from what people try and use after launch. * **Run a focused marketing plan.** Prioritize the stories and launches that matter, manage reviews and deadlines, and own distribution. Measure useful customer conversations, adoption, and contribution to qualified opportunities alongside engagement. * Inform Phylo’s broader brand and marketing strategy. Bring customer insights, positioning, and launch learnings to the founding team to help shape the company story, priority audiences, and where marketing should focus. **What you bring** ------------------ * **Hands\-on experience taking AI products to market is required.** You’ve personally owned positioning, launches, demos, and customer materials for a product whose core value depends on AI. You can explain its capabilities and limitations, translate them into credible customer value, and show work you created and shipped. * **The ability to follow a research workflow, ask useful questions, and communicate credibly with scientists and R\&D leaders.** Experience in pharma, biotech, or life sciences is strongly preferred, whether within those organizations or marketing software for scientific R\&D, but if you're unfamiliar, the ability to very quickly learn and ramp up is extremely valuable. * **An AI\-native way of working**: you use AI tools effectively in your daily work, but have strong product and creative taste. * **Excellent writing and editing.** You can explain a complex capability clearly and simply, and concretely demonstrate relevance to scientists. * **Strong customer / user interviewing skills and good evidence judgment**: you know what a result supports, what remains uncertain, and what you need to ask next. * **Strong execution in a small team.** You can make a recommendation, resolve conflicting feedback, and carry a project through without a large supporting organization. jobs.title: GTM Engineer- AI B2B Lead Generation & Automation
jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a hands\-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI\-powered lead generation engine. You build the core AI agents first, then run the campaigns on them every day, turning enterprise buying signals into qualified sales conversations. You might have started in outbound, SDR leadership, demand gen, or growth, then taught yourself to build the agents and automations that do the work. Or you're an engineer who learned B2B prospecting the hard way. Either way, you've personally built systems that booked real meetings, and you can show us how you have been successful. If that's you, we would like to meet you! **About PlanITROI** For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has turned retired technology into financial value for enterprise organizations. Our services cover IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). We operate on reuse\-as\-intended\-use: reuse before recycling, and recycling only when reuse isn't viable. PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide and is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor. Our mission is to maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients and gets a second life as affordable technology. **Your mission** Build and run the AI\-powered outbound engine that finds enterprise buying opportunities and turns them into qualified meetings and signed MSAs. Your agents will research 5,000\+ enterprise accounts and reach 250,000\+ contacts. You own it end\-to\-end: signal detection, account intelligence, contact discovery, personalization, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. **Build first, then run.** You start by building a few core agents. Then you run the campaigns on them: launching and monitoring sequences, working reply queues, tuning messaging and targeting every week, protecting deliverability, and handing warm conversations to sales at the right moment. Expect most of your time to shift from building to running once the agents are live. **Who we sell to.** Enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 11,000,000\+ employees, mostly knowledge workers (80%\+), complex buying committees, and an existing technology provider. Your challenge: find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and give them a compelling reason to talk to PlanITROI. **Who you work with.** You report to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer, and work closely with the VP of Marketing. No layers in between other than support. **What you'll build and own** * **Signal detection.** Ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals such as tech refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, and social activity. Trigger the right next action while the signal is fresh. * **Buying committee intelligence.** Identify high\-fit ICP accounts, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts per entry point, validate contact data, and track changes. * **Personalization and challenger messaging.** Combine account intelligence, signals, persona pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context into relevant outreach at scale. * **Multichannel orchestration.** Run email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR follow\-up as one system, with sequencing, timing, routing, and next\-best actions. * **Objection handling and follow\-up.** Respond intelligently to objections like "We already have a provider," keep conversational context, and escalate to humans at the right moment. * **Performance and optimization.** Measure results by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. Find what's winning, kill what isn't, and run the next experiment. These are capabilities, not six separate agents. You design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together. **What you bring** **This role requires a hands\-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself.** You'll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay, but using them isn't the role. Building the agents that run on top of them is. You understand both sides: the engineering, and the B2B prospecting strategy that turns agents into a working revenue system. **Must\-haves** * **AI agents that booked meetings.** You've personally built and run AI agents or automated outbound systems that produced measurable B2B meetings, and you have the performance data to prove it. * **Agent engineering.** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, memory and state, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n, or comparable frameworks. * **Coding and integration.** Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. * **Enterprise prospecting.** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying committee mapping, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. Bonus if you've displaced incumbent providers. * **GTM stack.** Hands\-on with tools like Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense or Bombora, and AI calling or voicemail platforms. * **Production operations at scale.** Monitoring, debugging, CRM sync, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, and error handling for systems reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail without burning domains or accounts. **Nice\-to\-haves** * A background in outbound, SDR/BDR leadership, demand gen, growth, or RevOps before moving into AI and automation. * Experience in IT services, ITAD, or computer hardware, hardware as a service **What success looks like** Your primary outcome is **qualified enterprise meetings** that meet defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. We also track: * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion.** How well your agents turn buying signals into conversations and meetings. * **Contact precision.** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Deployment velocity.** How fast a campaign idea becomes a working agent and a live test. * **Multichannel conversion.** Replies, conversations, meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability.** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, and compliance. * **Learning rate.** How quickly you find what isn't working, fix the root cause, and scale what is. **How we hire: show us, don't tell us** We hire on proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished slides about what agents might do. If you qualify, we'll give you a real project to show us how you build. * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show your architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, and integrations; how your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human handoff; and real performance data such as meetings, pipeline, or conversion gains. You won't need access to any PlanITROI system or need to buy software. Free tiers and trials are fine. Your work stays yours unless we hire you. If you show work from a past employer, please redact anything confidential. **Ready to build?** If you love hard technical problems and want to build something ambitious, bring your working agents, your results, and your drive. Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow. **Explore more about us:** PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| BuyRefurbished.com *PlanITROI is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Research Engineer - Pretraining Data
jobs.description: **Own Your Intelligence** ------------------------- Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team. Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high\-performance training, and deployment into one full\-stack system for post\-training at frontier scale \- from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open\-source models trained end to end for long\-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full\-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Role Impact** --------------- Build the data behind Prime Intellect’s next generation of open models. You’ll find valuable sources, turn them into training\-ready corpora, and work with researchers to test what actually improves the model. Your work will shape both broad pretraining and the data used to develop reasoning, coding, and long\-context capabilities. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Find, evaluate, and collect valuable training data from web, code, and technical sources. * Build scalable pipelines that turn raw data into training\-ready corpora through extraction, cleaning, deduplication, and filtering. * Develop checks for data quality, coverage, and contamination, and use them to improve collection and processing. * Work with researchers on data mixtures and sampling strategies for pretraining and midtraining. * Prepare and evaluate data for long\-context learning, reasoning, and coding, testing synthetic data where it proves useful. * Run controlled data experiments and use model evaluations to decide which sources, mixtures, and processing choices are worth scaling. * Make large\-scale data processing efficient, reproducible, and recoverable, with clear source provenance and dataset versioning. **Requirements** ---------------- * Strong programming skills in Python and a record of building reliable data\-processing or distributed systems. * Experience working with large datasets and managing the practical tradeoffs of storage, compute, throughput, and reproducibility. * Ability to diagnose data\-quality issues and translate research goals into measurable checks and experiments. * Comfort owning an evolving technical problem end to end and working closely with researchers to test assumptions and improve the system. Relevant experience may include: * Web crawling, document extraction, code\-data collection, or large\-scale corpus curation. * Deduplication, text classification, quality scoring, synthetic data, or training\-data contamination analysis. * Data\-mixture experiments, curriculum learning, or measuring how dataset changes affect model performance. **Nice to have** * Experience preparing datasets for language\-model pretraining, continued pretraining, or midtraining. * Work with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or comparable systems. * Experience with multilingual, mathematical, scientific, or repository\-level code data. * Familiarity with tokenization, training data loaders, and the needs of large model\-training runs. Depth in data acquisition, scalable processing, or data research can be a strong starting point. We don’t expect every candidate to have worked across all of them. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Cash Compensation Range of $150\-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect. * Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in\-person at our offices in San Francisco. * Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates. * Quarterly team off\-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities. * Opportunity to work with a talented, hard\-working and mission\-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI. If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert\-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire — and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking — we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Our clients don't buy software in the abstract. A BD team at a top\-20 pharma company, a biotech evaluating its pipeline, or an investment fund running diligence on a drug asset each arrives with its own data, its own workflows, its own security review, and its own definition of a good answer. Closing the gap between what our platform does out of the box and what that client needs this quarter is engineering work, and it's this role. We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be Prudentia's senior technical presence inside client engagements. You'll scope problems with client stakeholders, integrate our platform with their systems and data, build the configurations, workflows, and extensions that make it indispensable, and turn what you see in the field into product and platform improvements. You'll work across engineering, data, AI/ML, and the commercial team. **Why This Role is Hard (in a Good Way)** ----------------------------------------- Forward deployed work at Prudentia sits where several demanding worlds meet: * **Sophisticated, high\-stakes users:** BD leaders, portfolio strategists, scientists, and investors who know the domain cold and will spot a wrong number immediately. Trust is earned one answer at a time. * **Messy enterprise reality:** client data in internal systems, data rooms, spreadsheets, and licensed databases; SSO and security reviews; IT teams with their own timelines and constraints. * **AI that has to be right:** applying LLMs and retrieval to clinical trial data, scientific literature, deal history, and multi\-language sources, where hallucination isn't a quirk but a credibility risk. * **A product still taking shape:** every engagement is a chance to decide whether something should be a one\-off configuration, a reusable pattern, or a core platform feature. You'll help make that call. You'll need to be as comfortable in a client steering meeting as you are in a pull request, and able to switch between them in the same afternoon. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Client Deployment \& Integration** * Lead the technical side of client onboarding and deployment, from discovery and scoping through go\-live and expansion. * Integrate Prudentia with client systems and data: internal databases, data rooms, document repositories, licensed datasets, and identity providers, working within their security and compliance requirements. * Build client\-specific workflows, configurations, models, and extensions on top of our AWS\-based platform, written to production standards rather than as throwaway scripts. **Applied AI \& Data in the Field** * Apply our AI capabilities (LLMs, retrieval, extraction, scenario and risk modeling) to client\-specific questions, and evaluate whether the outputs are accurate and defensible. * Partner with the data team on onboarding new client and third\-party data sources, and on the provenance and quality standards that let clients trust the results. * Build evaluations and guardrails for client use cases so that quality is measured, not assumed. **Product Feedback Loop** * Be the field's voice in engineering and product: bring back patterns, gaps, and requests with enough technical depth that they can be acted on. * Turn repeated one\-off solutions into reusable components, templates, and platform features, contributing directly to the core codebase. * Help decide what should be productized, what should stay configurable, and what we should say no to. **Trusted Technical Advisor** * Act as the technical point of contact for your accounts, from day\-to\-day users through to executive sponsors. * Support the commercial team in pre\-sales technical discovery, pilots, and proofs of value with strategic prospects. * Help build the forward deployed playbook, and help shape the team as it grows. **Who You Are** --------------- **Essential Qualifications** * **5\+ years of software engineering experience,** including meaningful time in client\-facing, forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting roles where you shipped code that clients depended on. * **Strong full\-stack or backend engineering skills:** Python and SQL as a minimum, comfort with APIs and integrations, and the ability to work across a modern web stack. * **Hands\-on AWS experience:** you've deployed and operated production systems on AWS and can reason about security, networking, and cost in client environments. * **Practical experience with LLMs and AI applications:** retrieval, prompting, extraction, evaluation, and the judgment to know when an AI output is good enough to put in front of a client. * **Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences:** you can run a working session with scientists or investors, then explain the tradeoffs to engineers. * **Comfort with ambiguity and ownership:** you thrive when the problem isn't fully specified and the client is waiting on you to define it. **Bonus Points** * Experience in life sciences, biopharma, healthcare, or financial services, especially with clinical trial, scientific literature, or deal data. * Experience with enterprise integration patterns: SSO/SAML, data room APIs, data pipelines, and security questionnaires. * Experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup where you helped define a function rather than join an established one. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact:** Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader * **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity * **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ We are strongly prioritizing candidates based in London (UK), Dublin (Ireland), or Basel (Switzerland) to support our EU\-based clients. If we find truly exceptional talent in the US, we may consider fully remote in Eastern Time Zone in the United States. Compensation Range: €110K \- €132K

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> DSP Architecture and Design **General Summary:** **General Summary** Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6\+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real\-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS. As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open\-source community. Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality. * Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. Qualcomm is making a long\-term investment in Zephyr RTOS as a strategic platform across multiple product lines. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape both Qualcomm's internal RTOS strategy and the future direction of one of the industry's most important open\-source embedded operating systems. jobs.title: Healthcare Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Healthcare Software Integration Engineer** ============================================ Quest International \| Remote – United States (California Preferred) **Pay:** $32\.00–$35\.00 per hour DOE (Depending on Experience) **Employment:** Full\-Time, Temp\-to\-Hire **Location:** Remote – United States **Preferred Location:** California **Work Environment:** Remote / Healthcare Technology Integration **What's in It for You?** ------------------------- **Grow:** Build your career in healthcare technology, medical software integration, and technical support. **Collaborate:** Work with healthcare customers and technical teams to connect medical software with hospital systems. **Develop:** Expand your experience with HL7, DICOM, Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, and healthcare software interfaces. **Impact:** Help ensure patient information transfers accurately and reliably between healthcare systems. **Stability:** Join an established global technology services company. **About Quest International** ----------------------------- For more than 40 years, Quest International has supported medical device manufacturers, healthcare organizations, OEMs, and technology customers through equipment repair, field service, logistics, and technical support. We are looking for an experienced DICOM/HL7 Integration Engineer to support healthcare software integration projects. This remote opportunity is available to qualified candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for candidates located in California. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Connect medical software applications with hospital information systems. * Configure, test, and maintain HL7 and DICOM software connections. * Help ensure patient information transfers correctly between healthcare systems. * Troubleshoot software integration problems, connectivity issues, and system errors. * Test software connections to identify and resolve technical issues. * Work with customers to understand their healthcare software integration requirements. * Collaborate with technical teams to complete integration projects. * Configure healthcare software interfaces and support connectivity with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems. * Investigate software issues and develop appropriate technical solutions. * Document technical work, testing results, system configurations, and troubleshooting activities. * Communicate technical findings and project updates to customers and internal teams. * Learn new healthcare software applications and integration processes as needed. **What You Need to Qualify** ---------------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree. * At least 3 years of relevant professional experience. * Hands\-on experience working with HL7 and DICOM systems. * Knowledge of Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems. * Experience configuring healthcare software and interfaces. * Ability to test and troubleshoot software connections. * Ability to understand customer requirements and resolve technical issues. * Strong analytical thinking and technical problem\-solving skills. * Good communication and organizational skills. * Ability to document technical work accurately. * Ability to collaborate effectively with customers and technical teams in a remote work environment. ### **Preferred Experience — Not Required** Experience with any of the following is a plus: * SQL databases, including Firebird or Microsoft SQL Server. * Reading or understanding Pascal programming code. * Hospital information systems and healthcare software applications. * Healthcare software interface configuration and troubleshooting. * Technical project coordination. * Technical documentation and software testing. * Working with multiple healthcare technology systems. Experience with HL7 and DICOM is required. Knowledge of SQL databases and Pascal programming is preferred, not required. **Compensation — What Does DOE Mean?** -------------------------------------- DOE means "Depending on Experience." Quest International offers **$32\.00–$35\.00 per hour** for this position. Starting pay will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated technical skills. Candidates with experience configuring HL7 and DICOM interfaces, integrating healthcare software with hospital systems, and troubleshooting complex software connections may qualify for compensation within the posted range. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- Quest International offers eligible employees benefits, including during the temp\-to\-hire period: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life insurance and AD\&D coverage * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Critical illness and hospital indemnity insurance * Accident insurance * Voluntary supplemental life insurance * Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Technical training and career development opportunities Benefits are subject to applicable plan eligibility, enrollment requirements, coverage effective dates, and employee contributions. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, understands healthcare software systems, and can communicate effectively with customers and technical teams. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience connecting medical software to hospital systems, configuring HL7 and DICOM connections, and troubleshooting issues that affect the transfer of patient information. You should be comfortable working independently in a remote environment, documenting technical activities, testing software interfaces, and helping customers resolve integration challenges. **California\-based candidates are preferred, but qualified applicants throughout the United States are encouraged to apply.** If you have at least three years of relevant experience, knowledge of healthcare information systems, and hands\-on HL7 and DICOM experience, we encourage you to apply. **Ready to Start Your Quest?** ------------------------------ If you enjoy healthcare technology, solving software integration challenges, and helping medical systems communicate effectively, we'd love to hear from you! Quest International, Inc. www.questinc.com **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Quest International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on job\-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs without unlawful discrimination. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

weather drivers** * **Calendar and seasonal patterns** * **Lagged demand and weather relationships** * **Extreme\-weather behavior** * **Regional and customer\-segment differences** * **Peak\-demand training, and evaluating forecasting models.** **Required Skills \& Experience** * **Advanced proficiency in Python and common data\-science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, LightGBM, XGBoost, or equivalent tools.** * **Demonstrated experience developing and deploying forecasting, time\-series, or predictive models.** * **Strong knowledge of:** * **Feature engineering** * **Regression and time\-series methods** * **Gradient boosting** * **Ensemble forecasting** * **Probabilistic or quantile forecasting** * **Model validation and backtesting** * **Experience integrating and analyzing weather APIs, NWP forecasts, SCADA/telemetry, databases, and external data feeds.** * **Ability to evaluate weather\-provider performance and determine its impact on forecast accuracy.** * **Strong SQL and data\-analysis skills.** * **Experience transitioning models from research and development into reliable production workflows.** * **Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS, Step Functions, CloudWatch, and SageMaker, or comparable cloud technologies.** * **Experience with Git, version control, testing, and reproducible software\-development practices.** * **Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.** * **Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with data scientists, data engineers, DevOps, operations, trading, and business stakeholders.** **Model Performance \& Production Support** * **Monitor forecast performance using metrics such as MAE, RMSE, normalized error, bias, forecast skill, and probabilistic metrics where appropriate.** * **Benchmark internal forecasts against persistence, existing models, alternative weather providers, and third\-party forecasts.** * **Develop monitoring and diagnostics for:** * **Forecast degradation** * **Data\-quality issues** * **Weather\-provider outages or anomalies** * **Model drift** * **Operational impacts** * **Implement appropriate logging, alerts, error handling, and recovery procedures.** * **Support forecasting solutions designed to continue operating when individual data feeds or weather services become unavailable.** * **Perform root\-cause analysis of significant forecast misses and recommend corrective actions.** **Production \& Data Integration** * **Develop data connectors and pipelines supporting weather, telemetry, historical generation, load, and operational data.** * **Support scalable batch and near\-real\-time forecasting workflows.** * **Maintain clear model configuration, versioning, dependencies, and documentation.** * **Collaborate with data engineering and DevOps teams to deploy and maintain forecasting applications.** * **Build dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, Plotly, or similar technologies to communicate forecast performance, model behavior, and operational impacts.** **Preferred Experience** * **Experience with utility\-scale wind forecasting or renewable generation modeling.** * **Experience with multiple commercial or public weather/NWP providers.** * **Experience working directly with wind\-turbine, solar\-plant, or SCADA telemetry.** * **Experience with turbine power curves and weather\-to\-power conversion methodologies.** * **Experience benchmarking internal forecasts against commercial forecasting vendors.** * **Familiarity with energy markets, utility operations, generation scheduling, trading, or ISO/RTO environments.** * **Experience developing forecasts across intra\-hour, day\-ahead, and multi\-day horizons.** * **Experience with probabilistic forecasting and forecast uncertainty.** * **Experience supporting or mentoring less\-experienced data scientists.** Pay: $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Data Platform Engineer** ================================ Location: NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.)\| Full\-time \| Engineering **Who we are.** --------------- Reality Defender is an award\-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI\-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi\-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API\-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time. Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI\-generated media is not used for malicious purposes. *Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup* **The Staff Data Platform Engineer Role.** ------------------------------------------ Reality Defender's detection models are only as strong as the data behind them, and every new generative tool raises the bar on the volume and variety of media we need to train and evaluate against. The Staff Data Platform Engineer will own the shared AI data platform behind our vision, audio, and multimodal research, turning acquired and internally generated image, video, audio, and text data into reliable, reproducible datasets, from continuous ingestion through processing, governance, and export. This is a senior, hands\-on role where you'll complete our Databricks and distributed processing platform and build the reusable infrastructure behind our in\-house synthetic data generation, including producing the very deepfakes our models learn to catch. This is a full\-time role, reporting to our Director of Data. Responsibilities include: * Own the end\-to\-end data platform for AI research: continuous ingestion, preprocessing, governance, and export of image, video, audio, and text data at high volume. * Complete and scale our Databricks lakehouse and distributed processing stack (Spark, Ray, or similar), making architecture and build\-vs\-buy decisions that hold up as data volume grows. * Build reusable infrastructure for in\-house synthetic data generation, so researchers can produce new deepfake variants across modalities on demand instead of one\-off. * Make every dataset reproducible and traceable through versioning, lineage, metadata, quality checks, and stable train/eval splits, so any model result can be tied back to the exact data behind it. * Own pipeline reliability, observability, and processing cost per dataset as core metrics of the platform. * Partner with ML researchers to understand their data needs and turn them into self\-serve tools that speed up model iteration. * Mentor engineers and raise the bar on data engineering practices: code review, testing, documentation, and runbooks. * Work with Security and compliance stakeholders to make sure data handling, licensing, and access controls meet the standards our enterprise and government clients expect. * Help shape the long\-term data platform roadmap with engineering and research leadership. **Who you are.** ---------------- * 8\+ years building data platforms or data infrastructure, including staff\- or lead\-level ownership of production pipelines that generate, ingest, or deliver data at high volume. * Deep hands\-on experience with distributed processing (Spark, Ray, or similar) and lakehouse platforms, ideally Databricks, on top of cloud object storage (S3, GCS, or Azure Blob). * Production experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Spark on AWS, including performance tuning, access controls, and operational troubleshooting. * Experience working with large unstructured media such as video, audio, or images, including the realities of large files, decoding and transcoding, and metadata at scale. * A track record of building reproducible ML datasets: versioning, lineage, data quality validation, and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Databricks Workflows, or similar). * Strong Python and SQL, and the judgment to own ambiguous platform problems end\-to\-end on a lean team. * Own infrastructure and deployment automation using Terraform and CI/CD, including AWS storage, IAM, compute, Databricks resources, and distributed processing environments. * Experience building synthetic data generation pipelines or running generative models (diffusion, voice cloning/TTS, video generation) at scale. (nice to have) * Background supporting ML research teams with training and evaluation data, especially for multimodal models. (nice to have) * Experience in security, fraud, trust \& safety, or another adversarial domain, or at a Series A or B startup where scope regularly outpaces headcount. (nice to have) **Within 12 months, you'll…** ----------------------------- * Own a mature, self\-serve data platform that researchers use to create, version, and export datasets without waiting on platform support. * Have scaled synthetic data generation across vision, audio, and multimodal research, broadening our detection coverage of new generative techniques. * Deliver reproducible evaluation datasets that let the company compare model versions with confidence. * Be setting the multi\-year data platform roadmap and leading high\-leverage initiatives beyond the original scope. **What we offer.** ------------------ Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location: * Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents * Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents * Short/Long\-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees * FSA/HSA and 401k programs * Equity compensation * 20 days of PTO per year * 12 weeks of Parental Leave * Learning and Development budget * Monthly wellness benefits * Annual company\-sponsored offsite For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits: * Daily in\-office lunch through UberEats * Commuter benefits * Remote Fridays * Happy Hours and other local events Base salary range: 210,000 \- 260,000, based on experience, level, and location. Role includes equity. Compensation Range: $210K \- $260K

jobs.description: About Us: Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. jobs.description: Kensho is S\&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at S\&P Global and its customers worldwide. Kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative AI applications, agents, data retrieval APIs, data extraction, and much more. At Kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. We dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. As a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful. Kensho is S\&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at S\&P Global and its customers worldwide. Kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative AI applications, agents, data retrieval APIs, data extraction, and much more. The MLOps team is the de facto ML platform team at Kensho. Our team’s mission is critical: empower our ML engineers with state\-of\-the\-art processes, tooling, and infrastructure to iterate quickly, build reliably, and identify potential production issues early. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure and ML, and work closely with all our ML teams (ML Product teams, R\&D, …) and our infrastructure teams (Core Infra, SRE, Security). We are a small and high\-leverage team: our work practically touches every AI project at Kensho. We balance pragmatic platform development with hands\-on exploration at the frontier: building agentic applications ourselves, contributing to open\-source tools, and defining what a mature agentic platform looks like before the industry has settled on the answers. You’re equally likely to find us at a top ML conference (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML) and at major software and infra conferences (Amazon Re:invent, PyCon). To illustrate the point, within the same month, the same engineer went from reimplementing a prompt optimization research paper to shipping prometheus alerts. As an MLOps Engineer, you are a thoughtful, curious, collaborative, and resourceful person passionate about building and supporting a mature ML platform. You are not afraid to dig deep in both infrastructure and ML topics. You’re excited to work on internal tooling enabling ML engineers to iterate faster and build high\-quality production\-ready models, agents, and products. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **SRC, Inc.** is currently seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative AI capabilities for defense and national security missions. This is a hands\-on, early\-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine\-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. You will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. The work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative AI toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in ISR, EW, and advanced sensing. This is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ML on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard\-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny. **What You'll Do** * Build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels * Train, fine\-tune, and benchmark models using standard open\-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly * Develop and run evaluation pipelines — task\-specific metrics, held\-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results * Support generative AI efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open\-weight and commercial language models * Assist with parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) and supervised fine\-tuning of open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks * Implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement * Maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others * Contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations * Collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0\+ years of experience (internships, co\-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count) * Working proficiency in Python and the core scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, matplotlib) * Familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably PyTorch * Exposure to the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Tokenizers) or equivalent open\-source model tooling * Understanding of ML fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross\-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks * Comfort with Git\-based collaborative development * Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up **Ways to Stand Out** * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight language models using PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA) or the TRL/Axolotl/Unsloth toolchain * Hands\-on work with RAG systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation * Familiarity with LLM evaluation practice — LLM\-as\-judge, rubric\-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each * Experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, DVC) * Exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (Gymnasium, Stable\-Baselines3, CleanRL) or to preference\-based post\-training methods (DPO, GRPO) * Experience with agentic workflows, tool\-calling, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Work with non\-natural\-image modalities: RF, radar, SAR, audio, time series, or multimodal data * Containerization (Docker) and experience running jobs on GPU clusters or cloud compute * Master's degree in a related technical discipline **What Sets Us Apart?** SRC, Inc., a not\-for\-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. Across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. When you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep America and its allies safe and strong. You’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. You’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support. Total compensation for this role is market competitive. The anticipated salary range for this position based out of Dayton, OH is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. SRC offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

jobs.title: 2027 Spring Co op Biologics Design and AI Cambridge MA
jobs.description: **Job Title:** *2027 Spring Co\-op Biologics Design and AI* * **Grade:** *Co\-op* * **Location:** *Cambridge, MA* * **Duration:** *6 months* **About the Job** Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated **Spring Co\-op** to join our **Biologics Design and AI team**. Sanofi is seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Data Scientist Spring Co\-op to join our Biologics and Design AI team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of a highly innovative project: bridging the world of Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents with biophysical protein predictive models. Biologics like antibodies and nanobodies are highly effective therapies but optimizing them is a complex challenge. You will closely work with computational biologists and AI scientists to build intelligent, agentic workflows that can reason over structural data, orchestrate predictive tools, and map protein sequences to critical therapeutic properties, ultimately accelerating our biologics pipeline. Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams. **About Sanofi** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. **Main Responsibilities** * **LLM Fine\-Tuning \& Cross\-Modal Adaptation:** Fine\-tune conversational, natural language LLMs to directly interface with and reason over data from specialized protein prediction models. Using parameter\-efficient techniques (e.g., LoRA, PEFT), you will adapt these human\-language models to comprehend protein sequences, structural embeddings, and biophysical constraints. By bridging the gap between human\-like generative AI reasoning and rigorous structural biology, you will build hybrid architectures designed to significantly enhance the accuracy of critical antibody and nanobody property predictions, such as binding affinity and thermal stability. * **Collaboration \& Reporting:** Partner closely with experimental protein engineers and computational biologists to understand biological constraints, define the agent's objectives, and validate model predictions, ultimately presenting your methodologies, insights, and model performance to cross\-functional R\&D teams at the conclusion of the spring term. **About you** **Basic Qualifications:** * Currently pursuing a Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Bioengineering, or related field with plans to graduate by Spring 2027 (or 2028\). * Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H\-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the Internal requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long\-term status that does not require company sponsorship. * Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co\-op/internship. * Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday to Friday for the full duration of the co\-op/internship. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Previous academic projects or industry experience demonstrating the application of NLP, LLMs, or agentic workflows to complex, ideally scientific, problems. * Familiarity with biological data, specifically protein sequences and 3D structures. * Basic domain knowledge in immunology, structural biology, or biophysics. * Strong programming skills in **Python** and standard data science libraries. * Hands\-on experience with LLM fine\-tuning methodologies and orchestration frameworks. * Experience with deep learning frameworks such as **PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX**. * Experience using state\-of\-the\-art AI tools for biology (e.g., Protein LLMs, AlphaFold, Rosetta). * Excellent problem\-solving communication skills, with a passion for working at the intersection of generative AI and healthcare. * Fluent in English. **Why Choose Us** * Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team. * Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you. * Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare. Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve. * **Compensation** The salary range for this position is **$47 \- $60** hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. \#LI\-Onsite \#vhd

jobs.title: SAP Developer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled SAP Developer to join our innovative technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SAP\-based solutions that drive operational excellence and business growth. Your expertise will help optimize enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, streamline processes, and support digital transformation initiatives. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies and contribute to impactful projects in a fast\-paced environment. **Duties** * Develop, customize, and implement SAP modules to meet specific business requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze system needs, and translate them into scalable SAP solutions. * Design and develop APIs, web services, and interfaces using RESTful API standards to facilitate communication between SAP and other enterprise applications. * Maintain and enhance backend systems by writing efficient code in languages such as ABAP (Advanced Business Application Programming), Java, C\#, and JavaScript. * Conduct system design activities utilizing UML diagrams to visualize architecture and workflows for scalable system development. * Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure high\-quality deliverables while adhering to SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) best practices. * Implement CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and deployment using tools like GitHub, TFS (Team Foundation Server), or Jenkins to accelerate development cycles. * Support cloud infrastructure deployment on platforms such as AWS or Azure, ensuring robust security and scalability for enterprise applications. * Develop front\-end UI components with frameworks like React, Angular, or Bootstrap to create intuitive user experiences aligned with modern web development standards. * Engage in Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to promote iterative progress and team collaboration. **Experience** * Proven experience in SAP development roles with a strong understanding of SAP modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, or HANA. * Extensive knowledge of application design principles including system architecture, distributed systems, microservices architecture, and system design for scalability. * Hands\-on experience with front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Angular, and Bootstrap for UI development. * Proficiency in backend development using.NET (C\#), Java EE/Spring Boot, Python or Ruby on Rails for developing robust server\-side applications. * Strong understanding of relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle PL/SQL; experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB is a plus. * Familiarity with version control systems including GitHub, SVN (Subversion), TFS (Team Foundation Server), supporting collaborative code management. * Knowledge of software engineering best practices including UML modeling, application design patterns (OOP), unit testing frameworks, and debugging techniques. * Experience working within Agile environments utilizing tools like Jira or Azure DevOps to manage project workflows efficiently. * Ability to design RESTful APIs and web services using SOAP/WCF protocols for secure data exchange across distributed systems. * Exposure to cloud infrastructure management on platforms such as AWS or Azure for deploying scalable enterprise solutions. Join us if you're passionate about leveraging your SAP expertise combined with modern web technologies to create innovative solutions that transform business operations! Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote
