Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support automated deployment of infrastructure. * Lead pre\-production readiness efforts, POCs, lab testing and knowledge transfer. Provide architectural design diagrams and documentation and assess how to implement technologies into the existing infrastructure. * Provide expertise in VMware virtualization technologies, including vSphere and vCenter. * Act as a subject matter expert for Cloud Infrastructure Architecture and Cloud Adoption Frameworks, Well\-Architected Framework as it relates to compute, network, storage, and native SaaS/PaaS offerings. * Maintain overall industry knowledge on the latest trends and technology and demonstrate forward thinking around how technology can support the organizational direction. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a computer related field or equivalent training and experience with at least 5 years of related experience. * Strong experience with adoption of CAF (Cloud Adoption Framework), adhering to principles of WAF (Well Architecture Framework) and demonstrated ability of Migrating applications to cloud using AMPP and other methodologies. * Ability to design and manage Azure based and hybrid networking solutions across multiple sites, locations, subscriptions, and virtual networks. * Ability to design and manage Microsoft 365 \& collaboration Infrastructure \- Exchange Online, MS Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint Online, Intune, \& other Office 365 services. * Expert in Azure governance, Express Route, Site Recovery, S2S VPN devices, Azure Monitor, RBAC, virtual network and subscription peering. * Ability to create scripts in PowerShell, VBS, Python, Ansible and similar languages. * Infrastructure automation through Terraform, Ansible, Python, source control tools (GIT/GitHub/GitLab), Serverless Functions * Working level knowledge of, networking, virtualization, SAN, and related technologies. * Deep understanding of Active Directory architecture, Sites \& Services, DNS, DHCP, and cloud services integration **A solid understanding of most of the following** * Networking \- WAF (Web Application Firewall), NSGs (Network Security Groups), Azure Firewall, Azure DNS, Hybrid DNS. * Identity and access \- Azure Key Vault, Managed Identities, RBAC * Entra ID \- Managed Identities, PIM, Service Principals * IAM – users/groups/service accounts and their differences * Azure Governance and Compliance – Cloud Adoption Framework and Well\-Architected Framework * Data – Data Lake, Data factory and Blob storage * Containers \- Docker and Kubernetes * To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. We are hiring a Security Incident Response Engineer to join our Incident Response team. You will help redefine how incidents are handled at scale, pairing autonomous AI agents with human judgment so that we can detect, investigate, and contain threats faster across a rapidly growing cloud and AI footprint. **AS A SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:** -------------------------------------------------------------------- * Join a high\-impact team of security experts to scale security at one of the fastest\-growing software companies ever * Spearhead an agentic approach to Incident Response by deploying, guiding, and refining autonomous AI agents that execute initial triage, context gathering, and rapid investigation alongside human Incident Commanders * Handle escalations, lead security investigations, and act as Incident Commander for critical incidents * Build scripts, automation pipelines, and agentic workflows that continuously enhance Snowflake's incident response capabilities * Partner closely with our Threat Detection, Automation, Product Security, Legal, HR, Cloud, and Data teams * Create and improve detections, threat signatures, and guardrails for both traditional and AI\-driven attack vectors * Participate in a periodic on\-call rotation, which may involve non\-traditional working hours **OUR IDEAL SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:** ------------------------------------------------------------ * 2\+ years of relevant experience in incident response or security operations preferred * Strong experience in incident response, security investigations, and running incidents as the Incident Commander * Advanced experience using security stack capabilities (EDR, SIEM, SOAR, DLP) across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS, and cloud workloads * Deep familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, security copilots, and AI\-driven telemetry to accelerate investigations, threat triage, and post\-incident reporting * Knowledge of securing frontier AI infrastructure, including model training and serving pipelines and AI agent permissions * Proven ability to detect and respond to modern AI\-driven attacks * Proficiency in Python to build automated orchestration pipelines, reduce manual incident response toil, and programmatically enrich security alerts * Expert\-level understanding of cloud security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container runtime isolation (Docker, Kubernetes) * Ability to translate incident findings and root\-cause analysis into short\-term tactical fixes and long\-term security engineering objectives * Ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis using sandbox environments and modern AI\-assisted reverse engineering tools **BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:** ----------------------------------- * Experience with threat hunting or building detection\-as\-code programs * Experience running sensitive investigations alongside Legal and HR, such as insider risk cases * Familiarity with large\-scale data platforms and using them to analyze security telemetry * Contributions to open\-source security tooling, detection rules, or the broader security community * Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, or GREM **WHY JOIN OUR INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?** ----------------------------------------------------- This is an opportunity to shape what incident response looks like in the agentic era. You will work on the front line of defending one of the world's most important data platforms, building the AI\-driven workflows that let a team of experts respond with the speed and precision that modern threats demand. You will work across Detection, Product Security, Cloud, Legal, and HR, see incidents end to end, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to how Snowflake protects its customers and its people. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $143,000 \- $205,800\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer (Contractor)
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Position Summary** -------------------- We are seeking a mid\-level ServiceNow Developer to support and enhance our global ServiceNow platform. You will contribute to operational support, platform development, integrations, maintenance, and documentation while working with experienced developers, architects, and business partners. The level of responsibility will be aligned with the successful candidate's demonstrated skills and experience. Mid\-level developers will be expected to complete routine assignments with greater independence. This position offers opportunities to expand your ServiceNow expertise through hands\-on development, code and design reviews, and platform initiatives. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Operational Support** * Support queue management, incident investigation and mitigation, request fulfillment, and routine platform maintenance. * Monitor platform health, logs, scheduled jobs, and integrations; investigate issues and coordinate with dependent teams when necessary. * Document issues, findings, resolutions, and follow\-up actions. * Participate in agile team activities, including stand\-ups and planning. * Manage incident response during regular working hours and engage with global colleagues for handovers as needed. ### **Integration Development and Support** * Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using technologies such as IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST or SOAP APIs, and MID Servers. * Monitor and troubleshoot existing integrations and implement fixes appropriate to your experience level. * Participate in integration testing, validation, error handling, and reconciliation to support accurate and reliable data exchange. * Apply approved authentication, credential\-management, security, and data\-handling practices. ### **Platform Development and Engineering** * Configure, develop, test, and enhance ServiceNow solutions using components such as Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Transform Maps, Import Sets, and Flows. * Support platform upgrades, patches, clones, releases, and routine maintenance. * Create maintainable solutions that follow established development, security, testing, and accessibility standards. * Participate in peer reviews and address feedback before deployment. * Help identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, usability, and support processes. ### **Collaboration and Professional Development** * Work with developers, architects, product owners, administrators, and teams such as ITSM, HRIS, ITOM, Security, and external vendors. * Translate clearly defined business requirements into technical solutions, seeking guidance when requirements or risks are unclear. * Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Develop knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, APIs, authentication, data management, and secure development practices. ### **Documentation and Governance** * Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration mappings, process flows, support procedures, and runbooks. * Ensure work complies with applicable governance, change\-management, security, privacy, and data\-protection requirements. * Contribute reusable guidance and resolved issues to team wiki/confluence spaces. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Applicants should meet most of the following qualifications: * Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience with ServiceNow, another enterprise workflow platform, or a combination of related education, training, and practical experience. * Working knowledge of ServiceNow configuration and development concepts. * Experience with ITSM processes such as Incident, Change, Problem, or Request Management. * Experience with JavaScript or a comparable scripting language. ServiceNow\-specific scripting and Glide API experience may be developed in the role. * Foundational understanding of REST APIs, web services, authentication, and data integrations. * Ability to investigate technical issues, document findings, and communicate when assistance is needed. * Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues. * ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification, or willingness to obtain it. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- The following qualifications are helpful but not required. We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet every preferred qualification. * Experience with IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST or SOAP integrations, or MID Servers. * Familiarity with CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, Hardware Asset Management, or Software Asset Management. * Exposure to source control, automated testing, CI/CD, or ServiceNow Automated Test Framework. * Experience with Platform Analytics or Performance Analytics. * Familiarity with capabilities such as Virtual Agent, AI Search, or Now Assist. * ServiceNow certifications such as Certified Application Developer or relevant implementation specialist credentials. **Skills and Working Approach** ------------------------------- * Communicates progress, risks, questions, and technical information clearly. * Accepts and applies constructive feedback. * Organizes assigned work and follows through on agreed commitments. * Works collaboratively and respectfully with colleagues from different roles and backgrounds. * Balances independent problem\-solving with timely escalation. * Demonstrates interest in continued technical and professional development. Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: IT Network Engineer - Memphis
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** SpaceXSI is looking for an experienced network engineer with expertise in networking technologies that support routing, switching, dynamic multicast, Wi\-Fi, network access control, automation, etc. This position will be directly involved with supporting and expanding our campus and data center infrastructure as well as our expansive wireless network using reliable and redundant design standards. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead the design, implementation, and troubleshooting of large\-scale, complex wired and wireless networks. * Configure, install, and support campus and data center networks. * Troubleshoot wired/wireless networking\-related issues. * Support the deployment of network access control (NAC) using 802\.1X. * Develop and enforce network policies and standards. * Plan and prepare project roadmaps. * Develop network automation tools to support our enterprise network. * Monitor network health using in\-house and third\-party tools. * Create and maintain proper documentation of our networks. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 2\+ years of professional network engineering experience; OR 5\+ years of professional network engineering experience in lieu of a degree. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Expert understanding of the OSI model and network standards. * Cisco Catalyst, Juniper, and Arista data center\-class switches. * Cisco wireless LAN controllers or other wireless technologies. * Network Access Control (NAC) using 802\.1X. * Wave Division Multiplexing and Fiber Optics. * DNS, DHCP, SNMP, IP helpers, ARP, CDP, LLDP. * BGP routing. * Switch port security features. * Network monitoring tools. * Network documentation. * Linux/Windows system administration. * Experience with Python scripting. * Industry\-standard certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or JNCIE. ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed. * This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered. * Must have a valid driver's license. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform (Mid-Senior Level)
jobs.description: ### **About Sprinter Health** **At Sprinter Health, our mission is reimagining how people access care by bringing it directly to their homes.** Nearly 30% of patients in the U.S. skip preventive or chronic care simply because they can’t get to a doctor’s office. For many, the ER becomes their first touchpoint with the healthcare system, driving over **$300B in avoidable costs every year.** By using the same technologies that power leading marketplace and last\-mile platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most. So far, we’ve supported more than **2 million patients across 22 states, completed 130,000\+ in\-home visits, and maintained a 92 NPS**. Our team of clinicians, technologists, and operators have raised over $125M to date from investors like **a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel** and enjoy multi\-year runway. ### **About the Role** We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (5\+ years experience) who is passionate about platform engineering and wants to build the foundational systems that enable our engineering organization to scale. At Sprinter, you'll build the infrastructure, internal tooling, and shared services that help engineers develop, deploy, and operate software more efficiently. From improving CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure to building developer tools, automation, and observability systems, you'll own the platforms that make our engineering teams faster, more reliable, and more effective. This is a hands\-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code but is most motivated by improving how other engineers build software. You'll work across application code, infrastructure, and operational systems, solving complex technical challenges that have an outsized impact across the organization. ### **Hybrid \& Office Experience** We operate on a hybrid schedule, working from the office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays designated as work\-from\-anywhere days. We care deeply about work\-life balance and are happy to provide flexibility when life happens. We ask that employees be in the office Monday through Thursday to collaborate with their teams while maintaining flexibility where it matters most. Lunch is provided every day, and the entire team takes an hour to eat together. It's one of the ways we stay connected outside of meetings. You'll usually find us playing a board game before getting back to work. ### **What you will do:** * Design and build internal tools, shared services, and automation that improve developer productivity across engineering teams * Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and infrastructure that enable engineers to ship software quickly and reliably * Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure, developer environments, and foundational services that support our growing platform * Improve observability, monitoring, and operational tooling to make our systems easier to debug, maintain, and operate * Develop reusable frameworks, infrastructure components, and self\-service tooling that reduce manual work and accelerate development * Partner closely with engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, improve development workflows, and drive adoption of platform capabilities * Own foundational engineering projects end to end, making pragmatic architectural decisions that balance reliability, scalability, and developer experience ### **What you have done:** * Spent 5\+ years building and scaling backend software, infrastructure, or platform systems in production * Built internal developer tools, automation, shared services, or infrastructure that support multiple engineering teams * Worked hands\-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment systems, and production environments * Designed and implemented reliable, maintainable software that improves how other engineers build, test, deploy, or operate applications * Led technical projects end to end, from architecture and implementation through rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance * Collaborated across engineering teams to understand developer pain points and translate them into scalable technical solutions * Made technical decisions that balance developer productivity, operational reliability, and long\-term maintainability ### **What gives you an edge:** * You've deliberately built your career around platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, or developer productivity * You've built internal platforms, CLIs, frameworks, or self\-service tooling adopted by multiple engineering teams * You've improved engineering velocity through faster deployments, more reliable CI/CD pipelines, or reduced operational overhead * You've worked extensively with AWS, serverless architectures, infrastructure as code, or cloud\-native systems * You've implemented observability, monitoring, or incident management tooling that improved production reliability * You've worked in mid\- or growth\-stage startups (Series A–C) where infrastructure and developer tooling needed to evolve alongside rapid product development * You've measured the success of your work through developer adoption, deployment frequency, system reliability, or improvements in engineering efficiency ### **The Interview Process** **We aim to complete the interview process between 2–3 weeks. It will usually consist of:** * Recruiter Screen (30 Minutes) * Technical Assessment (45 Minutes) * Hiring Manager Introduction (30 Minutes) * Onsite Interview: Systems Design \+ Behavioral Interview \+ Lunch with the Team (3 Hours) * References ### **What we offer** * Meaningful pre\-IPO equity * Medical, dental, and vision plans 100% paid for you and your dependents * Flexible PTO \+ 10 paid holidays per year * 401(k) with match * 16\-week parental leave policy for birthing parent, 8 weeks for all other parents * HSA \+ FSA contributions * Life insurance, plus short and long\-term disability coverage * Free daily lunch in\-office * Annual learning stipend ### **Our Technology Stack** * Serverless AWS (AppSync, DynamoDB, Lambda, Amplify, CloudFormation, Node) * React Native, React Native for Web * GraphQL * TypeScript * JavaScript * Node.js Sprinter Health is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other protected classes. *Beware of recruitment fraud and scams that involve fictitious job descriptions followed by false job offers.* *If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles on our official**Sprinter Health Careers website**. All legitimate job postings will require an application to be made directly through our official careers website. Job\-related communications will only be sent from email addresses ending in @**sprinterhealth.com**. Please ensure that you're only replying to emails that end in @**sprinterhealth.com**.* Compensation Range: $175K \- $225K

jobs.title: CMS User Training Instructor
jobs.description: **About the Role** SCC is seeking experienced adult\-learning instructors to deliver instructor\-led user training to U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) personnel and external users as USACE replaces its Resident Management System (RMS) with the new Construction Management Platform (CMP). Instructors will teach engineering, construction, project management, and support staff, as well as external construction contractors, to navigate the CMP, use its applications, and apply it in their roles to deliver construction.**Responsibilities*** Complete Train\-the\-Trainer training (up to 40 hours plus approximately 2 hours of USACE contextual training), held in person at the USACE Kansas City District the week of December 14, 2026 or the week of January 11, 2027\. * Deliver CMP user training covering system navigation, data entry, reporting functions, and best practices, in person (3\-day, 24\-hour Construction Manager sessions) and virtually through Microsoft Teams (2\- to 24\-hour sessions for user groups including leadership, construction managers, project managers, engineers, and external construction contractors). * Teach from Government\-provided facilitator guides and materials, pulling the latest version before each session, and recommend updates where content is out of date or hard for trainees to follow. * Facilitate practical exercises, simulations, and case studies using engaging methods suited to a variety of learning styles; deliver training that meets Section 508 and WCAG 2\.1 AA standards. * Complete pre\-training checklists (audio\-visual, Microsoft Office, and CMP training environment checks). * Collect daily attendance records and submit them within 2 business days; provide weekly written feedback on sessions; participate in up to 5 short quality meetings. **Required Qualifications** Professional certifications to facilitate adult learning (e.g., Certified Professional in Training Management (CPTM), Certified Professional in Training Development (CPTD), or equivalent certification demonstrating competency to perform as an instructor) and a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in delivering effective training**OR** A minimum of 5 years of experience in adult training facilitation and a proven track record of delivering effective training, demonstrable through documented training evaluations.**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience training users on new software platforms * U.S. Army Corps of Engineers experience * Experience with construction management software or construction management projects * Adult education experience * Construction engineering experience **Additional Requirements*** Willingness to travel to USACE locations in and outside the continental U.S.; travel expenses reimbursed in accordance with the Joint Travel Regulations. * Provide your own computer; secure internet of at least 25 Mbps; a 1080p webcam; a noise\-cancelling microphone; and reliable screen sharing. * Complete DoD Level I Antiterrorism Awareness Training (online) and provide the certificate; complete up to 1 hour of cultural sensitivity training for assignments outside the U.S. * Maintain an average student satisfaction rating of at least 3\.5 out of 5\.0 per session. * Provide documentation of certifications and/or training evaluations; final instructor selection is subject to client approval.

What’s needed\- Basic Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or a related technical role. * 3\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale applications, integrations, APIs, or cloud solutions. * Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, integration patterns, and distributed systems. * Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud environments. * Experience leading cross\-functional technical initiatives and influencing architecture decisions. What’s needed\- Preferred Qualifications: * Master’s degree in a technology\- or business\-related field. * 10\+ years of architecture, engineering, or enterprise technology experience. * Experience supporting customer service, customer experience, CRM, contact center, or digital engagement platforms. * Experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, NICE, Genesys, Amazon Connect, or similar platforms. * Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation architectures, conversational AI, or intelligent automation solutions. * Relevant cloud, architecture, security, or technology certifications. We Offer: * Inclusive culture with associate\-led Business Resource Groups * 22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays \+ 1 floating holiday) * Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more! jobs.title: Infrastructure and Network Engineer
jobs.description: **State Bar of Wisconsin is seeking an Infrastructure and Network Engineer (hybrid position)** The State Bar of Wisconsin is in search of an experienced Infrastructure and Network Engineer to support and maintain our network, servers, virtualization environment, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, self\-starter who can complete projects and tasks with little day\-to\-day direction. We are looking for someone who will thrive in a small IT shop, loves to learn, and will take ownership and get it done. This person will also value excellent customer service and collaboration equally with technical elegance and skill. \*Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Relocation assistance is not available. **Who We Are** The State Bar of Wisconsin is a professional association, created by the Wisconsin Supreme Court, for all attorneys who hold a Wisconsin law license. With more than 25,000 members, the State Bar exists to serve its members and the public by promoting the law and access to justice. We aid the courts in improving the administration of justice, provide continuing legal education and other services for our members, support the education of law students, and educate the public about the legal system. The State Bar of Wisconsin also provides public services \-\- such as attorney referrals and public education – and supports programs that provide reduced\-fee legal assistance for low\-income state residents. **What You Will Love** * The people, the culture and the flexible work environment! We care about our people, our work, and our members. We value work/life balance and offer excellent benefits and flexibility to support our employees and their families. Once trained, this position is eligible to work from home up to 3 days per week while working in the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. * Working with a mission\-driven organization that acts with integrity, promotes justice, and works toward a fair and just legal system. * Variety in your job! You’ll have the opportunity to work with a variety of technologies and tools to lay the foundation for the future. * Working with a collaborative, small IT team where you will be challenged and have autonomy to make impactful decisions. No two days will be the same and you will thrive in a dynamic, changing environment. **What You Will Do** * Support and maintain Microsoft Hyper\-V and SCVMM, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure. * Support Cisco switching, wireless, VLANs, VPN, routing, and network connectivity. * Monitor and troubleshoot network, server, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure issues. * Support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, MFA, and identity services. * Assist with Cisco security technologies, including ISE and Umbrella, and support F5 application delivery and security infrastructure. * Perform system maintenance, patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure lifecycle activities. * Assist with cybersecurity monitoring, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, and incident response. * Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery systems and testing. * Provide Tier 2 technical support for escalated infrastructure, network, authentication, and security issues. * Maintain network diagrams, system documentation, configurations, and technical procedures. * Participate in infrastructure, cloud, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity projects. * Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and managed service providers. **What We Are Looking For** * Two\-year degree in computer science or equivalent work experience in network administration. Bachelor’s degree preferred. * 3–5 years of experience in network administration, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related IT role. * Experience supporting Windows Server and Active Directory. * Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and wireless networking. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Experience with Hyper\-V, VMware, or another enterprise virtualization platform. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity and endpoint security fundamentals. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience in gathering and analyzing business requirements * Project management experience * Experience with any of the following is beneficial but not required: Microsoft Hyper\-V, SCVMM, Intune, Cisco Networking, Cisco ISE, Cisco Umbrella, F5, Enterprise Storage and Backup/Disaster Recovery, HPE Servers * Relevant certifications such as CCNA, Microsoft, CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, or similar are a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** The State Bar of Wisconsin offers competitive compensation with annual merit increases and excellent benefits including: * 3 weeks of paid vacation per year * 2 weeks of paid sick time per year * Excellent and low\-cost health and dental insurance * Fully paid life and long\-term disability insurance * 2 weeks paid parental leave * 10 paid holidays plus 2 personal days * Hybrid work schedules and flexibility * 8% 401(k) contribution!! * The State Bar is also a “qualified employer” for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **How To Apply** To apply, visit www.wisbar.org/careers to upload your resume and cover letter. This position will be posted until it is filled but priority will be given to applicants who submit early, so don’t wait. Apply today! **The State Bar of Wisconsin is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a fair, merit\-based hiring process. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds and seek to create a supportive, welcoming environment for all. Candidates who share these values are encouraged to apply.** Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * What are your salary requirements? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Madison, WI 53718

jobs.title: Staff ML Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a \#1 team and do some good!**HYBRID:** Qualified candidates must live or relocate within a 180\-mile radius of a hub location listed below and should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Bloomington, IL; Dunwoody, GA; Richardson, TX; or Tempe, AZ**SPONSORSHIP: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity** Responsibilities: We are seeking a hands\-on Staff Machine Learning Engineer to architect, build, and scale enterprise\-grade AI/ML systems, real\-time decisioning capabilities, and agentic AI applications. This role will help develop our next\-generation Next Best Action (NBA) and recommendation platform, leveraging Databricks, AWS, and modern AI/ML technologies. The focus is on ML systems engineering, architecture, and productionization rather than developing predictive models from scratch.* ML Architecture \& Engineering: Design and build scalable, production\-grade ML systems, APIs, feature pipelines, and reusable engineering components. * Decisioning \& Recommendation Engines: Architect real\-time or near\-real\-time decisioning systems integrating predictive models, business rules, eligibility, prioritization, and optimization. * Closed\-Loop Learning: Build feedback mechanisms that capture customer interactions and business outcomes to continuously improve recommendations. * Databricks \& AWS Engineering: Develop reliable data and ML pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, Databricks, and AWS. * MLOps: Implement model deployment, serving, versioning, monitoring, CI/CD, and retraining workflows. * Agentic AI: Architect and develop production\-grade agentic AI applications, including LLM orchestration, tool integration, evaluation, and guardrails. * Technical Leadership: Lead architecture decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and collaborate across technical and business teams. Qualifications: Required* 10\+ years of experience in ML engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines, with demonstrated technical leadership. * Programming: Expert\-level Python and strong SQL skills; experience with APIs, microservices, and production software development. * Data Engineering: Expert\-level PySpark and Apache Spark; experience building reliable data and feature pipelines. * Cloud \& ML Platforms: Deep hands\-on Databricks expertise (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) and strong AWS experience (S3, IAM, compute, and application integration). * ML Engineering \& MLOps: Experience supporting the full production ML lifecycle, including model integration, deployment, serving, monitoring, versioning, and retraining. Familiarity with MLflow and CI/CD. * Real\-Time Decisioning: Experience building low\-latency inference services, decisioning APIs, and scalable recommendation systems. * Agentic AI: Hands\-on experience developing LLM\-powered or agentic AI applications, including orchestration, tool calling, and enterprise integrations. * System Architecture: Proven ability to independently architect and deliver complex, reliable enterprise systems. Preferred* Hands\-on experience developing or training ML models. * Experience building Next Best Action, recommendation, personalization, or decision optimization platforms. * Familiarity with contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, uplift modeling, or ranking algorithms. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar agentic AI frameworks. * Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $150,000 \- $198,000 (Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience. High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience.) * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives. The role Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to own AI features end to end: Learn the work from the people who do it, build the system, measure it, ship it, and run it in production. The systems you will work on read and file documents, pull facts from medical records and police reports, answer questions across a case's full history, and run agents that chase records and draft routine work for staff to approve. You will report to the Lead AI Engineer, who sets the architecture and build plan; you own delivery within it. This is an individual\-contributor seat for someone who drives work forward with urgency and high quality without waiting to be told how, and whose work reaches case teams within weeks, not quarters. Responsibilities * Build: Ship production AI features, including structured extraction, classification and routing, case search, and agents that act with a person approving the result. * Integrate: Connect those features to the firm's systems (e.g., Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft Graph for Outlook and SharePoint, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, DocuSign). * Measure: Build the evaluation sets and tests for your features so every model or prompt change is measured on facts captured, facts missed, wrong answers, cost, and speed before it ships. * Run: Deploy your services as containers on Azure, monitor them, and fix them when they break. * Learn and train: Sit with intake, case management, records, and litigation staff before automating their work, and train them on what you ship. * Document: Write each system down so anyone on the team can run it. Qualifications Required: * Experience: 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-powered features to real users. * Ownership: A record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped outcomes with little supervision, and of finishing what you start. * LLM craft: Hands\-on work with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) spanning prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluation. * Stack: Strong Python or TypeScript/Node (both preferred), SQL and Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Git, Docker, and cloud deployment (Azure preferred). * Communication: Care with sensitive data and the ability to explain technical work in plain language. Preferred: * Models and tooling: Vector search (e.g., pgvector), evaluation frameworks, and agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol. * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: APIs and SOQL; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI or telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Documents and industry: OCR and document processing; legal, insurance, or healthcare data Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law. Stay safe: We will never ask for payment or banking information during the hiring process. Questions? Contact careers@sweetjames.com

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity. **The Role: Senior Network Security Engineer** ---------------------------------------------- The Senior Network Security Engineer designs and implements complex network security solutions that protect Switch's critical infrastructure. This role leads technical initiatives, evaluates emerging technologies, establishes engineering standards, and improves the security, resiliency, and scalability of Switch's network environments. You will serve as a senior technical resource and subject matter expert, partnering across teams to solve complex network security challenges and expand automation. You will also mentor engineers, provide advanced escalation support, and participate in the network security on\-call rotation. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead complex network security engineering projects from technical evaluation and architecture through implementation. * Design and implement network security solutions aligned with Switch security and infrastructure requirements. * Assess existing network architectures and recommend improvements to security, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. * Design enterprise network segmentation strategies, including macro\- and micro\-segmentation. * Design and deploy Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall architectures. * Establish standards and best practices for network security device deployment, configuration, maintenance, and lifecycle management. * Evaluate emerging technologies, products, and industry practices and recommend solutions based on technical fit, risk, scalability, and cost. * Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations for new network security capabilities. * Conduct network security assessments, prioritize identified risks, and lead remediation efforts. * Implement and maintain intrusion prevention and advanced threat prevention technologies. * Develop and expand network automation using Infrastructure\-as\-Code, APIs, programming, and other automation frameworks. * Establish standards for network architecture, engineering, configuration, and project documentation. * Develop and maintain network security policies, standards, and procedures. * Collaborate across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and other teams on complex technical initiatives. * Serve as a senior escalation point and technical resource for Network Engineer I, II, and III team members. * Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. * Develop technical documentation and training materials that strengthen engineering capabilities across the team. * Maintain software and security updates across network security devices and platforms. * Provide advanced troubleshooting and incident escalation support. * Participate in the network security on\-call rotation. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * You lead complex technical initiatives with clear ownership from architecture through implementation. * You evaluate solutions across security, reliability, scalability, performance, operational impact, and cost. * You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * You identify security and operational risks early and develop practical solutions. * You work independently while building strong partnerships across technical teams. * You troubleshoot complex issues methodically and follow them through resolution. * You establish standards that improve consistency, security, and operational reliability. * You share technical knowledge and help other engineers develop their capabilities. * You look for practical opportunities to reduce manual work through automation. * You stay current with emerging technologies and apply them when they solve a clear business or technical need. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of network engineering experience, or 4\+ years of relevant experience with a CCIE\-level certification. * 6\+ years of experience implementing advanced network security projects and solutions. * 2\+ years of experience implementing network automation. * Deep understanding of network segmentation architectures and technologies. * Advanced experience designing, deploying, and managing Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall environments. *   prevention and advanced threat prevention technologies. * Experience with application tunneling and reverse proxy technologies. * Working knowledge of encryption protocols and security controllers. * Experience with Python or another programming language used for network engineering and automation. * Experience with source control systems and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience working with APIs and system integrations. * Working knowledge of Linux. * Experience with Cisco IOS\-XE and NX\-OS. * Experience with VPN and tunneling technologies and protocols. * Experience analyzing packet captures and network device logs. * Experience securing network data, control, and management planes. * Experience with authentication, authorization, and accounting protocols and applications. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with VMware NSX Gateway and Distributed Firewall technologies. * Experience with Cisco ISE and 802\.1X. * Experience with Cisco Cyber Vision. * Experience with Cloudflare proxy technologies. * Experience with enterprise load balancing technologies. * CCNP certification. * Cisco DevNet certification. We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply. ### **Why Switch?** * A Culture of Karma – We are self\-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward\-thinking environment. * Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development. * Flexibility \& Remote Opportunities – Whether in\-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive. * Career Stability \& Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities \& advancement in a stable, growing company. * Generous Benefits Package \- Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more! ### **Join Us \& Make a Difference** This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you. Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together. **Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice** Your privacy rights may vary by location. Learn more in our Switch Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.switch.com/applicant\-and\-candidate\-privacy/ to understand how Switch collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information during the recruiting process. **Safe Hiring Notice** Legitimate Switch recruiting emails come from switch.com. Current opportunities are posted on https://switch.com/careers and the official Switch LinkedIn Company page https://www.linkedin.com/company/switch\-data\-centers/. Switch will never ask you to pay fees, purchase equipment, send money, cash a check, or transfer funds as part of recruiting. Personal information is collected only through approved Switch systems. If you suspect recruiting fraud, stop communicating with the sender and review FTC guidance https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/what\-do\-if\-you\-were\-scammed. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Switch is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **Accommodations** Switch provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, contact careers@switch.com. Switch also considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable law. **Recruitment Agencies** Switch does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies without a current written agreement. Switch is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited submissions.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Systems Test and Software Quality Assurance
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** We are looking for a Senior Manager, Systems Test and Software Quality Assurance to join our Software Quality Assurance team within our Software Engineering organization. Your job will be to build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of senior system test and software quality engineers while driving the overarching software quality assurance vision. You will establish modern verification standards, quality gates, and compliance across multi\-tiered software, hardware, and distributed automation platforms. **What we do** The Software Quality Assurance team is part of the Software Engineering organization and is responsible for validating complex, multi\-system robotic solutions under realistic customer and site operating conditions. The team partners across Software Engineering, DevOps, Systems Architecture, and Site Operations/Customer Engineering to institutionalize quality\-first engineering practices, strengthen release readiness, and ensure seamless site acceptance. **What you'll do** * Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of senior system test and software quality engineers, driving technical excellence, clear career progression, continuous learning, and high accountability. * Contribute to formulating and drive the overarching software quality assurance vision, establishing modern verification standards, quality gates, and compliance across multi\-tiered software, hardware, and distributed automation platforms. * Architect and oversee realistic, site\-level customer simulation environments to benchmark system scale, stress limits, peak throughput, latency, availability, bottlenecks, and error budgets. * Embed automated test frameworks, harnesses, emulators, and AI\-assisted tooling into CI/CD pipelines, configuration management tools, and cloud/on\-prem environments to enable continuous performance and regression testing. * Oversee comprehensive end\-to\-end test programs spanning microservices, event\-driven messaging architectures, API layers, multi\-system integrations, and joint System Integration Testing with customer stakeholders. * Decompose complex system roadmaps into phased subsystem test plans, manage execution timelines and dependencies, and direct Release Readiness testing using key customer and site deployment scenarios. * Partner across Software Engineering, DevOps, Systems Architecture, and Site Operations/Customer Engineering to assess risk, accelerate defect resolution, and maintain rapid feedback loops. Travel to Symbotic production sites may be required up to 10%. **What you'll need** * Minimum of 12 years of progressive quality assurance or test engineering experience, with a proven track record of directly managing, mentoring, and scaling a team of senior engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Experience leading customer\-facing System Integration Testing and architecting realistic site\-level simulation environments for complex operational workloads, stress limits, and peak throughput. * Expertise establishing and analyzing operational KPIs, including transaction throughput, end\-to\-end latency, error budgets, resource utilization, SLA/SLO performance, and data\-driven release readiness gates. * Deep technical background validating distributed systems, microservices, Service\-Oriented Architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous messaging brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AMQP. * Hands\-on experience integrating test frameworks, emulators, and virtualized test harnesses into CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure\-as\-Code environments, including Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Terraform, and Ansible. * Proficiency with basic SQL and comprehensive knowledge of Black Box, Backend/API, Regression, Integration, End\-to\-End, Load/Stress, Scale, and User Acceptance Testing; practical experience with AI\-assisted QA tooling is preferred. **Our Environment** * Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. \#LI\-JS1 \#LI\-Hybrid **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $175,500\.00 \- $257,400\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployment Technician** Milwaukee, WI (home\-based, with frequent US travel) **About the role** Technova Industries is a startup building Nova Vision, an AI\-powered vision automation platform for supply chain operations. As our Forward Deployment Technician, you’ll take each deployment from the first technical call to a working system the customer can use. You’ll get the hardware wired, networked and running at the customer’s facility, and stay with it until it works. Our founders and engineering team handle the software and AI. You handle the field. **Location and travel** You’ll live in the Milwaukee area. Expect regular travel to customer sites across the US, often on short notice. Travel expenses are covered. **What you’ll do** *Project design and feasibility* * Join early technical calls to assess what’s feasible: site layout, camera placement, network and power constraints. * Work with our sales and customer success team to scope projects and flag risks before we commit to a timeline or price. * Bring what you learn in the field back into how we design the next project. *Network and IT setup* * Gather IT requirements from customer IT teams: network access, VLANs, QoS, VPN and IP addresses. * Configure devices and connect them to customer networks, wired, Wi\-Fi and remote. * Set up and test hardware before the visit. *On\-site installation* * Install and wire cameras, badge readers, gate\-arm beams, I/O modules and forklift\-mounted units, or direct the electricians and day labor who do. * Work out power with the customer, such as battery versus forklift wiring. * Test until trigger, timing and data are reliable, then leave the system running. *Support and handover* * Train the customer and be their first call for technical issues. * Troubleshoot on site and remotely, and escalate software issues to engineering. * Document every install so the next one is faster. **What we’re looking for** This is not a desk job, and it’s not a fixed list of tasks. You’ll be a good fit if you: * Want to be in the field: warehouses, distribution centers, maintenance shops. * Like puzzles and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working. * Are curious and learn fast. * Are comfortable in a startup, where priorities shift and you may need to take on something new on short notice. * Want to build something new and grow with the company. If you want a job description you can follow line by line, this isn’t the right role. If you want to help build something, it might be. **Required** * Willing to travel often, on short notice. * Technical background in computer science, software or IT, formal or self\-taught. * Networking skills: configuration, VLANs, VPN, IP addressing. * Some electrical and IoT skills: wiring, power, sensors, I/O modules. * Clear explanations of technical topics to non\-technical people, in writing and out loud. * A support mindset: patient and dependable with customers and with our sales and customer success team. You’ll give technical input to sales, but this is not a sales role. * Lives in the Milwaukee area or can relocate before the start date. **Nice to have** * Interest in agentic AI. * Experience with industrial cameras, badge or access control, or warehouse and yard equipment. * Linux or edge devices * Experience working with electricians, contractors or day labor. * Startup experience. **Compensation** Base salary can range from $50\-80k, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to deployment speed and success. We care more about fit than résumé length. **Start date** We’re hiring now and want someone who can join the next deployment window. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Willingness to travel: * 75% (Required) Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: VP, Engineering
jobs.description: Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Banks, credit unions, and mortgage lenders use our platform to turn data into relationships, and since 2016 it has enabled more than $7 trillion in funded loan volume. Our customers work in a regulated, high\-stakes industry, run on legacy systems they can't replace, and need software that fits how their people actually work. Those are hard problems, and they reward engineers who get close to the customer and take ownership of outcomes. We're also growing from a mortgage platform into one that serves banking, wealth, and insurance, and the products this role owns are where customers will feel that growth first. The work ahead is significant: a new orchestration engine that replaces seven legacy marketing automation systems, a migration of our Contact Service off the monolith, and lasting improvements to SMS reliability. AI is changing what engineering work looks like. More of the mechanical work is being done by tools; more of the value is in judgment, review, customer understanding, and the ability to lead change. Most companies will add AI and get complexity. A few will turn it into a real operating advantage. We intend to be one of the few, and that comes down to people and culture more than technology. We're building our Engineering and Product culture around three principles. You'll be the person who turns them into daily habits: * **Reality is the referee.** Decisions settle on customer outcomes and evidence, not title, opinion, or "that's how my last company did it." If something is working, we double down. If it isn't, we stop. * **Disagreement is a duty.** Raising a concern isn't a personality trait or a risk. It's part of the job, and we build mechanisms that make it safe and expected. * **Fix the system, not the person.** When something breaks, including a hire, a team, or a project, we ask what allowed it to happen and fix that. **The role** We're hiring a VP, Engineering to lead our Applications engineering organization, the customer\-facing products our users work in every day. You'll report to our SVP, Engineering, and act as the SVP’s partner and \#2\. You'll help shape our technical strategy and roadmap, alongside the SVP. You'll lead three engineering managers and roughly half of Engineering across six product areas, and you'll own delivery and quality for all of them. But your most important job is the people doing the work: developing leaders, setting clear expectations, holding people to them, and coaching them to get better. This is not a role for someone who wants to run a bigger org chart. It's for a technically strong leader who builds teams that solve real customer problems, and who builds the system that keeps producing those teams after they've moved on. **What you'll own** Six product areas: Journeys and Campaigns, SMS and Communications, CRM and Lead Management, Content, Contact Service, and Mobile. Within them, four programs will define the year: * **The orchestration engine.** The largest delivery commitment in Engineering: a multi\-workstream program replacing seven legacy marketing automation systems with a single graph\-based, event\-driven engine. * **The Contact Service migration.** A strangler fig migration that moves Contact Service off our monolith. * **Communications reliability.** Structural improvements to SMS reliability, including CI gates, contract tests, and canary deploys, plus the team habits that make them stick. * **Multi\-vertical readiness.** Making sure campaigns, communications, CRM, and content work as first\-class parts of our platform as we expand into banking, wealth, and insurance, not as bolt\-ons. You'll help shape the technical direction for these programs, with the SVP making the final call. You're accountable for landing them: the plan, the sequencing, the tradeoffs, the people, and the results. **What you'll be doing** * **Develop leaders.** Coach your managers and the technical leaders under them to know each person's superpowers and weak spots, manage to strengths, and use real stretch assignments to grow people faster. Build a bench so that key roles have successors. Expect this to be where most of your time goes. * **Hold teams accountable, with intent, not oversight.** Set clear goals and make sure every team knows what it owns and what it committed to. Let teams decide how to get there, then hold them to it. Replace status meetings and approval chains with visible commitments, peer accountability, and direct customer feedback. When something slips, raise it early and directly. Fix the system first; when the issue is performance, coach it, and act when coaching isn't working. * **Shape the technical strategy, then deliver it.** Bring a strong point of view to architecture, technical strategy, and roadmap decisions, with the SVP making the final call. Then translate those decisions into plans and team commitments across all six product areas. Balance the big architectur rstand the architecture well enough to shape it and deliver it, and you need to build the room. * Experience leading large, multi\-team programs from design through production delivery. * Real examples of leading change through resistance, including winning over respected senior people who didn't want the change. * A history of partnering with a strong technical leader, helping shape their strategy, executing it well, and making them more effective. * Personal use of AI tools in your engineering work, a point of view on how AI changes engineering teams, roles, and quality practices, and ideally experience driving that adoption across teams. **How you work** Our four core values, and what they mean in this role: * **Customer obsession.** Everything starts with the customer. You know how they use what your teams build, you get engineers in front of them, and you measure success by the value customers get, not features shipped. * **Grit and resilience.** Hard programs, production incidents, and setbacks don't knock you off course. You own outcomes end to end, give credit away, talk about failures plainly, and keep your teams steady. * **Speed.** You move fast and help your teams do the same. You decide quickly on good evidence, remove blockers, and change course when the evidence says so. * **Excellence.** You hold a high bar for people, code, and reliability, and you're direct and fair about it. You set clear expectations, give feedback early, and follow up, so people always know where they stand. **What this role isn't** * Not the final word on technical direction. You'll have real input into architecture and technical strategy, and the SVP, Engineering has the final say. You'll complement the SVP, not compete. * Not a hands\-off role. You'll stay close enough to the designs, the code, and the incidents to know something is off before a dashboard tells you. * Not a "bring the playbook from my last company" role. We want you to bring what you've learned and tell us why it will work here. * Not a role where the first answer to a problem is a reorg, a new process, or a personnel change. **Compensation and benefits** The anticipated base salary range for this role is $240,000 to $280,000 annually. Final total compensation offered is dependent upon the selected individual's qualifications and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on company performance and other factors. As an employee of the company, you will be eligible to participate in the Employee Stock Option Plan. Total Expert offers a competitive range of benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA (Health Savings Account), FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts), company\-paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Flexible Time\-Off (FTO), Paid Parental Leave, and 401(k) with employer match. **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.** **Equal opportunity** *Total Expert is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and evaluate everyone on the same criteria. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
