jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Seattle, WA / Sterling, VA **Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Hybrid \| Mondays Remote, Tuesday – Friday Onsite **Target Salary Range\*:** $215,000 \- $230,000 ($400,000 \- $450,000 OTE) * This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary **Position Overview** ===================== The Principal Machine Learning Engineer contributes to the architecture and implementation of the platform used by scientists to bring safe, secure, and reliable AI capabilities to counter\-UAS devices. Working closely with scientists and software engineers, this role enables new AI functionality across areas such as multimodal sensor fusion, real\-time systems, and distributed edge computing. The Principal Machine Learning Engineer supports the full AI lifecycle, from research and model development through optimization and deployment into production environments. This role focuses heavily on deploying and managing AI models at the edge, including resource\-constrained devices with limited memory and connectivity, while ensuring models are performant, reliable, and suitable for real\-world use. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Machine Learning and Deep Learning** * Develop, own, optimize, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models into production software products. * Support scientists throughout the AI lifecycle, from research and experimentation through production deployment. * Translate research outputs into scalable and reliable production AI capabilities. * Contribute to the development of safe, secure, and responsible AI solutions. ### **Computer Vision, Signal Processing, and Sensor Fusion** * Develop and support machine learning solutions involving computer vision, signal processing, and sensor fusion. * Integrate multiple sensor data sources using advanced machine learning techniques. * Support multimodal AI capabilities used in real\-time and distributed systems. * Apply machine learning approaches to complex sensing and perception problems. ### **Edge AI and Model Optimization** * Deploy and optimize machine learning models on AI chips and edge devices. * Optimize models for environments with limited memory, compute, and connectivity. * Support on\-device model deployment, management, and lifecycle activities. * Improve model performance and efficiency for real\-time edge applications. ### **ML Infrastructure and Platform Engineering** * Architect and maintain large\-scale distributed machine learning platforms and systems. * Support infrastructure used by scientists and engineers to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI capabilities. * Evaluate system architecture, performance metrics, code, test plans, project plans, deployments, and operational requirements. * Support reliable deployment of AI capabilities across distributed edge\-compute environments. ### **Software Engineering and Production Deployment** * Develop production software using Python and C\+\+. * Use machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow. * Take machine learning models from research and development through deployment into live software products used by customers. * Collaborate with software engineers to integrate AI models into production applications and systems. ### **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** * Provide technical leadership across machine learning, edge AI, and ML infrastructure initiatives. * Collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers. * Contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction for AI\-enabled systems. * Support multidisciplinary teams operating across Public Safety, Enterprise, and Defense domains. **Qualifications** ================== ### **Education** * B.S. in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or another highly technical field. **\[Required]** ### **Experience** * 13\+ years of software engineering experience. **\[Required]** * Proven experience architecting and maintaining large\-scale distributed platforms. **\[Required]** * Proven experience developing, owning, and deploying machine learning models into live production products. **\[Required]** * Experience deploying and optimizing AI models on chips and edge devices. **\[Required]** * Experience with computer vision, signal processing, and machine learning infrastructure. **\[Required]** * Experience taking machine learning models from research and development through deployment into production software used by customers. **\[Required]** ### **Skills** * Strong Python and C\+\+ proficiency. **\[Required]** * Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow. **\[Required]** * Advanced knowledge and hands\-on experience with on\-chip AI development. **\[Required]** * Strong understanding of edge model deployment and management. **\[Required]** * Excellent problem\-solving skills. **\[Required]** * Ability to analyze system architecture, design, performance metrics, code, test plans, project plans, deployments, and operations. **\[Required]** * Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with scientists, engineers, and product managers. **\[Required]** **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or an equivalent highly technical field. * Hands\-on experience solving computer vision or natural language understanding problems in a business environment. * Familiarity with responsible AI, de\-biasing techniques, model encryption, and de\-identification techniques.

jobs.description: **Job Description:** Thomson Reuters is hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the core of the document\-processing platform behind our AI products. The platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue\-driven pipeline. It powers flagship products like Westlaw and CoCounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. The work is mostly Rust in DU Core, with regular work in the C\#/.NET services (DU Apps) that sit in front of it. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you’ll lead high\-impact projects across Core and Apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Turn asks into requirements. Take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. Turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non\-goals, and how we’ll know it worked * Design with explicit trade\-offs. Write design docs and ADRs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. Cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path. * Define the architecture. Shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on Azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong. * Find and fix bottlenecks. Use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. Back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show. * Build and run the processing pipeline end to end. It’s a queue\-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. That means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third\-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput. * Work across Core and Apps. You’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend Rust services, but be willing to pivot to C\#/.NET to support the customer\-facing services that sit in front of them. * Evolve contracts safely. Change message schemas, API surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. Internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on. * Keep a strong engineering mindset. Prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it. * Work agentically. Write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. Evaluate AI tools for specific use cases. You own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it. * Improve how humans and agents work here. Evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. Write code, docs and PRs clear enough that a new teammate and an AI agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants. * Own it in production. Instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on\-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes. * Lead high\-impact work. Own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break * them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed. * Raise the team’s bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review. Influence direction. Translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership * **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in Rust or C\+\+. If your background is C\+\+, you should be keen to work in Rust day to day. * Experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi\-region or highly available systems. * Experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code. * Deep distributed\-systems expertise: message queues and at\-least\-once delivery, idempotency, backpressure, retries and timeouts, failure detection, and autoscaling. * Experience choosing between storage options (relational, NoSQL and others) for a given workload. * A record of performance work at scale: profiling, benchmarking, memory budgets, concurrency limits, and handling inputs that don’t fit in memory * A track record of written design work (d catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. The Global Westlaw Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that powers Westlaw, the world's leading legal research platform. Our teams develop innovative products and AI\-driven solutions that help legal professionals find trusted answers, uncover insights, and make confident decisions faster. Working across engineering, AI, data, platform, and product disciplines, we deliver secure, scalable, and intelligent experiences for customers around the globe. As an AI Staff Engineer, you will help define and build the AI foundation that powers the next generation of Westlaw experiences. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Product
jobs.description: **About Tin Can** ================= Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world. We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on two engineers to help make it happen. **The Role** ------------ A Tin Can earns its spot on the kitchen counter when a kid keeps picking it up. Because we build both ends of the call, we get to make things no other phone can, and the next ones are the kind families ask us for: an easier way to fill the contact book, even more speed dials, more a kid can do without waiting on a grown\-up. We’re hiring two Software Engineers to own the core product — the features that give a kid someone to call, a reason to call, and an easy way to do it. You’ll build across the whole product: the app parents live in (Flutter), the TypeScript services on AWS Lambda behind contacts, plans, call logs, and voicemail, and the call\-routing service that gates every call. You’ll sit with the Head of Product and the core experience’s PM and designer, alongside the engineers who own our voice platform, firmware, and account portal. When a feature reaches into the call path — a new hotline number, the voicemail menu — you’ll go there, with our voice engineers reviewing anything on the SIP and media plane. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Make it easier to hear who called and call them back — on the phone itself, in our services, and in the parents’ app * Give kids more of the phone: even more speed dials, and more a kid can set up alone, with a parent’s say\-so * Make the first week count — improved contact syncing, faster contact approvals, and a first run that has a family calling on day one * Build the fun, weird features no other landline can, the kind a kid tells their friends about * Own the call\-routing rules a feature needs — what a speed dial or a hotline number does, who a kid can reach — in the service every call goes through * Build the tooling behind hotlines — scheduling, uploading, playback — with the engineers who own our voice platform * Spec and build the service side of features whose other half is firmware — what the phone plays, how it rings — with the firmware engineer * Instrument what you ship — event schema, dashboard, alarm — so we can see kids calling more, week by week * Take a turn in our on\-call rotation, because nobody knows a feature like the person who built it **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years building user\-facing software, including a feature you took from idea to production and kept running * Strong TypeScript; you’ve built and run an API in production (ours run on AWS Lambda with Postgres) and can model contacts, permissions, and call history * You’ve shipped a mobile or web client people use every day; our app is Flutter, and we’ll teach you Dart * You think about the kid and the parent at once — what a kid can do alone, what needs a grown\-up, and how fast “no” takes effect * Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have * Hands\-on and scrappy; you’d rather prototype the flow on a real Tin Can than wait for a perfect spec * A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor * Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office Monday through Thursday; this isn’t a remote role * **Bonus:** Flutter or Dart; curiosity about telephony (dial plans, IVRs, text\-to\-speech); a product for kids or families; or Stripe, Shopify, or IoT integrations **Why Join Tin Can** ==================== * **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters. * **You’ll own the reason a kid picks up the phone:** Reliability makes a call connect; you’ll build what makes a kid want to make one — easier ways to call back, more speed dials, more to do when no one’s around — and see it in how often families call. * **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one. * **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care. If you’re excited by making a Tin Can the thing a kid reaches for when they’ve got something to tell someone — and building what makes that call easy to make and return — we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $145K \- $175K

jobs.description: ### **Join an award\-winning company!** **Who are we?** Since 1967, Toll Brothers has been building luxury homes and communities in the best locations in the U.S. Today, we’re a Fortune 500 company operating in over 60 markets. We’re the country’s premier luxury builder with the widest range of product offerings and price points in the industry, serving first\-time, move\-up, active\-adult, and second\-home buyers. From the homes we build to the talent we recruit, we know that to be the best, we have to work with the best. Toll Brothers is a place where diverse perspectives and experiences are welcomed and where employees of all backgrounds are treated with fairness, dignity and respect. We believe every employee should feel safe to be their true and authentic self at work. Our employees are our family, and we strive to uphold the values that our founders instilled in us, creating an exceptional place to work that is inclusive to all. **Toll Brothers**, America's leading luxury home builder, seeks an **Applied AI Engineer** to join our team at our Corporate office in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. **What is the opportunity?** The Applied AI Engineer builds the shared systems behind Toll Brothers’ AI products. The role creates the APIs, services, and AI workflows those products depend on, connects them to Salesforce, Snowflake, and other enterprise platforms, and refines them based on usage and feedback. This role reports to the Director, Applied AI. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate, Adaptive Learning Agents and Computational Cognitive Science
jobs.description: **Posting Number** req27365 **Department** Psychology **Department Website Link** https://psychology.arizona.edu/ **Location** Tucson Campus **Address** Tucson, AZ USA **Position Highlights** The NAIADEL Lab in the University of Arizona Department of Psychology seeks a Postdoctoral Research Associate with expertise in developing and analyzing adaptive learning agents to investigate the computational mechanisms of human intelligence and agency. The lab builds a neurocomputational theory of adaptive intelligence and agency. We study how people and artificial agents infer the structure of their environment, judge what they can control, revise those judgments after setbacks, and change their strategies when conditions change. Computational cognitive models and modern deep learning are our main instruments for this work. We treat deep reinforcement learning agents and sequence models as scientific models of human behavior. We train them, fit them to human data, interpret what they have learned, and compare them with process\-oriented cognitive models such as sequential sampling models and reinforcement learning models. These approaches offer complementary accounts of adaptation. Meta\-learning agents can model how learning strategies change with experience. Learned world models can represent environmental dynamics and support planning. Sequential sampling models characterize the dynamics of individual decisions. We ask when these accounts explain the same behavior, where they diverge, and how they can be integrated into a theory of adaptive intelligence. The candidate will lead the development of new adaptive agents for the lab’s game\-based environment, in which task structure and controllability change across game missions and over time. They will train these agents on the same games that people play, compare agent and human behavior on data from more than 1,000 participants across online, in\-person, and clinically characterized samples, and use the results to test and refine the lab’s theory of agency. The work will generate first\-author papers and an agent\-based research line the candidate can carry into an independent program. Recorded human data and a Gymnasium\-compatible runtime for the lab's games allow modeling to begin in the first weeks. Work with engineers and game designers allows new agents and new environments to be tested quickly. Resources include HPC clusters, GPU/CPU nodes, cloud compute, EEG, fMRI, and eye\-tracking. The lab is building a shared computational core of models, environments, and training pipelines on which its research runs, and the postdoc will substantially shape its design. They will join an active community of computational cognitive modelers and computer scientists across campus. International collaborations connect the candidate to machine learning, neuroscience, and clinical partners and to a global scientific network. The position offers close mentorship, funded international conference travel, dedicated compute allocations, fellowship support, and planning for independence, authorship, and project portability. The initial appointment is for one year, renewable based on satisfactory progress. The start date is negotiable; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. *Outstanding U of A benefits include health, dental, vision, and life insurance; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; U of A/ASU/NAU tuition reduction for the employee and qualified family members; access to U of A recreation and cultural activities; and more!* The University of Arizona has been recognized for our innovative work\-life programs. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and train new reinforcement learning agents for game\-based environments in which task structure and controllability change. Relevant approaches include meta\-reinforcement learning, continual learning, model\-based reinforcement learning and world models, and transformer\-based sequence models for decision\-making. * Treat trained agents as scientific models of behavior. Fit and compare them with human data from game\-based paradigms examining meta\-control, cognitive flexibility, and social learning, interpret the representations and strategies they acquire, and relate them to process\-oriented cognitive models such as reinforcement learning and sequential sampling models. * Develop methods that connect agent behavior with human behavior at the level of mechanism. Use simulation, recovery analyses, and out\-of\-sample prediction to determine which mechanisms are identifiable and supported by the data. * Formulate decisive comparisons among competing accounts of adaptation and help design or refine games and environments within the lab's game\-based adaptive platform. * Lead first\-author manuscripts aimed at machine learning venues and at cognitive science journals, and contribute to collaborative papers with partner sites. * Take scientific responsibility for the lab's agent research line, including theor  programming skills in Python and at least one modern deep learning framework. * A record of peer\-reviewed publication appropriate to career stage. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing new learning algorithms or substantially extending existing ones. * Experience with meta\-reinforcement learning, in\-context learning, or continual reinforcement learning in non\-stationary environments. * Experience with POMDPs, belief\-state inference, model\-based reinforcement learning, or learned world models for decision\-making under partial observability. * Experience with transformers or other sequence models for sequential decision\-making. * Experience evaluating LLM\-based agents as subjects in behavioral tasks, or developing LLM\-based agents with memory, planning, or tool\-use capabilities. * Experience using neural networks as models of human or animal behavior, or interpreting the representations and strategies of trained agents. * Experience fitting reinforcement learning or sequential sampling models to human behavior. Computational cognitive scientists who want to extend their work to developing adaptive agents are encouraged to apply. * Experience modeling controllability, latent\-state inference, exploration under uncertainty, or adaptive control. * Experience analyzing human or animal behavioral data, or comparing model predictions with empirical data. * Experience designing environments, tasks, or benchmarks for learning agents. * Experience with collaborative software development, version control, and reproducible research workflows. **FLSA** Exempt **Full Time/Part Time** Full Time **Number of Hours Worked per Week** 40 **Job FTE** 1\.0 **Work Calendar** Fiscal **Job Category** Research **Benefits Eligible** Yes \- Full Benefits **Rate of Pay** NIH salary guidelines, Depends on Experience **Compensation Type** salary at 1\.0 full\-time equivalency (FTE) **Type of criminal background check required:** Name\-based criminal background check (non\-security sensitive) **Number of Vacancies** 1 **Target Hire Date** **Expected End Date** 10/31/2027 **Contact Information for Candidates** Dr. Nadja R. Ging\-Jehli Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology nadjaging@arizona.edu **Open Date** 10/16/2026 **Open Until Filled** Yes **Documents Needed to Apply** Curriculum Vitae (CV), Cover Letter, and One Additional Document **Special Instructions to Applicant** Please submit your CV and Cover Letter, along with one Additional Document containing the following materials: * **Statement of Research Interest:** Identify one question about adaptive intelligence or agency that you would like to pursue in this lab, and describe how you would approach it with the methods you bring. * **Supporting Materials:** One or two representative publications, preprints, or code repositories, including at least one that shows your own algorithmic work. * **References:** Names and contact details of three referees. Please combine the Statement of Research Interest, Supporting Materials, and References into one file and upload it in the Additional Documents section of your application. **Notice of Availability of the Annual Security and Fire Safety Report** In compliance with the Jeanne Clery Campus Safety Act (Clery Act), each year the University of Arizona releases an Annual Security Report (ASR) for each of the University’s campuses. jobs.description: **Job no:** 503959 **College / VP Area:** College of Engineering **Work type:** Faculty **Location:** Newark, DE **Categories:** Biomedical Engineering **Tenure\-Track Faculty Position in Biomedical Engineering** **Musculoskeletal Bioengineering** The Biomedical Engineering Department (BME, www.bme.udel.edu) at the University of Delaware (UD) invites applications for tenure\-track assistant professor in basic and preclinical Musculoskeletal Research that includes, but is not limited to, understanding the physical and biological mechanisms of musculoskeletal structure and function, applied research in musculoskeletal disorders, and strategies for therapeutic interventions. Research can span a range of length scales from organisms to molecules. Successful applicants will be part of the Delaware Center for Musculoskeletal Research (DCMR), an NIH\-funded Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE). The DCMR recently received NIH Phase II funding to support multiple new faculty across collaborating departments with opportunities for joint appointments. The DCMR provides research infrastructure and supports faculty success with mentoring and funding opportunities. UD BME is ABET accredited with world class research programs in musculoskeletal biomechanics, disease modeling, drug delivery, nanomedicine, neuro\-engineering, and cell and tissue engineering. Successful applicants will share in our vision to be a BME department recognized for high impact research and delivering an exceptional engineering education. We seek creative individuals eager to work in a collaborative interdisciplinary environment, have demonstrated research excellence, are outstanding educators and mentors, and will contribute to a climate that attracts and affirms students from various backgrounds. UD BME has new state\-of\-the\-art research laboratories located on the STAR (Science, Technology, and Advanced Research) Campus, a hub of biomedical research and innovation at UD. Core facilities across the UD campus include: the DCMR Research Core (pre\-clinical models, in vivo animal imaging, histology, and biomechanics), the Center for Biomedical and Brain Imaging (3T human and 9\.4T small animal/specimen MRIs), the Delaware Biotechnology Institute (world\-class Bio\-Imaging Center, DNA sequencing \& genotyping, bioinformatics, and proteomics cores), and core labs for human\-based studies. Access to active outpatient clinics is fostered through long\-standing partnerships with UD’s outstanding Physical Therapy Department. UD BME also enjoys close relationships and opportunities for innovative clinical and translational collaborations with Nemours Children’s Health, Thomas Jefferson University, the University of Pennsylvania, and others. UD is home to several outstanding institutes, including the Institute for Engineering Driven Health, the Data Science Institute, and the National Institute of Innovation in Manufacturing Biopharmaceuticals (NIIMBL). UD’s Newark, Delaware campus provides a vibrant college town with convenient access to the major cities of the East Coast. Candidates must have a Ph.D. degree in engineering or a related field. jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer** **San Jose, CA, USA** **12 Months** **$70/HR on W2 OR $80/HR on C2C** **Any visa is fine** **Need candidates who are in California. W2 candidates are encouraged to apply.** Client is an AI\-enhanced security processor company redefining the control and management of every digital system. The company builds silicon\-rooted security and management chips — including the TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) — for AI data center infrastructure, combining platform security, BMC/firmware, and on\-chip AI for real\-time threat detection and dynamic power/thermal management. **Job Description** **About the role** We’re looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You’ll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you’ll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Requirements:** * 8\-10\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master’s required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don’t expect all five: – **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work – **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software – **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints – **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness – **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security

jobs.title: Critical Facilities Engineer, NA (Data Center)
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **This is a evergreen req for future openings \- timeline for talent conversations is TBD. We are collecting applications for future conversations.** *This role is open on a rolling basis, and we review applications as they come in. There’s no set deadline, but if you’re interested, we encourage you to apply soon—our hiring needs can shift, and we welcome applications at any time while the opportunity is available.* **Site Operations Department** The Site Operations Department is responsible for the overall health of all mechanical and electrical systems, building maintenance, and performance of all data modules in our data centers. The team is staffed 24 x 7 onsite with Critical Facility Engineers (CFEs) on each shift. This team is the face of Vantage to our customers and the first line of defense regarding the uptime of our campus as well as the performance of our customer installations. Using a Critical Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to plan and track work needed, the Site Operations department performs all preventative and corrective maintenance. Our culture expects and rewards team performance that engages directly with the customers and the facility infrastructure. This is a team that does most of the actual work versus calling upon vendors. As a result, we provide superior service that is faster and more cost effective. **Position Overview** **This role is onsite in Ashburn, VA. This is an in\-house position.** **Ideally we will be seeking experienced talent for Levels I or potentially II . One with data center, mission critical field service or mission critical military experience highly desired (US Navy, US Air Force, US Army, US Marines, US Coast Guard). These are in\-house and hands\-on roles using your critical thinking talents to troubleshoot and fix equipment vs subbing out the work.** **Electrical and mechanical expertise in a non\-mission critical field service in cross\-industry may be considered, e.g, chiller technician with larger tonnage but non\-critical environments or field service in OEM equipment outside of data center. (Johnson Controls, York, Trane, Daikin, Vertiv, Eaton, Liebert, Toshiba, Delta, CAT, ABB, Samsung, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Petra etc) . We are also able to consider those that are very trainable.** We are looking for a Critical Facilities Engineer who knows what best\-in\-class service looks like and can make that a reality. This role is an important member of our facilities team where we manage some of the most efficient and cost\-effective data center facilities in the industry. The successful candidate for this role will work with a team of other electrical and mechanical\-focused engineers performing maintenance and repair for our data center infrastructure. We take our customer requirements for uptime seriously and keep our facilities maintained to a very high standard to insure uninterrupted service for our customers. If you enjoy working on critical data center systems (UPSs, PDUs, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls), as well as industrial electrical equipment and systems that include power distribution components/wiring, electronic components and lighting systems. If you know the importance of getting it right the first time and not disrupting mission critical data centers. If you enjoy delighting customers with superior service and you have the desire and ability to do so, then please read on! **Essential Job Functions** * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment * Use discretion and judgment in organizing workflow and adapting as priorities are modified due to a changing environment * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors **Duties** * Operate, perform maintenance and service repairs on critical Data Center systems (UPS, PDU, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls, Chillers, CRAH, ETC) * Develop reliability reports to ensure availability and capacity targets are achieved and maintained with 100% uptime * Coordinate, and oversee all maintenance vendors to ensure personnel safety, protect the Facility’s critical equipment, and maintain power to the critical load * Create required MOPs (Method of Procedure), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures) to ensure all maintenance activities are perform operating, maintaining, repairing, inspecting and testing critical electrical distribution systems, HVAC systems and building management/automation equipment * Ability to read commercial building blueprints and understand electrical single lines and schematics * Knowledge of commonly\-used concepts, practices, and procedures related to mechanical \& electrical systems needed to run data centers * Technical Writing skills and experience; as well as creating, coordinating, updating and/or modifying MOPs/SOPs/EOP’s for critical facilities equipment, to include supporting new systems and researching technical requirements * Work experience in the electrical or mechanical field is highly desired. Strong emphasis on technical skills/training, with intent to obtain license within a reasonable time * May be required to complete formal training in an area of specialty, such as UPS maintenance * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts, or emergencies * Travel is expected to be less than 5%, occasionally for training purposes * Potential employees must complete a background check successfully **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to stand 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to walk 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to sit 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to climb and balance 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to reach with hands \& arms 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to smell, talk \& hear * Ability to use hands to type, handle \& feel * Ability to reach with hands and arms * Ability to see at close and distance ranges and the ability to see color * Must be comfortable working in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities * Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays, and on\-call support * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds 1/3 of the time **Additional Details** * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Posting range is $38\-55 / hour for level Is and IIs. **\#LI\-Onsite** **\#LI\-TS1** We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist
jobs.description: **About IonQ:** IonQ, Inc. \[NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier \- delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting\-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99\.99% two\-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance. Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. **About Vector Atomic:** Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real\-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, we'd love to hear from you. We are seeking an **IT Support Specialist** to join our growing IT team. This is a hands\-on position supporting approximately 100\+ employees and 350\+ endpoints in a primary Windows\-based environment with a smaller footprint of Linux systems. The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who excels at solving technical problems, working directly with users, and taking end\-to\-end ownership of issues. This role extends beyond traditional help desk duties to include endpoint administration, cloud productivity suite support, network maintenance, cybersecurity monitoring, and active participation in our federal and industry compliance programs. **Location:** **Pleasanton, California (Bay Area)** **Requirements** **What You’ll Do** * **Endpoint \& User Support** * + Provide Tier 2/3 technical support primarily for Windows systems, alongside foundational support for Linux environments. + Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals. + Support cloud productivity tools, user account lifecycles, authentication, and access controls. + Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset management records, and standard operating procedures. * **Identity \& Network Infrastructure** * + Assist with directory services, central identity management, and group policy administration. + Support enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM), Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM), and unified endpoint management platforms. + Troubleshoot local network infrastructure, including LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, and firewalls. + Assist with IT infrastructure projects, network deployments, office moves, and technology upgrades. * **Security \& Compliance** * + Assist with endpoint hardening, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and baseline security configurations. + Support enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools. + Administer phishing\-resistant Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) technologies and hardware security keys. + Assist with federal and industry cybersecurity compliance programs (e.g., NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC) and evidence collection. + Interface with engineering, manufacturing, and general business teams to ensure secure, compliant operational workflows. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Formal industry certifications are not required. Relevant certifications and demonstrated technical knowledge will be evaluated as part of your overall qualifications and reflected in total compensation. * Experience administering enterprise cloud productivity and identity management platforms. * Hands\-on exposure to Linux administration and endpoint support. * Familiarity with enterprise EDR and SIEM security logging solutions. * Experience maintaining network switches, firewalls, and wireless access infrastructure. * Familiarity with cybersecurity compliance frameworks (such as NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC, or DFARS) and handling standards for sensitive data. * Practical knowledge of phishing\-resistant MFA tokens and modern hardware security keys. **What We're Looking For:** * A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent professional experience and demonstrated capabilities will be fully considered. * **3\+ years** of professional IT support or systems administration experience in an enterprise environment. * Strong Windows OS troubleshooting and administration capabilities. * Practical experience supporting Directory Services (Active Directory) and Group Policy. * Solid understanding of core networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and wireless protocols). * Hands\-on experience with endpoint management, deployment tools, or RMM platforms. * Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and customer\-service skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. **Benefits** Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work\-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including: * Platinum\-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision) * Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Employer 401(k) contributions * 20 days of paid time off \& 11 paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Fully stocked kitchen **Pay Range** The approximate base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience level. *Vector Atomic is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.* *Vector Atomic does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **Description** Vector Solutions is a leading, AI\-enabled, performance platform powering safe, compliant, and efficient operations for the public, educational, and commercial sectors. We bring training, safety, and workforce operations together to boost readiness, reduce risk, and drive high\-performance results for the everyday heroes who count on us. The Senior Product Manager owns the technical product definition, roadmap, and release quality of Convergence, Vector Solutions’ cloud\-hosted learning management system (LMS) for the Commercial sector. The role applies engineering and strategic business knowledge to translate customer and market needs into precise technical requirements for a multi\-tier software platform built on a .NET/C\# back end, a JavaScript front end, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), API\-based integrations, and a mobile application, and for new AI\-enabled capabilities. The Senior Product Manager works daily with software engineers, architects, and quality assurance staff to evaluate design trade\-offs, validate that delivered software meets its specifications, and solve technical problems involving data, system integration, AI feature quality, and performance. Convergence is sold primarily to commercial industry customers, including manufacturing, oil and gas, pulp and paper, and construction companies, so the role also requires subject matter expertise in industrial operations, equipment, and safety\-critical work in order to define how the platform represents and verifies the skills, qualifications, and compliance requirements of those workforces. **What You'll Do:** **Technical Environment** * Back end: .NET / C\# services and relational data stores; cloud hosting on AWS and/or Azure. * Front end: JavaScript\-based web application. * Mobile Frameworks: both Android and iOS * Integration layer: APIs and data exchange between Convergence and external customer and third\-party systems. * AI/LLM\-enabled features: AI will be used used in various application features including search, administrative workflows and reporting. * Delivery: Agile development with sprint planning, backlog refinement, design reviews, user acceptance testing, and staged releases. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities** Approximate share of time is shown for each area. **1\. Technical Requirements, Architecture, and Integrations (approx. 30%)** * Analyze customer needs, usage data, and market gaps and convert them into product requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria for the .NET/C\# services, JavaScript user interface, and API layer of Convergence. * Participate in architecture and design reviews with engineering. Evaluate the trade\-offs among performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and delivery time of proposed solutions on the cloud\-hosted (AWS/Azure) platform, and assess technical feasibility, dependencies, and technical debt when sequencing the roadmap. * Specify API and data\-integration requirements for exchanging learner, activity, and credentialing data between Convergence and external systems, including data mapping, data\-integrity rules, error handling, and the handling of edge cases and conflicting source data. * Define how the platform models industrial workforce structures, such as sites, crews, job roles, equipment\- or task\-specific qualifications, and recertification cycles, so that training and competency records reflect the operating realities of manufacturing, oil and gas, pulp and paper, and construction customers. * Maintain the technical product roadmap and backlog, defining scope, dependencies, and release timelines in coordination with the development team. **2\. jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description: Location San Francisco Type Full\-Time Department Tech Compensation $132,000 \- $147,000 **About Watershed** ------------------- Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit\-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product\-building, want to work hard at a mission\-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! **The role** ------------ As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best\-in\-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent\-driven workflows, integrations, and self\-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well\-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better. As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long\-term engineering. If you’re customer\-obsessed, hard\-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in\-office culture. ### **You will:** * Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices * Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack * Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle * Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support * Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security * Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience * Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network\-related issues, as well as occasional in\-person support within the San Francisco office * Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring * Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems * Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root\-cause analysis, clear run books, employee\-facing guidance, and self\-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery * Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development * Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company ### **You might be a good fit if:** * You have 3\+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high\-growth technology companies * You have hands\-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least\-privilege access * You have hands\-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach * You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build * You have experience managing and supporting Mac\-based environments * You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices * You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements * You have excellent problem\-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * You're an effective communicator with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications * You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers * You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed ### **Nice to have:** * First\-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges * Experience with zero\-trust security frameworks * Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting * Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning * Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO) * Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco) **Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)** Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. **What’s the interview process like?** It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. **What if I need accommodations for my interview?** At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long\-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy\-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Wildfire Defense Systems, Inc.** Wildfire Defense Systems (WDS) is the North American leader in insurer wildfire services, combining professional wildfire consulting and loss intervention services with Qualified Insurance Resources (QIR). Founded in 2001 to fulfill initial\-attack assignments for the US Forest Service, the company added professional services support in 2005 and launched wildfire loss\-intervention programs for insurers in 2008\. WDS Wildfire Loss Intervention Service (WDS Service) applies a comprehensive approach to reducing risk in catastrophic exposure on an industry scale, decreasing the average annual loss (AAL) for our insurer clients, and providing peace of mind to their policy holders during wildfire events. WDS provides these industry\-leading services to insurer clients and their policy holders across a 22\-state service area. **FLSA Status**: Exempt **Reports To**: Director of Engineering **Location**: Post Falls ID **Salary Range**: $84,900 to $124,100 DOE **Purpose and Scope of Position** The Mechanical Engineer II/III transforms ideas into field\-ready wildfire mitigation solutions that protect structures, support operations, and reduce wildfire risk. This role is for a bold, highly creative engineer who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly from concept to prototype, and is driven to build things that have never been done before. The ideal candidate is not risk\-averse. Instead, they are a disciplined innovator who learns fast, iterates relentlessly, and pushes ideas to practical, operational success. This position bridges engineering design and field deployment. The engineer owns projects end\-to\-end: conceiving, designing, prototyping, testing, refining, and helping transition solutions into production and operational use. Success requires balancing speed, ingenuity, safety, manufacturability, and cost so that innovation creates not only technical value, but also scalable and profitable business outcomes. **Organizational Relationship** Wildfire Defense Systems Inc, (WDS) operates as a family of integrated companies and subsidiaries that combine engineering, operations, innovation, and consulting expertise to deliver end‑to‑end wildfire mitigation solutions, from concept and design through field deployment and real‑world execution. WDS is the parent company and is the largest professional wildfire consulting and risk intervention company serving the insurance industry. This role operates within an entrepreneurial, agile, and mission\-driven environment at WDS, where engineering decisions directly affect reliability, safety, and continuity of operations. Innovation is expected to perform under pressure, and the engineer’s ability to think critically, build effectively, and adapt quickly will have a tangible, real\-world impact. The Mechanical Engineer position operates within an integrated engineering ecosystem that spans three core functions within the organization: * Wildfire Protection Engineering (WPE): a department within WDS that focuses on designing and developing wildfire mitigation technology, testing materials, and advancing new wildfire protection technology for internal customers. * Innovation \& Assembly: a department within WDS that executes the construction, prototyping and testing phase of projects and entrepreneurial ideas, assembling fire apparatus and upfitted resources, wiring and integrating critical systems, and delivering fully tested innovative wildfire fighting equipment from concept to field\-ready deployment. * Wildfire Technical Services, LLC (WTS): a subsidiary of WDS that provides consulting wildfire protection engineering for external clients, delivering wildfire risk assessments, hazard mitigation recommendations and structural and site design concepts for wildfire resilience. The successful applicant will work in an entrepreneurial, agile, and mission\-driven environment where engineering decisions directly affect reliability, safety, and operational continuity. Innovation at WDS is expected to perform under pressure, and the engineer’s ability to think critically, build effectively, and adapt quickly will have tangible, real\-world impact. **Reporting** This position will report directly to the Director of Engineering. The engineer will work closely with the Innovation \& Assembly Manager, WPE engineers, Innovation \& Assembly technicians, Chief Wildfire Officer, Field Operations personnel, and external vendors and partners. The successful applicant will also periodically support projects directed by company ownership through Wildfire Technical Services, LLC. **Essential Functions** The essential functions of this position include the ability to design, build, test, and deploy mechanical and electromechanical systems in both lab and field environments. The engineer will be required to assemble and modify physical systems, conduct testing and validation activities, troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, and work collaboratively  ogress and solves problems without waiting for ideal conditions * First\-principles thinking: evaluates ideas quickly and avoids unnecessary complexity, delay, and cost * Commercial awareness: understands that good engineering must also support efficiency, scalability, and profit * Adaptability: responds quickly to changing field conditions, priorities, and stakeholder needs * Ownership and follow\-through: takes responsibility for results and pushes work to completion * Clear communication: documents work professionally and aligns stakeholders through concise technical communication **Execution Mindset** The successful applicant will approach work with a strong bias toward action, applying judgment, experience, and engineering creativity to move projects forward without waiting for perfect data. The engineer will balance innovation with operational reality, ensuring solutions perform reliably in real\-world field conditions. The role requires actively seeking and incorporating feedback (particularly from field users) and elevating project teams through energy, confidence, and a solutions\-oriented mindset. **Expected Behaviors and Indicators of Success** The successful candidate demonstrates a strong builder’s mindset, prioritizing practical execution, ownership, and results over theoretical perfection. This engineer is energized by turning ideas into reliable, field\-ready solutions and operates effectively in ambiguous, fast\-moving, and mission\-critical environments. They apply first\-principles thinking, sound judgment, and a strong bias toward action to evaluate concepts quickly, reduce unnecessary cost and complexity, and accelerate progress from design to deployment. Success in this role is demonstrated through creative problem\-solving, disciplined iteration, and the ability to balance innovation, speed, safety, reliability, and cost efficiency. The engineer consistently advances work by proposing solutions, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum through uncertainty, competing priorities, and technical challenges. They communicate ideas clearly, contribute positively to team performance through leadership, coaching, and collaboration, and treat setbacks as learning opportunities that improve future outcomes. Above all, they bring resilience, conviction, and a systems\-level perspective to deliver innovative solutions that perform in real\-world operations. **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer * While performing the duties of this job, the Engineer is regularly required to talk or hear, and must be able to lift up to 75\+ lbs., bend, climb, stand for duration of shift, etc. * Ability to successfully pass a DOT Physical * Able to pass Work Capacity Test up to the “moderate” level if necessary to perform field evaluations, QA/QC of innovations, etc. * Must be able to perform in an R\&D shop environment with the presence of machinery, personnel, distractions, flashing lights, and loud noises typical of a manufacturing environment. The application period will close August 28, 2026\. *This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements, but a general description of the job. Nothing contained herein restricts WDS rights to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Wildfire Defense Systems, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, ncluding recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

jobs.description: **Description** **Job Overview:** As Manager of Data Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our data strategy. You will lead a team of talented data engineers in designing, implementing, and optimizing our data warehouse to support business intelligence, analytics, data science and data\-driven decision\-making processes. Your expertise in modern data technologies and methodologies will ensure our data architecture is robust, scalable, and efficient. This is a hands\-on technical and management role. **Purpose:** Our genuine engagement and positive energy provide guests an escape from their routine into our exciting fantasy world of fun, chance, and possibility, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and importance. **Value System:** Our enthusiastic commitment to our purpose inspires and empowers us to do everything right, have fun, and be the best. AWS and GCP experience a plus. * Strong experience database modeling, data architecture and design, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience with data quality, validation, and governance processes. * Solid background in scripting and software development. * Demonstrated experience in agile software development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.), project management, ITIL concepts, service desk management and incident and request management. * Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor, inspire, and drive high performance. * Experience in Redshift, SQL Server, Oracle, and other data warehouse platforms a big plus. * Experience in real\-time stream processing and data ingestion a big plus. * Result\-oriented with exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Willing to work odd and irregular hours including nights, weekends, and holidays * Willing to travel and participate in training as recommended or required * Must have a valid and current State Driver's License and an insurable driving record for purposes of driving company vehicles as required * Must have a Tribal Gaming License (or the ability to obtain and maintain a license) as a requirement for this position * Must have willingness and ability to work in a smoke/secondary smoke environment **NATIVE AMERICAN INDIAN PREFERENCE IN HIRING POLICY SHALL BE ADHERED TO AT ALL TIMES** **Complaints about the recruitment or selection process for employment should be directed in writing to office of the President and CEO of Wind Creek Hospitality.**

jobs.description: **Woodstream is the largest independent pest \& animal control platform in North America, offering innovative brands with industry\-leading efficacy and safety.** **Ready to Bring Great Ideas to Life? Join Our Engineering Team!** We're looking for a **Mechanical Design Engineer II** to help drive innovation and create impactful solutions at our **Lancaster, PA** facility. **At Woodstream, our values drive everything we do:** * **Consumer is the Boss** – We are committed to listening to and understanding our customers’ needs! * **Invent the Future** – Challenge the status quo: Think boldly and creatively! * **Execution is Everything** – We are committed to deliver with excellence, speed, and accuracy. * **Collaborate Confidently** – We trust, respect, and empower each other to win together. * **Play to Win** – We’re bold, ambitious, and relentless in our pursuit of success. **Benefits of Working for Woodstream:** * Competitive benefits package including: + 401k with Company Match, eligible on First Day of Employment + Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance Effective on **First Day of Employment** + Company General Bonus Program + Company Paid Parental Leave + Adoption Assistance + Company Paid Basic Life \& Disability Insurance + Accident, Critical Illness, \& Hospital Insurance Options + Company Paid ID Theft + Legal Assistance Plan Options + Paid Vacation and Holidays + Pet Insurance * Stable, growing working environment with a history of 150 years of doing business. * Opportunity to advance within the company. **Overview of the Role:** The Mechanical Design Engineer II, Product Enhancement Engineering is responsible for mechanical design projects within the product enhancement engineering team. This role involves technical research, sourcing materials and components, prototyping, testing, and refining mechanical designs to meet technical and performance requirements that will deliver the same or an improved consumer experience with improved efficiency or at a more effective cost. Key responsibilities include, but not limited to: * **Mechanical Design:** Design, development, and testing of mechanical components and products, ensuring compliance with technical, safety, and regulatory standards. Oversee prototype refinement to improve performance and functionality. * **Support Manufacturing and Optimize Efficiency:** Collaborate with sourcing teams to select materials, create final specifications for product manufacturing, and provide technical support throughout the production process. Identify cost\-reduction opportunities and design production test fixtures to ensure manufacturing readiness. * **Drive Product Improvement:** Prepare and present technical developments, conduct DFMEA, patent assessments, and benchmark competitor products. Research and implement new technologies to enhance product performance, sustainability, and compliance with ESG goals. The Mechanical Design Engineer II will ensure that product enhancements are properly validated and documented via the product development process. This individual will be responsible for finalizing mechanical specifications and supporting the manufacturing process to ensure smooth production transitions, contributing to the company’s long\-term growth and cost savings objectives. **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities:** * Design, development, and refinement of mechanical product projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards, performance, safety, and cost objectives. * Oversee the development, testing, and refinement of mechanical prototypes to improve performance, safety, and functionality. * Collaborate with sourcing teams to select the best materials and components for quality and cost\-efficiency. * Create final mechanical specifications for product manufacturing and provide technical support during the production process. * Review existing designs and processes to identify cost\-reduction opportunities and improve product efficiency. * Design and build production test fixtures for new product launches, ensuring readiness for manufacturing. * Perform DFMEA, design reviews, and patent assessments to mitigate risks and identify patentable features or infringement issues. * Benchmark competitive products and research relevant technologies to enhance product performance, sustainability, and meet ESG goals. * Display perseverance and flexibility in overcoming technical challenges. Approach setbacks as opportunities to find alternative solutions, maintaining a proactive, growth\-oriented mindset to drive project success. * Regular attendance and punctuality are required. **This position has several primary objectives which are critical to the overall success of Woodstream:** * Design, development, and refinement of mechanical components and prototypes, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory standards. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to optimize material selection, create final manufacturing specifications, and provide technical support during production. * Drive product improvements through risk assessments, competitive benchmarking, and technology research to enhance product performance, sustainability, and cost\-efficiency. **Other fabrication, and general shop equipment use are also highly desirable * Experience with product prototyping and testing. * Creative approach to problem\-solving, broad understanding of manufacturing
