As enterprises put agents to work on HR and finance processes, customers need to know what each agent is, who is responsible for it, and whether it can be trusted. This team helps answer those questions, working alongside Workday Agent Passport, which gives agents verifiable credentials and attestations. **About the Role** As Senior Manager of Agent Trust \& Security, you will lead an engineering team building the security foundations of Workday's agent registry: how agents are identified, how they connect to Workday's security model, and how customers can verify what they're running. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You review designs and code, you build with AI code generation every day, and you bring product judgment to what the team builds. In this role, you will: * Lead, hire and grow a team of software engineers, including senior and principal engineers, and set a high bar for security engineering, design quality and pace. * Shape how agents are identified, authenticated and authorized across the registry, building on Workday's security model and standards such as OAuth. * Work with the Agent Passport team on agent identity, credentials and verification, so customers can trust which agent is running and what has been verified about it. * Bring product judgment: understand how customer administrators and security teams think about agents, and work with product management to decide what the team builds. * Partner with peer teams across the agent registry, agent gateway and Agent Passport, and with Workday security, so that security works consistently across the platform. * Make AI code generation central to how the team builds, and measure whether it is improving speed and quality. * Turn direction into written plans with dated milestones, and raise risks early. **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading and developing engineering teams that shipped and operated production services. 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with security\-critical systems such as authentication, authorization, identity, or security platforms. * **Other Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience also considered. * Strong, current hands\-on use of AI code generation tools, and experience leading a team that builds with them. * Working knowledge of OAuth, workload and service identity, and access control models. Experience with signed credentials, attestation or verifiable credentials is a plus. * Product sense: experience working directly with customers, or as a technical lead who shaped a security or identity product alongside product management. * Experience with AI agent platforms or protocols such as MCP or A2A, or with LLM applications in production. * Track record of predictable delivery across teams with shared dependencies. * Track record of hiring and developing senior and principal engineers, including a team split across locations. * Experience with multi\-tenant enterprise SaaS. Workday platform experience is a plus. jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** World Pediatrics partners with governments, health workers, and organizations to ensure that children in lower\-resource settings have access to safe, timely surgical care. When children are healed, the social and emotional health of families is restored, and the economic productivity of communities is strengthened. **OUR CORE VALUES** * **Kids First:** We are accountable to the children. * **Equitable Access:** We empower opportunity. * **Rooted in Community:** We build for a sustainable future. * **Best Practice to Next Practice:** We innovate and transform. * **Shoulder\-to\-Shoulder:** We operate with unity and integrity. Learn more about us by visiting https://worldpediatrics.org/. **Job Scope:** The Junior Data Engineer supports the development, integration, automation, and reliability of World Pediatrics data systems. This role builds and maintains connections among fundraising, financial, communications, payment, and reporting platforms; develops data pipelines and automated workflows; monitors data quality; and helps ensure organizational data is accurate, timely, secure, documented, and available for operational and executive decision\-making. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES HIGHLIGHTS:** The role includes but is not limited to data pipeline development, API integration, workflow automation, technical documentation, data quality monitoring, troubleshooting, and basic Domo dashboard support. **Data Pipelines** * Develop and maintain data pipelines to support accurate and reliable data movement between systems. * Create reusable data transformations and validation processes to improve data consistency and reporting. **API Development** * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot API integrations between organizational systems. * Support automated data synchronization, authentication, and integration updates. **Workflow Automation** * Design, implement, and monitor automated workflows to improve operational efficiency. * Develop automated data quality checks to identify errors, duplicates, and inconsistencies. **Documentation** * Maintain technical documentation, including data mappings, system integrations, and workflow processes. * Document technical issues, resolutions, and process improvements. **Technical Support** * Troubleshoot data imports, exports, integration failures, and system connectivity issues. * Communicate technical issues and resolutions clearly to internal stakeholders. **Domo Support** * Provide basic support for Domo dashboard development, maintenance, and reporting needs under the guidance of CRM managers. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * Foundational experience with SQL, relational databases, data transformation, and data validation. * Experience through employment, internships, academic projects, or independent projects with APIs, data pipelines, scripting, or workflow automation. * Ability to troubleshoot data movement, authentication, imports, exports, and scheduled data jobs. * Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, including staging, fact, and dimension tables. * Working knowledge of Python, Scala, Java, or another scripting language preferred. * Experience with donor CRMs such as DonorPerfect, financial systems, payment platforms, or Microsoft 365 preferred. **ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED** * Prior work experience in a nonprofit environment preferred. * Experience with DonorPerfect, Domo, financial systems, payment platforms, or Microsoft 365 preferred. * Strong commitment to ethical data stewardship and safeguarding confidential donor, financial, and organizational information. * Ability to maintain clear technical documentation, diagrams, field mappings, and support notes. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** * Full\-time hybrid role with three in\-office days per week; Mondays and Wednesdays are required in\-office. Richmond, VA is the preferred location; candidates in other World Pediatrics markets—Atlanta, GA; St. Louis, MO; or Raleigh, NC—may also be considered. * Regular use of a computer, cloud platforms, databases, and collaboration tools for extended periods. * Occasional work outside normal business hours may be needed to address critical integration failures, system changes, or scheduled deployments. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external technology vendors. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** include but are not limited to: * Regular use of a computer, cloud platforms, databases, and collaboration tools for extended periods. * Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** This annual starting salary range for this position is $72,500\-$80,000 based on experience. In addition, our benefits include 100% company\-paid employee coverage for all health and dental insurance offered, a retirement plan with a company match, 11 ½ paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, and four weeks of PTO in year 1\. We believe in a modern approach to Paid Time Off that aligns with flexibility and goes beyond the norm or required. **HOW TO APPLY:** If you are seeking to grow with an organization that is passionate about providing thousands of children with access to lifesaving and life\-changing care, we would love to talk with you. To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter to ***recruiting@worldpediatrics.org*** by November 3, 2026\. ***World Pediatrics is committed to creating an inclusive work environment and welcomes applications from all genders, races, religions, sexual orientations, ages, and any other group that can bring diverse perspectives to our organization.*** Pay: $72,500\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Are you currently located in Richmond, VA, or in one of our other chapter locations (Atlanta, GA; St. Louis, MO; or Raleigh, NC)? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Data visualization: 2 years (Required) * CRM software: 2 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Richmond, VA 23223

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Worthington Enterprises, we are not just experimenting with AI—we are embedding it into how we operate, make decisions, and create value for our customers. We are looking for a hands\-on, forward\-thinking AI Engineer to transform governed enterprise data into impactful business solutions. You will build and deploy AI\-powered applications, agents, predictive models, and intelligent workflows that help people work more efficiently, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. This is an opportunity to shape reusable enterprise AI patterns, tackle meaningful manufacturing and business challenges, and see your solutions progress from idea to measurable impact. **This hybrid role is based in Columbus, Ohio, and requires at 2 to 3 days per week on\-site**. Occasional travel—approximately 10%—to corporate and manufacturing locations may be required. **This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or U.S. work sponsorship.** **What You'll Do** * Design, build, deploy, and improve AI applications including enterprise agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), natural\-language analytics, predictive models, and workflow automations. * Build Snowflake\-native AI and ML solutions using capabilities such as Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views and structured\-data tools, Cortex AI functions, Snowpark, Model Registry, and Feature Store where appropriate. * Engineer retrieval and context pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including ingestion, chunking, metadata, hybrid search, citations, permissions, and freshness. * Create reliable agentic workflows in n8n or comparable orchestration platforms, incorporating tool calling, human approval, retries, idempotency, secrets management, auditability, and exception handling. * Develop secure integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, enterprise APIs, databases, file sources, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. * Establish evaluation and monitoring practices for answer quality, task completion, drift, safety, latency, cost, adoption, and business value. * Apply software engineering practices including modular design, automated testing, code review, Git\-based delivery, CI/CD, documentation, and production support. * Partner with business teams to frame opportunities, prototype quickly, translate ambiguity into a delivery plan, and guide adoption of solutions that are useful and trusted. * Contribute reusable patterns, standards, and guardrails that help other teams and AI Champions build responsibly. * Continuously evaluate new models and capabilities, separating durable value from short\-lived hype. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or data science, including evidence of delivering at least one AI\-enabled solution beyond a one\-off prototype. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience with APIs, source control, testing, and maintainable application or pipeline development. * Hands\-on experience with one or more of the following: LLM applications, RAG, tool\-using agents, natural\-language analytics, ML pipelines, or intelligent automation. * Understanding of data modeling, identity and access control, privacy, secure development, and responsible AI principles. * Ability to evaluate AI system quality systematically and diagnose failure modes rather than relying on anecdotal testing. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to both technical and business partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Snowflake AI/ML experience, especially Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Snowpark, Model Registry, Feature Store, or related capabilities. * n8n or comparable workflow/agent orchestration experience such as Workato, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar tools. * MCP, function/tool calling, structured outputs, event\-driven integrations, containers, serverless services, or cloud application delivery. * LLMOps/MLOps practices, evaluation frameworks, observability, model/prompt versioning, Docker, CI/CD, or MLflow. * Enterprise knowledge and productivity integrations involving Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, or governed data catalogs such as Alation. * Experience applying AI in manufacturing, supply chain, finance, operations, or another industrial domain. **Team and Collaboration Context** You will join the Corporate IT – Data, Analytics \& AI team and partner with data engineering, analytics, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business functions. We value curiosity, sound judgment, disciplined experimentation, and people who enjoy turning difficult business problems into simple, reliable experiences. **Why Worthington?** Worthington is applying modern AI inside a real operating business, where better data, smarter automation, and trusted decision support can improve how work gets done every day. This role offers the opportunity to build enterprise AI products that move beyond demos and become part of the way employees ask questions, automate tasks, and make decisions. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision insurance starting on the first day, including employer HSA contribution. * On\-site medical center, pharmacy, barbershop, and fitness center. * 401(k) match plus employer contribution. * Employee Assistance Program. * Flexible work schedule. * Quarterly profit sharing, with no cap. Our Company is proud to have a dynamic and inclusive workforce where employees are empowered to innovate, thrive and grow. We believe that each employee’s unique strengths contribute to the success of our organization. This belief extends to how we consider our job applicants. Your talents may align with this position or other opportunities within our organization. Apply today to start unlocking your career potential with Worthington Enterprises. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in the application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment with Worthington Enterprises and need an accommodation or assistance using the careers website, please contact careers@wthg.com. Worthington Enterprises (NYSE: WOR) is a designer and manufacturer of market\-leading brands that help improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences. The Company operates with two primary business units: Building Products and Consumer Products. The Building Products segment includes cooking, heating, cooling and water solutions, architectural and acoustical grid ceilings and metal framing and accessories. The Consumer Products segment provides solutions for the tools, outdoor living and celebrations categories. Product brands within the Worthington Enterprises portfolio include Balloon Time®, Bernzomatic®, Coleman® (propane cylinders), CoMet®, Elgen, Garden Weasel®, General®, HALO™, Hawkeye™, Level5 Tools®, Mag Torch®, NEXI™, Pactool International®, PowerCore™, Ragasco®, Well\-X\-Trol® and XLite™, among others. Founded in 1955 as Worthington Industries, Worthington Enterprises follows a people\-first Philosophy with earning money for its shareholders as its first corporate goal. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Worthington Enterprises and its joint ventures employ approximately 6,000 people throughout North America and Europe.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for engineering managers who want to lead strong teams, solve meaningful technical problems, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As an engineering manager, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to set direction, turn broader priorities into actionable plans, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work and continue to grow. We are looking for an engineering manager to join the **Knowledge Graph** team, which builds and maintains the systems that turn customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. The team develops the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences. The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real\-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences. This role is based in our New York City office in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration. **What You'll Do** * Lead and develop a team of software engineers, providing regular coaching, actionable feedback, and support for their career growth * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities and longer\-term goals into clear, achievable plans for the team * Own the team's execution and delivery, establishing priorities, breaking larger initiatives into manageable work, and maintaining a sustainable development cadence * Create clarity for the team by resolving ambiguity, removing blockers, managing competing priorities, and protecting engineers from unnecessary organizational churn and distractions * Maintain a strong technical understanding of the team's systems and provide guidance on architecture, design, implementation, and technical tradeoffs * Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement * Ensure the team is prepared to respond effectively to production incidents, providing leadership and coordination during incidents and driving meaningful follow\-up afterward * Build an environment where engineers take ownership, collaborate effectively, learn from one another, and feel comfortable raising concerns and challenging assumptions * Collaborate across Product Engineering and with partners throughout the company to coordinate dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver shared initiatives * Recruit and hire talented engineers, actively participate in the interview process, and build an effective onboarding experience for new team members * Identify opportunities to improve the team's systems, processes, and ways of working, and help turn those opportunities into meaningful change * Model thoughtful use of AI\-assisted development tools and help engineers incorporate AI effectively throughout design, research, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review * Maintain a high\-quality bar for AI\-assisted work by ensuring engineers understand and validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards * Encourage experimentation with new AI capabilities and workflows, share successful approaches across the team, and help identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve engineering effectiveness **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent college\-level education * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * 1\+ years of team or technical leadership * Experience coaching engineers, providing direct and constructive feedback, and supporting their professional development * Experience translating product or business priorities into technical plans and driving a team toward successful delivery * The ability to stay technically engaged enough to guide design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and help engineers work through difficult problems * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous * A track record of building healthy, effective engineering teams while holding a high bar for quality and accountability * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to evaluate their output critically as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools * Strong technical judgment and a foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms * Fluency with Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go) * Experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding software engineers * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment \#LI\-JB1 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

jobs.title: Yourgi Principal Engineering
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family. Yourgi's mission is to be pet parents' most trusted source for pet care services. We are building a differentiated experience for both pet parents and pros through our marketplace and software platform. Pet parents book grooming, boarding, daycare, and training, and independent pet\-care pros run their businesses with Yourgi Pro, Connect, and Match. We also power booking for Destination Pet's own locations. We're rebuilding how we deliver: AI\-first workflows from spec to deploy, automated testing at every layer, real production monitoring, and continuous delivery. As our first Principal Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for cloud services, service design, and data across API, web, and mobile. You'll own the architecture for our software platform, and you'll lead by example by designing, prototyping, reviewing, coding, and delivering simplicity from complexity and ambiguity. **LOCATION** **:** Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship) **REPORTS TO**: VP of Engineering **PAY:** $275,000 base \+20% bonus **CORE RESPONSIBILITES:** * Own the target cloud services architecture on AWS and the roadmap to get there, including simplifying a large estate of Lambda services and reducing dependence on legacy partner systems. * Lead service design: define service boundaries, event and API patterns, and versioned contracts that stay backward compatible with older app versions. * Own database design and optimization: data models, schema standards, query and index performance, and the path from today's MySQL databases to a well\-governed data architecture. * Draft architecture and design documentation and chair reviews for any change that crosses teams or touches payments, booking, or customer data. * Raise the engineering bar for code review, testing strategy (unit through end\-to\-end and performance), observability, and performance budgets such as P75 latency. * Partner with Engineering Services on CI/CD, unattended deploys and rollbacks, and production monitoring. * Shape our spec\-driven, AI\-assisted delivery workflow with product and design, from PRD to stories, code, tests, and deploy. * Mentor senior engineers and tech leads, help hire, and assess build\-vs\-buy decisions with cloud, AI, and third\-party cost in view. **30/60/90 plan** **First 30 Days:** Map the current architecture, data stores, key technical risks, and sources of production issues. Meet with every pod and its leads to understand existing workflows, challenges, and priorities. By the end of the first 30 days, review the current\-state architecture and data map with the VP of Engineering and identify and rank the top 10 technical risks. **By Day 60:** Publish the target architecture and establish the direction for the data model. Collaborate with the Head of Backend Services to align on API contract and schema standards. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - Big Data
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Big Data Engineering team builds the scalable data platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that power analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven experiences across Zillow. Our newest effort is a shared AI context and agent platform. Working at the intersection of software engineering and data, this team creates reliable, high\-quality data products that help teams make informed decisions and deliver great customer experiences. We value collaboration, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement, and we're excited by the opportunity to solve complex data challenges at scale. **About the role** ------------------ The Senior Software Development Engineer, Big Data designs, builds, and optimizes scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that power analytics and AI\-driven capabilities across Zillow. This role applies advanced software engineering and big data expertise to create reliable, high\-quality data products that enable teams to deliver innovative customer experiences and data\-informed decisions. You will get to * Architect and implement scalable, secure, and observable data pipelines and services that collect, process, and store large, diverse data sets to support analytics, machine learning, and product use cases. * Design and optimize data models, storage patterns, and processing frameworks to meet performance, reliability, and cost objectives for high\-volume, real\-time, and batch workloads. * Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, and best\-practice guidance for Big Data solutions, mentoring engineers on topics such as data quality, resiliency, and operational excellence. * Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, and platform engineering teams, and company stakeholders, to translate business and modeling requirements into robust, production\-grade data solutions and APIs. * Implement and maintain automated testing, monitoring, and alerting for data services, proactively improving reliability, data quality, and incident response. * Evaluate and introduce new big data technologies, tools, and patterns to improve developer productivity, platform scalability, and end\-to\-end data lifecycle management. * Document data flows, interfaces, and operational runbooks, and contribute to shared standards and patterns for Big Data engineering across the organization. * Build the company context layer and agentic platform tools, authentication, and APIs that teams across Zillow use at scale. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400\.00 \- $262,600\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200\.00 \- $249,400\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on building and operating data\-intensive or distributed systems. * Experience designing, implementing, and supporting production data pipelines and platforms using modern big data, streaming, and/or cloud\-native technologies. * Experience collaborating with cross\-functional partners (e.g., product, analytics, and data science) to deliver scalable data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI needs. * Hands\-on experience building agentic solutions or skills with major AI tools and internal platform tools used by many teams; Databricks is a plus. * Or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer (QA Services)
jobs.description: Zions Bancorporation’s Enterprise Technology and Operations (ETO) team is redefining what it means to work for a financial institution. For over 150 years, we have delivered exceptional experiences to our clients and communities. Today, we are accelerating innovation and modernizing technology to build the workforce of the future. Join us and help shape this transformation. We are seeking a Software Engineer that has in depth knowledge and experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter or LoadRunner to join our QA Services team. This Software Engineer will improve application performance, scalability, and reliability across online and batch processing platforms. This role focuses on 40% Performance Engineering and 60% Application Performance Tuning / Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). **Responsibilities:** Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and endurance tests using JMeter, or LoadRunner. Analyze application, API, database, and batch processing performance under load. Identify performance bottlenecks across application, infrastructure, and database layers, and provide recommendations for performance improvements and optimization. Monitor system health, reliability, and performance using observability platforms such as Grafana, Splunk, or similar tools. Drive root cause analysis, performance tuning, and resiliency improvements. Integrate performance testing and monitoring into CI/CD pipelines. Partner with development and platform teams to ensure applications meet performance, availability, and scalability goals. **Qualifications:** Strong experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, etc. 4\-5\+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field plus Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline. A combination of education and experience may meet qualifications. Experience analyzing performance of REST APIs, SOAP Services, Event\-driven systems, Microservices, and Batch processing applications Strong proficiency in Java, Python, C\#, or similar programming languages. Strong SQL and database performance tuning experience. Knowledge of Linux, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and monitoring/observability tools. Strong troubleshooting experience (CPU bottlenecks, memory leaks, thread contention, garbage collection issues, database performance problems, network latency issues), performance analysis, and problem\-solving skills. Experience in application performance tuning, reliability engineering, or SRE practices. Knowledge of distributed systems and modern application architecture. **Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads Experience with Google Cloud Experience implementing SLI/SLO/error budget framework Experience supporting high\-volume enterprise banking or financial systems **Visa Sponsorship:** This position is currently not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B visa). This includes, for example, situations where a candidate may have temporary work authorization while enrolled in school or upon graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT) but would need H\-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment in order to maintain employment eligibility. **Location:** This position has a hybrid work from home schedule with a minimum of three days per week in the office at the new Zions Technology Center in Midvale, UT. The Zions Technology Center is a 400,000\-square\-foot technology campus in Midvale, Utah. Located on the former Sharon Steel Mill superfund site, the sustainably built campus is the company’s primary technology and operations center. This modern and environmentally friendly technology center enables Zions to compete for the best technology talent in the state while providing team members with an exceptional work environment with features such as: Electric vehicle charging stations and close proximity to Historic Gardner Village UTA TRAX station. At least 75% of the building is powered by on\-site renewable solar energy. Access to outdoor recreation, parks, trails, shareable bikes and locker rooms. jobs.description: Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and build ground\-up autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. You’ll set technical direction for distributed training, parallelism strategies, mixed\-precision training, and RL on SOTA accelerators, especially for multi\-modal VLA and VLM models. multi\-quarter roadmap for RL framework and RL performance optimization for driving foundation models. * Drive profiling and root\-cause analysis of throughput bottlenecks across the compute, compiler, framework, and cluster\-networking stack. * Partner with ML researchers, data engineers, and hardware engineers to define requirements and make architectural decisions for large\-scale training infrastructure. * Build custom kernels and benchmarks that track and validate performance gains across the stack. * Mentor engineers and raise the team’s technical bar through design reviews and best practices. ### **Qualifications** Note: **You do not have to meet all the requirements** below to be considered for this position: * 7\+ years of total experience, including 4\+ years on large\-scale model training platforms, with a record of leading projects end to end. * Deep experience with distributed training frameworks (Megatron\-LM, TorchTitan) and efficiently utilizing GPU/accelerator clusters at scale. * Experience with RL frameworks (Verl/MILES) and algorithms (GRPO, PPO). * Experience with collective communication libraries (e.g., NCCL) and optimizing communication/compute overlap in multi\-node training. * Strong command of profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, or XLA/JAX profiling) to find and resolve training bottlenecks. * standards, and engineering excellence **Who you are:** * 10\+ years of engineering experience with design, implementation, and operations of critical systems * Demonstrated success working in cross\-functional environments, advocate for tight collaboration between engineering, user experience, and product teams, and are comfortable making engineering and system\-level decisions and tradeoffs * Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including React and Node.js * Experienced with relational, NoSQL, and document/object storage * Proven record of solving deep problems in with concrete examples of how it changed how you build and ship * Sound judgment on where AI helps and where it adds risk, and the discipline to validate generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability * Have coached other engineers, including senior ones, to adopt AI\-assisted workflows * Thrive on autonomy and ownership, and adapt quickly as tools and practices change * Model good engineering behavior, practices, and processes **Our Values:** * Relentlessly Prioritize the Customer * Own Outcomes * Be Straightforward * Act Now \& Iterate * Grit * Decide with Data * Hire and Develop A Players * Be Coachable * Organize and Plan * Expect and Embrace Change **Benefits and Perks:** * Work with a talented but humble team * Competitive compensation and equity * Weekly paid family meal * 401k, medical, dental, and vision insurance * Flexible PTO Policy * 15\.5 company\-paid holidays including Juneteenth, MLK Day and a 1\-week company shut down * To support remote work jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role:** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Qubit team, you will play a pivotal role in building and maintaining highly reliable, scalable, and observable software systems that support 24/7 warehouse automation and client operations. You’ll collaborate with a team of talented engineers to deliver robust tooling, public API development, telemetry, and data analytics that directly impact customer value. The Qubit team is at the heart of AutoStore’s warehouse fulfillment strategy, powering high\-uptime, client\-facing systems used by major global brands. You’ll contribute to a platform that supports real\-time operations, integrates with hardware, and scales across multiple sites. This is a hands\-on engineering role with opportunities to lead initiatives, mentor peers, and shape the future of our software architecture. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex software solutions. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards. * Conduct code reviews and share knowledge with team members. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and performance issues. * Develop and maintain technical documentation. * Mentor junior engineers and foster their growth. * Collaborate with Cloud Infrastructure Engineers and other squads on architecture and deployment strategies. * Evangelize technical concepts and contribute to setting SLOs and SLIs for core features. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. * Strong understanding of software development methodologies and tools. Strong communication and teamwork abilities. * **Key Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in software development * Proficiency with version control systems, especially Git. * Strong experience developing and maintaining public APIs. * Solid understanding of access management, security protocols, and OAuth. * Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications. * Hands\-on experience with messaging frameworks such as RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus, and Event Hubs. * Exposure to hardware integration is a plus. * Experience working with data lake platforms, particularly Azure Databricks. * Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and .NET languages including C\# and F\#; functional programming experience is highly desirable. * Working knowledge of PostgreSQL databases. Deep understanding of concurrency control and multi\-tenant architecture. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

service\-level agreements (SLAs) * Oversee batch job execution, ensuring timely and accurate processing * Troubleshoot and resolve failed batch jobs in collaboration with internal teams * Deliver timely and accurate updates to clients and executive stakeholders during incidents or high\-impact events * Support root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence * automation tools and cross\-functional coordination * Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues under pressure * Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining a high level of service quality * Familiarity with Active Directory and Microsoft Administration * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation for after\-hours support **Preferred:*** Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field * Experience in process automation and system monitoring tools * Familiarity with ServiceNow * Familiarity with cloud\-based IT operations and monitoring solutions (i.e. Elastic, Datadog, Power BI etc.) **Affirmative Action/EEO statement:** defi SOLUTIONS is an Equal Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer (Generalist)** **Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid / Onsite options) **Type:** Full\-time **Level:** Mid to Senior **About the Role** We are looking for a **Software Engineer (Generalist)** as a generalist, you won't be boxed into a single layer of the stack—you'll own features end\-to\-end, tackle high\-impact bottlenecks across the codebase, and help shape technical architecture as we scale. If you love shipping product fast, diving into unfamiliar technologies to solve tough problems, and balancing speed with high\-quality engineering, you’ll fit right in. **Requirements** **What You’ll Do*** **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Design, build, test, and deploy features across the entire stack—from frontend UI/UX to backend services and database schemas. * **Problem Solve Across the Stack:** Jump in wherever the product needs you most, whether that’s building an API, optimizing SQL queries, or setting up a deployment pipeline. * **Product Collaboration:** Work closely with product designers, founders, and engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into production\-ready software. * **Architect for Scale:** Help maintain clean abstractions, write maintainable code, and ensure system reliability as user base grows. **What We’re Looking For*** **Broad Engineering Foundation:** 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience working across both backend and frontend systems. * **Language Agnostic:** Fluency in modern languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, React, Rust, PostgreSQL) and a track record of learning new technologies quickly. * **Product\-Minded \& Pragmatic:** You prioritize delivering value to users over tech stack dogmatism, preferring rapid iteration over over\-engineering. * **Strong Ownership:** A track record of taking complex features from concept to production with minimal supervision. * **SF Bay Area Presence:** Based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area for collaborative in\-office work days. **Nice\-to\-Haves*** Experience in fast\-paced startup environments or early\-stage team dynamics. * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). * Interest or experience building with AI/LLM frameworks and APIs. **Benefits** **Due to the high volume of applications we anticipate, we regret that we are unable to provide individual feedback to all candidates. If you do not hear back from us within 4 weeks of your application, please assume that you have not been successful on this occasion. We genuinely appreciate your interest and wish you the best in your job search.** **Commitment to Equality and Accessibility:** At MLabs, we are committed to offer equal opportunities to all candidates. We ensure no discrimination, accessible job adverts, and providing information in accessible formats. Our goal is to foster a diverse, inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for all. If you need any reasonable adjustments during any part of the hiring process or you would like to see the job\-advert in an accessible format please let us know at the earliest opportunity by emailing human\-resources@mlabs.city. MLabs Ltd collects and processes the personal information you provide such as your contact details, work history, resume, and other relevant data for recruitment purposes only. This information is managed securely in accordance with MLabs Ltd’s Privacy Policy and Information Security Policy, and in compliance with applicable data protection laws. Your data may be shared only with clients and trusted partners where necessary for recruitment purposes. You may request the deletion of your data or withdraw your consent at any time by contacting legal@mlabs.city.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineering
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. **About The Role** Our sales team is growing and we are looking for a strong Solution Engineer (Product Experts) to join the Solutions Engineers group. As a Solution Engineer at monday, you’ll play a critical role in helping our prospects understand the value of our platform. Through your deep product knowledge, expertise in how companies use and deploy SaaS applications, and objection handling in customer interactions, you’ll support our sales team with the sales process. We are looking at experienced individuals that would be able to establish the team’s methodologies and streamline our sales processes. You’ll be a strategic member of our team working closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success. **Please note that this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Denver office.** **We are willing to hire remote for the right talents if located in different locations.** * You will play a critical role in helping our prospects understand the value of monday * Leverage deep product knowledge to lead the technical aspect in large and complex sales processes * Work closely with our salespeople and help streamline monday's sales process * Map out prospects' business processes and assist them to implement them in our platform * Establish pre\-configured solution packages and define best practices * Help to strategize large opportunities **Requirements** * 2\+ years in a Pre Sales Engineering role (or similar) in a SaaS environment * Strong problem\-solving skills * A deep technical curiosity for how IT systems work in a business context * Great communication and customer\-facing skills * Understanding of JSON and RESTful APIs * Understanding of GraphQL \- an advantage * Ability to clearly articulate technical topics to a non\-technical audience * Business process mapping skills * Experience responding to technical questions and security requirements from customers * Exceptional teamwork capabilities **What** **monday.com** **can offer you:** * Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall * Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide * Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success * Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we * A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more Compensation Range: $148K \- $165K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - US East Coast
jobs.description: **The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.** n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: * Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders * Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects * Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production\-ready success stories by embedding on\-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product. To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high\-impact, scalable, and repeatable: **Drive high\-impact enterprise deployments** Embed on\-site with enterprise customers for focused 5\-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place. Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals. Build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions. **Build production\-grade automation solutions** Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case. Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high\-value enterprise use cases. Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity. Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments. **Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering** Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability. Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals. Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library. **Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks** Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product. Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library. Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized. **Keep engagements focused and scalable** Deliver time\-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open\-ended professional services work. Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves. Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity. ### **REQUIREMENTS** Must\-haves Strong engineering background: You have solid full\-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments. Integration\-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event\-driven systems. Product\-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one\-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating. Customer\-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non\-technical stakeholders. Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design. Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold\-plating solutions that should stay simple. Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30\-50% of the time for on\-site engagements. Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing every ou’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments. Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks. Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product\-led technical organization. Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications. Why join us? At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long\-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales. You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest\-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote\-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact. Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of automation. *n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.* ***Our company language is English.*** *You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).* ***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.* **Benefits** ------------ * **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay. * **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. * **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: + **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. + **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. * **Health \& wellness** – + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\* + **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. * **Future planning** – + **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\* + **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. * **Financial security** – + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\* + **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. * **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. * **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! * **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. * **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. * **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. * *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.*
